title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**What this job involves:**

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer on JLL’s Technical Engineering team for corporate functions, you will serve as a trusted technical authority for the PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 environment that underpins finance operations across our global business. You will bring deep expertise in PeopleSoft development, functionality, and backend administration, along with strong automation skills, including server-level scripting and Python, to design, implement, and maintain reliable, scalable, and performant platforms. Working alongside Product Management, Production Support, and Engineering teams, you will independently solve medium to high complexity PeopleSoft infrastructure problems and translate financial close and business continuity needs into clear technical reliability requirements. You will also help shape how our ERP environments evolve on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) using Oracle Database, Oracle GoldenGate, and Oracle-native GenAI services, in support of JLL’s Accelerate 2030 priorities of platform excellence and outpacing through data and AI. You will lead incident response, take ownership of reliability improvements with limited oversight, and act as an informal coach who shares knowledge with less experienced colleagues. This role includes on-call support, primarily covering the Americas, and administrative activities performed over weekends in close collaboration with fellow PeopleSoft and OCI administrators. What sets JLL apart is our culture of collaboration, locally and across the globe, and we believe the most effective teams are built when everyone is empowered to thrive.

**What your day-to-day will look like:**

* Design and implement resilient, scalable solutions for complex PeopleSoft infrastructure, and evaluate the designs of integrations with other applications using reliability engineering methodologies
* Perform PeopleSoft backend administration, including application server and web server management, patching, tools upgrades, and environment refreshes
* Lead incident response through to root cause analysis and long-term remediation, using metrics and multiple sources of insight to resolve medium to high complexity issues
* Participate in an on-call rotation, primarily covering the Americas, and partner with other PeopleSoft and OCI administrators to plan and support weekend administrative activities and maintenance windows
* Protect financial close and month-end processing by building reliability, performance, and recovery safeguards for critical PeopleSoft workloads
* Build server-level scripts and Python automation, and strengthen monitoring, alerting, and observability so that operational effort is reduced and reliability improves
* Contribute to the architecture and optimization of PeopleSoft workloads on OCI, including Oracle Database and Oracle GoldenGate for change data capture (CDC) and replication, and apply Oracle-native GenAI services to monitoring, automation, and operational insight
* Lead medium-sized reliability projects with manageable risks, define and track service level objectives, and recommend best practices to improve operational processes
* Coach less experienced colleagues through troubleshooting and knowledge-sharing sessions, while working with Product, Production Support, application, security, and infrastructure teams to uphold change management, audit and SOX compliance, and disaster recovery standards

**Required qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in PeopleSoft development, functionality, and backend administration, ideally with PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2, including PeopleTools three-tier architecture, application server and web server configuration (WebLogic or Oracle HTTP Server/Tuxedo), Process Scheduler administration, and Integration Broker troubleshooting
* Proven experience independently performing PeopleTools installations, upgrades, patching, and PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) image application, along with PeopleTools security administration and environment refresh, cloning, and data masking
* Demonstrated ability to tune application server domains, JVM and web server parameters, and cache settings, and to diagnose performance issues using SQL, AppServer, and PeopleCode traces and PeopleSoft-specific or third-party monitoring tools
* Strong automation skills in server-level scripting (Unix/Linux shell or PowerShell) and Python, with familiarity applying Oracle-native GenAI services to operational solutions
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database structures as they relate to PeopleSoft, including table and index design, tablespace management, and Application Designer, and exposure to Oracle GoldenGate for replication
* 3+ years of experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute shapes, networking fundamentals (VCN, subnets, NSGs, load balancers), and interpreting OCI Monitoring and Logging output to correlate infrastructure alerts with application symptoms
* Demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis across database, application server, and network tiers, and to solve medium to high complexity problems independently and under pressure
* Ability to work on-call, primarily covering Americas hours, and to support weekend administrative activities as needed
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain difficult operational concepts, build consensus, and collaborate with distributed teams

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Exposure to Oracle Autonomous Database, including its AI features, and to the Oracle AI Data Platform
* Exposure to disaster recovery configurations on OCI, including failover mechanics and their impact on PeopleSoft maintenance windows, and experience with load balancing and failover across application server domains
* Experience collaborating with cloud infrastructure teams on capacity planning, resource scaling, and incident escalation, with familiarity with OCI IAM policies, compartments, and groups
* Practical understanding of how OCI compute, storage, and database choices affect cost, enabling informed participation in capacity planning for peak processing periods
* Experience automating health checks, log rotation, or batch job scheduling beyond basic scripting, and exposure to infrastructure-as-code or configuration management tools (Terraform, Ansible), observability platforms, DevSecOps, or CI/CD practices
* Experience supporting a global ERP instance across multiple regions and time zones, including financial close and month-end support, and operating within audit and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls for finance systems
* Experience applying site reliability engineering practices such as SLOs, error budgets, and blameless postmortems, leading medium-sized projects, and acting as an informal coach or mentor to colleagues
* PeopleSoft or Oracle certifications, including OCI certifications, and experience introducing automation or GenAI capabilities into enterprise finance technology operations, with a curiosity for innovation and a willingness to embrace more innovative ways of working

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks — from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies operating in locations without reliable connectivity.
  
  
Join us as we build the data and science backbone for Leo's entire organization. As a central team, we establish the infrastructure, analytics capabilities, and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)-powered tools that enable every Leo team — from business operations to customer support to capacity planning — to make data-driven decisions and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
As a Data Engineer, you will build and own the pipelines that power Leo's data platform. You will design, implement, and maintain the data infrastructure that ingests from dozens of source systems, enforce quality standards that teams rely on for business decisions, and drive operational efficiencies that allow Leo to scale. Your work directly enables the launch and global growth of a rapidly scaling satellite business.

description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Data Engineer role will be responsible for implementing and managing the business's data infrastructure to support operations and strategic initiatives. This position plays a crucial part in developing and maintaining a robust, scalable data architecture that ensures data integrity, security, and accessibility across the organization. A typical day involves designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines, collaborating with the Data Architect and business stakeholders, ensuring high data quality, and exploring opportunities for AI and automation. Additionally, this role leverages new technologies to continually enhance the overall data ecosystem and support business growth.
  
  
Only applicants living in Southern California will be considered.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from various sources into the data ecosystem.
* Implement processes and tools for data validation, cleaning, and quality assurance to maintain a reliable and accurate data foundation.
* Work closely with the Data Architect to design and implement a scalable and secure data infrastructure, including data lakes and data warehouses.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data requirements and deliver solutions that enable data-driven decision-making.
* Utilize container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes to deploy scalable data services and machine learning environments.
* Implement and enforce data governance and security policies to ensure data privacy and compliance throughout the data lifecycle.
* Work with business users to assess opportunities and support AI automation with LLMs and agents.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in data engineering to continuously improve the data infrastructure.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Ready to Help Shape the Future of Legal Tech?!**
At Litera, we don’t just build software, we transform how the world’s top law firms operate. Every day, we Raise The Bar™️ for what’s possible through AI, innovation, and solutions that power millions of legal professionals worldwide. If you’re energized by scale, real impact, and meaningful challenges, you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
**Where You’ll Work**
This is a hybrid role based in
**Denver, Colorado**
with the expectations to be in office at least 3 days a week for collaboration and connection.
  
  
**Why this Role Matters**
We’re looking for a Tech Lead, Data Engineer to help design, build, and operate a scalable analytics data platform that supports key business domains. This role focuses on developing high‑quality data pipelines, a trusted Snowflake data warehouse, and well‑modeled datasets that power analytics and decision‑making across the organization.
  
  
You’ll work closely with analytics, engineering, and business stakeholders while owning data solutions end‑to‑end — from design through production.
  
  
**What You’ll Deliver**

* Design, build, and maintain production‑grade data pipelines and ELT workflows at scale.
* Develop and own a Snowflake‑based data warehouse using dbt best practices (models, tests, documentation, incremental strategies).
* Partner with analytics and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well‑modeled, reliable datasets.
* Write and optimize complex SQL for large analytical datasets, ensuring performance and accuracy.
* Apply strong software engineering practices to data work, including version control, testing, and CI/CD.
* Integrate data from third‑party SaaS platforms such as CRM, product analytics, and finance systems.
* Produce clear technical documentation, including pipeline designs and data flow diagrams.
* Take end‑to‑end ownership of data solutions, ensuring quality, performance, and long‑term maintainability.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment. If you need accommodations at any point in the process or in the role, we’re here to support you.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
Must-Haves:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production‑grade data platforms, including scalable data pipelines and cloud data warehouses.
* 2+ years of production experience using dbt to build scalable, well‑tested data warehouse solutions.
* Strong SQL expertise, including complex analytical queries, performance optimization, and working with large datasets.
* Hands‑on experience with Snowflake (or similar cloud data warehouses) in a production analytics environment.
* Strong proficiency in Python (or another object‑oriented language) applied to data engineering, including writing maintainable, tested code.
* Solid data engineering and software engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, version control (Git), testing, documentation, and collaboration with cross‑functional stakeholders.

Nice-To-Haves:
  
  

* Advanced Snowflake expertise, including performance tuning, query profiling, and warehouse optimization.
* Experience with dimensional and enterprise data modeling methodologies (e.g., Kimball, Inmon).
* Experience owning analytics solutions for business domains such as Finance, Sales, or Marketing.
* Advanced Python experience and/or multiple production dbt implementations with mature practices (testing, CI/CD, multi‑environment deployments).

We know great candidates don’t always check every box. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**What You’ll Experience**

* A team that shows up. Work alongside people who collaborate, support one another, and lead with integrity.
* Global Reach. Partner with teams around the world to solve complex challenges that matter.
* Real opportunity for growth. Expand your impact through meaningful stretch opportunities, visibility and career development.
* AI-driven innovation. Work at the intersection of legal technology, customer outcomes, and cutting-edge AI.

**Pay Transparency for Colorado Applicants**
The base salary range for this role is $140,000 to $180,000. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, education, and other relevant qualifications. This role is also eligible to participate in a company bonus plan.
  
  
In addition to base salary, Litera offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, and incentive and recognition programs. Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements.
  
  
Litera is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
ImmunityBio is a vertically integrated commercial stage biotechnology company developing next-generation therapies that bolster the natural immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases. The Company’s range of immunotherapy and cell therapy platforms, alone and together, act to drive and sustain an immune response with the goal of creating durable and safe protection against disease. Designated an FDA Breakthrough Therapy, ANKTIVA is the first FDA-approved immunotherapy for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer CIS that activates NK cells, T cells, and memory T cells for a long-duration response. The Company is applying its science and platforms to treating cancers, including the development of potential cancer vaccines, as well as developing immunotherapies and cell therapies that we believe sharply reduce or eliminate the need for standard high-dose chemotherapy. These platforms and their associated product candidates are designed to be more effective, accessible, and easily administered than current standards of care in oncology and infectious diseases.
  
  
Why ImmunityBio?
  
  

* ImmunityBio is developing cutting-edge technology with the goal to transform the lives of patients with cancer and develop next-generation therapies and vaccines that complement, harness and amplify the immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases.
* Opportunity to join a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company with headquarters in Southern California.
* Work with a collaborative team with the ability to work across different areas of the company.
* Ability to join a growing company with professional development opportunities.

Position Summary
  
  
The DevOps Engineer serves as the critical bridge between software development and operations, driving the delivery of reliable, scalable, and secure production services across the enterprise. By integrating continuous delivery practices with robust infrastructure automation, the engineer accelerates feature rollout while maintaining stringent uptime and compliance standards. This position operates within a cross‑functional team, collaborating closely with developers, quality‑assurance engineers, security specialists, and product owners to align technical execution with broader business objectives. This role supports engineering leadership in driving appropriate change control, designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, and providing technical support for daily platform operations including the specification, deployment, and qualification of infrastructure systems.
  
  
**Essential Functions**
Architect and implement fully automated, reproducible environments using IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, maintaining version‑controlled infrastructure definitions.
  
  
Build, tune, and maintain end‑to‑end CI/CD pipelines that integrate source‑control triggers, automated testing, container registries, and release‑gate policies to accelerate reliable code delivery.
  
  
Build, manage, and optimize Kubernetes cluster workloads, including deployment, networking, storage, Helm chart management, and resource governance.
  
  
Harden container images and enforce least-privilege principles; implement and maintain Kubernetes RBAC and network policies in alignment with security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
  
  
Design and operate observability solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Stack), establishing dashboards, alerts, and incident‑management processes to ensure rapid remediation.
  
  
Embed shift‑left security testing, secret‑management, and role‑based access controls, and run automated vulnerability scans to meet standards.
  
  
Set up and maintain observability stacks including logging metrics and distributed tracing.
  
  
Embed security best practices into the development lifecycle and (DevSecOps).
  
  
Collaborate with developers, QA, product owners, and security teams; produce up‑to‑date documentation and lead knowledge‑sharing activities to promote best practices and cross‑team agility
  
  
Document infrastructure, architecture, runbooks and operational procedures.
  
  
Create, edit and adhere to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process improvements, and standardization of templates.
  
  
Performs ad-hoc and cross-functional duties and/or projects as assigned to support business needs and provide developmental opportunities.
  
  
Education & Experience
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience is required.
  
  
3+ years of experience in Devops, site reliability engineering or infrastructure engineering is required.
  
  
Experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD) is required.
  
  
Experience working with a Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology organization is preferred.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**
Strong knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK, etc.).
  
  
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to implement security best practices including image hardening, RBAC, network policies, and vulnerability scanning integration.
  
  
Strong knowledge and proficiency in Linux systems, Git, and container registry management.
  
  
Solid understanding of infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform or Ansible preferred).
  
  
Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages.
  
  
Deep technical knowledge and hands-on proficiency with container orchestration (Kubernetes), including deployment, networking, storage, and Helm.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams.
  
  
Ability to work cross functionally on teams.
  
  
Excellent project management skills and attention to detail.
  
  
Working Environment / Physical Environment
  
  
This position work in El Segundo, CA or remotely depending on the candidate’s geographic location as noted on the offer letter.
  
  
Regular work schedule is Monday – Friday, within standard business hours. Flexibility is available with manager approval.
  
  
Must possess mobility to work in a standard office setting and to use standard office equipment, including a computer.

title: Associate Site Reliability Engineer
description:
* Please note that this is a HYBRID role, requiring this person to work at our Cottonwood Heights office in SLC three days a week. We are not able to provide work sponsorship (i.e. OPT or H-1B visa) for this role \*\*\*

Site Reliability Engineers keep the platforms behind Extra Space Storage's applications available, fast, and secure. SRE owns the AWS environments those applications run in, the pipelines that deploy them, the telemetry that proves they are healthy, and the response when they are not.
  
  
This is the entry level of the SRE track. You will own scoped infrastructure and automation work inside established standards, pipelines, and runbooks, and grow into owning initiatives start to finish. You will spend more time automating operational work than performing it.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Operate and improve AWS infrastructure across a multi-account environment, covering compute, containers, networking, databases, and identity, using infrastructure as code rather than console changes
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including reusable workflows, composite actions, and OIDC-based deployment roles, and help migrate remaining legacy pipelines onto that platform
* Instrument service level indicators and objectives in Datadog, and improve dashboards, alerting, log pipelines, and APM coverage so problems surface before customers report them
* Take a full share of the team's on-call rotation, drive incidents to restoration, and contribute to blameless postmortems and the follow-up work they generate
* Remediate security findings from sources such as Tenable, CrowdStrike, and AWS Security Hub, and own a piece of monthly patching and vulnerability work through production deployment
* Automate recurring operational work such as access provisioning, credential rotation, patch cycles, and environment standup and teardown, with the goal of removing the task rather than speeding it up
* Support product teams as an infrastructure partner on environment builds, deployment troubleshooting, and cost and performance questions
* Write and maintain runbooks, architecture notes, and self-service documentation so other engineering teams can move without waiting on SRE
* Use AI-assisted development and triage tooling as part of normal engineering practice, and help evaluate where it can safely reduce operational toil

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and hands-on experience. Non-traditional paths including bootcamps, military technical training, internal transfers, and self-taught candidates with a demonstrable portfolio are considered.
* 2+ years of software engineering, IT operations, or infrastructure experience preferred. Internship, service desk, or systems administration experience with demonstrated automation work counts toward this.

**Competencies**

* Proficient in at least one language used by the team: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript, or C#/.NET
* Working knowledge of a public cloud, preferably AWS, including core compute, storage, networking, and identity services and how they fit together
* Infrastructure as code experience or strong demonstrated interest (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform), plus comfort with Git-based workflows, pull requests, and code review
* Familiarity with containers and serverless patterns (ECS/Fargate, ECR, Lambda) and with relational databases on a managed service such as RDS
* Exposure to observability tooling (Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent) and an instinct for what makes a system measurable
* Understanding of network and security principles, including least-privilege IAM, secrets handling, and frameworks such as CIS and OWASP
* Clear written communication. Documentation, ticket updates, and incident notes are a substantial part of the job
* Willingness to carry a full share of the 24/7 on-call rotation described below, and to work occasional scheduled maintenance windows outside business hours

**On-Call**
Every Engineer On The Team, At Every Level, Carries An Equal Share Of The On-call Rotation. The Cycle Runs In Three Stages
  
  

* One week as 24/7 primary, taking first response for all pages
* One week as 24/7 secondary, backing up the primary and picking up escalations
* Off rotation until the cycle comes back around to you

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**
Performs sedentary work in an office environment with limited lifting (less than 10 pounds) or walking required. Close visual acuity required to perform work at computer terminal. No exposure to adverse environmental conditions. Requires repetitive typing motion, talking, hearing, grasping and feeling.

* Monitor site stability and performance using GCP-native observability tooling (Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Error Reporting) and troubleshoot issues across the stack

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer
description:
Leggett & Platt is seeking a Senior Azure Cloud Engineer to join our engineering team at the IDEA Center in Lenexa, Kansas. This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a close-knit team in a global organization. In this position, you will own the design, deployment, and ongoing operation of cloud infrastructure within Microsoft Azure, enabling reliable and scalable product delivery across our development teams.
  
  
You will bring deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, and deployment strategies that minimize risk and maximize uptime. We are looking for a highly collaborative engineer who builds strong working relationships across IT teams and business units, communicates technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, takes ownership of outcomes, and continuously raises the bar on engineering excellence.
  
  
What will you be doing as Senior Azure Cloud Engineer?
  
  

* Design, implement, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure using Bicep as the primary Infrastructure as Code (IaC) language, ensuring environments are repeatable, version-controlled, and auditable.
* Architect and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, enabling automated build, test, and deployment workflows across development, staging, and production environments.
* Lead implementation of Blue/Green and canary deployment strategies to enable zero-downtime releases and rapid rollback capabilities.
* Own deployment management practices across multiple environments, including environment promotion workflows, release gates, and deployment approvals.
* Manage Azure networking components including Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall, and Application Gateway.
* Configure and maintain Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Azure Container Apps for containerized workload deployments.
* Implement and manage observability solutions using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights to ensure system health and rapid incident response.
* Enforce cloud governance through Azure Policy, RBAC, Managed Identities, and security baselines aligned with organizational compliance requirements.
* Drive FinOps practices including cost monitoring, resource tagging standards, and optimization recommendations across Azure subscriptions.
* Serve as a key liaison between the IDEA Center engineering team and IT teams across multiple business units, aligning on infrastructure standards, shared services, and deployment practices to enable consistent, reliable delivery organization-wide.
* Implement disaster recovery and high availability architectures to meet defined RTO/RPO targets.
* Evaluate and integrate AI-assisted operations tooling and Azure AI services to improve platform reliability and developer productivity.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* 7+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience, with 3+ years focused on Microsoft Azure.
* Expert-level proficiency in Bicep for Infrastructure as Code; ability to author, test, and maintain modular Bicep templates across complex environments.
* Proven experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps Pipelines, including multi-stage pipelines, environment approvals, and artifact management.
* Demonstrated experience implementing Blue/Green, canary, or feature-flag-based deployment patterns in production environments.
* Strong command of Azure networking: VNets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, DNS, Load Balancers, and Application Gateway.
* Solid understanding of Azure security fundamentals: Azure Active Directory / Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and Defender for Cloud.
* Proficiency in PowerShell and/or Azure CLI for scripting, automation, and operational tasks.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, AKS, or Azure Container Apps).
* Strong understanding of Agile/DevOps methodologies and the software development lifecycle.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose infrastructure, networking, and deployment issues under pressure.
* Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to build relationships and work effectively across IT teams spanning multiple business units; able to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority.

**Things We Consider a Plus**

* Experience with Azure AI services or integrating AI/ML workloads into cloud infrastructure (Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services).
* Familiarity with agentic AI concepts and tooling, including orchestrating AI agents, integrating large language model (LLM)-based workflows into cloud pipelines, and leveraging frameworks such as Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel, or LangChain to automate operational and development tasks.
* Familiarity with Terraform as an alternative IaC tool alongside Bicep.
* Experience with GitOps workflows and tools such as Flux or ArgoCD for Kubernetes-based deployments.
* Knowledge of Azure API Management for managing and securing APIs at scale.
* Experience with infrastructure drift detection and compliance tooling (Azure Policy, Checkov, tfsec).
* Exposure to FinOps frameworks and Azure Cost Management tooling.
* Relevant Azure certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert), or AZ-305 (Solutions Architect Expert).

**What To Do Next**
Now that you’ve had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available.
  
  
**Our Values**
Our values speak to our shared beliefs and describe how we approach working together.
  
  

* Put People First reflects our commitment to safety and care of each other, learning and development, and creating an inclusive environment of mutual respect, empathy and belonging.
* Do the Right Thing focuses us on acting with honesty and integrity, delivering the results the right way, taking pride in our work, and speaking the truth – good or bad.
* Do Great Work…Together occurs when we engage without hierarchy, collaborate as a team, embrace challenges, and work for the good of all of us.
* Take Ownership and Raise the Bar demonstrates our responsibility to add value and make a difference, challenge the status quo and biases to make things better, foster innovative and creative solutions to drive impact, and explore new perspectives and embrace change.

**Our Commitment to You**
We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all. Leggett & Platt is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veteran status, and more. Join us!

title: IT Data Analytics Specialist - Data Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Product's Engineer with deep expertise in Snowflake and strong hands-on experience with Matillion on AWS. The ideal candidate will design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that feed our Data Marketplace and enable the creation, publication, and consumption of certified Data Products across the enterprise.
  
  
This role is central to our Data Marketplace strategy — ensuring data flows reliably from source systems through our silver, and gold layers, and is curated, governed, and made discoverable as reusable Data Products. The ideal candidate thrives in complex, enterprise-level environments, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and is passionate about delivering high-quality, governed, and AI-enabled data assets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Products Engineering & ETL Development
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Matillion on AWS to ingest, transform, and curate data across incoming (raw/staging), silver (cleansed & conformed), and gold (business-ready/aggregated) layers in Snowflake.
* Develop and publish certified Data Products — governed, documented, and reusable datasets made available through the Data Marketplace for self-service consumption by analysts, data scientists, and business users.
* Develop and optimize Snowflake objects including warehouses, schemas, tables, views, streams, tasks, and stored procedures to support Data Product pipelines.
* Optimize Snowflake performance through clustering, caching, micro-partitioning, and resource monitoring to ensure Data Products are delivered with reliability and speed.

Data Marketplace & Data Governance
  
  

* Support the design and population of the Data Marketplace, ensuring Data Products are cataloged, discoverable, and compliant with enterprise data governance standards.
* Define and enforce data contracts, SLAs, and quality standards for each Data Product published to the Marketplace.
* Define and automate data validation, profiling, and quality checks embedded within ETL pipelines to guarantee Data Product integrity.
* Collaborate with data governance teams to implement naming standards, lineage tracking, metadata management, and access policies for Data Products.
* Ensure data lineage is traceable end-to-end from source systems through bronze/silver/gold layers to the final Data Product.

Collaboration & Delivery
  
  

* Work closely with data analysts, data scientists, AI/ML teams, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into well-defined Data Products.
* Partner with the Data Marketplace product owner to define the Data Product lifecycle (creation, certification, publication, deprecation).
* Lead code reviews, provide mentorship, and support best practices across the engineering team.
* Contribute to architectural decisions and participate in strategic data roadmap planning.

Automation & DevOps
  
  

* Build CI/CD pipelines for Matillion job deployments and Snowflake object management.
* Develop reusable ETL frameworks, templates, and patterns to accelerate the creation of new Data Products.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, and operational excellence practices for data pipelines and Data Product health.
* Automate Data Product certification workflows, including quality gates and approval processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role.
* Strong expertise with Snowflake (SQL, performance tuning, data modeling, warehouse configuration, streams, tasks).
* Hands-on experience with Matillion on AWS (or comparable ETL/ELT tools such as Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory).
* Solid understanding of Data Product and Data Marketplace concepts (data contracts, data-as-a-product, self-service data consumption).
* Advanced SQL skills; ability to write complex queries and optimize them.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, dimensional models, star schemas, and data warehouse/data lake concepts (bronze/silver/gold architecture).
* Experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS.
* Experience with Oracle Business Applications (ERP/EBS) as source systems is a plus.
* Proficiency in Python, Airflow, or other orchestration tools.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and general DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of data governance principles, metadata management, and data cataloging tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building or contributing to an enterprise Data Marketplace or Data Catalog.
* Familiarity with data mesh or data product thinking methodologies.
* Experience with near real-time data ingestion tools (e.g., OpenFlow, Kafka, CDC).
* Exposure to AI/ML data preparation and delivering AI-enabled datasets.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, AI & DX Analytics
description:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.
  
  
Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.
  
  
**The Role**
The AI & DX (Developer Experience) Analytics team exists to measure and improve Block's developer experience and investment in AI. We turn raw engineering signals (agent session data, pull request and CI activity, and AI spend) into reporting and analysis that shape leadership's AI investment decisions, and drive improvement in AI ROI and developer experience. Your work will be the trusted source of truth that engineers and executives use to decide where AI investment is working and where to redirect it.
  
  
We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to own parts of that pipeline end to end. This is a broad, high-visibility role with a lot of white space: you will instrument new telemetry at the source and build production pipelines that turn it into governed data, then turn that governed data into executive-facing reporting and the analysis that surfaces concrete opportunities to improve AI ROI and developer experience. You'll also help pioneer one of the most consequential open problems in the industry right now: measuring the productivity impact of an increasingly AI- and agent-augmented engineering workforce, where there is no textbook answer and real room to set the standard. You'll define new metrics and craft the visual narrative — the charts, dashboards, and presentation materials — that make them land with an executive audience. AI-first workflows are central to how this team operates and critical to succeeding in this role: using AI coding agents is a default part of how you build and maintain pipelines and dashboards. You'll excel in this role if you're as comfortable defining and visualizing a brand new executive-facing metric from a messy signal as you are debugging why a pipeline silently stalled overnight.
  
  
**You Will**
**Instrumentation & Telemetry**

* Instrument and extend the raw telemetry captured about AI usage, code changes, CI/CD activity, and spend — building new data capture, not only transforming what already exists. This is core to the role, as evolving AI tools and increased AI adoption constantly creates new signals that need to be captured.
* Partner with data engineers on production ETL pipelines that land that telemetry into governed tables, with the freshness monitoring, backfills, and alerting that keep it trustworthy, rather than a one-off script.
* Define new metrics out of ambiguous or evolving signals, and earn stakeholder trust in a new number by validating and reconciling it until it holds up.

**Dashboards & Analysis**

* Build and ship the executive-facing dashboards and visualizations that turn governed metrics into decision-ready reporting — with the polish and precision a room of executives will scrutinize.
* Run the analysis that a new chart or metric needs and anticipate questions that an executive audience will ask, then bring senior stakeholders a recommendation, not just a number, and defend the methodology behind both.
* Translate complex, technical findings into a clear narrative: the headline chart and the one sentence that makes an executive act on it.

**Across Both**

* Use AI coding agents as a default part of how you write, test, and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and analyses.
* Partner across data engineering, applied AI, and data science teams to keep telemetry connected end to end — the raw signal you capture directly feeds the session classifiers, not just the dashboards you build.
* Turn what the data shows into action: flag where AI spend isn't paying off or where developer friction is most costly, and push the tooling, process, or investment changes that address it.
* Push the industry-frontier work of quantifying AI and agent productivity impact — there's no established playbook, and this team sets one.

**Qualifications**
**You are:**

* Self-sufficient across the full analytics loop: instrumentation, pipeline building, metric definition, and dashboards — not someone who hands off past the query.
* At home in messy, evolving telemetry, with the judgment to know when a new number is right and when it needs a second look before an executive sees it.
* A strong product thinker: you get at what a stakeholder actually needs from a metric or chart, not just what they asked for.
* Comfortable with ambiguity on a genuinely unsolved problem — measuring AI/agent productivity impact — and motivated to go set the standard rather than wait for one.
* An exceptional communicator, able to defend a metric's methodology and a chart's framing directly to senior stakeholders.
* Thoughtful about using AI coding agents in your own craft: fast to build with them, and rigorous about evaluating what they produce rather than taking it on faith.

**You Have**

* 8+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or business intelligence, owning production data pipelines and insights end to end.
* Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines against a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
* Experience partnering with engineering teams to instrument new event or telemetry data, not only transforming what's already captured.
* Experience building dashboards or internal tools that non-technical stakeholders rely on to make decisions.
* Comfort with git, CI/CD systems, and debugging production pipeline failures such as retries and backfills.

**Even Better**

* Experience with a metrics-governance or semantic-layer system, such as a metrics store, dbt semantic layer, or LookML.

**Technologies We Use And Teach**

* SQL (Snowflake), Python, TypeScript and React, Git, CI/CD pipelines, a governed metrics store, AI coding agents, and LLM-based classification tooling.

title: Data Platform Engineer/Business Analyst
description:
**Description:**
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
****Description****
*NOTICE: JOB APPLICANTS LIMITED TO DC, MD, OR VA RESIDENTS. POSITION IS HYBRID.*
This position requires candidates to be local to the Washington, DC metropolitan area. Applicants must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of our headquarters and be able to meet the position's onsite work requirements.
  
  
*Be part of Lafayette Federal Credit Union, recognized by USA Today as a Top Workplace for three consecutive years (2024–2026)*
We are expanding and looking for exceptional talent to support our members and contribute to our reputation as an employer of choice. Be a key player in our mission to become the premier financial partner for our community. Your skills and dedication are essential to our success.
  
  
Build the Future Workforce of Lafayette Federal Credit Union
  
  
Exceptional organizations are built by exceptional people.
  
  
At Lafayette Federal Credit Union, we believe our future success depends on our ability to attract, develop, engage, and retain outstanding talent. As we continue to grow, invest in our people, and strengthen our organizational capabilities, we are creating a new leadership opportunity to help shape the future of our workforce. We believe the future of work will be driven by people who embrace curiosity, continuous learning, and responsible innovation, supported by technologies – including artificial intelligence – that enable our employees to work more effectively, make better decisions, and deliver exceptional experiences for our members. We're looking for leaders who see AI not as a replacement for people, but as a tool that empowers people to do their best work.
  
  
**Why Lafayette Federal**
**Our Difference**
: Lafayette Federal Credit Union is not only a great place to bank, but also a great place to build a career. We have received national recognition, including placement on Newsweek’s America’s Best Banks list, a five-star rating from Bauer Financial, and recognition by S&P Global among top-performing credit unions.
  
  
**Our Culture**
: Lafayette Federal values inclusion, diversity, high performance, teamwork, and community. Every employee brings a unique set of skills, and we share a commitment to serving our members and giving back through charitable activities throughout the year. It is a collaborative, mission-driven environment where strong ideas and thoughtful leadership can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**Our Opportunities**
: Professional development, training, and certification are priorities for our employees. We support career growth and provide opportunities for advancement within the financial services industry, helping talented people continue to grow while doing meaningful work for our members and communities.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Help turn dependable data into actionable insights.
  
  
This role will help Lafayette Federal maintain a reliable data platform while evolving the capabilities that support reporting and analytics across business units.
  
  
**You Will Help Us Answer Important Questions:**

* How do we keep data pipelines and reporting systems available and reliable?
* How do we bring core banking data, APIs, and flat files into OneLake?
* How do we maintain consistent data models across loans, deposits, and general ledger domains?
* How do we enable dashboards and ad hoc analysis that support business users?
* How do we identify data anomalies and improve the platform’s future-state architecture?

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to the technical foundation and analytics capabilities that support teams across the organization.
  
  
****What You Will Lead****
Platform Ownership & Maintenance
  
  
You will maintain and strengthen Lafayette Federal’s data platform by:
  
  

* Ensuring high availability and reliability of data pipelines and reporting systems built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
* Implementing monitoring for pipeline failures, performance issues, and data anomalies.
* Contributing to the data platform roadmap and future-state architecture.

Data Engineering & Integration
  
  
You will support the flow and structure of data across the organization by:
  
  

* Ingesting data from core banking systems, APIs, and flat files into OneLake.
* Maintaining and evolving data models across business units, including loans, deposits, and general ledger domains.
* Supporting reliable data pipelines that enable scalable analytics.

Analytics Enablement
  
  
You will help business users turn data into insights by:
  
  

* Partnering with business users to support dashboards and ad hoc analysis.
* Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using Tableau or similar business intelligence tools.
* Supporting the reporting and analytics needs of leadership and business stakeholders.

Organizational Partnership
  
  
Success in this role requires strong collaboration across the organization.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of data engineering, platform operations, and business analytics, translating business needs into practical data solutions and fostering effective relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**You Will Work Alongside:**

* The SVP of Finance & Accounting to support department priorities and carry out related duties as assigned.
* Business users and leaders across the Credit Union to maintain data models and support dashboards, reporting, and ad hoc analysis.
* Technical stakeholders to support reliable platform operations, data integration, and continuous improvement.

As directed by management and/or the SVP of Risk Management, you will complete all annual mandated training applicable to your position accurately and on time, including Bank Secrecy Act, Anti-Money Laundering, OFAC, Cybersecurity, Diversity & Anti-Harassment, and Fair Lending requirements.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Reliable platforms keep data moving.
  
  
Well-maintained data models and accessible analytics help teams put that data to work.
  
  
This role brings those capabilities together.
  
  
If you are looking for the opportunity to strengthen a modern data platform, partner across business units, and support meaningful insights, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Pay**
$91,325.0400 $114,156.3000 - Annually depending on experience and qualifications
  
  
**Requirements:**
**Who You Are**

* You are both technically focused and business-minded.
* You understand that a data platform is more than a collection of pipelines—it is a foundation for reliable reporting and scalable analytics.
* You are comfortable collaborating with technical stakeholders and helping business users translate their needs into data solutions.
* You build sound relationships, communicate effectively, and can influence, motivate, and train others while handling sensitive information with care.
* Most importantly, you value dependable data and the practical insights it enables.

****What You'll Bring****

* Five to eight years of similar or related experience.
* A bachelor’s degree, or formal industry-recognized certifications considered equivalent to a bachelor’s degree, such as qualifying information technology certifications.
* The ability to maintain and evolve a data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
* The ability to support data engineering and ETL workflows that ingest core banking data, APIs, and flat files into OneLake.
* The ability to maintain and evolve data models across business units, including loans, deposits, and general ledger domains.
* The ability to develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau or similar business intelligence tools.
* The ability to monitor pipeline reliability, performance, and data quality and contribute to continuous improvement.
* Strong relationship-building, communication, influencing, and training skills to support technical and business stakeholders.

****What We Offer****

* Competitive compensation

**Position Summary**

PointClickCare's Marketing organization is hiring a Marketing Data Analytics Engineer to build and maintain the data infrastructure behind marketing analytics and pipeline reporting. This hands-on, backend-focused role works across Salesforce, Marketo, and the data warehouse, increasingly leveraging AI-assisted analytics tools such as Claude, to streamline how campaign performance data is captured, connected, and reported. The role partners closely with Marketing Analytics, Demand Generation, and Marketing Operations to turn recurring reporting needs into automated, trustworthy data flows that directly support executive-level reporting on marketing-sourced pipeline across the Senior Care and Acute & Payer businesses.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Pipelines & Integrations: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines connecting Salesforce, Marketo, and the data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery) to support marketing performance reporting.

* Campaign Attribution & Data Quality: Strengthen campaign attribution logic (campaign codes, UTM/campaign member data, lead-to-opportunity linkage) and monitor, troubleshoot, and improve data quality across Marketo, Salesforce, and downstream reporting tables.
* AI-Enabled Analytics Workflows: Apply AI tools such as Claude to accelerate data exploration, documentation, and query development, while maintaining rigor and accuracy in production reporting.
* Systems Support & Documentation: Support backend administration and configuration in Salesforce and Marketo (fields, objects, sync rules, campaign structures), and document data models, definitions, and processes so metrics stay consistent and self-serve for marketing stakeholders.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (completed or in final year) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field. New graduates are encouraged to apply.
* 0 – 2 years of applicable experience.
* Strong SQL skills: comfortable writing joins, aggregations, and window functions against large relational datasets.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language used in data work (e.g., Python) for scripting, automation, or ETL.
* Understanding of relational data models and how CRM/marketing-automation data is structured (leads, contacts, accounts, campaigns, opportunities).
* Highly analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong bias toward automating repetitive work.
* Intellectually curious and open-minded, with a genuine thirst to learn new tools, systems, and business context.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Hands-on exposure to Salesforce (SOQL, reports, campaign objects, admin concepts) or Marketo (programs, smart campaigns, field sync).
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) and BI tools (Power BI, Looker, Tableau).
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development or analytics tools, such as Claude or similar large language model platforms.
* Exposure to ETL/ELT tooling, APIs, or workflow orchestration (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or equivalent scripting).
* Familiarity with marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, opportunities, pipeline) or B2B demand generation.
* Co-op, internship, or project experience in a data engineering, analytics engineering, or revenue operations context.

**PointClickCare Benefits & Perks**

Benefits starting from Day 1!

Retirement Plan Matching

Flexible Paid Time Off

Wellness Support Programs and Resources

Parental & Caregiver Leaves

Fertility & Adoption Support

Continuous Development Support Program

Employee Assistance Program

Allyship and Inclusion Communities

Employee Recognition … and more!

At PointClickCare, base salary is one of the many components that make up our total rewards package. The US base salary range for this position is $87,000 - $97,000 + bonus + benefits, non-overtime eligible. Our salary ranges are determined by job and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by job-related skills and knowledge, relevant experience including professional and lived experience, and/or work location. title: Senior DevOps Engineer, Applications
description:

You'll own the infrastructure and reliability story end-to-end: provisioning cloud resources, maintaining Kubernetes deployments, improving CI/CD pipelines, and building the observability that lets engineers move fast with confidence. * Manage PostgreSQL infrastructure: backups, replication, failover, and query performance

**What We're Looking For**

* Favor simple, maintainable architectures
* Work closely across engineering, product, and design

title: Senior DevOps & Release Engineer
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
What You Can Expect
  
  
As a Senior DevOps & Release Engineer, you will join a multidisciplinary engineering organization responsible for delivering regulated Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) solutions. You will work closely with Software Engineering, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Security, IT, Product, and Research teams to ensure the delivery of secure, reliable, compliant, and audit-ready software platforms used in clinical and field environments.
  
  
The primary operational environment for this role consists of Linux-based physical devices, workstations, and on-premise systems used for software development, validation, testing, and clinical deployment. You will be responsible for ensuring these systems are reproducible, maintainable, secure, and operationally reliable throughout the software lifecycle.
  
  
This role serves as the technical authority for Linux operational infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, build and release engineering, software deployment, and system automation within a regulated medical device environment. While AWS and Azure are used for selected supporting services and workloads, cloud infrastructure is not the primary focus of the role.
  
  
How You'll Create Impact
  
  
In this role, you will design, implement, and maintain secure and reproducible DevOps infrastructure supporting Linux-based medical software and hardware. You will own the end-to-end software build, packaging, release, deployment, and operational lifecycle while ensuring compliance with FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and ISO 14971 expectations.
  
  
You will contribute to operational excellence by implementing scalable automation, secure deployment mechanisms, validated CI/CD systems, and traceable release processes suitable for regulated environments and audit readiness.
  
  
DevOps Architecture & Operational Infrastructure
  
  

* Administer Debian Linux systems
* Support Linux-based deployment and security on bare-metal devices (not cloud)
* Design, maintain, and evolve DevOps and release engineering platforms
* Ensure reliability, reproducibility, and operational consistency across development, validation, testing, and production systems
* Align operational practices with risk management and post-market surveillance activities

Build, Packaging & Release Engineering
  
  

* Own software build, packaging, release, rollback, and patch management processes
* Support controlled software release strategies consistent with regulated medical environments

CI/CD & Automation
  
  

* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting regulated software development workflows
* Administer and optimize tooling including GitHub, Jenkins, TeamCity, or equivalent systems
* Automate build generation, testing, static analysis, packaging, and artifact management
* Ensure CI/CD outputs are auditable and suitable as objective evidence during inspections and audits

Validation, Security & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure infrastructure and DevOps practices comply with the field norms such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and FDA cybersecurity guidance
* Implement defense-in-depth security controls across build systems, deployment pipelines, and operational environments
* Enforce least-privilege access, authentication controls, secure secrets management, and audit logging
* Support internal audits, FDA inspections, and ISO certification activities through proper documentation and evidence generation

ML/AI Operational Support
  
  

* Support lifecycle management of ML/AI inference components within regulated environments
* Ensure model versioning, traceability, controlled promotion, and alignment with released software versions
* Maintain reproducible ML build environments and containerized workflows where appropriate

Monitoring, Incident Response & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Implement monitoring, logging, and operational observability for on-premise clinical systems and development environments
* Support incident response, root cause investigations, CAPAs, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Maintain operational records and deployment logs supporting audit and compliance requirements

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Act as the primary technical authority for DevOps and release engineering practices
* Mentor junior DevOps and platform engineers
* Translate regulatory and quality requirements into practical, scalable technical implementations
* Maintain clear operational documentation, deployment procedures, rollback guides, and technical runbooks

What Makes You Stand Out
  
  

* Experience in C++, QT-based applications
* Experience working in regulated industries such as medical devices, healthcare, or life sciences
* Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971 standards
* Experience supporting validation activities, audits, inspections, and compliance evidence generation
* Prior experience supporting Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) products
* Experience with ML/AI deployment workflows in regulated environments
* Experience designing DevOps systems intended for regulatory evidence and audit readiness

Your Background
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Release Engineering, or System Engineering
* Deep Linux administration, preferably Debian/Ubuntu environments
* Bare-metal/ /on-premise systems experience
* Programming: Python, Bash, C++
* Strong understanding of system security, networking, deployment architectures, and operational best practices
* Experience with GitHub administration, CI/CD tooling, Jira, and source control governance
* Hands-on experience with Jenkins, TeamCity, or similar CI platforms
* Experience supporting GPU-enabled systems and native application build environments
* Experience with AWS and Azure cloud ecosystems

Travel Expectations
  
  
The position is based onsite in Salt Lake City, USA. You might be required to travel within the USA and France per business needs.

As a Data Engineer on this team, you will build and scale the data infrastructure behind this source-of-truth dataset, enabling finance and operations teams to assess network execution and understand cost drivers. This role sits at the center of network topology analytics, where the ability to understand Amazon's complex supply chain network and drive data model, mapping, and dimensional standardization is critical. title: Senior Data and Analytics Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**About AbbVie**
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Senior Data and Analytics Engineer**
will be responsible for translating complex business and data requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing analytics and data engineering solutions for the Operations (Supply Chain) organization. The role will partner closely with internal DATA (Data, AI, Transformation and Automation) teams, and cross functional Business Technology Solutions (BTS), business stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to understand strategic priorities and design, build, and deliver modern data solutions that enables analytics, business intelligence, and AI use cases.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of hands-on technical expertise and strategic thinking, understanding the North Star platform architecture to implement practical engineering solutions while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, development standards, data governance, security, and engineering best practices.
  
  
The individual will also provide technical leadership throughout the solution lifecycle, proactively manage technical risks and dependencies, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Hands-on engineering and solution delivery: Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production-grade data pipelines and data products for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data. Build for both batch and near-real-time/streaming patterns, with reusable components, parameterized frameworks, and automated recovery.
* Lakehouse and modern data warehouse architecture: Implement solutions using Amazon S3, Apache Iceberg/open table formats, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Amazon EMR/Spark, Amazon Redshift and Redshift Spectrum. Apply medallion patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold), dimensional and domain-oriented modeling, workload isolation, partitioning, clustering/sort strategies, and performance optimization.
* Data product and data mesh enablement: Translate business domains into discoverable, interoperable, and governed data products. Define product contracts, ownership, metadata, quality expectations, service-level objectives, lineage, and approved consumption patterns for dashboards, self-service analytics, APIs, data science, and AI.
* Ingestion and orchestration: Engineer reliable ingestion from enterprise applications, databases, files, APIs, and event streams. Develop orchestration using tools such as Apache Airflow, dbt, AWS Step Functions or equivalent approved platforms, with dependency management, idempotency, observability, alerting, and backfill capability.
* Data quality, governance, and security: Embed automated data-quality controls, reconciliation, schema validation, lineage, cataloging, retention, encryption, least-privilege access, and auditability. Partner with data governance, security, privacy, architecture, and platform teams to meet AbbVie standards and regulated-industry expectations.
* DevSecOps and engineering excellence: Establish source-control, code-review, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, environment promotion, release management, and operational monitoring practices. Improve reliability, cost, performance, and developer productivity through measurable engineering standards.
* Business partnership and technical leadership: Understands organization's vision, goals, and strategies and partner with DATA, BTS, Operations stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable designs. Provide technical direction, resolve design and delivery issues, communicate risks and trade-offs, and contribute to portfolio prioritization and roadmap decisions.
* Operational ownership: Own solutions through the full lifecycle, including production readiness, deployment, support transition, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, technical debt reduction, and continuous improvement. Work with minimal oversight while escalating material risks early.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field plus 7 years of relevant experience; Master's Degree plus 6 years of experience; PhD plus 2 years of experience.
* Respective years of hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise modern data warehouse, Lakehouse, data engineering, and analytical solutions.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with strong hands-on experience in PySpark or Scala and distributed data processing on Apache Spark/EMR or a comparable platform.
* Demonstrated experience building large Lakehouse and modern warehouse solutions using Amazon S3, Apache Iceberg or comparable open table formats, AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, Amazon Redshift, and Redshift Spectrum.
* Proven experience with medallion architecture, data modeling, schema design, incremental processing, change data capture, partitioning, performance tuning, and cost optimization.
* Experience developing production-grade batch and streaming data pipelines, including orchestration, retries, backfills, observability, alerting, and operational support.
* Hands-on experience with data transformation and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions or approved equivalents.
* Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, Git-based development, infrastructure-as-code, and Agile DevOps delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to build governed, AI-ready data products that support BI, self-service analytics, data science, machine learning, and contextual AI consumption.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams in a matrixed organization.
* Experience with data catalogs, lineage, and governance platforms such as Alation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, or approved equivalents.

**Preferred:**

* Supply Chain or Operations domain knowledge across planning, sourcing, inventory, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution.
* Experience with streaming technologies such as Amazon Kinesis, Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, or equivalent platforms.
* Working experience with AWS Lake Formation, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and enterprise controls for secure data platforms.
* Experience exposing data through APIs, semantic models, governed data services, or feature/context layers for AI-enabled applications.
* Relevant cloud or data engineering certifications are beneficial but not required.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise modern data warehouse, Lakehouse, data engineering, and analytical solutions.

title: DevOps Engineer I
description:

The role assists with the implementation, administration, and support of DevOps and DevSecOps platforms used throughout the software development lifecycle.

The position emphasizes technical growth, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and collaboration across application development and IT teams.

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Libra Solutions helps simplify and ease the burden of legal processes for plaintiffs, heirs, and the attorneys and doctors who serve them. By combining financial strength with technology-driven innovation, we simplify difficult legal processes, reduce delays, and help people access both money and the care they need, when they need it most. Our companies are leaders in their industries! MoveDocs streamlines the coordination of medical, financial, and professional services for personal injury cases—improving efficiency for attorneys, care providers, and their clients. Oasis Financial is the largest and most recognized plaintiff funding brand in the nation, having helped 400,000+ plaintiffs access more than $2 billion in funding while their personal injury cases progress. And through Probate Advance, we enable heirs to access their inheritance without waiting through the lengthy probate process.
  
  
Together, under the Libra Solutions banner, we support a nationwide network of more than 45,000 attorneys and 10,000 healthcare providers - creating a powerful platform to deliver faster, more seamless outcomes for our customers.
  
  
Libra Solutions is seeking an Azure DevOps Engineer to build, automate, and operate the delivery pipelines and cloud platform behind our products. You will own our Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines end to end, from build and test through security scanning, approval gates, and multi-environment promotion, and you will manage our infrastructure as code so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and deployed the same way every time. You will also operate the application and integration tier those pipelines deliver to, including App Service, API Management, Data Factory, and Application Insights, and design the multi-region resilience that keeps it running. Familiarity with SQL Server and Azure SQL is a plus, particularly for automating database deployments and environment refreshes.
  
  
We operate in a regulated environment that handles sensitive medical and financial data, and we maintain a SOC 2 Type 2 program. The right candidate understands that a pipeline, a failover plan, or an environment deployment is also a control that must work every day and produce evidence that it did. You will work closely with software engineering, data, IT operations, and security, and with our AI-native engineering pods as they adopt agentic development and delivery tooling.
  
  
This position reports to the Director, TechOps and Security and can be based in any of our office locations in Denver, CO, Charlotte, NC, Rosemont, IL, or Las Vegas, NV. We welcome strong remote candidates, with occasional travel as needed.
  
  
**Requirements**
Desired Skills and Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 4+ years of hands-on DevOps, platform, or cloud engineering experience operating production workloads in Microsoft Azure
* 3+ years building and operating Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML), including multi-stage deployments, pipeline templates, environment approvals, and secure service connections
* Hands-on infrastructure-as-code experience with Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform, deployed through CI/CD
* Experience integrating security and quality tooling into CI/CD (code, dependency, and secrets scanning) and implementing release strategies such as deployment slots, blue/green deployments, and rollback
* Strong Git skills, including branching strategies, pull request workflows, and branch policies
* Hands-on experience operating Azure App Service and Azure API Management in production
* Working knowledge of Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and KQL for building alerts, dashboards, and diagnostic queries
* Experience developing and supporting Azure Data Factory pipelines
* Experience designing and testing multi-region architecture, geo-replication, and disaster recovery in Azure
* Proficiency in scripting and automation with PowerShell and/or Python, and comfort with the Azure CLI
* Understanding of security fundamentals for cloud infrastructure, including RBAC in Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, encryption, and secure-by-default configuration
* Experience working within a compliance framework such as SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001, and an understanding of how infrastructure controls are evidenced to auditors
* Self-motivated and collaborative, with strong written communication; able to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, security staff, and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort supporting an existing production platform while building new automation
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Preferred Technical Familiarity:
  
  

* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-400, AZ-104, or AZ-305
* SQL Server or Azure SQL experience, including T-SQL, database deployment through pipelines (e.g., SSDT/DACPAC), backup and restore, and basic query performance tuning (DP-300 a plus)
* Experience with GitHub Actions or GitHub Advanced Security alongside Azure DevOps
* Experience with containers, including Docker, Azure Container Registry, and Azure Container Apps or AKS
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and agentic CI/CD patterns in day-to-day work
* Experience with Azure OpenAI or other Azure AI services
* Familiarity with Azure networking: hub-and-spoke VNets, private endpoints, private DNS zones, NSGs, and Application Gateway/WAF
* Experience with Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata)
* Experience with Azure Functions, Service Bus, and Azure Front Door

**Benefits**
**Benefits**
We offer competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance plans, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off.
