title: Senior AWS Cloud Engineer
description:
Description:

**Company Background and Summary**

Vaylent is a Cerberus-backed aerospace and defense manufacturing platform building the enterprise infrastructure, capabilities, and operational foundation to support a growing network of manufacturing companies, including Votaw Precision Technologies. Through its operating companies, Vaylent supports demanding aerospace, defense, and industrial programs by combining advanced manufacturing expertise with scalable business and technology infrastructure.

The Senior AWS Cloud Engineer will build and own Vela’s cloud foundation in AWS GovCloud (US), where CUI and manufacturing data will reside. This hands-on role will establish the landing zone, infrastructure-as-code standards, and secure data architecture connecting manufacturing operations to analytics. The engineer will help build the cloud environment that supports Vaylent and its operating companies as the platform grows.

**What You Will Own (Essential Functions)**

* **Design and build the GovCloud landing zone** in AWS GovCloud (US) accounts, networking, identity, guardrails, and logging aligned to FedRAMP High / CMMC L2 expectations.
* **Establish infrastructure-as-code standards** using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) so the environment is version-controlled, repeatable, and auditable.
* **Build the platform data architecture**— secure ingestion from the shop floor via industrial IoT / edge connectivity, a CUI-tiered data lake, and downstream analytics.
* **Stand up secure access** — bastion/jump hosts, private connectivity (Direct Connect/VPN), and least-privilege access patterns for a controlled environment.
* **Implement** FIPS-validated encryption in transit and at rest, KMS key management, immutable logging, and boundary controls.
* **Own cloud networking** — VPC design, Transit Gateway, and Direct Connect/VPN connectivity to on-prem sites, in partnership with the network engineer.
* **Establish delivery automation** with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows so infrastructure and deployments are automated and repeatable.
* **Own operational health** — monitoring, logging, and observability (e.g., CloudWatch), plus cost visibility and optimization discipline appropriate to a lean, PE-backed platform.
* **Partner on M&A integration** to integrate acquired companies' data and systems into the platform on a repeatable pattern.

Requirements:

**Qualifications and Skills**

**Education & Experience**

* 7+ years of cloud engineering, with deep hands-on AWS experience.
* Direct experience with AWS GovCloud (US) (not only commercial AWS) — 2+ years in GovCloud or another accredited/regulated cloud strongly preferred.
* Strong AWS networking skills — VPC, Transit Gateway, and hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect/VPN).
* Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) and CI/CD / Git-based automation.
* Experience designing secure data pipelines / data lakes on AWS (S3, IAM, KMS, VPC, networking).
* Familiarity with CMMC / NIST SP 800-171 or FedRAMP control expectations in a cloud context (a plus; willingness to learn required).
* Comfortable operating independently in an early-stage environment and documenting for a team that will grow around them.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Industrial IoT / edge experience — AWS IoT Greengrass / SiteWise, Azure IoT, or similar OT data-ingestion technologies.
* Manufacturing or defense-sector cloud experience.
* AWS certifications (Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security).
* Bachelors in a technical field or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Experience integrating acquired companies onto a common cloud platform.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Establish and maintain a secure AWS GovCloud foundation aligned with CMMC Level 2/NIST 800-171 requirements.
* Implement repeatable, version-controlled infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD automation.
* Deliver secure, scalable manufacturing data architecture connecting shop-floor systems to analytics.
* Maintain 99.9%+ availability, monitoring, logging, and operational resilience for critical cloud services.
* Maintain strong cloud security, access controls, encryption, and audit readiness.
* Establish repeatable cloud integration patterns for new sites and M&A activity.
* Optimize cloud infrastructure for security, scalability, performance, and cost.
* Maintain accurate architecture, security, and operational documentation.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly self-motivated and directed.
* Keen attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.
* Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

**Work Conditions**

* Ability to work onsite, including hours outside of a normal working day, to meet critical deadlines.
* This position operates within a precision manufacturing environment supporting the production of mission-critical aerospace and defense components. Success requires a high sense of urgency, attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple departments to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing operations and customer delivery commitments.
* Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment, including walking the production floor, climbing stairs or ladders, occasionally lifting up to 25 pounds, and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

**Additional Requirements**

* This position requires the use of information or access to hardware subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons as defined by ITAR.
* Able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

title: Cyber & IT Operations Analytics Engineer
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Cyber & IT Operations Data / Splunk Analytics Engineer to support the Sponsor’s IT systems data modernization ecosystem. In this role, you will address critical data challenges by establishing data quality baselines, schema standards, and normalization pipelines for high-velocity, disparate cyber feeds and IT operations telemetry (system performance metrics, service health, network infrastructure logs, and application events). Working within an Agile engineering environment, you will architect robust ingest pipelines, build optimized Splunk models and correlation searches, and ensure raw telemetry is transformed into standardized, high-confidence data powering both threat analysis and holistic IT operational health monitoring.

* Data Quality & Normalization: Standardize, cleanse, and normalize high-velocity machine data from disparate security tools and IT operational systems into common information schemas (e.g., Splunk CIM) to ensure data fidelity, search efficiency, and unified observability.
* Splunk Architecture & Operations: Configure, tune, monitor, and administer distributed Splunk infrastructure (Heavy Forwarders, Universal Forwarders, Indexer Clusters, Search Head Clusters) and ingest streams.
* Analytics & Search Optimization: Develop complex, performance-optimized Search Processing Language (SPL) queries, accelerated data models, event correlations, and real-time alerts supporting cyber threat detection and IT operational reliability/availability.
* Telemetry Pipeline Engineering: Design and support data routing, parsing, filtering, and transformation pipelines for logs, metrics, and traces using Splunk Forwarders, Syslog/HEC, or Apache NiFi.
* Observability & Dashboards: Build operational dashboards and reporting interfaces that translate security events and IT operational health/performance indicators into actionable insights for engineers and leadership.
* Ecosystem Integration: Collaborate with platform and cloud engineers to integrate clean, standardized cyber and IT operational datasets with downstream machine learning and automated analytics tooling.

 **Requirements**  

* Splunk Administrative Expertise: Hands-on experience deploying, architecting, managing, and optimizing distributed enterprise Splunk environments, including index management, forwarder configurations, search optimization, and data model acceleration.
* Cyber & IT Operations Telemetry Standards: Proven experience with log and metric telemetry (syslog, Windows Event Logs, network flows, application logs, infrastructure metrics), field extraction (⁠props.conf⁠ / ⁠transforms.conf⁠), and enforcing data quality and normalization standards across high-throughput data streams.
* Data Ingestion & Pipelines: Experience ingesting, parsing, and routing streaming data utilizing Splunk native inputs, HTTP Event Collector (HEC), Apache NiFi, or Kafka.
* Scripting & Automation: Ability to write scripts in Python, Bash, or JSON/REST APIs to automate data collection, pipeline health monitoring, and data sanitization tasks.
* Infrastructure & Enclave Environment: Solid working knowledge of Linux system administration, network connectivity troubleshooting, and secure cloud environments (e.g., AWS).
* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent operational engineering experience).
* Must have an active TS/SCI with Polygraph Clearance.

title: Data Engineer - Data Platform
description:
Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. We build smart systems and infrastructure for homes, businesses, and municipalities that transform food scraps from landfill-bound waste into valuable resources, including chicken feed. Tens of thousands of Mill’s residential food recyclers are already helping households divert millions of pounds of food scraps every year, paving the way for our upcoming launch of Mill Commercial—the industry’s first end-to-end solution for managing, understanding, and preventing food waste in commercial environments (e.g. grocery, restaurants, food services). At Mill, we are passionate about building easy-to-use, beautifully designed technologies that keep food in the food system and out of landfills.
  
  
The Role
  
  
As a Data Engineer at Mill, you'll build and maintain the core data infrastructure that powers analytics and product data across the company — ingestion pipelines, warehouse modeling, data quality, and the self-serve analytics platform (Hex + Snowflake) our business teams rely on. You'll work closely with the Senior Data Engineer owning our recommendations platform, contributing to and supporting that work as needed, with the opportunity to grow into deeper recommendation/LLM-based work over time. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and marketing teams.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines across Mill's product and operational systems
* Manage and maintain data infrastructure that powers our product and operational systems, ensuring it's reliable and ready to feed external customers and downstream analytics
* Collaborate with software engineers to instrument new product features and ensure event data flows cleanly
* Help build and maintain the self-serve analytics platform in Hex and Snowflake for internal business teams
* Help maintain the metrics, table endorsements, and business logic that analysts and stakeholders rely on
* Own data quality monitoring — build alerting, validation frameworks, and observability tooling so data issues get caught before they become business problems

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 3-5 years of experience operating data engineering systems in production
* Have built and operated data pipelines in production using Python, SQL, and tools like dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or similar against a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake)
* Have used Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi) to provision and manage data infrastructure, with CI/CD discipline for pipeline and infra changes (automated testing, staged rollout, rollback)
* Experience working with transactional databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS) as a data source, including understanding how OLTP systems differ from warehouse/analytical workloads
* Comfort working in a collaborative environment where data consumers are partners, not just stakeholders, and comfort moving between different types of work as priorities shift
* A bias toward action

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to recommendation, personalization, or LLM-based product logic — not required, but a strong plus given the team's direction
* Experience building or supporting self-serve analytics tooling (Hex, Looker, or similar)
* Exposure to distributed systems concepts (partitioning, consistency, fault tolerance)
* Experience with Mixpanel, Tableau, or similar BI/analytics tools
* Familiarity with data contract or data mesh patterns, or RBAC/access governance on a warehouse
* Experience with event tracking or product analytics

*The estimated base salary range for this position is $185k to $210k,
*which does not include the value of benefits or a potential equity grant. A wide range of factors are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets, market conditions, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and business and organizational needs.**

title: Data Engineer
description:
**The Company:**

David is building the next generation of high-protein foods. Our mission is simple: create tools to increase muscle and decrease fat. We launched with a category-defining protein bar that delivers exceptional nutrition without compromising on taste and have since expanded into new categories, including frozen desserts and ready-to-drink protein beverages. Our ambition is to build a broad platform of high-protein, low-calorie, blood-sugar-friendly foods that consumers genuinely crave.

David is part of Medici Brands, which recently raised a $250 million Series B at a $2.25 billion valuation, marking a major milestone in its rapid growth. Led by CEO Peter Rahal, Co-founder and Former CEO of RXBAR, David combines deep expertise in product innovation, brand building, and scaling category-defining consumer businesses.

This is a rare opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing brands in consumer food at a defining moment in its growth. As David expands into new categories and markets, we're building toward an ambitious vision: becoming the leading high-protein food brand in North America and beyond.

**Role Overview:**

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

The Data Engineer will co-own David's data infrastructure and build AI-powered workflows that eliminate manual, repetitive work across the organization. This role sits at the center of how the company turns operational data from our ERP, retail platforms, e-commerce channels, finance platforms, and supply chain systems into reliable pipelines, trusted data models, and automated workflows that are leveraged cross-functionally.

**Data pipelines & modeling**

* Design, build, and maintain ETL pipelines from source systems (NetSuite, Shopify, retail platforms/EDI, etc) into BigQuery, with automated testing, monitoring, and alerting for data quality.
* Develop canonical, well-documented dbt models for spanning sales, inventory, fulfillment, financials, and our in-house S&OP platform that serve as the trusted foundation for reporting and analytics.
* Partner with Finance, Retail, Supply Chain, and Growth to turn business requirements into data solutions, and help set standards for modeling, documentation, and governance.
* Co-own our semantic layer and BI tooling (Omni): model curation, metric definitions, and the reporting leadership relies on.

**Internal tooling & automation**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows for document parsing, data extraction, classification, and enrichment as part of data pipelines and operational processes.
* Implement evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop patterns to ensure reliability and accuracy of AI-driven outputs.
* Manage credentials, sensitive data, and third-party integrations, and design workflows with appropriate access controls and guardrails.
* Build scripts, automations, and lightweight internal tools that replace manual processes, working alongside engineers who own application development.
* Automate recurring reporting and ad hoc analyses to support organizational visibility to key metrics.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* 2+ years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related technical role.
* Technical proficiency:
* Strong SQL and data modeling skills: you can design clean, well-documented models from messy operational and ERP data, and you understand dimensional modeling and incremental transformation patterns.
* Production experience with dbt and a cloud data warehouse.
* Proficiency in Python for pipelines, automation, and data workflows: clean, testable code with proper version control.
* Working fluency with modern AI tooling.
* Nice to have: TypeScript and full-stack experience (Next.js/React, Postgres), agent frameworks and orchestration, semantic layer / BI modeling (Omni, Looker), and experience with ERP, supply chain, or CPG data.
* A track record of building pipelines, systems, or automations that other people actually depend on in a professional setting, a side project, or an open-source contribution.
* The ability to operate independently while clearly communicating priorities and initiatives to the rest of the team.
* Humble, self-aware, and curious.
* A desire to build an early stage CPG company with a mission to help people increase muscle and decrease fat.

**Practicalities**

* This is a full-time role.
* Salary: $150K - $200K per year, inclusive of cash bonus based on attainment of company targets
* Company equity opportunity
* 100% covered Health, Vision, Dental Insurance
* 401(k)
* Additional perks, such as covered gym expenses
* Substantial and required PTO
* We work in the office 5 days per week in New York City – when culture lines up, it is fun to be in the office together.

title: Data Engineer (SQL)
description:
**Description**
**About Peregrine**
Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.
  
  
Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.
  
  
We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.
  
  
As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.
  
  
**People first. Ownership always.**
We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.
  
  
At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.
  
  
At Peregrine Advisors, you will design and build the data layer for a federal enterprise platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.
  
  
This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.
  
  
**Your first project**
Your First Project Will Likely Have You Taking Responsibility For The Accuracy And Performance Of Your Assigned Components. Depending On The Assignment, You May
  
  

* Design database schemas, and write the views, stored procedures, functions, and Structured Query Language (SQL) queries that run on them.
* Build and maintain data pipelines and extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) processes, including loads from Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3).
* Make queries and databases fast enough for high-volume workloads.
* Help model data across Amazon Web Services (AWS) stores such as Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), Amazon DynamoDB, and S3.
* Keep data accurate and secure, with governed access and changes that can be audited.
* Work out data access patterns and integrations with developers, architects, and data engineers.
* Where the work allows, use artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tools for query, pipeline, and troubleshooting work, and review and validate what they produce.

You deliver database components accurate and fast enough that analysts and systems trust them. You automate the loads and checks that used to be run by hand, and you build models that keep working as the platform grows.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 4+ years of data engineering, database development, database engineering, software development, or comparable practical experience
* Bachelor's degree
* SQL skills across complex queries, views, stored procedures, and functions, together with relational design, normalization, and data modeling
* Working expertise in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), covering schema design, stored procedures and functions, and indexing
* Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, covering data modeling and Global and Local Secondary Indexes (GSIs and LSIs)
* Performance and query tuning that addresses slow queries through indexing and execution-plan work
* Experience making logical data modeling and database-design decisions for assigned components within an established platform architecture
* ETL and ELT development and data integration across AWS data services such as Aurora, DynamoDB, and S3
* Experience working within data security controls such as encryption, access management, and auditing
* Experience loading data from S3 into the platform stores and connecting through Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC)
* Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

**Preferred**

* An AWS certification at the associate level, such as Developer Associate or Solutions Architect Associate
* Experience tuning queries that involve locking and deadlocks
* Familiarity with supporting cloud-native applications in AWS through continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices
* Ownership of physical design for Aurora and DynamoDB schemas and indexes, or the drive to grow into it
* Experience in federal information technology or high-volume transaction environments
* Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tools

**Who You Are**
You enjoy building with SQL and take responsibility for getting data right. You can take a database problem from design through delivery and stand behind how your work performs. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.
  
  
**What You Bring**

* Solid SQL on a modern relational platform, Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), with stored procedures, functions, and views that hold up in use.
* Practical skill in query tuning against slow queries, indexing, and execution plans, together with data loading, connectivity, version control, and clean delivery.
* Practical experience developing logical data models and database schemas, and making database-design decisions for assigned components within the established platform architecture.
* The ability to own assigned database work from design through maintenance, working within data security controls, with sound judgment where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

**When we talk**
Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.
  
  
**Benefits**
This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year.
  
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.
  
  
**What We Offer**
You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.
  
  
**What We Commit To**
As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.
  
  
We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.
  
  
Pereg

Gridware’s advanced Active Grid Response platform uses high-precision sensors to detect potential issues early, enabling proactive maintenance and fault mitigation. This comprehensive approach helps improve safety, reduce outages, and ensure the grid operates efficiently. The company is backed by climate-tech and Silicon Valley investors. www.Gridware.io
.

This is a hands-on, high-growth role ideal for engineers ready to deepen their expertise in distributed data systems.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Data Engineer | Full-time | Remote | $120,000–$160,000 per year**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Data Engineer is a senior, hands-on role that owns the data foundation of the CES-LINKS platform: the data models, pipelines, and integrations that every part of the product depends on. This is a builder role: you design and maintain the schemas and data flows, bring in student and school data from district systems, and make sure the data the application and its users see is accurate, consistent, and secure. Startup experience is highly preferred.

CES-LINKS is building a comprehensive K-12 education platform. The initial release centers on the LMS and curriculum core (curriculum, standards alignment, assessments, gradebook), and the platform expands from there across seven stakeholder portals serving students, instructors, administrators, families, boards, student services, and the public. Data work in this environment means SIS integrations (Clever and OneRoster today, additional SIS sources ahead), rostering and data imports, curriculum and standards data, and the compliance requirements (FERPA/COPPA) of student-data software.

CES-LINKS is an AI-native company: AI tools (Claude) are a standard part of daily work, with all AI-generated output reviewed and validated before use.

**HOW THIS ROLE FITS THE TEAM**

* You own the data layer: the data models, schemas, and data contracts that the front end, back end, and reporting rely on, and you keep them documented, versioned, and in sync across environments.
* You build and run data integrations: the pipelines that ingest, transform, and validate data from SIS and rostering sources, district imports, and curriculum and standards content.
* You partner on implementations: you work with the Technical Project Manager on the data side of each school and district implementation: mapping, configuration, imports, and validation before go-live.
* The Engineering Pit Lead owns overall architecture and engineering practice; you own data design within it and bring data-related technical decisions to the Pit Lead.
* The Product Manager owns priority, meaning what gets built and why. The Technical Project Manager owns sprint planning and delivery sequencing. You surface data dependencies, risks, and effort so trade-offs are made with the full picture.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We're looking for a hands-on data engineer who is comfortable owning the data foundation of an early-stage product. You can design clean, well-documented data models, build reliable pipelines without over-engineering them, and explain data decisions clearly to engineers, product, and non-technical colleagues. You communicate openly about data issues and trade-offs, collaborate closely with the people who build on your work, and care about getting student data right.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, build, and maintain the platform's data models and schemas, including data contracts between services and clear documentation of data structures.
* Build and operate data pipelines and integrations for SIS and rostering sources (Clever, OneRoster, and additional SIS sources), district data imports, and curriculum and standards content.
* Own data quality: validation, monitoring, and alerting so issues are caught before they reach users or a district go-live.
* Partner with engineering on how the application reads and writes data, with clear, timely communication when data structures or formats change.
* Support school and district implementations with data mapping, imports, and validation, in partnership with the Technical Project Manager and Customer Success.
* Apply privacy and security practices for student data, including access controls, data minimization, and FERPA/COPPA compliance requirements.
* Prepare and maintain realistic sample and test data sets for development and QA.
* Use AI tools throughout (design, coding, documentation, and analysis), validating all outputs.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in data engineering or a closely related backend/data role.
* Startup experience preferred: building data infrastructure from an early stage, wearing multiple hats, and working directly with founders.
* Strong SQL and data modeling skills, with experience designing relational schemas for a production application.
* Proficiency in Python (or a similar language) for building and maintaining data pipelines.
* Experience building pipelines and data infrastructure on a major cloud platform, with version control and CI/CD.
* Experience integrating third-party data sources and APIs, with attention to data validation and error handling.
* Fluency with AI assistants as daily working tools, with the judgment to verify outputs.
* K-12 / edtech experience strongly preferred: SIS and rostering integrations (Clever, OneRoster), education data standards, or student-data privacy (FERPA/COPPA).
* Excellent written communication, including clear technical documentation.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

Baselines for all measures are established jointly with the CTO in the first 30 days; measurement is owned by the CTO, not self-reported.

* Data reliability: pipeline uptime and successful scheduled runs against the agreed baseline.
* Data quality: data issues caught by validation before reaching users or a district go-live; defects traced to data trending down.
* Integration delivery: SIS and district data onboarding delivered to plan, with time per onboarding trending down as patterns and tooling mature.
* Documentation and alignment: data models and contracts documented and current, with schema changes communicated before they affect other teams.

**COMPENSATION**

The salary range for this position is $120,000–$160,000 per year. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

description:
**Description**
**About Peregrine**
Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.
  
  
Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.
  
  
We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.
  
  
As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.
  
  
**People first. Ownership always.**
We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.
  
  
At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.
  
  
At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the data pipelines and databases behind a mission-critical federal enterprise data platform: their design, their performance and reliability, and the integrity of the data in them. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.
  
  
This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.
  
  
**Your first project**
Your First Project Will Likely Have You Owning The Extract, Transform, And Load (ETL) And Extract, Load, And Transform (ELT) Processes, Logical And Physical Data Models, Physical Data Configurations, And The Performance Of That Layer Under Real Query Volume. Depending On The Assignment, You May
  
  

* Design and maintain databases that scale, in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), Amazon DynamoDB, and the platform's other data stores.
* Design the logical and physical data models, and build the schemas, indexes, views, stored procedures, and functions that implement them.
* Write and tune complex Structured Query Language (SQL), reading execution plans and adjusting indexes until high-volume queries hold up.
* Build and support extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) pipelines and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) loads that keep the data accurate and complete.
* Track down performance, locking, replication, and data consistency problems.
* Keep the databases available and recoverable through monitoring, capacity planning, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Secure them with least-privilege access, and keep them auditable.
* Work with architects, developers, and data engineers, and move database changes through continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and infrastructure as code.

You deliver a database layer analysts and systems can trust at scale. You automate the data-integration and load patterns that would otherwise be hand-run, and you build the access controls that keep a governed platform governed.
  
  
This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 7+ years of hands-on data engineering, database development, database engineering, software development, or comparable practical experience in support of enterprise applications
* Bachelor's degree
* Expertise in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), covering schema design, stored procedures and functions, indexing, and execution-plan analysis
* Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, covering data modeling, partition and key design, and Global and Local Secondary Indexes (GSIs and LSIs)
* Advanced SQL skills across complex queries, views, stored procedures, and functions, together with relational design, normalization, and data modeling
* Performance and query tuning that resolves slow queries, locking, and deadlocks through indexing and execution-plan work
* ETL and ELT development and data integration across Amazon Web Services (AWS) data services, such as Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), S3, and data migration services
* Data security controls such as encryption, access management, auditing, and compliance
* Support for cloud-native applications in AWS through CI/CD and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices, including monitoring, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery
* Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

**Preferred**

* An AWS certification at the level of Database Specialty, Developer Associate, or Solutions Architect
* Federal information technology experience with systems that require security controls and compliance frameworks
* Experience with high-volume transaction processing, large-scale data platforms, or regulatory reporting
* Experience with database observability and monitoring tools such as Amazon CloudWatch, Performance Insights, Datadog, or Splunk
* Experience with Amazon Redshift, AWS Glue, AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), or AWS Lake Formation
* Experience with infrastructure as code, including Terraform, CloudFormation, and the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK)
* Experience with artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted development tooling

**Who You Are**
You make data flows and databases fast and keep their data trustworthy. You have designed and tuned large data platforms and understand why the logical and physical models matter. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.
  
  
**What You Bring**

title: Sr. Analytics Engineer
description:
Pelago is the leading specialty substance use care provider, built on the belief that effective treatment means matching care intensity to what each member actually needs rather than defaulting to the most expensive intervention. Our programs guide members through every stage of the substance use spectrum, from unhealthy habits to active use disorders, delivering personalized treatment for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, cannabis, and stimulant use based on individual health, habits, genetics, and goals.
  
  
With Sona, our voice-first AI Mental Health Specialist, Pelago now applies that same clinically-driven model to mental health, pairing deep clinical expertise with technology to expand access without compromising care quality. We believe technology should make clinical care more precise and more human, not replace the judgment behind it.
  
  
Pelago has scaled to helping hundreds of employers and health plans and has already helped more than 750,000 members better manage their substance use. If you're passionate about AI and making an impact on the health of others, join us and make it happen!
  
  
**About Our Data Team**
Our Data team sits at the center of how Pelago makes decisions. As we scale, we're building a data function that doesn't just report on the business — it shapes it.
  
  
We transform complex healthcare and product data into clean, reliable, well-documented models that power reporting, experimentation, AI initiatives, and day-to-day decision-making across the company. The Senior Analytics Engineer is a key force multiplier on that mission.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
We’re hiring an Analytics Engineer who loves building scalable data models, thinking deeply about business logic, and creating reusable data assets. In this role, you’ll help shape how data is structured and defined across Pelago—ensuring consistency, quality, and usability for everything from dashboards to experimentation to future machine learning use cases. This is a business intelligence role with an analytics engineering toolkit. Reporting to our Director of Analytics, you'll partner with our Commercial, Marketing, and Health Services teams to understand what they need, and then own the dbt and semantic layers that deliver it. We want someone who asks why a number looks the way it does and stays with a problem until it's actually solved.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain dbt models in Redshift, designed from the business need backward rather than from the raw data forward.
* Apply software engineering practices to our transformation layer: DRY code, meaningful tests, clear lineage, and documentation.
* Turn ambiguous questions from our Commercial, Marketing, and Health Services teams into reusable data models and dashboards, built for both analysts and AI.
* Define and govern consistent metrics through our semantic layer, and keep testing whether they're still the right way to look at the business.
* Support experimentation and campaign measurement so we know what's working and why.
* Partner with Data Engineering and Product to understand source data, and with analytics peers to deliver analysis-ready data.
* Build reusable AI-driven workflows that change how the data team works.
* Find and fix problems in the data before they become problems in the business.

**The Background We Are Looking For**

* 5+ years in analytics engineering, BI, data analytics, or data modeling.
* Expert SQL and fluency with dbt, Git, and the full analytics development lifecycle, with software engineering discipline: DRY code, meaningful tests, and clear lineage.
* Strong data modeling and warehousing fundamentals, including clean, well-documented tables with clear grain that work for both analysts and AI.
* Experience building and governing metric definitions through a semantic layer, in partnership with analysts, data engineers, and product teams.
* A track record of turning business needs into models and dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
* Hands-on experience building AI-driven workflows or skills.
* Comfort operating autonomously while things change.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with Cube, Looker, or similar semantic-layer and BI tools.
* A background in healthcare or other regulated data.
* Experience measuring marketing campaigns, experiments, or engagement.

**What You’ll Love About Us**
We have a whole host of perks for our people! From life essentials to nice-to-haves, there are more than a few good reasons to love working with us. We strive to ensure Pelago employees have equitable access to healthcare, wellbeing, time away, and then some.
  
  

* Generous and meaningful equity package
* Full Medical, Dental, & Vision coverage
* 401k Plan
* Unlimited PTO Policy, 10 paid holidays, & company wide “Me Time” Days
* Paid maternity, paternity & new parent leave
* Flexible working environment
* Annual Learning and Development stipend to support continued learning and career development
* Wellness Reimbursement Program
* Access to Reproductive & Family Planning Care
* Substance Use Support for employees and family members

**At this time, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.**
The provided range reflects our US target salary range for this full-time position, which is part of our broader total compensation package, including incentive bonus program, stock options, comprehensive benefits, and incentive pay applicable to eligible roles. Individual pay within the range will vary based on a variety of factors like role-related experience and education, internal pay equity, and other relevant business factors. At Pelago, we are committed to an equitable and fair pay philosophy and review total compensation for our employees at least twice a year.

$165,000 - $185,000 USD

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
About Till
  



Till is a family banking app and kids' debit card that helps parents raise financially capable kids. Now part of Western & Southern Financial Group, Till has the resources of a Fortune 500 company behind it. Till is entering its biggest growth phase yet, expanding direct to consumer and building new ways for families to save, spend and grow together. Data sits at the center of that growth: understanding our families, measuring what drives acquisition and engagement, and giving every team numbers they can trust.



The role
  



You will be the first data hire alongside our Data Analytics Lead, taking on a growing share of Till's analysis and reporting and building the dbt models that power it. Family banking brings real analytical depth: shared accounts with multiple users, distinct parent and kid experiences, and relationships that evolve as kids grow into teens and young adults.
  



Your first focus is marketing. We're significantly increasing our marketing investment and building the team, and you'll be its core data partner for attribution, conversion and engagement. You will also have a voice in how the data function grows, from tools and infrastructure to future hires.
  



This role reports to the Analytics Lead. You will work closely with:

* **Growth Marketer:**
  you build the attribution and reporting that guide acquisition spend and decide where the next dollar goes.
* **Lifecycle Marketer:**
  you define segments and keep our customer engagement platform fed with reliable data, so journeys run on the same numbers as the rest of the company.
* **Product, Engineering and Operations:**
  you turn open questions into analysis grounded in how the product and business actually work.

What you'll do

* **Be marketing's core data partner.**
  Build reporting on acquisition, attribution, conversion and engagement across the warehouse and product analytics, and maintain the measurement framework that guides acquisition spend and lifecycle programs.
* **Keep the customer engagement platform fed.**
  Make sure the right customer and event data flows reliably into our CEP, and help the team understand what they're looking at.
* **Turn questions into recommendations.**
  Translate open-ended requests into analysis grounded in how our product and business work, and go past the answer to what we should do next, and why.
* **Ask the next question first.**
  Investigate anomalies and open questions on your own before anyone else asks.
* **Build models and dashboards people trust.**
  Write efficient, tested and documented dbt models in Snowflake, and build ad hoc reports and long-lived Metabase dashboards for teams across the company.
* **Share findings in the format that fits.**
  A dashboard, a doc or deck, or a clean spreadsheet someone else can pick up, tailored to the audience and tied to the business goal behind the question.
* **Help shape the data function.**
  Give input on new tools, infrastructure and future hires as the team grows.

What we're looking for
  



**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, analytical, or technical field, or commensurate work experience.
* 2–5 years in analytics engineering, data analytics or a similar role, ideally at a fintech or financial services company.
* Strong SQL, equally at home writing production models and exploratory queries.
* Experience building models in dbt, SQLMesh or a similar tool, using git for version control and code review.
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift.
* Experience with a BI tool such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau or Mode, and a product analytics tool such as Mixpanel or Amplitude.
* Experience with marketing data (attribution, conversion, engagement), plus supporting at least one other function.
* Working proficiency in Python for analysis and light scripting.
* A clear communicator who presents findings to technical and non-technical audiences and ties them to business decisions.

**Nice to have**

* Getting data into a CEP such as Braze or Iterable, and supporting segmentation and campaign measurement.
* Using Meta or Google Ads data to measure campaign performance and acquisition cost, or building reporting in Google Analytics.
* Designing A/B tests and analyzing results.
* Analyzing retention, churn or revenue for a subscription product.
* Building workflows in Airflow or another orchestration tool.
* Using AI tools to work faster, with the judgment to know when your own analysis needs to lead.

What success looks like
  



Your first priority is giving the marketing team measurement they can rely on ahead of our next major launch. Broader company reporting builds from there.

* **First 30 days:**
  you know our data, models and dashboards, and have mapped the gaps in marketing measurement with the Growth and Lifecycle Marketers.
* **First 60 days:**
  core attribution and conversion reporting is live, and the data feeding our CEP is reliable.
* **First 90 days:**
  the marketing measurement framework is in place and the team uses it to make spend and program decisions.

Our stack
  



Warehouse: Snowflake. Transformation: dbt. BI: Metabase. Product analytics: Mixpanel. Customer engagement: Braze and Iterable (consolidating on one). Languages: SQL and Python.



Location
  



This is a hybrid role based at our office in DUMBO, Brooklyn, with a few days a week in person. We're looking for candidates in the greater NYC area.



Compensation
  



The base salary range for this role is $105,000 to $150,000, depending on experience. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus.



Logistics
  



Till is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a team that reflects the families we serve and welcome candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.
  



Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Till Financial is not able to sponsor employment visas (e.g., H-1B) at this time.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**J**
**ob Summary**
The Data & Analytics team builds the reporting and data infrastructure that supports company-wide decision-making. The Analytics Engineer will own the layer between raw data and finished reporting, combining SQL data modeling with Power BI semantic models and dashboards.
  
  
This hybrid role partners with the Sr. Manager, Data & Analytics and business stakeholders across Finance, Operations, and other functions to build accurate, well-documented data models, support scheduled data pipelines, and troubleshoot refresh or pipeline issues as needed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data modeling & SQL: Design, build, and maintain SQL views, staging tables, and fact/dimension models in our Azure SQL data warehouse, including deduplication and business-rule logic (e.g., status-based routing, multi-source reconciliation).
* Semantic models & reporting: Build and maintain Power BI semantic models — relationships, DAX measures, security roles — and the reports and dashboards built on top of them for business stakeholders and company-wide reporting.
* Pipeline support: Share responsibility with the Sr. Manager, Data & Analytics for monitoring scheduled Azure Data Factory pipelines and Power BI dataset refreshes. Respond to failures and perform basic troubleshooting.
* Pipeline modifications: Make minor modifications to existing pipelines to support new or changing business requirements, as your familiarity with the tooling grows.
* Business partnership: Partner with business SMEs to translate reporting requests and business logic (commission structures, revenue recognition, inventory rules, etc.) into accurate, well-documented data models.
* Documentation: Write and maintain documentation for data models, metric definitions, and report logic so that data lineage and ownership are clear beyond any one person.
* Standards & quality: Follow and help evolve team standards for naming conventions, DAX style, and semantic model design as the team's practices mature.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for process improvements, optimize current data workflows, and incorporate new technologies or tools to enhance data analytics capabilities.

**Knowledge And Skills**
**Required**

* Solid Power BI experience beyond report formatting — you've built semantic models from scratch and written DAX involving CALCULATE, filter context, and context transition, not just basic aggregations.
* Dimensional modeling fundamentals (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions).
* A track record of working directly with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements or business rules into a working data model.
* Strong attention to detail with data integrity — you double-check your joins and know how a bad join or an inclusive date boundary can quietly break a report.

**Preferred**

* Exposure to an ERP or other core business system as a data source (order, invoicing, or GL data) - you understand that business rules, not just dates, often drive how records should be deduplicated or classified.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and working knowledge of orchestration tools like Azure Data Factory or similar tools for automating data pipelines.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric Administration and Environment (Lakehouses, Dataflows Gen2) — not required, but a plus given our platform direction.
* Basic Git/source control experience.
* Python for data tasks.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
* Minimum (three) 3+ years in a data-focused role (analytics engineer, BI developer, data analyst, or similar) with hands-on SQL work — comfortable with CTEs, window functions, and reading/writing complex, multi-source views.
* Knowledge of data quality frameworks and data governance practices.

title: GTM Analytics Engineer
description:
**About Decagon**
Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.
  
  
Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.
  
  
We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.
  
  
We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.
  
  
**About The Team**
Decagon’s Revenue Operations team is a multidisciplinary group of operators combining strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and high-velocity execution. Covering GTM-wide strategy, operations and analytics, we are proactive, data-driven partners to leadership – providing critical insights, driving operational efficiency, and getting things done.
  
  
**About The Role**
Decagon is looking for its first GTM Analytics Engineer to build the data infrastructure that our entire go-to-market organization runs on. You'll own turning that raw, messy data into clean, well-modeled tables that the rest of RevOps, sales leadership, and the exec team can actually build on. This is a true 0-to-1 role with support from the broader RevOps & GTM team: you'll design lots of data structures and modeling layers from the ground up, set the standards for how GTM data gets structured, and become the trusted person to answer "where does this number actually come from."
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Design and build the foundational GTM data infrastructure in BigQuery — ingesting, organizing, and modeling data from Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, and other GTM systems into a reliable data lake
* Write and maintain models that transform raw CRM and GTM tool data into clean, trusted tables for pipeline, forecasting, segmentation, comp, and territory reporting
* Partner with sales leadership and cross-functional partners to translate ambiguous, ad hoc reporting requests into durable, well-documented data models rather than one-off queries
* Build and maintain data pipelines that keep GTM data fresh, accurate, and consistent as new tools and data sources get added
* Own data quality end-to-end — establishing testing, validation, and monitoring so the numbers in Hex are numbers people trust
* Set technical standards and best practices for GTM data modeling as the function scales

**Your background looks something like this**

* 4+ years of experience in data/analytics engineering, with hands-on ownership of ETL/ELT pipelines and dbt in a production environment
* Strong SQL skills and direct experience building and maintaining data warehouses in BigQuery (or a comparable cloud warehouse)
* Real experience working with GTM data — Salesforce is a must, plus familiarity with tools like Gong, Outreach, or similar sales engagement platforms in a high-growth B2B company is a plus
* Strong grasp of core SaaS and GTM metrics — conversion rates, ARR/NRR, win rates, sales cycle length, quota attainment — and how they're derived from the underlying GTM tool data
* Comfort turning messy, inconsistent source data into clean, well-organized, documented tables built for downstream reporting and dashboarding
* Experience creating outputs, including dashboards, ad hoc analysis with large datasets in BI tools (Hex preferred) for dashboarding and self-serve analytics
* A builder mindset — you're excited to build foundational infrastructure from scratch in a fast-moving environment rather than maintain an existing system
* Strong cross-functional communication skills; you can work directly with sales leadership to understand what they actually need, not just what they ask for

**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
* Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
* Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
* Parental Leave
* Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
* Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

Who you are

* 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a closely related field, working with large datasets to develop reliable analytical data models and data products.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

We partner with hospitals, health systems, ACOs, and payers to bring clarity to quality data, connecting clinical and claims information into a single, reliable view. More than 1,800 organizations and 130M+ patient records rely on Medisolv to measure, report, and improve performance across 500+ measures tied to CMS, The Joint Commission, and other programs.

With support from Bessemer Venture Partners Forge, we're continuing to grow our platform and expand our impact — investing in advanced analytics, AI, and new capabilities that help healthcare organizations stay ahead of change and improve outcomes with confidence.

Reporting to Director of AI & Data Engineering, we are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our team.

**About the Role**

The Senior Data Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership for Medisolv's healthcare data platform and customer implementations. You will design, build, and operate reliable data products that transform payer and quality data into trusted measure calculations, forecasts, and decision-ready insights.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership across Snowflake, dbt, orchestration, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, data quality, and production operations. You will partner closely with product, domain experts, application engineers, security, and client-facing teams while helping the engineering team establish scalable patterns and sound technical decisions.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the design and evolution of scalable Snowflake and dbt data models supporting healthcare quality measurement, forecasting, reporting, and customer-specific workflows.
* Lead complex ingestion and connector implementations for claims, enrollment, eligibility, pharmacy, survey, plan, and reference data delivered through SFTP, object storage, data shares, and APIs.
* Set engineering patterns for orchestration, incremental processing, dependency management, reruns, reconciliation, and production support across Airflow and related workflows.
* Drive cloud modernization work across AWS and Azure, including Terraform-based infrastructure, secure connectivity, secrets management, environment promotion, and operational readiness.
* Strengthen CI/CD and release practices using GitHub Actions and related tooling, with automated tests, security checks, observability, and controlled production deployment.
* Translate healthcare quality requirements into maintainable technical designs, partnering with domain experts on CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, PQA, measure calculations, and scenario modeling.
* Investigate complex data and platform issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable improvements to reliability, performance, cost, and data trust.
* Provide technical mentorship through architecture reviews, pull-request feedback, documentation, and reusable patterns without direct people-management responsibility.
* Collaborate with product, client delivery, security, and engineering leaders to scope work, surface dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver against customer commitments.

**What You'll Accomplish — Your Performance Objectives**

**In your first 30 days, you will:**

* Build working knowledge of the Lilac platform, healthcare-quality domain, Snowflake/dbt model layers, orchestration, cloud environments, release processes, and active customer commitments.
* Partner with engineering and domain leads to map critical data flows from ingestion through measure calculation, forecasting, reporting, and application consumption.
* Review current architecture, operational risks, and the AWS-to-Azure migration plan; complete an initial production-support shadowing cycle.

**In your first 60 days, you will:**

* Assume technical ownership of a meaningful data-platform or customer-integration workstream, including design, implementation plan, tests, observability, and rollout criteria.
* Deliver or materially advance a production-ready Snowflake/dbt, ingestion, or cloud-infrastructure enhancement with measurable quality or reliability outcomes.
* Establish clear design and review practices for the workstream and mentor teammates through code, model, and infrastructure reviews.

**In your first 90 days, you will:**

* Independently lead a cross-functional delivery from requirements through production validation, including dependency management, data reconciliation, release coordination, and post-release monitoring.
* Recommend and begin implementing prioritized improvements to scalability, test coverage, operational resilience, security, or cloud portability.
* Be a trusted technical owner for a core platform area and a reliable partner for healthcare-domain, product, and customer-delivery stakeholders.

**Who We're Looking For — The Competencies That Matter**

**Required**

* Substantial professional experience building and operating production data platforms, with senior-level ownership of architecture, delivery, and operational outcomes.
* Advanced SQL and data-modeling expertise, including hands-on production experience with Snowflake and dbt or closely comparable modern cloud-warehouse tooling.
* Experience designing robust batch data pipelines and ingestion frameworks, including schema mapping, incremental processing, testing, reconciliation, and failure recovery.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python or another production language, with disciplined version control, code review, automated testing, and documentation practices.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, People Data and Insights
description:
**The** **mission** **of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It's why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It's why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it's why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it's worth paying for.**

**About the Role**
------------------

The New York Times is rebuilding how we use people data. Instead of one-off reports and ad hoc pulls, we are building governed, reusable data tools that HR leaders, HR partners, and their counterparts use to make decisions. You will help build this layer. People data at The Times lives in several systems, each with its own definitions and history. You will turn that into a modeled, tested, documented foundation that products can be built on repeatedly. You will lead the models, transformations, and data quality behind every product this team ships. You will report to the Senior Director, People Data and Insights. You will work out of the New York office on a hybrid schedule.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* You will design, build, and maintain the data models and databases that our products run on.
* You will oversee the transformation layer from source systems into governed, tested, documented models.
* You will turn metric definitions from the data dictionary into executable logic, so that a definition and the number it produces cannot drift apart.
* You will build data quality into the pipeline: tests, validation, and reconciliation across sources that surface problems before team members do.
* You will work with the Program Manager to translate product requirements into models, and push back when a requirement and the underlying data do not agree.
* You will handle effective-dated and historical data correctly, so that point-in-time questions get point-in-time answers.
* You will implement and maintain access controls appropriate to compensation, demographic, and other sensitive data.
* You will document models and lineage so that all can understand why something was built the way it was.
* You will demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

  

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or an equivalent role building production data models.
* You are a SQL expert
* Strong dimensional modeling skills, and the judgment to know when to normalize and when not to.
* 5+ years of experience with a transformation framework such as dbt, and with version control and code review as part of normal practice.
* 5+ years of experience handling slowly changing dimensions, dated records, and point-in-time reporting.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience with HR or people data, and with systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, or One Model.
* Python for orchestration, API work, or data validation.
* 2+ years of experience with AWS data services.
* Familiarity with BI and analytics tooling such as Hex, Tableau, or Looker.
* 2+ years of experience in an organization with distinct populations operating under different rules, such as union and non-union groups.

title: Data Engineer
description:

The **Data Engineer** is responsible for building and maintaining data pipelines that move and transform data from Stuller’s systems into its cloud data warehouse. Working with senior team members, this role follows established data modeling patterns to support business intelligence, analytics, and data science. * Transform and integrate data from multiple sources into models that support reporting and analytics.

* Monitor data workflows, troubleshoot issues, and help identify and resolve data quality concerns.

* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to quality and detail.
* Strong communication skills within a team setting.
* Ability to manage assigned work, follow established guidelines, incorporate feedback through regular reviews, and escalate blockers appropriately.

title: Data Engineer (AI-ML Data Systems)
description:
**Company Overview**

Pantheon Data (a Kenific Holding company) is a private, small business based in the Washington, DC, area. Pantheon Data was founded in 2011, initially providing acquisition and supply chain management services to the US Coast Guard. Our service offerings have grown in the past ten years, including infrastructure resiliency, contact center operations, information technology, software engineering, program management, strategic communications, engineering, and cybersecurity. We have also grown our customer base to include commercial clients. The company has used this experience to expand our service offerings to other agencies within the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other Federal Civilian Agencies.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on **Data Engineer** to help design, build, and operate the data foundations that support advanced analytics, AI/ML, and intelligent document processing solutions. The right candidate is a strong engineer who understands how data moves through real systems: ingestion, orchestration, transformation, quality checks, storage, query patterns, operational monitoring, and delivery to downstream applications. This person should be comfortable working across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data held in relational, graph, and vector data stores, and should bring the judgment to build pipelines that are reliable, explainable, maintainable, and useful to the engineering teams and products that depend on them.

The ideal candidate has strong Python and SQL skills, understands when data should be modeled for operational use versus analytical use, and can reason clearly about batch processing, event-driven pipelines, data quality, lineage, and downstream consumption. They should be able to become productive quickly in a complex engineering environment, ask good questions, and build systems that other engineers can trust and extend. Experience with AWS, graph databases and query languages such as AQL, vector search, document data, or AI/ML data pipelines is valuable, but the core requirement is strong data engineering judgment: knowing how to move, structure, validate, and serve data reliably in support of real products and mission needs.

This role owns the data pipelines and data stores. You will partner closely with the Machine Learning Engineers, who own models, retrieval, extraction, and evaluation: they define how documents are chunked, embedded, enriched, and retrieved, and you build and run the pipelines and stores that apply those designs reliably at scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources.
* Develop Python-based processing workflows for data ingestion, normalization, validation, enrichment, and transformation.

* Work with graph databases and query languages such as ArangoDB/AQL to model relationships between entities, documents, and metadata, and to support traversal and relationship-driven queries.

* Support data pipelines that feed AI/ML, retrieval, document intelligence, analytics, and application workflows.
* Collaborate with machine learning engineers, software engineers, cloud engineers, and product stakeholders to turn ambiguous data problems into working software.
* Write maintainable code, participate in code reviews, document data flows, and contribute to engineering standards for testing, deployment, observability, and version control.
* Help improve the velocity of a growing engineering team by taking ownership of well-scoped data engineering work while continuing to grow into broader system ownership.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field from an accredited university.
* 5+ years of professional hands-on data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or closely related experience.
* Strong Python programming skills, including experience writing maintainable production-oriented code rather than only notebooks or one-off scripts.
* Strong SQL skills and practical understanding of data modeling, query performance, joins, indexing, schemas, normalization/denormalization, and data quality.
* Understanding of core data engineering concepts, including batch processing, event-driven workflows, ETL/ELT, orchestration, idempotency, retries, backfills, lineage, and failure handling.
* Working knowledge of OLTP versus OLAP systems and the tradeoffs between transactional databases, analytical stores, object storage, search-oriented systems, and graph and vector databases.
* Experience building or supporting data pipelines that move data between systems, such as APIs, databases, files, object storage, queues, warehouses, or downstream applications.
* Ability to reason about data correctness, schema changes, validation, reconciliation, duplicate handling, missing data, and operational recovery.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain data flow, design choices, limitations, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a distributed, cross-functional engineering environment and produce high-quality work with limited hand-holding.
* Ability to work effectively remotely in cross-functional teams.
* Ability to meet deadlines and produce quality work.
* Proficient in Microsoft Suite software including Outlook, Word, Excel, SharePoint, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* AWS data services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, Kinesis, EMR, RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift, OpenSearch, or CloudWatch.
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, AWS Step Functions, Glue, or similar.
* Experience with PySpark, Spark, Databricks, EMR, Snowflake, Redshift, or other distributed/analytical data platforms.
* Experience supporting AI/ML or RAG-style data workflows, including metadata enrichment, retrieval datasets, vector search, embeddings, evaluation datasets, or human validation workflows.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Overview:**

Expression is seeking a mid-level DevOps Engineer to support the National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) Federal Spectrum Data Systems (FSDS) program within the U.S. Department of Commerce.

The FSDS program supports the modernization of federal spectrum management systems through improved technology, automation, data integration, and interoperability. These systems help NTIA manage federal spectrum use and support essential government missions.

In this role, you will implement and maintain secure Azure cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines supporting applications, data services, and analytics. You will work with senior engineers, software developers, system administrators, and security personnel to support deployments across Azure Commercial, Government, and Secret cloud environments.

We're looking for someone who can take ownership of defined tasks, troubleshoot deployment issues, and turn repeatable work into reliable automation. You should bring practical DevOps experience, know when to ask questions, and be ready to build your skills in a secure federal environment.

**Location:** Washington, DC (3 days/week on-site).

**Cloud Infrastructure & Automation**

* Deploy, configure, and maintain Azure resources supporting unclassified and classified spectrum management systems.
* Create and update Infrastructure as Code using established patterns and tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
* Build and maintain Docker images and support container deployments using Kubernetes and Helm.
* Configure networking, access controls, and environment settings in coordination with senior engineers and security personnel.

**CI/CD & Secure Software Delivery**

* Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines that automate application builds, testing, and deployments.
* Integrate and maintain code, dependency, container image, and infrastructure security checks using established tools and processes.
* Maintain deployment scripts, pipeline templates, artifacts, and release configurations, and support release approvals.
* Support deployments within restricted environments, following approved procedures for software dependencies and artifact handling.
* Work with developers to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, and configuration differences across development, test, and production environments.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain assigned security controls in accordance with applicable Department of Commerce, NTIA, and federal requirements.
* Apply approved configuration baselines and STIGs where required, and remediate identified vulnerabilities with guidance from security personnel.
* Support RMF, ATO, and continuous monitoring activities by collecting technical evidence and tracking remediation actions.
* Maintain secure handling of credentials, secrets, and deployment artifacts throughout the delivery process.

**Reliability & Operations**

* Configure and maintain monitoring, centralized logging, and alerts using established tools and standards.
* Investigate infrastructure and application issues, review logs, and support incident response and root cause analysis.
* Execute and help test backup, recovery, and rollback procedures.
* Keep deployment documentation, configuration records, and operational runbooks current.
* Support new application releases and production transitions in coordination with the broader engineering team.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Active Secret security clearance or higher is required.
