**SRC Logistics (SRCL) | Full-Time | Primarily Remote — Missouri Residency Required**

SRC Logistics is seeking a **Senior DevOps Engineer** to own the infrastructure and operational processes supporting our enterprise SaaS platforms. Our systems serve international enterprise customers, support complex integrations, and process transactions with substantial financial consequences.

At SRCL, *this role combines senior software engineering capabilities with extensive systems administration experience*. You must understand how application code, databases, servers, networks, and security controls work together—and how changes affect customers and business operations.

Working closely with software engineering and IT, you will keep RLMS and related services reliable, secure, and maintainable. The position reports to the **Senior Software Architect.**

**What You Will Do**

* Independently identify, prioritize, and resolve operational needs within your assigned responsibilities and authority.
* Maintain and improve production and nonproduction Linux servers, LAMP environments, and supporting infrastructure across AWS and on-premises environments.
* Support SaaS availability, security, performance, and recovery commitments.
* Maintain backups, database replication and transaction-log shipping, certificates, DNS, access controls, and monitoring.
* Support infrastructure for internal and customer integrations, including APIs, SFTP, proxies, and file transfers.
* Investigate incidents across software and infrastructure boundaries and address underlying causes.
* Conduct routine operational and security reviews, remediate findings, and support customer security requirements.
* Automate recurring work and maintain technical documentation and recovery procedures.
* Plan and execute upgrades, migrations, and resilience improvements through established engineering change controls.

**Required Qualifications**

* Extensive hands-on experience operating production Linux environments supporting business-critical applications.
* Strong LAMP expertise, including Apache, PHP runtime configuration, and MySQL/MariaDB operations.
* Software engineering skills sufficient to troubleshoot application code, develop maintainable automation, and assess the impact of infrastructure changes.
* Experience with AWS, DNS, TLS certificates, reverse proxies, firewalls, and web application firewalls.
* Experience with backups, restoration testing, replication, monitoring, and production incident response.
* Ability to diagnose problems involving authentication, HTTP/API traffic, databases, networking, and customer integrations.
* Demonstrated discipline in planning, testing, documenting, reviewing, and safely executing production changes.
* Sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to work independently while keeping work and risks visible.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI in a hybrid fashion to assist with planning, scripting and documentation

**Helpful Experience**

Experience with Amazon Route 53, Check Point WAF, PRTG/SNMP, centralized logging, Microsoft Server administration, security scanning tools, and SOC 2 readiness is beneficial.

**Work Expectations**

This is a full-time, primarily remote position requiring Missouri residency. Most major production changes will occur outside normal business hours, with coordinated flex time during business hours. The role also includes after-hours response to significant service incidents under established coverage and escalation arrangements.

The position requires a transparent work schedule and accurate time reporting in 15-minute increments. Changes must follow SRCL’s planning, testing, technical review, and approval procedures. Routine work may be performed under documented, preapproved procedures and delegated authority.

Following an initial supervised training period, the engineer is expected to independently own assigned operational responsibilities. Direct production access and delegated authority will expand as technical competence, business familiarity, sound judgment, and adherence to security and change-control requirements are demonstrated.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Finance
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Responsible For**
Circle has made its reputation on being compliant and transparent. That reputation rests on data that is right.
  
  
As a Senior Data Engineer at Circle, you'll own the pipelines and data models that our product, treasury, finance, accounting and compliance teams depend on to meet their reporting and regulatory requirements and to run the business day to day. You'll work with large-scale on-chain and internal data and turn it into datasets that people can trust, explain and defend. You'll also have the chance to shape how we think about data reliability, so that the most important information we track is well organized, well monitored, and understandable to the people who rely on it. The right candidate will join a team of passionate engineers who care about data reliability, and your work will support our mission to be a world-class company driven by data. If you have a lot of attention to detail, get bothered when the numbers don't tie together, are excited to learn from our expert finance, accounting and treasury partners, and want to help people understand how our systems really work, we would love to talk to you.
  
  
**What You'll Work On**

* Partner with product engineering, finance, accounting, treasury, data analytics, and compliance teams to understand how new products and regulations will affect the data we need, and work with them to design the data requirements, models, business logic and pipelines that let us track and verify that we are meeting our obligations.
* Develop a strong understanding of how the business thinks about its money and its customers' balances, including custody, reserves and reconciliation, and partner with those teams to make the inner workings of our data transparent.
* Build the frameworks and systems that help us see when something might be going wrong, such as reconciliation, data quality checks, and alerting. Lead the charge to fix the immediate problem, then design solutions that keep it from happening again.
* Work with on-chain data at scale, ingesting and modeling data from multiple blockchains and handling the realities of that data, such as reorgs, late or missing records and upstream schema changes.
* Work with analytics and data science colleagues, and with the teams that consume your data, to make sure what you ship is documented, trustworthy and fits how it will be used. Reframe requests into better data products and push back early when a request isn't well scoped.
* Build scalable automated solutions using SQL, Python, orchestration and transformation tooling, and AI.
* Review code, models and designs, and mentor junior engineers.
* Occasionally share your work with larger audiences to educate them on the inner workings of our data and financial systems.

**You Will Aspire To Our Four Core Values**

* Multistakeholder - you have dedication and commitment to our customers, shareholders, employees and families and local communities.
* Mindful - you seek to be respectful, an active listener and to pay attention to detail.
* Driven by Excellence - you are driven by our mission and our passion for customer success which means you relentlessly pursue excellence, that you do not tolerate mediocrity and you work intensely to achieve your goals.
* High Integrity - you seek open and honest communication, and you hold yourself to very high moral and ethical standards. You reject manipulation, dishonesty and intolerance.

**What You’ll Bring To Circle**

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance or similar), or equivalent experience.
* 6+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and models.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python, and experience with a modern data stack: a cloud data warehouse, an orchestrator such as Airflow, and a transformation tool such as dbt.
* Experience owning a data domain end to end and being the person partners come to when something breaks or needs to change.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain clearly to non-technical audiences how the systems you own and design work.
* Strong collaboration skills that allow you to make sure that product engineering, data, finance, accounting, treasury and compliance are all on the same page about requirements and expectations.
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability: when a number looks wrong or a pipeline breaks, you take the lead in triaging it, investigating the root cause and driving it to resolution, and you keep cross-functional partners informed until it is fixed.
* Experience with blockchain data, financial services, banking or other regulated industries is a plus, but not required.

*Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.*
*Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.*
Base Pay Range: $152,500 - $205,000

. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

*accommodations@circle.com*

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - Cloud Foundations
description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.
  
  
If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.
  
  

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco/San Jose/Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

Cloud Foundations manages the account, access, and network foundation that Lambda's cloud infrastructure runs on, implementing governance and access controls in line with company policies. In practice that means AWS accounts and IAM, the VPC and transit network structure, DNS, and the Terraform execution platform that every change flows through.
  
  
This is a new team, and this role helps define it. Working closely with Security, GRC, IT, and the engineering teams that consume the foundation, this position turns policy into working controls and paved paths, so that hundreds of engineers can safely self-serve instead of filing requests.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and evolve the IaC execution platform (Terraform, Atlantis): how infrastructure changes are proposed, reviewed, and applied across the company
* Design and operate Lambda's cloud account, access, and IAM structure: organizational hierarchy, provisioning, and permission models
* Own the cloud network foundation: VPCs, Transit Gateway, and DNS, including the patterns other teams build on
* Drive AWS cloud governance: tagging standards, compliance guardrails, and cost visibility and accountability
* Implement least-privilege access and compliance automation in line with company requirements and policies, replacing manual access and provisioning work with self-service
* Help shape how this new team operates: its scope, priorities, and service boundaries
* Participate in an on-call rotation and keep the systems you own well-documented, reliable, and observable

**Who You Are**

* 6+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud platform, or cloud security engineering, or a closely related discipline
* Deep experience managing AWS at scale: multi-account organizations, IAM and permission boundaries, SCPs, and resource organization
* Strong foundation in infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and the tooling around it: modules, state management, and automated plan/apply workflows
* Solid cloud networking fundamentals: VPC design, transit and hybrid connectivity, DNS, and edge/CDN configuration
* Comfortable writing the automation and tooling that runs the foundation (Go and/or Python), and treating it as a product: real users, real quality standards, and things that actually get adopted
* Use AI tools as a natural part of how you work, and hold their output to the same bar as your own: you review it, verify it, and own what ships
* Build for the many, not for one team or one use case
* Comfortable with ambiguity and clarifying ownership
* Distill the right problem out of the noise: ask the why behind the why
* Own what you build past the point it ships: monitor it, measure whether it actually helped, and act on what you learn
* Sweat the details and aren't satisfied until things run smoothly

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building agentic workflows that automate meaningful parts of infrastructure operations or governance
* Experience implementing controls for a compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001) without turning it into manual toil
* Cloud cost management and FinOps experience
* Hands-on experience with Azure, GCP, or OCI alongside AWS

**Salary Range Information**
The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.
  
  
**About Lambda**

* Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
* Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
* We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
* Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
* We offer generous cash & equity compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
* 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
* Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
Senior Cloud Engineer at Tractian
  
  
In a data-driven company like Tractian, the Cloud Engineering team is essential for maintaining robust, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructures. This team implements automation, security practices, and rigorous protocols to safeguard our digital assets and data infrastructure across diverse cloud environments. The Cloud Engineering team plays a crucial role in our internal operations and client solutions by ensuring continuous integration, secure deployments, and advanced observability.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for contributing to a technical team, safeguarding the company's cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS and OCI, with occasional projects involving GCP and Azure. Your role involves implementing state-of-the-art infrastructure solutions, embedding robust security measures, and ensuring efficient deployment processes. This position requires deep technical expertise and a hands-on approach to infrastructure automation, security integration, and observability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect, implement, and secure scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS, OCI, and occasionally GCP/Azure.
* Oversee CI/CD pipelines, enhancing them through GitHub Actions and GitHub Enterprise.
* Maintain and optimize Kubernetes clusters and AWS ECS environments, including GPU infrastructure management.
* Embed comprehensive security measures, integrating advanced security tools and practices proactively.
* Implement observability and monitoring solutions with Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Sentry.
* Utilize Jira effectively for project management and issue tracking.
* Collaborate closely with other engineering teams to drive secure and efficient development practices.
* Address vulnerabilities, security incidents, and tickets promptly and proactively.
* Field DevOps / SRE intake queues.
* Execute Kubernetes service migrations from AWS (EKS) to OCI (OKE), ensuring workload compatibility, stability, and minimal disruption.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Engineering, DevSecOps, or similar roles.
* Extensive knowledge of AWS and OCI; familiarity with GCP/Azure preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes (k8s), including cluster management, pod architecture, and GPU-based workloads; CKA or CKAD certification a plus.
* Expert in Terraform (primary IaC tool), Helm, Docker, and AWS ECS.
* Strong experience with GitHub Actions, GitHub Enterprise, and Cloudflare.
* Proficiency in monitoring tools including Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Sentry.
* Solid understanding of security best practices and compliance frameworks including SOC2 and ISO 27001.
* Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation purposes.
* Docker Kompose experience a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications in AWS, OCI, Kubernetes (CKA, CKAD), or relevant cloud engineering certifications.
* Prior experience in high-growth tech environments.

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to lead and directly influence infrastructure and security strategy.
* Innovative and challenging technical environment.
* Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive Compensation
* Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off (PTO): 15 Days
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Wellhub Membership - Access a wide range of gyms and training programs.
* Long-Term Benefit - After four years of service, earn a fully funded trip anywhere in the world.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**About FiscalNote, Inc.**
FiscalNote combines the latest AI technology with decades of trusted expertise to simplify the way you track and shape policy. Through our flagship suite, PolicyNote, we deliver the most complete view of the policy landscape — from local to global— in platform and through API. By uniting the trusted reporting of CQ and Roll Call with the grassroots power of VoterVoice, we deliver end-to-end policy intelligence with unmatched clarity and speed. We zoom into the details so you can see the big picture, making sure you’re not just in the loop, but in the lead.
  
  
To learn more about FiscalNote and our suite of solutions, visit FiscalNote.com or follow us across social media platforms @FiscalNote.
  
  
**About The Role**
At FiscalNote, we build platforms that connect people to their governments, and our Data Analytics team builds tools, processes, and reporting capabilities to integrate operational data and enable enterprise decision making. As an Analytics Engineer on the Data Analytics team, you recognize the value of properly managing, analyzing and reporting data to improve operational efficiencies, customer experience, and financial performance, and want to build the data models and analytics capabilities that empower decision making across the company. You will work closely with our product and operations teams to build clean, scalable analytics models which are the backbone of our reporting and advanced analytics capabilities. This role reports to the Director of Data Analytics & Business Intelligence.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Data Analytics team sits at the intersection of data, technology, and strategy at FiscalNote. We build and maintain the systems, models, and reporting infrastructure that enable the entire business to operate with clarity and confidence. Our work connects every function from sales to finance to customer success, ensuring that the right data reaches the right people at the right time to drive informed decisions. Our core mission is to understand the business and impact decision-making across all departments through the effective use of data. We are AI-forward but we do not vibe code. Experience with AI and agentic harnesses is a plus but not required for this role.
  
  
**About You**
You are curious, thoughtful, and detail-oriented. You see technical challenges as puzzles to solve, and can generalize a solution to an individual problem out to an entire class of problems. You dislike doing the same thing manually over and over and enjoy automating systems. You take pride in your work and do not like leaving things half-done. You can operate independently, but have support from your team as needed. You are proficient in SQL and have hands-on experience building data models in dbt. You know how to explore and analyze unfamiliar datasets and find insights in the data. You want to deepen your technical expertise and may have experience with Python or other general-purpose programming languages.
  
  
*****Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.*****
**What To Expect**

* Build and maintain dbt models with SQL and Jinja for analytics and dataops across departments including finance, product, sales, and customer success
* Harden analytics models via tests, freshness checks, constraints, etc. to ensure the quality and correctness of our data
* Create reports and dashboards in Metabase using the visual query builder
* Conduct ad-hoc analysis to understand our data in depth and answer business questions
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to understand their respective business domains and design analytics solutions for them

**What Sets You Apart**

* 4+ years in analytics engineering, data analysis, or a related technical role
* Excellent data modeling proficiency with an eye toward simplicity and modularity
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and CTEs
* Production experience in at least one dbt project
* Strong dimensional, relational, or semantic data modeling skills
* Familiarity with structured, semi-structured and unstructured data formats
* Experience with data visualization products such as Metabase, Looker, and Tableau
* Ability to explore and analyze complex datasets
* Strong communication skills and ability to write thorough, high-quality documentation
* Basic statistical analysis to identify trends, outliers, etc.
* Git-based development, pull requests, code review, and CI/CD
* Experience with Snowflake and SnowSQL (preferred)
* Experience with Metabase (preferred)
* Python proficiency (preferred)
* Experience performing data munging and analysis with tools and environments like Pandas/Polars and Jupyter Notebooks (preferred)

**The Pay Range For This Role Is**
130,000 - 145,000 USD per year(United States)

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Join Casey’s Analytics Solutions team as an Analytics Engineer and help shape how data is used across the organization. In this role, you’ll build the scalable Power BI models and analytical foundations that turn complex data into trusted, easy-to-use insights for teams across the business. This isn’t an ad-hoc reporting role. You’ll work at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and business intelligence, designing enterprise-grade semantic models, improving Power BI performance, and creating solutions that make self-service analytics easier and more consistent.
  
  
Just as importantly, we’re looking for someone who enjoys teaching and developing others. You’ll help analysts across the organization strengthen their Power BI capabilities through training, coaching, technical communities, standards, and knowledge sharing. If you love solving complex data problems and helping others become better at solving them too, this could be a great fit.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build analytics that scale: Design, build, and maintain enterprise Power BI semantic models that provide trusted analytical foundations for multiple areas of the business.
* Create better data models: Develop dimensional models, star schemas, standardized business metrics, DAX measures, calculation groups, and model relationships that are intuitive, maintainable, and high performing.
* Optimize Power BI performance: Improve refresh and query performance through incremental refresh, partitions, aggregations, and other optimization techniques for large-scale datasets.
* Partner across data and the business: Work closely with Data Engineering and business teams to ensure data is structured for effective analytical consumption and translate complex needs into durable analytics solutions.
* Set the standard: Help establish and champion Power BI best practices, including modeling standards, naming conventions, row-level security, documentation, governance, and dataset lifecycle management.
* Enable self-service analytics: Build well-documented semantic models that make it easier for analysts and business teams to confidently answer questions with data.
* Teach, coach, and build capability: Develop training, certification programs, technical communities, and knowledge-sharing opportunities that grow Power BI expertise across Casey’s.
* Be a trusted technical resource: Coach and consult with Power BI-enabled analysts across business functions, helping them apply best practices and build stronger analytics solutions.

Casey's is open to hiring at multiple levels (Associate, Analyst, Senior) based on candidate experience.
  
  
**Compensation:**
Starting pay range:‏‏‎ $81,500 ‎-‏‏‎ ‎$112,100.‏‏‎ Actual pay may vary based on Casey’s assessment of the candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, and qualifications. Other factors impacting pay include local prevailing wages and internal equity. This position is eligible for an annual cash bonus based on company performance. Our full salary range for this role does extend beyond the hiring range listed, allowing team members the opportunity to continue to grow within the company.
  
  
What you can expect when you join the Casey's Team:
  
  

* A transformative culture putting service first and taking pride in caring for our guests, our communities, and each other.
* Opportunities to use cutting edge technologies and enterprise-wide collaboration to enable our strategy and drive world class service.
* We're here for families! Great benefits including choices in medical plans, dental, vision, life insurance, charitable giving programs, parental leave and an onsite Child Development Center.
* Competitive pay, 401k company match up to 6%, vacation & sick time, paid holidays, volunteer time, and an onsite cafeteria.
* Dress for your day dress code, jeans are welcomed!
* The opportunity to work for a big company that has not lost our small company feel. Our senior leadership team is engaged, involved and accessible!

What are you waiting for? Come be a part of a company that is growing, transforming and is here for good!
  
  
**Requirements**
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Analytics, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent years of related work experience.
* 3-5 years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, or semantic data modeling.
* Advanced Power BI expertise, with experience in:

+ Semantic model design
+ DAX (including performance tuning)
+ Power Query (M)
+ Row-level security (RLS)

* Strong foundation in dimensional modeling (facts, dimensions, star schemas).
* Proven experience optimizing Power BI performance, including query plans and refresh strategies.
* Proficiency with SQL and working with analytical data platforms.

Qualified candidates must live within a daily commutable distance of Casey's Store Support Center in Ankeny, IA and willing to work onsite 5 days per week.
  
  
**Preferred Technical Experience**

* Experience with Power BI companion tools such as Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and ALM Toolkit.
* Familiarity with source control and deployment pipelines for BI assets (Azure DevOps, GitHub).
* Experience working with cloud data platforms and lake house architectures (Databricks strongly preferred; Snowflake or BigQuery acceptable).
* Understanding of CI/CD patterns and environment promotion for semantic models.
* Exposure to large datasets and enterprise BI governance practices.

This position requires authorization to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Casey’s will not provide sponsorship or employer support for applications or petitions for F-1 OPT, F-1 CPT, H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, J-1, or any other employment-based visa.

title: BI & DATA ENGINEER
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The BI & Data Engineer builds and operates the systems that move data from vendor and internal source systems into Azure, and turns that data into reporting the business relies on. This is a hands-on build-and-run role on a two-person data team: you will write the extraction, build the pipeline, model the data, publish the Power BI, answer the business questions that come back, and own it when it breaks.

Enterprise architecture and platform design are set by the Enterprise Data lead. You are the person who implements it — with real input into how, and real ownership of what you build.

This role includes recurring reporting work that is manual today, including Excel-based reports and ad-hoc requests from finance and operations. Taking that over is part of the job, and so is systematically automating it. We are not looking for someone to maintain manual processes indefinitely; we are looking for someone who will replace them.

Several of our source systems are vendor-managed platforms with limited, undocumented, or unreliable APIs. A meaningful share of this work is engineering dependable extraction from systems that were not built to be integrated with. Comfort in that environment matters more here than credentials.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

***Reporting & Business Support***

* Own recurring weekly and monthly reporting cycles, including reports that are manual today
* Build and maintain Power BI datasets, reports, and DAX measures
* Serve as first point of contact for reporting and analytics requests from finance, operations, and leadership
* Translate business questions directly into reporting without an intermediary
* Systematically replace manual and Excel-based reporting with automated equivalents, and document what you replace

***Data Extraction & Integration***

* Build and maintain extraction from vendor and internal systems into Azure — REST APIs, database sources, SFTP, and file-based feeds
* Engineer around real-world API constraints: missing pagination, row caps, rate limits, intermittent failures, and undocumented behavior
* Implement partitioned, resumable, idempotent extraction so a failed run resumes where it stopped rather than starting over
* Detect and handle silent failure modes, including truncated result sets and partial loads
* Reverse-engineer undocumented vendor endpoints and maintain that documentation internally

***Pipelines & Data Modeling***

* Build, schedule, and maintain pipelines in Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, or equivalent
* Land raw source data durably before transformation so loads can be replayed without re-extraction
* Build and maintain layered SQL models from raw landing through curated reporting tables, to defined architectural standards
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting; act as first response when pipelines fail
* Keep pipeline and extraction code in source control with repeatable deployment

***Data Quality & Reconciliation***

* Run reconciliation between source systems and reporting, including control totals that surface incomplete extraction
* Investigate discrepancies to root cause and remediate rather than annotate
* Treat unexplained variance as a defect, not a reporting caveat

***Security & Vendor Engagement***

* Follow least-privilege access practice; keep credentials and secrets in Key Vault rather than in code or configuration files
* Meet compliance and audit expectations for regulated data
* Reproduce and document vendor-side issues with evidence to support escalation

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 3–7 years in a data engineering, BI engineering, or hybrid analytics role
* Hands-on Azure data services experience: Data Factory, Blob Storage / Data Lake, Azure SQL
* Strong SQL, including performance work on large tables
* Power BI: datasets, DAX measures, refresh configuration
* Python or C# at a level sufficient to write and maintain API extraction code independently
* Practical experience consuming REST APIs: authentication, pagination, rate limits, retry and error handling
* Advanced Excel, including automation
* Source control (Git) and repeatable deployment practice
* Comfort working directly with business stakeholders and owning the conversation end to end
* Demonstrated ownership of production systems, including responsibility when they fail

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience as the sole or primary data person at a small or mid-sized company
* Integration experience with Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, ADP, or Entra ID / Azure AD
* Microsoft Fabric or Synapse
* Regulated or compliance-driven environment — healthcare, medical waste, or finance
* Waste, logistics, or field-service operations domain knowledge
CI/CD or infrastructure-as-code for data pipelines  
* Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: ML/AI Data and Cloud Engineer
description:
We are seeking an **ML/AI Data & Cloud Engineer** to design, build, and operate the cloud-native components that deliver large-scale, data-intensive AI capabilities.

This role focuses on building scalable data platforms, distributed processing systems, and model-serving infrastructure that enable end-to-end machine learning workflows in production. You will work closely with data scientists and product teams to transform advanced models into reliable, high-performance services.

The ideal candidate combines strong engineering skills with a solid grounding in quantitative methods, and is comfortable leveraging modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate research, prototyping, and delivery.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design and implement cloud-native data platforms that integrate structured and unstructured data into scalable data lakes or unified data systems
* Build and maintain robust ingestion pipelines using API-driven, streaming, and batch processing workflows
* Architect data processing systems for feature engineering, large-scale computation, and model training support
* Develop and operate model-serving infrastructure enabling real-time and batch inference via APIs
* Develop advanced modeling approaches combining statistical methods and machine learning (e.g., regression, gradient boosting, random forests, and ensemble/meta-learning techniques)
* Implement model validation and monitoring frameworks addressing bias, drift, robustness, and performance
* Tune cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency across compute, storage, and data transfer layers
* Build and maintain MLOps pipelines for model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and automated retraining
* Ensure platform reliability, fault tolerance, and data integrity across all stages of the data and model lifecycle

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 3+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, ML platform engineering, machine learning engineering, AI systems, quantitative modeling, or data-intensive platform development
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience with backend, data engineering, or experience with modern ML frameworks and data tooling
* Experience designing and operating cloud-native systems (AWS or equivalent)
* Experience building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines and working with high-volume datasets
* Experience developing APIs or microservices for production systems
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, data processing, and system reliability concepts
* Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and computational thinking

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and workflows (e.g., LLM-based coding assistants, agentic development environments, or similar tools)
* Exposure to machine learning workflows and the infrastructure required to support training and inference at scale
* Experience with cloud services (e.g., AWS: S3, EC2, Lambda, Glue, SageMaker, or equivalents)
* Experience with containerization (Docker/Podman, ECS)
* Experience with data lake architectures and multi-source data ingestion patterns
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, including reproducibility, model versioning, and deployment automation
* Working knowledge of statistics, econometrics, quantitative modeling, and optimization
* Familiarity with cloud cost optimization strategies and performance tuning

**What You’ll Work On**

* Scalable cloud data platforms integrating diverse, high-volume datasets
* Foundational predictive models that adapt across markets rather than being rebuilt for each use case
* A cloud-native platform supporting data ingestion, model training, inference, and scalable deployment
* Intelligent systems for ranking, matching, scoring, and explanation of model outputs
* Robust evaluation and monitoring frameworks for model performance and reliability
* API-driven integration of AI capabilities into broader software ecosystems

**Why Join Us?**

You’ll work on challenging, high-scale systems at the intersection of data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and machine learning. This role offers the opportunity to build foundational platforms that support advanced AI capabilities while shaping architecture, tooling, and best practices in a rapidly evolving space.

title: Data Engineer Client Data Operations
description:
**An important note before applying:** ***We're a small, growing team, and openings like this can attract 1,000 or more applications. We want to give as many qualified candidates as possible a fair shot, but there's only so much a small team can do when reviewing that volume while also doing the work that's the reason this opportunity exists.***

***To help, we're using an AI-powered verbal screening tool where you can talk through your experience and how you approach problems. We know... we know... another AI tool in the hiring process. We're not exactly fans of that either, but we believe it gives more people an opportunity to show us what they know beyond what's on their résumé.***

***We're not looking for perfect or rehearsed answers. In fact, we'd much rather hear a genuine, imperfect answer than something polished that doesn't really tell us anything. We want to hear about your actual experience, and our team will make the hiring decisions, not the AI.***

***Please complete the screening questions as part of your application. Quick Apply or Easy Apply submissions without completed responses may not be considered.***

 **Data Engineer Client Data Operations**  
Location: Remote (United States; Dallas, TX area preferred, not required)

**About Limetree**
==================

Limetree is a performance-focused marketing agency that blends behavioral science, data, and practical marketing know-how to help organizations say the right thing, to the right people, in ways that actually work.  
We specialize in industries where customer interaction is high-value and high-stakes, including healthcare, financial services, and other regulated or complex environments. Our work connects insight to action, using behavioral science and data to inform strategy, creative, and delivery in ways that drive measurable outcomes for our clients.  
  
Limetree has been recognized multiple times on the Inc. 5000 as well as a national Inc. Best Workplace, and holds multiple patents that inform our approach to marketing performance, decision-making, and execution.

**Role Summary**
================

We are hiring a hands-on Data Engineer to own how new client data gets into our systems and keep the pipelines behind our direct mail, digital marketing, and reporting work reliable. You will take unfamiliar feeds, make sense of them, build repeatable ingestion processes, and catch problems before they become bad data or missed campaign deliveries.  
  
This is a production ownership role. You will be the first person working through data and pipeline failures and, as you learn our processes, take over the technical execution of routine mail drops. You will work closely with our Senior Analytics Engineer, who depends on clean, consistent data for downstream analytics and reporting. This is an individual contributor role, not a people-management position.

**What You Will Do**
====================

**Onboard Client Data**
-----------------------

* Set up new feeds from client and vendor systems, including SFTP and scheduled file deliveries; identify source fields, changes, missing data, and inconsistent formats.
* Map incoming data into established schemas and tables, identify sensitive fields, and apply approved privacy and access rules. Raise ambiguous data or policy questions before moving forward.
* Build the validation and matching steps that make data usable, including record counts, identity matching or LTID assignment, and CASS/NCOA processing where relevant.
* Document each feed so someone else can understand the inputs, transformations, checks, outputs, and what to do when it fails.

**Build New Pipelines**
-----------------------

* Build and extend SQL, Python, and Spark pipelines as we bring on new direct mail and digital clients, using consistent data structures rather than one-off solutions.
* Set up scheduled jobs, file watchers, transformations, testing, and monitoring so new data streams run with minimal manual intervention.
* Improve existing pipelines as source files, schemas, tools, and business requirements change.

**Keep Production and Campaign Delivery Running**
-------------------------------------------------

* Own the day-to-day checks and troubleshooting for current Databricks workflows, AWS jobs, and related tools; investigate failures and fix root causes.
* Handle schema drift, bad source files, expired credentials, broken dependencies, stale data, and vendor-tool issues; improve alerts, recovery steps, and runbooks.
* Take ownership of routine audience and mail-drop production, including suppressions, address hygiene, count reconciliation, QC, and vendor file preparation, within established approvals.
* Flag risks to scheduled client drops early, explain what is affected, and recommend a safe path to resolution.

**Work With the Team**
----------------------

* Hand off reliable, documented data to our Senior Analytics Engineer for downstream modeling, analysis, and reporting; work together when definitions or matching rules need decisions.
* Partner with campaign, account, and technical colleagues to clarify requirements and resolve issues without making them chase the status of a feed or delivery.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* First 90 days: Understand the main feeds and drops, take over daily checks, fix production issues with support, and independently set up or improve a client data flow with review.
* By six months: Own routine new-client ingestion and pipeline maintenance, be the first responder for issues, and run standard mail drops with documented quality and release checks.
* The result: New client data is repeatable and trustworthy; pipeline failures have a clear owner; routine troubleshooting and drop execution no longer depend on a single senior colleague.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Experience and Judgment**
---------------------------

* Several years of hands-on data engineering experience, ideally four or more, including pipelines you have operated in production and failures you personally diagnosed.
* Comfort taking a messy or poorly documented source file from first inspection through a reliable production data feed.
* Strong attention to detail: you reconcile counts, question suspicious data, and make fixes that prevent a problem from coming back.
* Able to work independently, explain technical issues plainly, and know when a business rule or privacy question needs an owner to decide.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Strong SQL and Python; practical experience with Spark or similar large-scale data processing.
* Production cloud data engineering experience. We currently use Databricks and AWS, but value strong AWS-native or comparable experience as our platform evolves.
* Experience with orchestration, monitoring, schema mapping, file-based integrations, access controls, Git, testing, and operational documentation.
* Careful handling of personally identifiable or protected health information in regulated data environments.

**Helpful Background**
======================

* Direct mail and/or digital marketing audience data, including deduplication, suppressions, CASS/NCOA, AccuZIP, AccuTrace, USPS tracking, or digital marketing sources and APIs.
* Healthcare, Medicare, or health plan marketing data; SFTP, S3, Parquet, and client-facing reporting feeds.

**Why Join Limetree**
=====================

You will own real production work, see the effect of getting data right, and improve the processes as you learn them. We need someone who likes building reliable systems and taking ownership of how they run.

**Compensation**
================

Base salary: $115,000-$145,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Position Summary
  
Penn Foster Group is seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to help shape the future of our enterprise data platform and AI strategy. This is a highly visible technical Leadership role responsible for architecting, building, and evolving our modern cloud data platform while establishing engineering standards, mentoring a growing team, and driving innovation across the organization.
  
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will serve as a Senior Technical expert for our Databricks Lakehouse platform, providing hands-on Leadership across data ingestion, transformation, governance, analytics enablement, and AI-ready data products. You will partner closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Platform Engineering, Security, Data Governance, and MLOps teams to build trusted, scalable, and governed data solutions that power enterprise analytics, machine learning, and generative AI.
  
This role combines deep technical expertise with Leadership, mentoring, and strategic influence. You'll help establish the long-term technical direction of Penn Foster Group's data ecosystem while coaching and developing engineers, driving engineering excellence, and implementing modern data engineering best practices.
  
  
Why Join Penn Foster Group?
  
Penn Foster Group is in the midst of an exciting enterprise-wide data platform modernization journey. We are investing in a modern cloud-native architecture built on Databricks, Azure, and AI-enabled technologies that will become the foundation for analytics, operational reporting, machine learning, and generative AI across the company.
  
This is a unique opportunity to join at a transformational point in our technology journey. Rather than simply maintaining existing systems, you'll help define the future of our data platform—shaping architecture, engineering standards, governance, and the adoption of emerging AI technologies that will influence how data is used across the organization for years to come. You will also be a key player in our drive for Self Service Analytics at PFG.
  
**As our Senior Data Engineer, you will have the opportunity to:**
  

* Help define the long-term strategy for Penn Foster Group's modern Data & AI platform.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions around Databricks, Azure, Unity Catalog, semantic data products, and AI-powered analytics.
* Build modern, scalable data products that enable self-service analytics and generative AI.
* Lead adoption of emerging Databricks capabilities, including Genie, AI/BI, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and other evolving platform innovations.
* Mentor and develop a growing Data Engineering team while establishing engineering standards that scale across the organization.
* Partner directly with technology and business Leaders to solve meaningful business problems using modern cloud and AI technologies.

If you're passionate about building modern data platforms, mentoring engineers, and helping shape the future of AI-enabled analytics, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Technical Leadership
  

* Provide technical Leadership for the Data Engineering team through architecture guidance, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering best practices.
* Mentor and develop junior and mid-level Data Engineers, fostering technical growth, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Establish engineering standards for software development, testing, CI/CD, documentation, observability, and operational excellence.
* Senior technical design discussions, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and drive adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Champion a culture of quality, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Data Platform & Databricks Leadership
  

* Serve as the technical Senior Engineer for Penn Foster Group's Databricks Lakehouse platform.
* Design, build, and support scalable enterprise data pipelines using SQL, Python, Apache Spark, and Databricks.
* Define best practices for Databricks development, including Workflows, Repos, Jobs, notebooks, reusable Python libraries, Git integration, cluster policies, SQL Warehouses, and deployment automation.
* Design and optimize Delta Lake architectures using Medallion patterns, Delta optimization, Liquid Clustering, and Photon.
* Build reusable ingestion frameworks supporting batch, streaming, CDC, and API-based integration patterns.
* Optimize Spark workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud cost efficiency.

AI & Databricks Genie Enablement
  

* Partner with Analytics and business stakeholders to develop trusted semantic data products that power Databricks Genie.
* Design and maintain Genie Spaces and Genie Ontologies that accurately represent business entities, relationships, metrics, and terminology.
* Establish best practices for semantic modeling, governed metrics, business metadata, and AI-ready datasets.
* Evaluate and implement emerging Databricks AI capabilities to improve self-service analytics and business productivity.
* Collaborate with Data Science and MLOps teams to enable machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics initiatives.

Data Architecture, Governance & Operational Excellence
  

* Design scalable Lakehouse architectures supporting analytics, reporting, AI, and operational data products.
* Partner with Data Governance teams to implement enterprise governance using Unity Catalog, including data lineage, fine-grained security, metadata management, and access controls.
* Champion automated testing, monitoring, observability, data quality, and production reliability.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for complex production issues and Senior root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives while balancing delivery, scalability, maintainability, and operational excellence.

Cross-Functional Partnership
  

* Collaborate with Business Intelligence, Product, Platform Engineering, Security, and MLOps teams to deliver trusted, scalable data products.
* Translate business requirements into modern technical solutions that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI, and strategic decision-making.
* Contribute to technical roadmaps, platform strategy, and the continued evolution of Penn Foster Group's Data & Analytics capabilities.

Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or Data Platform Engineering.
* 2+ years of experience leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineering teams.
* Demonstrated success developing engineers while driving engineering excellence and technical standards.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders.

Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven sodium-ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid.

 

Sodium-ion is cheap, readily available, and safe — making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market.

 

Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt-level innovation at world-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, SunPower, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners including TDK Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and GM Ventures.

 

We recently announced America's first sodium-ion grid storage factory in Sacramento with production starting Q1 2027, and over $1B in signed customer commitments including Jupiter Power and Energy Vault.

 

 

**About the Role**

 

Peak Energy is looking for a DevOps Engineer to build and scale the cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and automation systems supporting our grid-scale battery storage technology.

 

As Peak grows from pilot deployments to gigawatt-scale production, our software infrastructure must scale alongside our products. You'll help establish the foundation that enables our engineering teams to develop, test, and deploy software efficiently and reliably.

 

This is a hands-on infrastructure engineering role focused on cloud services, Infrastructure as Code, database provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation. You'll build and maintain the systems that connect our development environments, manufacturing operations, and deployed battery systems to the cloud.

 

You'll work closely with software, test, and manufacturing engineering teams to improve automation, reliability, and scalability across our software infrastructure.

 

**What You'll Do**

 

* Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure supporting Peak's battery storage software, data pipelines, and engineering applications.

* Develop and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for software builds, testing, and deployment across development and production environments.

* Define, provision, and manage cloud resources using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, establishing scalable and repeatable infrastructure practices as Peak expands its manufacturing operations and deployed battery fleet.

* Partner with software and test engineering teams to integrate automated testing and validation into development and deployment workflows.

* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to improve infrastructure reliability, performance, and observability.

**What You'll Bring (Minimum Qualifications)**

 

* 4+ years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical role.

* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform or equivalent tooling.

* Experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar tools.

* Experience provisioning, configuring, and managing cloud infrastructure on Azure, AWS, or GCP.

* Experience deploying and managing cloud databases, including PostgreSQL or similar relational database systems.

* Proficiency in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages for infrastructure automation.

* Experience with cloud networking, access management, monitoring, and infrastructure security.

* Experience supporting software deployments and troubleshooting production infrastructure.

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized application deployments.

 

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure Functions, Service Bus, Azure Monitor, or Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

* Experience with IoT device infrastructure and management.

* Experience supporting automated testing infrastructure, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or engineering validation environments.

* Familiarity with data ingestion pipelines, streaming infrastructure, or cloud-connected devices.

* Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Datadog, or Application Insights.

* Experience supporting manufacturing systems, industrial automation, IoT, or hardware-integrated software.

* Familiarity with database administration, backup and recovery, and infrastructure performance optimization.

* Prior experience building infrastructure and deployment processes in an early-stage or rapidly scaling engineering organization.

 

**Our Core Values**

 

* ****Speed Through Focus****

  — Move fast but understand why. Focus on the goal, don't sacrifice quality.

* ****Mission Over Self****

  — Put the company's mission and team success ahead of individual interests.

* ****Face the Brutal Truth****

  — Transparency, honesty, big-picture curiosity. Fearless decision making.

* ****Be a Good Person****

  — Kindness, collaboration, and teamwork.

 

**Compensation & Benefits**

 

The salary range for this role is
**$180,000 - $240,000**

, with actual pay varying based on work location, experience, and skills. Our competitive benefits package includes:

 

* Flexible time off

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

* Strong 401(k) plan

* Equity opportunities

* Many great work perks

Join us to thrive in a supportive environment while making a meaningful impact in the energy sector!

 

At Peak Energy Technologies Inc., we believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace makes us a more capable, innovative, and competitive company. We welcome people who represent diversity in their backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. Peak Energy Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, aiming to reach our company's full potential by cultivating an inclusive workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: DevOps & Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**  
The DevOps & Systems Engineer is responsible for the reliability, security, automation, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing administration of the company's cloud and internal technology infrastructure.  
This position serves as the primary technical resource for **Microsoft Azure infrastructure and DevOps operations**, while also supporting internal servers, networking, hardware, identity, backups, and other systems-engineering responsibilities.  
The role works closely with software development, data engineering, security, and business technology teams to ensure applications and infrastructure are deployed consistently, monitored effectively, secured appropriately, and designed for scalability and high availability.  
The position should emphasize automation and repeatability rather than manual administration. SafePoint's existing technical direction already incorporates Azure PaaS services, PowerShell automation, Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps/Git-based CI/CD, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.  
  
**Duties and responsibilities**

* **Azure Cloud Administration:** Manage and support Azure subscriptions, resource groups, App Services, Azure Functions, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL resources, Service Bus, networking, Key Vault, monitoring, backups, and related services. Maintain appropriate development, UAT, and production environments and ensure resources are configured according to company standards.
* **DevOps & CI/CD:** Build, maintain, and improve Azure DevOps pipelines for build, testing, deployment, and release management. Administer repositories, branching strategies, service connections, deployment approvals, environment variables, secrets, and release processes. Promote repeatable deployments and minimize manual production changes. SafePoint's cloud architecture already identifies Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, release management, automated testing, and quality gates as core platform capabilities.
* **Infrastructure as Code & Automation:** Develop and maintain Bicep, ARM, Terraform, PowerShell, or similar automation for infrastructure provisioning and configuration. Automate repetitive administrative, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance tasks. Existing SafePoint role requirements similarly call for Bicep/ARM/Terraform and PowerShell-based cloud automation.
* **Monitoring & Production Support:** Configure Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, alerts, dashboards, availability monitoring, and performance metrics. Investigate outages, performance degradation, failed deployments, service interruptions, and infrastructure-related application issues. Participate in root-cause analysis and document remediation actions.
* **Systems Engineering:** Administer and troubleshoot Windows servers, operating systems, DNS, DHCP, certificates, file services, authentication, scheduled services, service accounts, and other corporate infrastructure. Perform system upgrades, patching, configuration management, capacity planning, and lifecycle management.
* **Identity & Access Management:** Support Microsoft Entra ID, application registrations, managed identities, service principals, role-based access control, MFA, SSO, privileged access, and least-privilege security practices.
* **Networking:** Support Azure and internal networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, private endpoints, VPN connectivity, DNS, routing, firewall rules, IP restrictions, and connectivity troubleshooting between cloud, internal, and third-party systems.
* **Internal Hardware & Infrastructure:** Support internal servers, network equipment, switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, storage devices, conference-room or shared IT equipment, and other business-critical hardware. Coordinate hardware replacements, upgrades, warranties, and lifecycle planning.
* **Backup, Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Maintain backup and recovery processes for cloud and internal systems. Periodically validate restoration procedures, point-in-time recovery, redundancy, failover, and disaster-recovery capabilities. SafePoint's current cloud architecture calls out Azure Backup, point-in-time recovery, geo-redundancy, high availability, and failover as platform requirements.
* **Security & Compliance:** Apply system hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation, encryption, secret management, logging, access controls, and security best practices. Work with security resources to address findings and maintain systems appropriate for a regulated insurance environment.
* **Cost & Capacity Management:** Monitor Azure resource utilization and cloud spending. Identify oversized, unused, or inefficient resources and recommend changes that improve performance or reduce cost. Maintain budgets and alerts where appropriate.
* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain infrastructure diagrams, inventories, configuration standards, deployment procedures, recovery procedures, support runbooks, architecture documentation, and troubleshooting guides. Documentation is also an established requirement in SafePoint's existing Azure technical roles.
* **Vendor & Third-Party Integration Support:** Assist with connectivity, certificates, SFTP, APIs, IP allowlists, VPNs, DNS, and other infrastructure requirements for third-party systems.
* **Operational Support:** Participate in scheduled maintenance and, when necessary, after-hours support for production deployments, outages, infrastructure failures, or critical business systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
#### **About Primordial Labs**

We're building the next generation interface for commanding autonomous systems in the real world. Our core product, Anura, translates spoken or typed intent into structured actions across drones, sensors, and mission software—enabling faster, more intuitive control in high-stakes environments. We’re a distributed team of engineers, operators, and technologists focused on deploying reliable autonomy at the tactical edge.

#### **The Opportunity**

Anura has to run everywhere our customers operate, from a robot’s onboard computer to networks with no internet connection at all. We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer who will own how our software gets built, tested, and delivered.Your job is to turn mature our pipeline into a more extensive CI/CD pipeline that takes a change from a developer’s laptop to a fielded robot, and to make that path fast, repeatable, and trustworthy. This role suits someone who wants their infrastructure work to show up in the field, not just on a dashboard.

In your first six months, you’ll focus on expanding our CI/CD and automated testing. From there, you’ll take on edge deployment and updates, then help us grow into secure and disconnected delivery.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Build, Test & Delivery Pipelines:**

* Mature and expand our existing GitHub Actions CI into full CI/CD, from commit through release, with automated build, test, and packaging for multiple target platforms and reproducible releases.
* Integrate the testing tools our engineers and Test and Evaluation team build so they run automatically and reliably on every change.
* Set up and maintain self-hosted runners, including GPU and hardware-in-the-loop runners, so simulation and hardware tests catch issues before they reach a robot.
* Keep pipelines fast and trustworthy: reduce build times, track down flaky tests, and make results easy for engineers to act on.

**Edge & On-Device Deployment:**

* Design how Anura is packaged, deployed, and updated on robotic and embedded compute platforms, including NVIDIA GPU edge devices, and work alongside engineers to bring up new partner platforms quickly.
* Build safe update workflows for fielded devices, including versioned releases, rollback, and tracking which version runs on which customer’s hardware.
* Build tooling for monitoring, logging, and diagnostics on devices with limited bandwidth or intermittent connectivity.

**Team Operations:**

* Automate environment setup and other manual workflows that slow engineers down.
* Help the team adopt good testing and CI habits through documentation, reviews, and pairing.

**Secure Delivery (growing over time):**

* Help build delivery workflows for air-gapped customer networks, including offline packaging and transfer.
* Add security practices to our pipelines, such as dependency scanning, signing, and SBOM generation.

#### **Required Skills and Experience**

* 5-8 years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineering.
* Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines with automated testing.
* Experience deploying software to edge, embedded, or robotic systems.
* Strong with GitHub Actions or a similar CI system, including self-hosted runners.
* Experience building and testing mixed Python and C++ codebases, including CMake.
* Strong with Docker and containerized builds.
* Proficient in Linux administration and scripting in Python or Bash.
* Able to own problems end to end and make sound decisions without a large team around you.

#### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience delivering software into air-gapped or classified environments.
* Experience deploying to NVIDIA Jetson or other GPU edge hardware, including GPU-enabled containers and cross-compiling for ARM.
* Experience with software supply chain security and compliance, such as code signing, SBOMs, NIST 800-171, or CMMC.
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar) and a major cloud provider, with AWS GovCloud or Azure Government a plus.
* Experience at a startup or small defense technology company.

**Important Qualification Note:** *Due to the nature of our work and federal compliance requirements, this position strictly requires U.S. Citizenship and current residency within the United States. Please note that Permanent Residency (Green Card status) or visa sponsorship cannot satisfy these specific regulatory requirements.*

#### **Compensation**

Compensation for this position includes a target base salary of $160,000 - $200,000 annually, with the specific figure determined by the candidate's experience level.

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation and are happy to explain how we determine our salary ranges, just ask!

#### **Our Benefits**

* Beyond a Competitive Salary, we provide a significant equity stake, aligning your growth with ours.
* 100% Remote: This role is fully remote, open to residents across the US. We believe that talent knows no borders (well, except for the US in this case!).
* Comprehensive Health Coverage: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans so you and your family can stay healthy and worry free.
* Retirement Planning: Plan for tomorrow with our 401(k) package, complete with a generous 6% company match.
* Generous DTO: Our generous Discretionary Time off (DTO) policy is all about helping you take the breaks you deserve and live your healthiest, most fulfilling life.
* Elite Technology Package: Enjoy an elite technology package to make your work effortless and efficient.

#### **Our Interview Process**

Our interview process is designed to be thorough and respectful of your time. It typically includes:

* Conversation with the People Team: Lets get to know one another first!
* Screener Interview: A 30-minute discussion about relevant engineering concepts and your past experience.
* Offline Coding Test: We provide an at-your-own-pace test focused on algorithm and system design. After completion, you'll present your solution in a follow-up call. This allows us to understand your thought processes and technical approach.
* Technical Collaboration & Team Q&A: Walk through a recent code sample with the engineering team, discuss your design choices, and ask us anything about our stack, culture, and day to day work.

We are committed to a low-stress interview experience—no trick questions or brain teasers!

Primordial Labs is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone. Discrimination and harassment have no place here. We firmly believe that a diverse team enriches our problem-solving capabilities, sparks greater creativity, and ultimately leads to a better product and a more vibrant company.

We understand that great talent comes from various paths and that passion and transferable skills are invaluable. At Primordial Labs, what truly matters is your ability to make an impact, your dedication to our mission, and your capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative atmosphere. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where you can contribute your unique talents, expand your skills, and learn continuously. If you’re driven to make a real impact, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification.

#LI-REMOTE
