title: Data & Analytics Engineer – Microsoft Fabric
description:
Data & Analytics Engineer – Microsoft Fabric

**Location:** Irving, TX  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Salary:** $100,000–$120,000 per year  
**Work Setting:** Primarily in person

About the Role

Quantum Pain & Spine is looking for a **Data & Analytics Engineer** to help build and own the data foundation supporting a growing multi-entity healthcare organization.

We are building a centralized analytics environment in **Microsoft Fabric** that will bring together data from eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, financial and operational systems, and other business applications.

This role sits between traditional data engineering and analytics engineering. We are not looking for someone focused primarily on massive distributed systems, streaming infrastructure, or highly complex data platforms. We need someone who can take source data, make it reliable and understandable, model it around real business questions, and deliver trusted datasets and reporting that leadership can actually use.

The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and data-modeling skills with practical Microsoft Fabric and Power BI experience and is comfortable working directly with business stakeholders.

ResponsibilitiesMicrosoft Fabric & Data Platform

* Help design, build, and maintain our Microsoft Fabric environment.
* Work with Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, pipelines, and related services.
* Build and maintain reliable data pipelines from business systems.
* Integrate data from sources including eClinicalWorks, HubSpot, spreadsheets, APIs, and other operational platforms.
* Develop repeatable ingestion and transformation processes.
* Monitor data refreshes, pipeline performance, and failures.
* Help establish deployment, documentation, and data-development standards.

Analytics Engineering & Data Modeling

* Transform raw and standardized data into business-ready analytical models.
* Build dimensional and star-schema models.
* Develop curated Gold-layer datasets for reporting and analysis.
* Create reusable definitions for key business metrics.
* Build and maintain semantic models for Power BI.
* Work with DAX where needed to support reporting and analytical use cases.
* Create data-quality checks and reconciliation processes.
* Investigate conflicting data and help determine reliable sources of truth.

Reporting & Business Analytics

* Partner with Strategic Operations, Finance, Operations, and leadership to understand business questions.
* Translate business requirements into datasets, models, and reporting solutions.
* Build or support Power BI dashboards and reporting products.
* Improve the reliability and consistency of existing reporting.
* Reduce manual spreadsheet-based reporting where appropriate.
* Help develop analytics around financial/AR performance, referral performance, patient journeys, operational efficiency, and other business priorities.

Data Governance & Documentation

* Document data sources, transformations, business definitions, and dependencies.
* Help establish consistent data standards across the organization.
* Identify data-quality issues and work with operational teams to understand their root causes.
* Help create scalable structures that make future analytics work easier and more reliable.
* Support appropriate access controls for business and healthcare data.

What We’re Looking For

* Approximately 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a similar role.
* Strong SQL skills.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and star-schema design.
* Experience building business-ready datasets from multiple source systems.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric or closely related Microsoft data technologies.
* Experience with Power BI.
* Understanding of semantic models and DAX.
* Ability to investigate messy or conflicting data and determine how it should be reconciled.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate questions into technical solutions.
* Strong problem-solving and documentation skills.
* Ability to own projects from source data through final analytical product.

Preferred Qualifications

* Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience.
* Experience with Fabric Lakehouse and/or Warehouse.
* Experience with Power BI semantic models.
* Experience integrating REST APIs or SaaS platforms.
* Python experience.
* Familiarity with Azure data services.
* Experience with HubSpot data.
* Healthcare analytics experience.
* Experience with EHR data, particularly eClinicalWorks.
* Experience with financial, revenue-cycle, referral, or operational healthcare data.
* Familiarity with data governance and healthcare privacy considerations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcome.

Experience with PySpark, Databricks, or large-scale distributed data technologies is useful but is **not the primary focus of this role**.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first several months, this person should:

* Understand the organization’s major data sources and data-quality challenges.
* Establish a stable Microsoft Fabric development foundation.
* Validate and organize eClinicalWorks data being shared into Fabric.
* Begin integrating additional high-value data sources.
* Establish standards for business-ready data models.
* Deliver the first trusted end-to-end analytical products.
* Reduce dependence on manually reconciled spreadsheets.
* Give leadership faster access to consistent and explainable business information.

Initial analytical priorities are expected to include:

* Financial and accounts-receivable visibility
* Referral performance and conversion
* Operational and patient-journey analytics

Work Environment

This is primarily an **in-person position in Irving, Texas**. Occasional remote work may be approved at manager discretion based on current projects, deadlines, and operational needs.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching

title: Senior Azure Platform / DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Makai**
Makai uses best-in-class AI and data to solve real-world operational and strategic challenges at scale. We help businesses with enterprise automation, human-machine teaming, product design and development, and market intelligence. Until now, people have had to learn and adapt to software. Makai creates solutions that adapt to people because technology will never be 100% accurate. People are essential for all of our human-machine teaming solutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Makai, we build and run cloud platforms for clients in healthcare and other high-stakes industries. You take a platform from an empty Azure subscription to production, make the architecture calls and live with them, and own the infrastructure as code, the pipelines and the monitoring. Much of this runs inside our clients’ own Azure environments, so you work with their infrastructure teams daily: reviewing their designs, explaining what we need and why, and keeping work moving when it depends on them.
  
  
**The ideal candidate will be able to**

* Design, build and maintain Azure environments with Terraform across multiple subscriptions, from networking and identity to a running application
* Build and maintain CI/CD for applications and infrastructure in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and similar platforms: release promotion with approvals, secure deployment identities and repository synchronization
* Operate the compute and runtime platforms, from virtual machines to containers and PaaS: base images, upgrades, patching, rolling deployments, autoscaling and capacity planning
* Design and tune monitoring, logging and alerting with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights
* Design and operate the identity and access model: Entra ID, SSO, workload identities, role- and attribute-based access control, privileged and just-in-time access, and secrets in Key Vault
* Design and maintain secure network architectures: hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN, private endpoints and DNS, Application Gateway and WAF, Azure Firewall, NSGs and isolation between environments
* Maintain security and compliance: vulnerability remediation, patching, Azure Policy, and audits against client policies and regulatory frameworks
* Design and run backup, high availability and disaster recovery: recovery objectives, zone and region redundancy, restore testing, DR drills and failover
* Own production changes and incidents: formal change management with verification and rollback, and troubleshooting through to root cause
* Act as the technical counterpart to clients’ infrastructure and security teams: design reviews, proposals, change requests and runbooks

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building and operating production Azure environments
* Expert-level Terraform: you have owned large multi-environment, multi-subscription Azure codebases, designed their code and state structure, and carried out major refactors and state migrations on live infrastructure
* Proven experience designing CI/CD systems for both applications and infrastructure on Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable platforms, across many repositories and environments
* Strong Linux systems administration background, with a deep understanding of how servers are provisioned, configured and run, and hands-on troubleshooting of services, containers, storage and networking at the OS level
* Fluency in Bash and PowerShell; Python is a plus
* Deep understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and of identity protocols such as OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SAML, and of Azure’s control-plane and data-plane authorization models

DevOps Engineer
  
  
**Position Location:**
Tampa, Florida (Downtown)
  
  
**Position Description:**
Altamira is seeking an expert Senior AWS DevSecOps Engineer to lead the design, build, and automation of our cutting-edge hybrid cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate is passionate about building secure, scalable, and highly available platforms on AWS and other cloud platforms utilizing cloud-native technologies. Your expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container orchestration with EKS, and CI/CD pipelines will be critical to empowering our development & data science teams with a robust, self-service platform. * Proficiency with Git and modern GitOps workflows.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Deep understanding of advanced networking concepts, DNS, gateways in a hybrid/multi-cloud context.
* Extensive expertise in advanced networking, including DNS management and gateway configuration, to support robust connectivity and integration across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Understanding of common authentication mechanisms, OIDC, OAuth2, LDAP, SAML.
* Experience with VMware vSphere in a hybrid cloud context.
* Experience with configuration man

title: Sr Software Engineer, DevOps
description:
**TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a talented Sr DevOps Engineer to join our Smart Mobility team in Austin, Texas.**
**Summary – About The Role**
TransCore is building Smart Mobility, a cloud-native mobility platform that lets people move through tolling, parking, and transit from their phone, and connects the agencies, partners, and consumer apps behind it. We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to build and run the delivery pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and observability that get that platform to production safely and repeatedly.
  
  
This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. You will own infrastructure as code across the full environment pipeline, build the CI/CD that engineering ships through, and make the platform observable and recoverable. The environment is being stood up now, so you are building the foundation rather than inheriting one.
  
  
**Reporting & Organizational Context**
This role reports to the Director, DevOps & Release Engineering, as part of a shared services DevOps team and partners with the Smart Mobility Architecture function, which owns target-state infrastructure design and standards, and with the Platform Engineering organization, whose shared capabilities you consume rather than duplicate.
  
  
You are the DevOps counterpart to the Smart Mobility software, mobile, and QA Automation engineers. Where they own application code and test suites, you own the path that code takes to production and the infrastructure it runs on.
  
  
**Location and Work arrangement**
Ideally this position will be based in Austin, Texas or Atlanta, Georgia. Position may be hybrid, with a blend of in-office and remote work. Occasional travel may be required based on business needs. Relocation is available for the right candidate.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
  
  
**CI/CD And Release Automation**

* Pipeline ownership: Design, build, and maintain build, test, and deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps, with quality and security gates enforced in the pipeline rather than by convention.
* Deployment strategy: Implement repeatable, low-risk deployments across the environment pipeline, including blue/green or canary patterns, automated rollback, and database migration handling.
* Release enablement: Automate versioning, artifact management, and environment promotion so releases are routine and auditable.
* Test integration: Work with QA Automation to wire smoke, regression, API, and performance suites into the pipelines and make the results visible at the gate.

**Infrastructure As Code And Cloud Platform**

* Infrastructure as code: Own the Azure infrastructure definition in Terraform or OpenTofu, including module structure, state management, and drift detection, with no manual portal changes as the standard.
* Environment pipeline: Build and maintain the Dev, QA, UAT, Staging, Production, and Pilot environments so they are consistent, reproducible, and cheap to rebuild.
* Container platform: Operate containerized workloads on Azure, including registries, Kubernetes or Azure Kubernetes Service, autoscaling, and resource right-sizing.
* Cost discipline: Track and report cloud spend by environment and service, and drive out waste as the platform grows.

**Reliability, Observability, And Security**

* Observability: Build the logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting layer so failures are detected and diagnosed quickly, and so service level objectives can be measured rather than asserted.
* Telemetry standards: Own the OpenTelemetry standard for the platform, including instrumentation guidance, collector and exporter configuration, and sampling, so traces, metrics, and logs land usefully in Dynatrace and the Grafana stack instead of accumulating cost.
* Reliability engineering: Implement backup, recovery, and failover, run recovery testing, and support incident response and post-incident follow-up.
* Security and compliance: Implement secrets management, identity and access controls, network controls, vulnerability and dependency scanning, and the pipeline controls needed to support PCI-DSS.
* Identity and access standards: Implement workload and pipeline identity using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, managed identities, and federated credentials, and drive out long-lived static secrets and shared service accounts.

**Collaboration And Enablement**

* Developer experience: Give engineers fast feedback, self-service tooling, and local and preview environments that behave like production.
* Documentation and standards: Document infrastructure design, runbooks, and operational procedures, and set the DevOps standards the team follows.
* Agile delivery: Work in sprints alongside the engineering team, provide realistic estimates for automation work, and take part in code review for both infrastructure and pipeline code.

**Requirements And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of professional DevOps, platform, or site reliability engineering experience, with a strong automation focus.
* 3 to 6 additional years of experience as a Software Engineer.
* Deep hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, including declarative or YAML pipeline definitions, environments, approvals, and artifact management. Azure DevOps is the platform in use today, so Azure DevOps experience is preferred, but strong GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins experience with only passing Azure DevOps exposure is welcome if you can transfer that knowledge quickly.
* Strong infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu, including reusable modules, remote state, and plan review discipline.
* Demonstrated experience operating cloud-native workloads on Azure, including networking, identity, and managed data services. Strong AWS or GCP experience considered with some Azure exposure.
* Strong experience with Docker and container orchestration, preferably Kubernetes or Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Scripting proficiency in PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
* Practical experience with monitoring, logging, and APM platforms such as Dynatrace, the Grafana stack (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo), Azure Monitor and Application Insights, or the Elastic stack. Dynatrace is in use today.
* Working knowledge of OpenTelemetry, including instrumentation, collectors, exporters, and how to standardize telemetry across services rather than per team.
* Working knowledge of authentication and authorization standards and cloud security practices, including OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, JWT, service principals and managed identities, TLS and mTLS, certificate lifecycle management, and secrets management.
* Solid networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and load balancing.
* Enough application development background to read and debug application code, ideally C# and .NET, and to be a credible partner to the engineering team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting event-driven systems built on message queues or streaming platforms such as Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, or Kafka.
* Experience defining and operating against service level objectives and running incident and on-call practices.
* Experience in a PCI-DSS or comparable regulated environment, including audit and evidence collection.
* Experience with policy as code, compliance as code, or automated drift and inventory validation against a defined architecture model.
* Experience with Azure Resource Graph, Bicep, or ARM templates in addition to Terraform or OpenTofu.
* Experience with cloud migration, including on-premises-to-cloud and cloud-to-cloud moves, and hands-on delivery of Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)-aligned solutions such as multi-tenant Azure landing zones, to support future migrations of Infinity, Inference, and other platforms to Azure.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Python & API Integration
description:
**About Us**

At Vanterra Foundation Solutions, we believe the future of our industry belongs to those who put people first and empower them with AI-driven systems and real-time insights. Grounded in partnership, teamwork, and pride in craftsmanship, we help homeowners protect and improve their homes through expert foundation repair, waterproofing, and crawl space solutions.

Join a team that’s powered by people, fueled by teamwork, and accelerated by innovation.

**Come join us.**

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our remote engineering team. Most of your time will go to building Python services that connect external SaaS platforms to each other and to our internal systems, keeping data accurate and in sync across them. Claude is part of how we work at every stage of the software development lifecycle, and you’ll also serve as a subject matter expert in our organization-wide rollout of AI tools. Front-end work is occasional, and this is primarily a back-end integration role.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Build and maintain Python services**
  using FastAPI, Django, or similar, with typed, async-capable, well-tested code.
* **Design API-to-API integrations**
  between third-party SaaS platforms (REST, webhooks, and vendor SDKs), handling authentication, pagination, rate limits, retries, and failure recovery.
* **Keep systems in sync.**
  Upload, synchronize, and enrich records across platforms, with logic that stays reliable when data is late, duplicated, or malformed.
* **Own the data layer**
  in MySQL on AWS RDS: schema design, migrations, and query optimization.
* **Deploy and run containerized services**
  on AWS (ECS and EC2), with logging and monitoring that make integration failures easy to catch and diagnose.
* **Work with Claude across the SDLC.**
  We use it for planning, design, coding, code review, testing, debugging, and documentation. You’ll be responsible for verifying everything it produces before it ships.
* **Act as an SME on AI adoption.**
  Participate in our organization’s AI rollout by advising on use cases, helping define guardrails for data handling, and helping colleagues use tools like Claude effectively and safely.
* **Make occasional front-end updates**
  in a modern JavaScript framework (React, Vue, or Angular) using TypeScript.
* **Raise engineering quality**
  through code review and automated testing.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5+ years as a senior software engineer or full stack developer, with experience across the full development lifecycle
* Strong Python skills for back-end development, scripting, and automation
* Extensive hands-on experience integrating with complex third-party APIs, including OAuth 2.0, webhooks, pagination, rate limiting, and retry handling, for reliable, high-volume sync
* Solid SQL and relational database fundamentals, preferably with MySQL
* Working experience deploying applications on AWS (RDS, EC2, ECS) and with Docker
* Working knowledge of a modern JavaScript framework (React, Vue, or Angular) plus HTML5, CSS3, and TypeScript/JavaScript
* Fluency with Git and collaborative branching workflows on shared codebases
* Experience handling sensitive data securely (credentials, tokens, PII)
* Comfort working with AI coding assistants throughout the development process, and the judgment to review their output critically, especially around security and data handling
* Willingness to teach and advise colleagues on AI tools, and to give input on how the organization adopts them
* Strong written communication and the self-direction to work effectively on a remote team

**Nice to Have**

* Background in home services, such as field service management, scheduling, dispatch, CRM, or lead management platforms
* Familiarity with WordPress development (modern PHP, block themes, plugins) for maintaining internal admin tools
* Experience building LLM-powered features or integrations
* Prior experience leading or supporting AI tool adoption in an organization

The engineer partners with application, infrastructure, security, analytics, and business teams to translate operational requirements into maintainable integration architectures.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver end-to-end batch, near-real-time, and event-driven integrations among enterprise applications, databases, APIs, files, messaging platforms, and external partners.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, jobs, schemas, indexes, constraints, and data models that support integration and reporting workloads.
* Analyze source and target database structures, relationships, keys, data types, dependencies, and business rules; create source-to-target mappings and transformation specifications.
* Build, configure, test, deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot Vertex integrations using applicable connectors, interfaces, APIs, import/export utilities, configuration components, job scheduling, and logging capabilities.
* Create integration services using REST and SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, CSV, fixed-width files, secure file transfer, webhooks, queues, JDBC/ODBC, and other enterprise exchange patterns.
* Develop reusable ETL/ELT components, data pipelines, validation routines, reconciliation controls, restart and recovery processes, and exception-handling frameworks.
* Lead performance tuning, root-cause analysis, defect remediation, and production support for integration failures, latency, data-quality issues, and database bottlenecks.
* Implement logging, auditability, alerting, metrics, dashboards, and operational runbooks to strengthen observability and reduce manual intervention.
* Apply standards for source control, peer review, environment promotion, release management, configuration management, and separation of development, test, and production environments.
* Protect sensitive data through least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, secure transport, appropriate masking, retention controls, and alignment with organizational security requirements.
* Collaborate with architects, analysts, developers, vendors, and business stakeholders; mentor less-experienced team members and provide technical direction for complex integrations.
* Create and maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, data dictionaries, lineage documentation, support procedures, test evidence, and technical design documents.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Seven or more years of progressive experience in data integration, database development, application integration, software engineering, or related disciplines.
* Three or more years leading or independently delivering complex, production-grade integration solutions across multiple systems and data domains.
* Advanced SQL development and troubleshooting experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio, including T-SQL, stored procedures, query optimization, SQL Agent jobs, backup and recovery concepts, and security roles.
* Advanced knowledge of relational database structures, including normalized and dimensional models, tables, views, relationships, keys, indexes, constraints, transactions, locking, execution plans, and referential integrity.
* Hands-on experience integrating Vertex solutions, including applicable configuration tools, connectors, APIs, data mappings, file interfaces, scheduling, error handling, reconciliation, and production support.
* Experience with one or more additional relational database platforms such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, or IBM Db2.
* Experience with integration and data-engineering platforms such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Informatica, Talend, Boomi, MuleSoft, or comparable ETL/iPaaS tools.
* Proficiency with REST and SOAP APIs and associated authentication patterns, including OAuth 2.0, certificates, tokens, service accounts, and secrets management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and designs to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications
* Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, or comparable cloud data services.
* Working knowledge of document, key-value, column-family, graph, search, and caching technologies such as MongoDB, Cosmos DB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j, Elasticsearch, or Redis.
* Experience with Visual Studio Code, Git, Azure DevOps or GitHub, PowerShell, Python, Postman, database comparison tools, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of data quality, master and reference data, metadata, lineage, governance, reconciliation, auditing, and privacy principles.
* Experience supporting tax, ERP, billing, finance, monitoring, or other high-volume transactional platforms.
* Relevant certifications in Microsoft data technologies, cloud platforms, database administration or development, integration platforms, or Vertex solutions.

**Core Competencies**

* Integration architecture and engineering
* SQL and database design
* Data mapping and transformation
* Performance tuning and troubleshooting
* Security and data governance
* Production reliability and observability
* Technical leadership and mentoring
* Documentation and stakeholder communication

**Physical And Work Environment**
The employee regularly works in a professional office or remote-work environment and uses standard computer and communications equipment. The role may require participation in planned maintenance, releases, incident response, or support activities outside normal business hours. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
*Shaw Industries Group, Inc. is a leader in flooring and other surface solutions designed for residential housing, commercial spaces and outdoor environments. Leveraging strengths in design, innovation and operational excellence, the company takes a people-centered, customer-focused, and growth-minded approach to meet diverse market needs. It creates differentiated customer experiences through its expansive portfolio of brands: Anderson Tuftex, COREtec, Shaw Floors, Patcraft, Philadelphia Commercial, Shaw Contract, Shaw Sports Turf, Shawgrass, Southwest Greens, Watershed Geo and more. Headquartered in Dalton, Georgia, Shaw is a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc. with more than $6 billion in annual sales and 18,000 associates worldwide.*

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Analytics Engineer III to join our Residential Enablement and Insights team in Dalton, GA. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, advanced analytics, and data engineering — with a strong emphasis on data modeling, Power BI, and Databricks.

As an Analytics Engineer, you will design and implement scalable, trusted data models and visualization tools that drive strategic decision-making across our Residential Sales and Marketing organizations. The ideal candidate will blend technical depth with business insight, playing a critical role in enabling data self-service and modern analytics practices across Shaw.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with senior business leaders (DVPs, VPs, Directors) to gather requirements and translate them into scalable data models and analytic frameworks.
* Design, develop, and maintain semantic models, star schemas, and data marts to support self-service analytics.
* Build and deploy advanced analytic pipelines using Databricks, transforming large and complex data sets into analytics-ready assets.
* Create clear, actionable visualizations and dashboards using Power BI, enabling users to uncover insights and make informed decisions.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure data integrity, optimize pipeline performance, and enforce data governance standards.
* Provide subject matter expertise in Power BI development, data modeling practices, and dashboard UX.
* Coach and mentor analysts and business users in best practices for data visualization, model reuse, and analytic thinking.
* Contribute to the development of enterprise data standards, catalogs, and metadata documentation.
* Stay current with evolving technologies in analytics, cloud computing, and data engineering — especially Databricks, Power BI, and modern data architectures.

**Requirements**

**Technical Skills & Experience:**

* Advanced knowledge of SQL and experience designing scalable logical and physical data models.
* Expert-level proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, dataflows, custom visuals, row-level security).
* Proven experience working with Databricks (preferably on Azure) to process and model data using notebooks and Delta Lake.
* Strong understanding of data pipeline orchestration, ETL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake).
* Familiarity with Python or R for advanced analytics and automation tasks.
* Experience working with version control (e.g., Git) and implementing DataOps or CI/CD practices.

**Core Competencies:**

* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business context.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
* Ability to work cross-functionally in a highly collaborative environment.
* Interest in continuous learning, especially in areas of machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics.
* Passion for creating clean, reusable, and well-documented data assets.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
* 2–5+ years of experience delivering modern analytics solutions using Power BI, Databricks, and strong data modeling practices.
* Experience working in or supporting business analytics teams within a large enterprise environment.
* Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale big data systems using Hadoop, Spark, Apache Hive, or similar frameworks.
* Strong proficiency in SQL databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and cloud databases including Azure Data Lake or similar platforms.
* Extensive knowledge of data warehousing design principles including dimensional modeling and ETL pipeline development.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-based data management solutions on AWS or other public cloud providers.
* Proficiency in software development languages such as Java and Python for building scalable analytics applications.
* Familiarity with business intelligence tools like Looker for creating insightful dashboards and reports.
* Knowledge of data modeling techniques including linked data concepts to enhance data integration across diverse sources.

Join us to be at the forefront of transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive strategic growth!

title: Analytics Engineer 5 - Promotional Media
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
  
  
When a Netflix member opens our app, we have a few precious moments to help them choose a story or a game that is right for them at that instance. Presenting them with evidence – Artwork, Trailers, Synopses – that authentically represent each title and resonate with the member is essential to this effort.
  
  
Beyond connecting global stories with existing audiences, we also aim to reach new subscribers and increase engagement through innovative marketing campaigns. By crafting compelling and targeted marketing strategies, we strive to capture the attention of potential members and convert their interest into subscriptions. Additionally, we focus on increasing conversation and excitement about Netflix and our content, creating buzz and anticipation that encourages both current and prospective members to explore and engage with our diverse offerings.
  
  
The Promotional Media AI for Member Systems team is at the forefront of designing and advancing state-of-the-art ML recommendation algorithms related to the "life of an asset" — spanning on-service promotional assets like artwork, synopses, and clips, as well as off-service marketing campaigns. We are responsible for empowering our business partners across Promotional Media and Marketing to understand, generate, and optimize these assets to provide a stellar member experience and drive subscriber growth.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Analytics Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will design and develop analytic tools and systems to monitor the adoption and accountability of our algos across both Promotional Media and Marketing workflows. You will partner with a talented cross-functional team of ML engineers, data scientists, product managers, and domain experts to shape the future of promotional asset recommendation and generation, as well as marketing campaign performance, at Netflix.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as a strategic partner for stakeholders and cross-functional collaborators to identify analytic opportunities and enhance business strategies with automated data solutions
* Drive the direction and execution of your work, which spans from developing scrappy code to designing high-visibility dashboards and analyses
* Translate ambiguous creative and quality requirements into measurable objectives and evaluation frameworks
* Build and maintain observability for our automated pipelines, tracking SLA adherence, performance drift, and other key health signals to confirm our systems are performing as intended
* Partner closely with machine learning engineers and scientists to improve our asset creation and recommendation models, and accelerate the productization of data insights
* Share your innovation and collaborate with the broader analytics community to strengthen analytics enablement
* Become a knowledgeable practitioner/expert in our space, both as the go-to person regarding tooling and methodologies, and as a liaison with the stakeholders, understanding their business needs and how to fulfill them

**About You**

* Proven track record of designing and developing scalable analytic tools and systems
* High proficiency in standard tech stack (e.g., Python, SQL, Spark) and common data visualization tools (e.g., Plotly Dash, Tableau)
* Familiar with the fundamentals of Statistical Inference and Data Analysis, as well as data engineering best practices
* 5+ years of relevant experience in building data products powered by big data
* Experienced in orchestrating cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority, and leveraging analytics to steer business decisions
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills coupled with strong business acumen
* Comfortable with ambiguity; able to take ownership, and thrive with minimal oversight and process
* Netflix culture resonates with you
* Bonus points if experienced with pipelines and visualizations involving media files (images and video)

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $330,000.00 - $566,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.
  
  
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.
  
  
Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.
  
  
Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
  
  
We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.
  
  
Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join Seismic’s Corporate Data & Analytics team and own our finance data domain. In this role, you’ll partner with our Finance team to model, maintain, and scale the data assets that power financial reporting, planning, and decision-making across the business. You’ll serve as the technical bridge between Finance stakeholders and the data platform, translating business requirements into clean, reliable, well-documented data models that analysts and leaders can trust.
  
  
While Finance ownership is the core of this role, you’ll also contribute across other business domains and work closely with data analysts, analytics engineers, and data engineers to build a cohesive, high-quality data layer. The Senior Analytics Engineer will report to the Manager, Analytics Engineering.
  
  
**Who you are:**
**Required**

* 5+ years of analytics engineering or data analyst experience, with at least 3 years hands-on with dbt (Core or Cloud) — building and maintaining multi-layer model architectures in a production environment
* Direct experience modeling financial data and working with Finance as a business stakeholder
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with business-facing teams on end-to-end analytics projects, from requirements gathering through delivery
* Hands-on experience with a finance SaaS platform such as NetSuite (or similar), including modeling financial data and surfacing it from source systems to the reporting layer.

* Expert SQL skills – comfortable writing complex transformations, window functions, and CTEs
* Experience with Git/GitHub — branching, pull requests, code review workflows

* Experience with financial planning tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning

You'll have real ownership, not just tickets. You'll work on a collaborative team that cares about doing things right and building systems that last.
  
  
**What you’ll be doing:**

* Partner with FP&A, Accounting, and Systems teams to build and maintain trusted dbt models for bookings, ARR, and quote-level revenue data (e.g., Salesforce CPQ price-per-seat, discounting, and booking calculations), ensuring metrics reconcile across Finance systems and downstream reporting
* Build and maintain dbt models across the full modeling stack following layered dimensional modeling practices.
* Work directly with data analysts to evaluate reporting requirements and translate business logic into reusable, well-tested data models.
* Collaborate with analytics engineers and data engineers on data ingestion, pipeline reliability, and source system changes.
* Apply software engineering best practices to analytics code: version control (GitHub), testing, CI/CD, and documentation
* Write and maintain clear dbt documentation (model descriptions, column-level doc blocks, and lineage) so the data layer is self-service friendly.
* Actively participate in project scoping, sprint planning, and cross-functional delivery using agile workflows.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.

Seismic's salary range for this position is: USD $103,000.00/Yr. - USD $140,000.00/Yr.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.

**Who You Are**

We are hiring a dedicated Analytics Engineer to help build and scale the data and AI foundation of our enterprise SaaS business.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of AI & Analytics within our centralized Operations organization, this is a highly hands-on role focused on architecting scalable analytics systems and AI-enabled workflows that power decision-making across the company.

You will design the core data models, architecture, and reusable assets that serve Product, Engineering & Design — while helping redefine what an analytics function looks like in the age of AI.

This is a foundational hire with high ownership and long-term growth potential.

**What You'll Do**

Enterprise Data Modeling & Architecture

* Design and maintain scalable dbt data models in Snowflake that serve as trusted sources of truth across the business
* Architect data pipelines and transformation workflows using Fivetran and modern ELT practices
* Develop durable, extensible data assets that evolve as the company scales
* Establish modeling standards, documentation practices, and governance frameworks
* Partner with RevOps and Finance to define and operationalize core SaaS metrics (ARR, retention, expansion, pipeline, etc.)

AI-Enabled Systems & Workflow Integration

* Build data foundations that power internal AI applications and LLM-enabled workflows
* Prototype and productionize AI-driven operational use cases
* Integrate analytics and AI into everyday workflows using tools such as Notion, Cursor, Glean, and other emerging platforms
* Design systems that embed data directly into operational processes — not just dashboards

Cross-Functional Analytics Infrastructure

* Partner with leaders across Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Engineering to translate business needs into scalable technical systems
* Create reusable data assets that enable activation via Hightouch and analysis via Omni
* Ensure architecture is scalable, secure, and adaptable to evolving enterprise requirements

**Our Stack**

**Analytics:**
Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Hightouch, Omni

**AI & Knowledge Systems:**
Notion, Cursor, Glean

Experience with these tools is helpful but not required. Strong fundamentals and the ability to quickly learn new technologies matter more than prior tool exposure.

* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of modern data modeling (dimensional modeling, transformations, data contracts, etc.)
* Experience building in cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.)

* Systems-level thinker who designs for scalability, extensibility, and flexibility
* Naturally curious and energized by solving ambiguous problems
* Pride in building clean, durable architecture — not just shipping quick fixes
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across business and technical teams

**Why This Role Matters**

We are not building a traditional BI function.

We Are Building An AI-augmented Analytics Capability That

* Embeds data into operational workflows
* Enables faster, smarter enterprise decision-making
* Evolves as AI tooling evolves
* Treats architecture as a strategic asset, not a back-office utility

You won’t just build dashboards — you will help shape how analytics and AI power our company over the next several years.

Anniversary & Milestone Celebrations

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**The Role**
------------

You will be Doctronic's first dedicated data engineer, and you will own the plumbing end to end: how data moves from our production systems into our lakehouse and warehouse, how it gets transformed into trusted, documented tables, and who can access what.

This role serves every team in the company: AI engineering, product, finance, partnerships, and data to name a few.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build reliable, monitored CDC pipelines from our production databases (MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) into our S3 + Iceberg lake and Snowflake
* Stand up a transformation layer (e.g. dbt) on Snowflake so core business metrics (visits, bookings, revenue, retention) come from tested, version-controlled models
* Select and implement an orchestration tool so pipelines and dashboard refreshes run automatically, with alerting when they break
* Design and enforce the access control model for patient data: row/column-level PHI restrictions, HIPAA Safe Harbor compliance, anonymization pipelines, and account deletion workflows
* Establish a single governed copy of production data that analytics, finance, and the AI team all read from
* Support the AI team's data needs for model training
* Design and build a best-practice warehouse architecture with clean raw, transformed, and business-ready layers powering our executive dashboards

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of data engineering experience, including ownership of production data platforms end to end
* Strong SQL and Python, with experience building and operating ELT/CDC pipelines (Fivetran, Airbyte, or similar)
* Hands-on experience with a modern lakehouse/warehouse stack: S3, Apache Iceberg, a catalog layer, and Snowflake or an equivalent warehouse
* Experience with transformation frameworks (dbt or similar) and orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Glue workflows, or similar)
* Solid AWS fundamentals: IAM, Lambda, Kinesis, Glue
* A pragmatic, reliability-first mindset
* Comfort operating with high autonomy and minimal specs in a flat, engineering-first organization
* Strong communication skills; you'll work directly with product, marketing, finance, and AI stakeholders

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with HIPAA/PHI data governance, anonymization, or healthcare data

title: DevOps / Build & Delivery Engineer
description:
Wizard is the AI-native platform for creative work, starting with professional video: a native C++ editor and headless media runtime that humans, agents, and developers all operate.

*Build the systems that let us develop and deliver dependable software at agentic speed.*

**Why this role matters**
=========================

Wizard combines a native C++/Qt editor, a Python AI stack, and a headless media runtime. Our engineers need useful feedback quickly, and our customers need builds they can install, update, and trust with real work.

As our team and products grow, our build and delivery systems have to keep pace. We're hiring an engineer to own that infrastructure and keep improving it.

**About the role**
==================

You'll join our Pipeline team, which builds and improves the systems that let Wizard develop, test, ship, and scale. You'll own build and release infrastructure, working with Charles Harris III and our application, Core, and AI engineers. As our first DevOps engineer, you won't be on your own: Charles knows these systems well and will back you up on build and release work as the team grows.

Your initial focus will be CI, build performance, and reliable desktop delivery. You'll measure where time goes, address the largest bottlenecks, and make the resulting systems straightforward for other engineers to use and operate.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own CI workflows and build infrastructure across our components and supported platforms.
* Measure the complete CI path: queueing, setup, dependency preparation, compilation, testing, and artifact handling. Improve the stages that cause the most waiting.
* Maintain pinned toolchains, dependencies, caches, and reusable build outputs. Verify that compatible inputs reuse work and relevant changes trigger the required rebuilds.
* Own packaging, signing, notarization, release channels, updates, and recovery to a known-good version.
* Make the hotfix path dependable and measurable, from an approved fix to a verified installation.
* Keep source revisions, build recipes, symbols, and delivered artifacts traceable so failures can be investigated.
* Work with Quality & Release on release candidates and delivery checks, and with application engineers on crash-reporting integration.
* Improve developer workflows through scripts, tools, and agent-assisted diagnosis. Evaluate new methods and turn useful experiments into supported systems.
* Track runner, storage, and build costs, and recommend infrastructure changes based on measured needs.

**What you bring**
==================

* Experience operating CI and build systems for substantial C++ or desktop software.
* Familiarity with CMake, Ninja, compiler caching, and GitHub Actions or comparable systems.
* Experience delivering macOS software, including signing, notarization, packaging, and updates.
* Strong scripting and debugging skills across build tools, operating systems, and dependency environments.
* An understanding of credentials, permissions, and artifact integrity in CI and release systems.
* A habit of measuring before optimizing and making failures understandable to other engineers.

Experience with Windows or Linux delivery, embedded Python, GPU or media dependencies, and infrastructure as code would be useful.

**Show us what you've built**
=============================

A release pipeline, build system, cache, or developer tool you owned. Tell us what was difficult, what you changed, and how you established that it improved speed, reliability, or cost.

We welcome different backgrounds. We care about what you've built, what you've measured, and how you make systems easier for others to use.

**About Wizard**
================

Every so often, a new technology redefines how stories get told: the printing press, the telephone, radio, the film camera, the cutting room, television, the digital camera, non-linear editing. We think we're at the start of the next one, and we intend to build the company that defines it.

Wizard is the AI-native platform for creative work, starting with the hardest creative workflow: professional video. In roughly six months, our team built a native C++ editor and a headless media runtime that humans, agents, and developers all operate. Oz, our agent, ingests footage at roughly 300× real time and edits at 30–60× real time, and every change it makes stays inspectable, editable, and reversible.

Our philosophy is creative as code: every decision editable, controllable, composable, never generative slop you regenerate and hope for the best. Controllability over convenience. Artist integrity over automation. Taste over throughput.

Our sister company is Story, a production company making video for frontier AI labs and deep-tech companies. We work closely with them: Story is our first customer and in-house design partner, and its editors cut real client work on Wizard every day.

Our team comes from Industrial Light & Magic, Netflix, Apple, Epic Games, Lucasfilm, Blizzard, and 2K. We work in person in San Francisco.

title: Mid-Level Databricks Engineer
description:
We are seeking a **Mid-Level Databricks Engineer** to design, develop, and support scalable data solutions using Databricks and modern cloud data platforms. This role will focus on building reliable data pipelines, implementing lakehouse architectures, improving data quality, and supporting analytics and AI use cases.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with **Databricks, SQL, Python/PySpark, Delta Lake, and cloud data services** and can work independently within established architectural and data governance standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, and maintain data pipelines using **Databricks, PySpark, Python, and SQL**.
* Develop ingestion and transformation processes across **Bronze, Silver, and Gold** layers using Medallion Architecture principles.
* Build and optimize **Delta Lake** tables, including data partitioning, schema management, and performance tuning.
* Develop batch and streaming pipelines using Databricks capabilities such as **Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, Workflows, and Delta Live Tables/Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines**, where appropriate.
* Integrate structured and semi-structured data from databases, APIs, files, cloud storage, and enterprise applications.
* Implement data quality validation, reconciliation, exception handling, monitoring, and logging.
* Work with **Unity Catalog** to support data governance, access controls, metadata management, lineage, and data discovery.
* Develop reusable frameworks and components for ingestion, transformation, and data validation.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and performance issues and implement sustainable fixes.
* Participate in code reviews and follow established development, testing, security, and deployment standards.
* Support **CI/CD** practices for Databricks development and collaborate with DevOps teams on automated deployments.
* Work closely with data architects, analysts, data scientists, governance teams, and business stakeholders.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, data mappings, pipeline specifications, and operational support documentation.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **8-10 years** of experience in data engineering, ETL/ELT development, or related data platform development.
* **5+ years of hands-on Databricks experience** preferred.
* Strong proficiency with:
  + **Python / PySpark**
  + **SQL**
  + **Apache Spark**
  + **Delta Lake**
  + Databricks notebooks, jobs/workflows, and compute
* Experience developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and working with large datasets.
* Understanding of **lakehouse, data warehouse, and Medallion Architecture** concepts.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform: **Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud**.
* Experience working with Git-based source control and CI/CD processes.
* Understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, security, and data governance concepts.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in an Agile delivery environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with **Databricks Unity Catalog**.
* Experience with **Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps**, or comparable AWS/GCP services.
* Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and infrastructure/deployment automation.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, Parquet, Avro, and other common data formats.
* Exposure to **Power BI**
* Experience supporting data science, machine learning, or GenAI workloads is a plus.
* Databricks certification such as **Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate** is a plus.

### **What We're Looking For**

A successful candidate should be able to take a defined data requirement or technical design and independently turn it into a **production-ready Databricks solution**. They should be comfortable troubleshooting problems, collaborating with senior engineers and architects, and helping less-experienced developers follow good engineering practices.

**Leveling distinction:** This is not primarily an architecture role. The emphasis is on **hands-on engineering, independent delivery, code quality, data reliability, and Level 2 production support**.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Quantum Sky is seeking a
**Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
to design, build, and operate the cloud and AI infrastructure behind Project 137, the company's applied-research and IP engine. Reporting to the Director of Infrastructure Engineering, this engineer will own Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes environments that run AI/ML training, inference, and data workloads.

The role is approximately 85% hands-on engineering and 15% project coordination. The ideal candidate is a senior practitioner with deep GCP expertise, production experience supporting AI workloads, and the organizational discipline to plan and schedule infrastructure work across teams.

**Responsibilities:**

**Cloud and AI infrastructure**

* Design, build, and operate production infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform, including landing zones, VPC networking, Cloud IAM, storage, and organization policy.
* Engineer and scale infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: GPU and TPU capacity, distributed training, model serving and inference, and high-throughput data pipelines.
* Support data-science and research teams on Vertex AI, Kubeflow, and related MLOps tooling, including environment provisioning, model registries, and experiment infrastructure.
* Build and maintain hybrid connectivity between on-premises data-center and cloud environments, including Cloud Interconnect, VPN, DNS, and load balancing.

**Kubernetes and platform engineering**

* Architect and operate GKE clusters, including GPU node pools, autoscaling, workload identity, networking and ingress, and version upgrades.
* Build reusable platform components and Helm charts that give engineering and research teams self-service access to compute and AI tooling.
* Define and automate infrastructure with Terraform and GitOps practices, using Git as the source of truth for configuration, manifests, and CI/CD pipelines.

**Reliability and security**

* Implement observability, alerting, and SLOs using Cloud Operations, Prometheus, and Grafana; participate in on-call and lead root-cause analysis on incidents.
* Apply cloud security controls: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, container image scanning, policy-as-code, and software supply-chain protections.
* Plan, build, and test backup and disaster-recovery capabilities for platform and AI workloads.
* Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and document architecture standards and runbooks.

**Project coordination (approx. 15%)**

* Plan and schedule infrastructure workstreams, maintaining timelines, milestones, and dependency tracking across engineering, research, and operations teams.
* Organize technical work into clear tasks and priorities, and report progress and blockers to the Director of Infrastructure Engineering.

**Required:**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field. Equivalent experience considered.
* **Experience:**
  7+ years in infrastructure, platform, cloud, or site reliability engineering, including 2+ years of hands-on production work on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or AWS.
* **Google Cloud:**
  Deep expertise across Compute Engine, GKE, VPC, Cloud IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud Operations.
* **AI infrastructure:**
  Experience supporting AI/ML workloads in production, including GPU or TPU provisioning, training and inference platforms, and MLOps tooling such as Vertex AI or Kubeflow.
* **Kubernetes:**
  Production experience operating Kubernetes, including cluster operations, Helm, networking and ingress, RBAC, autoscaling, and upgrades.
* **Automation:**
  Strong Terraform and Git-based workflow skills; experience with CI/CD tooling such as Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Argo CD.
* **Scripting:**
  Proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash for automation and tooling.
* **Networking and systems:**
  Solid understanding of Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
* **Organization:**
  Proven ability to plan, schedule, and track technical work across multiple concurrent workstreams using tools such as Jira or Confluence.
* **Communication:**
  Clear written and verbal skills; able to explain technical trade-offs to engineers, researchers, and leadership.

**Desired:**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, or Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Application Developer (CKAD), or Security Specialist (CKS).
* Experience with GPU scheduling and sharing on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, Kueue, or Ray) and large-scale distributed training.
* Familiarity with data-center fundamentals for high-density compute, including power, cooling, and capacity planning.
* Multi-cloud experience with AWS or Azure alongside GCP.

**Location:**

* This position is based in [Reston, VA] with a [hybrid / on-site] schedule. Occasional travel of approximately 10-20% to partner sites and data-center locations.

**Clearance:**

* Secret (required), Top Secret/ SCI (preferred)

The world the mission operates in is going post-quantum, contested, and machine-speed. Quantum Sky engineers the advantage across cyber, networks, software, and quantum because the mission demands dominance, not parity. We don't follow the map. We draw it.

At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. Are you ready to join #TeamQuantumSky?

Quantum Sky Engineering LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, [sexual orientation, gender identity,] national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Senior Analytics Engineer for a Series B Venture backed Startup | New York City, NY | Hybrid Compensation: $180K–$211.5K base + equity

About the Company Our client is a fast-growing technology company building modern digital infrastructure for payments, transactions, and business operations.

As the company continues to scale its data and analytics capabilities, they are hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to take foundational ownership of how core business metrics are defined, modeled, governed, and used across the organization. This is a highly visible role at the intersection of analytics engineering, data governance, business strategy, and cross-functional decision-making.

The Opportunity We are looking for a founding-level Senior Analytics Engineer to own the data stack from the gold layer onward. Our Data Engineering team handles raw ingestion, warehouse reliability, and the bronze-to-silver layers. This role picks up from there to ensure the organization has trusted, consistent, and reusable definitions for key business performance metrics. For example, operational performance and transaction throughput metrics should mean the same thing whether queried in a BI dashboard, surfaced through an internal Slack chatbot, or consumed by an LLM-based agent.

This is much more than a traditional transformation-pipeline role. The Senior Analytics Engineer will own semantic layers, metric definitions, data contracts, cross-team metric standardization, gold-layer modeling, certified data products, analytics cost management, and data context for both human and AI consumers.

What You'll Own

* Own the gold layer and ensure core business metrics are modeled consistently and reliably.
* Design and maintain the company’s semantic layer / metrics layer.
* Define metrics and data contracts that are adopted across multiple teams.
* Partner with stakeholders across the business to resolve disagreements around metric definitions.
* Establish trusted, reusable data products that can support dashboards, reporting, self-service analytics, and AI/LLM-based consumers.
* Partner on the company’s broader reporting and analytics revamp.
* Expand data capture and improve the quality and usability of business-critical datasets.
* Help manage and optimize analytics infrastructure costs, including Snowflake and dbt usage.
* Improve documentation and create a more scalable, writing-first analytics culture.
* Work closely with Data Engineering while maintaining clear ownership of analytics-layer modeling and governance.

What We're Looking For

* 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a closely related field.
* Strong, clearly demonstrated advanced SQL experience.
* Strong experience with dbt and Snowflake.
* Direct ownership of a semantic layer, metrics layer, or equivalent modeling framework.
* Experience defining metrics or data contracts adopted by multiple teams.
* Experience acting as the sole or lead analytics engineer for important modeling or metric work.
* Track record of resolving cross-functional disagreements around how business metrics should be defined.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to operate independently in a decentralized, fast-moving environment.

Particularly Relevant Experience

* dbt Semantic Layer, LookML / Looker, Cube, Sigma, self-service analytics tooling, semantic modeling, metrics governance, or data contracts.
* Snowflake or dbt cost optimization.
* Airbyte or Fivetran.
* LLM or AI-enabled data products, structured chatbot context, MCP-style interfaces, or data products used by AI agents.
* Client-facing analytics or consulting work.
* A master’s degree in a relevant discipline is a plus, but not required.

Ideal Background

* The strongest candidates may have worked as Senior Analytics Engineer, Lead Analytics Engineer, Staff Analytics Engineer, Founding Analytics Engineer, Analytics Engineering Manager interested in returning to an IC role, or Senior Data Analyst with significant analytics-engineering and modeling ownership.
* Strong candidates often come from high-growth startups or high-caliber technology companies that use a modern data stack (e.g., payments platforms, business software, SaaS, or high-growth tech unicorns).

What Success Looks Like The ideal candidate is not simply someone who builds data models. They are someone who can step into a company where different teams may have different interpretations of the same metric and create a clear, trusted source of truth.

You should be comfortable asking questions such as: What does this metric actually mean? Who should own its definition? Why are two teams calculating it differently? Which version should become the company standard? How should that definition be represented in dbt, BI tools, and future AI applications?

The strongest person for this role combines technical depth, business curiosity, and strong cross-functional judgment.

Green Flags

* Founding or first analytics-engineering ownership at a startup.
* Direct ownership of semantic or metrics infrastructure.
* Strong Snowflake + dbt experience.
* Clear examples of creating metrics or data contracts used by multiple teams.
* Experience resolving disagreements between Product, Finance, Operations, or other business teams around metric definitions.
* Strong documentation habits and writing-first communication.
* Initiative beyond the formal job description.
* Experience thinking about how analytics models support both BI tools and AI agents.
* Experience with AI, LLMs, or agentic data consumers.

What May Not Be a Fit

* Data engineering infrastructure, orchestration, or ingestion with limited analytics modeling.
* Pipeline development without meaningful SQL/dbt ownership.
* Analytics roles without ownership of shared metrics or semantic layers.
* Highly academic or research-heavy backgrounds with limited production experience.
* Candidates who have mainly contributed to models owned by a centralized Data Engineering team rather than leading analytics-layer ownership themselves.

Location & Compensation

* Location: New York City, NY — Hybrid.
* Compensation: $180K–$210K base salary + equity.
* Relocation and visa sponsorship may be considered on a case-by-case basis.

Why This Role Is Interesting This is an opportunity to become the person who defines how the company understands and uses its own data. Rather than inheriting a fully mature analytics function, you will have the chance to shape the company’s semantic layer, establish metric governance, influence how teams make decisions, and build data products that will eventually serve both people and AI systems.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Tala**

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.
  
  
The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

#### **The Role**

We are looking for aSenior Data Engineer to help build, operate, and continuously improve the data infrastructure that powers analytics and business intelligence across Tala's global markets.

In this individual contributor role, you will take ownership of Tala's data synchronization pipelines, ensuring that data from our market-level databases is reliably captured, processed, and delivered to Snowflake for downstream analytics and business use.

Our data infrastructure uses a modern AWS-based architecture, including AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Apache Iceberg, Amazon S3, and Snowflake. You will work across this ecosystem to ensure data is accurate, available, and delivered with minimal latency.

Beyond maintaining existing pipelines, you will identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. You will also establish and monitor service level objectives (SLOs), strengthen testing and deployment practices, and lead root cause analysis when issues arise.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex distributed data challenges and takes ownership of production systems from development through operation.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own and operate data pipelines: Maintain and improve Tala's change data capture (CDC) and data synchronization infrastructure, ensuring accurate and timely delivery of data from market-level databases into Snowflake.
* Improve pipeline performance and scalability: Identify and implement improvements to reduce latency, optimize infrastructure costs, and support growing data volumes across markets.
* Build and evolve data infrastructure: Onboard new data sources, tables, and markets while managing schema evolution and ensuring compatibility across systems.
* Drive reliability and data quality: Establish service level objectives (SLOs), implement monitoring and alerting, and build automated data quality checks to ensure data remains accurate and available.
* Strengthen engineering practices: Develop and maintain unit and integration tests, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment strategies, including dry runs and blue-green deployments.
* Lead incident resolution: Troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analyses, and translate lessons learned into better monitoring, testing, documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Contribute to technical direction: Participate in architecture and design discussions, write and review technical design documents, and provide thoughtful feedback through code reviews.
* Collaborate across teams: Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Data Platform, Product, Credit, and Business Development teams to understand their data needs and ensure reliable access to the information they depend on.

### **What You'll Need**

* 4+ years of experience in backend engineering or data engineering, ideally supporting consumer-scale applications.
* At least 2 years of hands-on professional Python experience.
* Proven experience independently building, operating, and improving production-grade data pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with change data capture (CDC) and stream processing technologies such as Kafka, Amazon MSK, AWS DMS, or comparable tools.
* Strong proficiency in Apache Spark, particularly Spark Structured Streaming.
* Experience with modern data lakehouse architectures and table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi, as well as Parquet.
* Strong database experience across relational and analytical systems, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS, and Snowflake.
* Hands-on experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, ideally including EMR, S3, MSK, DMS, RDS, and EKS.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tools such as Terraform, Terragrunt, Helm, and Jenkins.
* Familiarity with pipeline orchestration and job scheduling tools such as Airflow or Python-based services running on Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalable algorithms, and large-scale data processing.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams and business stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Trino or Presto.
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
* Familiarity with AWS Glue.
* Experience with additional stream processing technologies such as Debezium, Amazon Kinesis, or Apache Flink.
* Experience with other modern data lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake or Apache Hudi.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience.
