title: Senior Data Engineer, Data Products
description:
Summary
  
  
At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers' experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they are looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses. Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, Apple Maps, MLS Season Pass, and F1. Everything we do is designed for trust, connection, and impact: we respect user privacy, integrate advertising thoughtfully into the experience, and deliver value for advertisers of all sizes, from small app developers to big global brands. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone. The Data Products Engineering team is seeking versatile data engineers to build, extend, and operate the near-real-time and batch pipelines at the heart of Apple Ads, and to help design and improve them as you grow. You will ship features, schema changes, backfills, and improvements to petabyte-scale funnel and aggregate pipelines, including privacy-preserving critical pipelines, with strong ownership of quality, reliability, and time to delivery. Depending on your level, you will also own the design of pipeline components, drive reliability and efficiency improvements, and mentor other engineers. You will join a team of world-class data engineers with an appetite for applying leading-edge technologies, and collaborate closely with your pod and with the business to deliver relevant data and insight. This is a high-velocity, AI-native role: you will use AI agents daily to move fast without cutting corners on correctness. You should have 5 plus years of data engineering experience, ideally within the ads or media space, a strong understanding of scalable approaches, and the ability to thrive and stand out under tight deadline constraints in Agile environments. We will calibrate the level and scope to your experience.
  
  
Description
  
  
At Apple Ads, we are building the next generation of privacy-focused advertising capabilities. As part of the data organization, we work at the cutting edge of data engineering, machine learning, and privacy at Apple scale. We are constantly developing data products to provide amazing user experiences and to drive value for developers and publishers. As a member of the Data Products Engineering team, you will: - Engineer and operate secure, scalable data processing systems across real-time, near-real-time, and batch execution contexts using Spark, Kafka, and Iceberg - Deliver features, schema changes, backfills, and fixes with clean, well-tested, well-documented code, and help support privacy-preserving critical pipelines - Depending on level, own the design of pipeline components, define and refactor approaches to meet correctness and scale challenges, and drive reliability and efficiency improvements - Use AI coding agents to accelerate implementation, test coverage, and debugging, validating every result for correctness, privacy, and cost - Apply a strong understanding of the intersection between business, analytics, and engineering, taking a proactive approach focused on reusable solutions to improve efficiency and time to insight - Contribute to on-call, monitoring, and the continuous improvement of pipeline reliability and efficiency; more senior engineers help lead incident response and root-cause analysis - Collaborate with a team of world-class data engineers and product managers; grow through code and design reviews, and mentor other engineers as you gain seniority - Work effectively in a rapidly changing, sprint-based, agile environment, and contribute to a culture that emphasizes reliability, resiliency, extensibility, scalability, and productivity. We are one team, nurturing each other's growth and supporting each other in delivering for our customers and Apple
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 5+ years of industry experience building distributed, scalable data pipelines
* Proven track record of successful and timely software delivery with complex dependencies
* Demonstrated innovative, critical thinking and troubleshooting skills
* Proficiency with modern programming languages (for example Scala, Java, or Python) and ease with picking up new technologies independently
* Strong computer science and data-engineering fundamentals
* Proficiency in distributed data processing technologies (for example Spark, Kafka, Flink) and data modeling with Iceberg lakehouse concepts
* Experience building and scaling systems on premise and in the cloud
* Demonstrated productive use of AI coding tools in real delivery
* Passion for data quality, code elegance, clear documentation, cost saving, and operational excellence
* Excellent collaborative skills

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience owning the design and architecture of pipeline components or services, not just implementing them
* Experience with near-real-time or streaming pipelines, event-driven ingestion, deduplication, parity and reconciliation, and lakehouse table formats at scale
* History of driving reliability, efficiency, or cost improvements, and mentoring other engineers
* Contribution to open source distributed system projects
* Ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional technical and non-technical teams
* Comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with ambiguous requirements
* Comfortable with rotating on-call for mission-critical applications
* Prior experience in the advertising industry is a huge plus

The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

experience.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Span**
--------------

Span exists to help engineering organizations turn AI adoption into real effectiveness. As AI tools reshape how software gets built, the companies that continuously improve how their teams use AI in their day-to-day will pull ahead. We're the AI-native developer intelligence platform built for that moment. We're looking for people who want to shape how the next generation of high-performing engineering orgs operate.

We're a Series A company with a small, focused team that moves fast and ships things that matter. We’re proud to be helping forward-thinking orgs like Ramp, Carvana, Intercom, and OpenTable. We're honored to be backed by dozens of founders, CTOs, and CPOs we admire from Slack, Notion, Rippling, Fivetran, Coda, Adobe, and Square, as well as funds including Alt Capital, BoxGroup, Bling, Craft, and SV Angel.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to help build, scale, and maintain the infrastructure that powers Span.

You'll work closely with our engineering team to ensure our systems are reliable, secure, performant, and built to scale. From automating deployments and improving CI/CD pipelines to managing cloud infrastructure and strengthening observability, you'll play a critical role in making it easier for our engineers to build and ship great software.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, eliminating operational friction, and building systems that enable engineering teams to move faster.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own and scale our infrastructure:** Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure to support our growing platform.
* **Improve CI/CD pipelines:** Build and optimize automated build, testing, and deployment workflows to help engineers ship quickly and confidently.
* **Automate everything:** Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes through infrastructure as code, scripting, and automation.
* **Strengthen reliability and observability:** Implement and improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response processes to ensure system health and availability.
* **Optimize performance and costs:** Monitor infrastructure utilization, identify inefficiencies, and improve performance while managing cloud costs.
* **Build secure systems:** Partner with engineering and security stakeholders to implement infrastructure security best practices, access controls, and compliance requirements.
* **Enable developer productivity:** Create tools, processes, and infrastructure that reduce friction and improve the developer experience.
* **Support production operations:** Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, investigate incidents, and implement long-term improvements.
* **Collaborate across engineering:** Work closely with software engineers to support new features, architectural decisions, and evolving infrastructure needs.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
* Strong experience managing cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
* Strong understanding of networking, Linux systems, cloud security, and infrastructure best practices.
* Experience troubleshooting production systems and improving reliability.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to solving technical challenges.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience working at an early-stage or high-growth startup.
* Experience supporting SaaS platforms or data-intensive applications.
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure, workloads, or deployment patterns.
* Experience with customer-managed cloud environments, including Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) architectures.
* Experience with SOC 2 compliance and infrastructure security controls.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, databases, and high-volume data processing.
* Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service infrastructure tooling.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer, Info Apps
description:
Summary
  
  
The Info Apps DevOps team provides the infrastructure backbone for Apple News, Stocks, Weather, and Apple Creator Studio, powering experiences used by millions of users worldwide and fueling capabilities like Siri AI's World Knowledge Answers. This team owns CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, developer tooling, and operational support for large-scale backend systems deployed across hybrid cloud environments. Join us to shape how software is built, deployed, and scaled across some of Apple's most beloved consumer products.
  
  
Description
  
  
In this role, you will design and build infrastructure that serves millions of concurrent users across multi-cloud and on-premises environments, with a primary focus on development tooling, deployment automation, and CI/CD pipeline improvements. You will partner closely with engineering and SRE teams to architect scalable solutions using Kubernetes, AWS, and GitOps workflows. Day-to-day work is roughly 70% automation and tooling development and 30% operational support, giving you deep hands-on ownership across the full software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in a DevOps or infrastructure-focused engineering role, including work on systems at large scale (millions of concurrent users)
* Expert-level proficiency with Kubernetes and container orchestration, including deployment, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting on EKS or equivalent managed Kubernetes platforms
* Advanced scripting skills in Python or Java , applied to automation workflows and custom tool development
* Deep expertise in CI/CD systems including ArgoCD, Jenkins, and Gradle/Maven, paired with advanced Git and GitOps workflow experience
* Proven experience managing cloud platforms (AWS and/or GCP), covering compute, networking, storage, and managed services
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation to manage resources and build reusable abstractions
* Solid understanding of Linux operating systems, shell scripting, and core networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and load balancing
* Demonstrated ability to debug complex distributed systems and solve ambiguous infrastructure problems under production conditions
* Bachelors degree in a related field or we may consider an equivalent experience

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Familiarity with Generative AI concepts and experience supporting AI/ML development environments, model operationalization, or platforms such as SageMaker
* Experience maintaining and debugging Spring-based Java runtime environments in a DevOps or platform engineering context
* Strong background in modern web services architectures including REST APIs, microservices, and service mesh patterns
* Proficiency with data infrastructure components such as Cassandra, Kafka, Solr, Postgres, or Redis in a large-scale backend environment
* Track record of working closely with product engineering and SRE teams to define and enforce deployment standards across multi-team organizations

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Summary
  
  
The Synthetic Data Group (SDG) Cloud Infrastructure team at Apple is responsible for building the next generation of secure, high-performance cloud services to support machine learning/GenAI and synthetic data initiatives. We are a multi-functional team solving challenging engineering problems across distributed systems, large-scale data infrastructure, and cloud services.
  
  
Description
  
  
In this role, you will architect and develop the cloud infrastructure powering Apple’s Machine Learning and Synthetic Data Platform. You will design scalable services and pipelines to process and manage large volumes of data, enabling cutting-edge ML applications. This role involves tackling complex distributed system challenges — from optimizing data storage and retrieval to ensuring low-latency, high-throughput computations — all while maintaining world-class security and reliability. You will collaborate closely with machine learning engineers, data scientists, and other engineering teams to integrate new algorithms and data sources into our platform. Your work will involve full-stack ownership of cloud services: from defining system architecture and APIs to implementing back-end services and deploying infrastructure as code. We use a broad range of technologies including AWS services, Kubernetes, Terraform, Golang, and modern databases. We value simplicity and rigor: you will drive for clean, maintainable designs and use data-driven insights to continuously improve performance and scalability. You will also mentor other engineers and play a key role in setting technical direction. You’ll have the opportunity to innovate — exploring alternative technologies, prototyping new solutions, and influencing product direction to better serve our internal customers. If you are excited by the prospect of building critical cloud infrastructure for AI/ML at a large scale, this role will allow you to do the best work of your life at Apple.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* BS and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience
* 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale
* Hands-on experience with AWS services including EC2, EKS, S3, ELB and SQS
* Experience with Kubernetes-based container orchestration and production operations
* Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform
* Strong programming skills in Go (Golang) for systems and service development
* Proficiency in at least one additional language used for full-stack services development (JavaScript, Python)
* Experience designing and building microservices-based architectures in production
* Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres) and NoSQL datastores in production environments
* Demonstrated ability to use a quantitative approach to architect and develop robust, secure, high-performance cloud services (modeling, iterative prototyping, analysis, tools)
* Track record of influencing cross-functional architects and high-performance teams to define architecture
* Exposure to Agile development methodologies

* Experience designing and building applications using container and serverless technologies
* Good exposure to Agile software development and DevOps practices such as Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Continuous Integration, and automated deployment

* Strong practical application development experience on Linux systems
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Experience with film and game development pipelines (plus)

description:
hatch I.T. is partnering with Expression to find a **DevOps Engineer**. See details below:

**About The Role:**

Expression is seeking a mid-level DevOps Engineer to support the National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) Federal Spectrum Data Systems (FSDS) program within the U.S. Department of Commerce.The FSDS program supports the modernization of federal spectrum management systems through improved technology, automation, data integration, and interoperability. These systems help NTIA manage federal spectrum use and support essential government missions.In this role, you will implement and maintain secure Azure cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines supporting applications, data services, and analytics. You will work with senior engineers, software developers, system administrators, and security personnel to support deployments across Azure Commercial, Government, and Secret cloud environments.We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of defined tasks, troubleshoot deployment issues, and turn repeatable work into reliable automation. You should bring practical DevOps experience, know when to ask questions, and be ready to build your skills in a

* **Location:** Washington, DC (3 days/week on-site).

**About the Company:**

Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Washington DC, Expression provides data fusion, data analytics, software engineering, information technology, and electromagnetic spectrum management solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense, Department of State, and national security community. Expression’s “Perpetual Innovation” culture focuses on creating immediate and sustainable value for their clients via agile delivery of tailored solutions built through constant engagement with their clients. Expression was ranked #1 on the Washington Technology 2018's Fast 50 list of fastest growing small business Government contractors and a Top 20 Big Data Solutions Provider by CIO Review.

### **Responsibilities:**

**Cloud Infrastructure & Automation**

* Deploy, configure, and maintain Azure resources supporting unclassified and classified spectrum management systems.
* Create and update Infrastructure as Code using established patterns and tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
* Build and maintain Docker images and support container deployments using Kubernetes and Helm.
* Configure networking, access controls, and environment settings in coordination with senior engineers and security personnel.

**CI/CD & Secure Software Delivery**

* Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines that automate application builds, testing, and deployments.
* Integrate and maintain code, dependency, container image, and infrastructure security checks using established tools and processes.
* Maintain deployment scripts, pipeline templates, artifacts, and release configurations, and support release approvals.
* Support deployments within restricted environments, following approved procedures for software dependencies and artifact handling.
* Work with developers to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, and configuration differences across development, test, and production environments.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain assigned security controls in accordance with applicable Department of Commerce, NTIA, and federal requirements.
* Apply approved configuration baselines and STIGs where required, and remediate identified vulnerabilities with guidance from security personnel.
* Support RMF, ATO, and continuous monitoring activities by collecting technical evidence and tracking remediation actions.
* Maintain secure handling of credentials, secrets, and deployment artifacts throughout the delivery process.

**Reliability & Operations**

* Configure and maintain monitoring, centralized logging, and alerts using established tools and standards.
* Investigate infrastructure and application issues, review logs, and support incident response and root cause analysis.
* Execute and help test backup, recovery, and rollback procedures.
* Keep deployment documentation, configuration records, and operational runbooks current.
* Support new application releases and production transitions in coordination with the broader engineering team.

### **Qualifications:**

* Active Secret security clearance or higher is required.
* Current CompTIA Security+ certification, or ability to obtain it within 30 days of hire.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and three or more years of relevant DevOps/cloud engineering experience, or five or more years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
* Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining infrastructure in Microsoft Azure.
* Experience creating, modifying, and troubleshooting Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for builds, testing, security scanning, and deployments.
* Experience supporting application deployments across development, test, and production environments.
* Practical experience using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or comparable technologies.
* Experience building and running containers using Docker, with working knowledge of Kubernetes and Helm.
* Ability to write and troubleshoot automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience using Git-based version control, including branches, pull requests, and collaborative code reviews.
* Working knowledge of Linux administration, cloud networking, access controls, secrets management, and monitoring and logging.
* Ability to investigate technical issues, document solutions, communicate progress, and work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating with the team.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Azure Government, Azure Government Secret, or other restricted federal environments.
* Experience supporting federal system modernization or operational cloud services.
* Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53 controls, RMF, ATO support activities, or STIGs.
* Experience using security scanning tools such as Nessus, SonarQube, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Aqua Security, or comparable products.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, or Grafana.
* Familiarity with database or search platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch.
* Exposure to data engineering or machine learning workloads, including platforms such as Databricks or Apache Spark.
* Relevant Microsoft Azure administration, development, DevOps, or security certifications.

**Benefits:**

Expression offers competitive salaries and benefits, such as:

* 401k matching
* PPO and HDHP medical/dental/vision insurance
* Education reimbursement
* Complimentary life insurance
* Generous PTO and holiday leave
* Onsite office gym access
* Commuter Benefits Plan

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: DevOps Engineer, Senior
description:
**Your Role**

The Digital Platform team creates and maintains the foundation and features upon which Stellarus Digital Applications’ technical products are built . The DevOps Engineer, Senior will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Platform as your direct manager. In this role you will design, implement, and manage scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

  

**Your Work**

**In this role, you will:**

* Design reusable Azure platform components, cloud automation frameworks, self-service capabilities and CI/CD solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and deployment efficiency.
* Develop reusable Terraform, Bicep, GitOps, and platform engineering accelerators consumed across multiple teams , configuration management, and environment automation for complex applications or platforms.
* Resolve complex production, deployment, and performance issues; drive root cause analysis and preventive improvements.
* Design enterprise observability frameworks, SLO tracking, and operational excellence tooling, alerting, disaster recovery readiness, and operational practices to improve system resiliency and reduce downtime.
* Implement Security-as-Code, Compliance-as-Code, and Policy-as-Code frameworks into infrastructure and pipeline design to support secure, governed delivery.
* Lead platform adoption and developer experience improvements for less experienced engineers and promote DevOps best practices across engineering, QA, SRE, and platform teams.

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* 5 years of prior relevant experience
* Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD architecture, automation, and release engineering practices.
* Experience implementing infrastructure - as - code, configuration management, and automated environment provisioning for complex applications.
* Experience resolving complex deployment, production, performance, or reliability issues through root cause analysis and corrective action.
* Knowledge of observability, monitoring, alerting, disaster recovery readiness, and service reliability practices.
* Experience embedding security, access, vulnerability, and compliance controls into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

**Preferred Knowledge & Experience:**

* Advanced experience with Azure or other major cloud platforms in regulated or enterprise environments.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container platforms, microservices, API gateways, or distributed systems.
* Experience mentoring engineers or promoting DevOps standards, patterns, and best practices across teams.
* Relevant certification such as Azure DevOps Engineer, AWS DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes CKA, or comparable certification.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

**Position Summary**
====================

The Senior DevOps Engineer designs, automates, secures, and supports AWS cloud infrastructure and software delivery pipelines for a mission-critical application supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The position provides senior-level technical expertise in infrastructure as code, CI/CD, controlled deployments, system reliability, production troubleshooting, and federal security compliance, while collaborating with development, quality assurance, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable, compliant releases.

##### **Qualifications**

**Core Requirements**
=====================

* Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD, 12 years with a HS Diploma
* Experience with hands-on AWS infrastructure experience
* Active AWS Associate-level certification and understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
* Hands-on administration of Linux servers (Ubuntu preferred), including scripting and automation of patching, backups, logging, key management, and system hardening.
* Experience with AWS storage (S3, EBS, incremental snapshots, and AMI management), cloud networking and connectivity, load balancing, and Auto Scaling.
* Proficiency with infrastructure as code and CI/CD tools, including Terraform, Ansible, and Jenkins.
* Ability to obtain a VA Public Trust clearance; U.S. Citizen, Green Card holder, residing in the United States for at least three years.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Engineer and maintain reusable Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for source validation, builds, automated testing, security scanning, containerization, artifact promotion, and deployment.
* Manage releases across DEV, DEV2, TEST, MVC, PREPROD, and PROD environments, using automated lower-environment deployments and controlled approvals for higher environments.
* Provision and maintain AWS infrastructure and Amazon ECS services using CloudFormation and other IaC tools, including IAM, VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, target groups, resource sizing, and health checks.
* Build, tag, publish, and promote Docker images through Amazon ECR with artifact traceability and no unnecessary rebuilding between environments.
* Automate Java/Maven API and Node.js/npm application builds, dependency management, linting, caching, and security checks; integrate Amazon S3 and ECR with delivery workflows.
* Lead technical execution of release and change controls, production deployments, quality checks, maintenance windows, and stakeholder communications.
* Diagnose and resolve complex pipeline, AWS, networking, IAM, dependency, configuration, and production issues; support disaster recovery planning, testing, and ongoing environment management.

**Security and Compliance**
===========================

* Integrate AWS Inspector, GuardDuty, and dependency scanning into DevSecOps workflows; identify, assess and remediate vulnerabilities, threats and configuration risks.
* Implement system hardening using applicable STIGs and support security policies, procedures, and controls; review network and system configurations against security requirements.
* Support VA Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities, System Security Plans (SSPs), NIST/FISMA compliance, security control assessments, contingency planning, and continuous monitoring.

**Additional Technical Qualifications**
=======================================

* Experience with AWS EC2, ECS, ECR, S3, EBS, EFS, ALB, CloudFront, CloudTrail, EventBridge, IAM, and cloud networking; familiarity with Kubernetes.
* Experience with web and application servers, load balancers, web application firewalls, and container deployments.
* Familiarity with Jira Cloud, Confluence, Slack, Agile practices, release governance, and change management.

**Professional Competencies**
=============================

* Communicates clearly with VA stakeholders, program and project managers, technical leads, architects, security teams, and application developers.
* Demonstrates independent problem-solving, sound judgment, risk management skills, organizational skills, attention to detail, and accountability for delivery.

Collaborates effectively across teams and adapts to changing priorities and technical requirements

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

title: DevOps Engineer I
description:
**DevOps Engineer I**

**Location:** Durham, NC (Hybrid)

**ABOUT US**

Victra is Verizon’s largest premium retailer in the United States. We thrive on collaboration, innovation, and performance. Our mission is to “Connect technology to life in a trustworthy, fun, and profitable way”. We work closely with Verizon and our brand partners to deliver exceptional product offerings, promotions, and campaigns that drive in-store traffic and revenue.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

The DevOps Engineer I is an entry-level contributor on the Cloud Platform & DevOps team, supporting the delivery pipelines, cloud environments, and automation that application teams rely on to ship software. Working under the direction of senior engineers, this role supports one to two application teams or a defined slice of the delivery platform, executes well-scoped tasks and tickets typically sized in hours to days, and implements changes within existing patterns, escalating anything that requires design or standards decisions.

This role is designed for someone early in their career who is motivated to become a proficient cloud DevOps engineer. The DevOps Engineer I is expected to be curious, coachable, and reliable, learning the team’s tools and standards and growing into greater responsibility over time. Success in this role reflects Victra's core leadership principles including: Results Driven, Relationship Building, Change Management, Customer Focus, and Talent Management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Execute scoped changes to existing CI/CD pipelines, including YAML edits, variable updates, and environment wiring, under the direction of senior engineers. [Results Driven]
* Investigate and triage failed builds, deployments, and release pipelines; resolve routine failures and escalate complex issues with clear context. [Results Driven]
* Fulfill developer requests for pipeline access, environment configuration, and standard tooling setup. [Customer Focus]
* Monitor assigned pipelines and deployments and alert the team to anomalies. [Results Driven]
* Update runbooks, README files, and documentation as pipelines and processes change. [Talent Management]
* Participate in code reviews, primarily to learn the codebase and receive feedback as an author. [Relationship Building]
* Pair with senior engineers to learn Azure services, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices. [Relationship Building]
* Pursue certification and skill development aligned with the role’s growth path. [Talent Management]

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 0–2 years of professional experience in DevOps, cloud, software development, IT support, or a related technical role.
* Foundational understanding of at least one major cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP accepted).
* Working knowledge of Git, including commits, branches, and pull requests.
* Some scripting experience in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Basic understanding of what a CI/CD pipeline is and what it does.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills. [Relationship Building]
* Curiosity to read documentation, build labs, and understand how things actually work. [Change Management]
* Coachability, with an openness to seeing feedback as a learning opportunity rather than a judgment. [Relationship Building]
* Clear communication when asking for help, including what you tried, what you saw, and what you expected. [Relationship Building]
* Attention to detail, verifying your work before calling it done. [Results Driven]
* Dependability with assigned tasks and a commitment to finishing what you start. [Results Driven]

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Hands-on Azure experience, whether professional, academic, or through personal projects.
* Exposure to Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or a similar CI/CD platform.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code concepts.
* Exposure to Docker and containerization basics.
* AZ-900 (Azure Fundamentals) certification, or progress toward it.

**WHY JOIN US?**

* Paid training and career development opportunities.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401k retirement plan.
* Tuition reimbursement.
* Employee discounts on Verizon services.
* Referral bonuses.
* Career pathing opportunities.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our employees' differences, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or Veteran status. Different makes us better.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**

As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll build, automate, and maintain reliable cloud infrastructure that supports applications and business services. You’ll work across public and private cloud environments, strengthen security, and partner with software and IT teams to deliver scalable solutions. Your impact: By improving deployment and infrastructure reliability, you help application teams release services smoothly and give users dependable access.

**Job Location:** 100% Remote – United States  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Arrangement:** Fully Remote

**Responsibilities**

* Design and manage cloud architecture and infrastructure across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and other cloud services.
* Automate deployment processes and infrastructure management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Operate and improve Linux and Windows systems, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and distributed systems.
* Apply system hardening and identity and access management (IAM) controls; support networking, Virtual Private Clouds, and VPN connectivity.
* Monitor cloud services, troubleshoot incidents, and document changes in line with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile practices.

* Preferred: Infrastructure tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Jenkins, and Git; platforms such as VMware, OpenStack, Rackspace, Citrix, and Meraki.
* Preferred: Exposure to S3, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, Docker, NoSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, SQL, T-SQL, or PL/SQL.
* Helpful: Background in computer science, software development, application development, DevOps, Java,.NET, Node.js, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Internet of Things, or computer management.

**Mandatory Eligibility Requirements**

* Must currently reside in the United States.
* Must be physically located within the USA while performing the job.
* Candidates currently residing in India or any other country outside the USA are NOT eligible.
* Must be comfortable working in a fully remote environment.
* Must be able to provide proof of US residence during the recruitment process.

Pay: $90,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to maintain and improve the deployment pipelines, infrastructure environments and operational systems used by our software teams. Based at 911 Virginia Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30306, this role involves managing CI/CD pipelines, troubleshooting build failures, maintaining infrastructure and ensuring that system changes are properly documented.

You will work closely with software developers and infrastructure teams to keep development and production environments stable. The position requires practical DevOps experience, scripting knowledge and a responsible approach to maintaining systems that support ongoing business operations.

The regular work schedule is Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain and monitor CI/CD pipelines used for application builds, testing and deployments.
* Investigate and resolve failed builds, deployment errors and pipeline interruptions.
* Manage development, staging and production environments.
* Perform routine maintenance and security patching across infrastructure and clusters.
* Monitor system performance, availability and deployment health.
* Use scripting and automation to reduce repetitive operational work.
* Review pipeline configurations and identify opportunities to improve reliability.
* Coordinate infrastructure changes with software development and technical teams.
* Troubleshoot environment-related problems and investigate recurring failures.
* Support application releases and ensure deployment procedures are followed.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation, configuration records and change logs.
* Prepare and update operational runbooks for routine maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Communicate technical issues, planned changes and potential service disruptions to relevant teams.
* Follow established procedures when accessing production environments and implementing system changes.

**What We're Looking For**

* Three or more years of professional experience in DevOps, systems administration or cloud infrastructure.
* Practical experience maintaining CI/CD pipelines and continuous integration tools.
* Understanding of software build, testing and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and container technologies.
* Scripting knowledge using Python, Bash, PowerShell or comparable languages.
* Experience troubleshooting build failures and deployment problems.
* Understanding of infrastructure maintenance, system patching and environment management.
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
* Strong technical problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Good written communication and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to manage operational responsibilities independently and work effectively with development teams.
* A reliable and methodical approach to system maintenance and technical changes.

**What We Expect**

We expect careful work, clear writing and straight dealing. Pipeline changes should be tested, infrastructure updates should be documented and technical problems should be communicated without unnecessary delay.

The successful candidate should maintain accurate operational records, prepare useful runbooks and take responsibility for assigned environments. When deployment problems occur, we expect a calm, structured approach focused on identifying the cause and restoring normal operations.

**How to Apply**

Submit your résumé directly through Indeed using the **Apply Now** button.

Applications received through Indeed will be included in the recruitment process and reviewed within the same week they are submitted. Every submitted résumé will be counted in the application review process.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

**Applicants will be considered based on job-related skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws.**

Pay: $130,000.00 - $135,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Location**: Vineland, New Jersey

**Work Setting**: In Person

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Department**: IT / Infrastructure

**About DataOne**  
DataOne designs, develops, and operates sustainable AI Factories, bringing together energy, infrastructure, and artificial intelligence at industrial scale. With operations in the U.S. and internationally, we deliver large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure with a focus on innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence. As we grow, we’re looking for people who want to bring their experience, ideas, and perspective to meaningful projects and help shape what comes next.

**About the Job**  
DataOne is hiring a DevOps Engineer to build, automate, and maintain the infrastructure and deployment pipelines that support our AI Factories and 24/7 Tier III mission-critical facilities. You’ll work to keep our platforms reliable, secure, and scalable through automation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This role calls for strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to stay calm when responding to production incidents.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments
* Manage and automate infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar)
* Deploy, operate, and scale containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes
* Monitor system health, performance, and availability using observability tools
* Respond to alerts, outages, and incidents, and lead root cause analysis and remediation
* Partner with software, data, and facilities teams to support GPU and high-performance computing environments
* Implement and maintain security best practices, access controls, and vulnerability management
* Manage cloud and hybrid infrastructure across on-premises and public cloud platforms
* Maintain clear runbooks, technical documentation, and incident reports
* Participate in on-call rotations, disaster recovery testing, and ongoing training

**What You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Minimum 3 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role
* Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar)
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar)
* Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Strong Linux administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar)
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, or similar)
* Solid understanding of networking, security, and system reliability principles
* Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to respond effectively under pressure
* Ability to participate in an on-call rotation

***Experience and skills come from many paths. Relevant professional, hands-on, educational, military, trade, and industry experience may all qualify you for this role.***

 **Requirements**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting data center, critical infrastructure, or other 24/7 environments
* Experience with GPU clusters, HPC, or AI/ML infrastructure
* Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (AWS, CKA, CKAD, or similar)
* Experience with configuration management, secrets management, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar)
* Experience with energy, power, or facility monitoring systems

**What to Expect**

* On-site position supporting a 24/7 Tier III mission-critical environment
* Regular collaboration with engineering, operations, security, and facilities teams
* Occasional after-hours work for maintenance windows, deployments, or incident response
* Ongoing learning as our technology and infrastructure evolve

**Physical Requirements**

Ability to work at a computer for extended periods. Occasional on-site visits to data center or facility areas may require standing, walking, and lifting up to 50 lbs.

 **Benefits**

**What We Offer**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match up to 3%
* PTO
* Annual performance-based bonus opportunity
* Company equity opportunity for eligible positions

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

DataOne provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type and are committed to a workplace where everyone is treated with respect.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Clinical Quality and Outcomes
description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.
  
  
Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!
  
  
*LifeStance Health Values*

* Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.
* Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.
* Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.
* One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

**Benefits**
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Analytics Engineer, Clinical Quality and Outcomes supports the Chief Medical Officer organization in building the future state of clinical quality, patient safety, outcomes measurement, and clinical research analytics at LifeStance.
  
  
Reporting to Clinical Strategy, this individual contributor will serve as the bridge between clinical stakeholders, executive leadership, and enterprise data teams. The role will transform complex clinical data into trusted, governed, and actionable insights that drive clinical decision-making, enterprise quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and research initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in healthcare analytics with the ability to understand end-user needs and translate them into intuitive dashboard experiences, scalable reporting solutions, and research-grade data assets. This individual will be responsible for ensuring data integrity from source systems through executive reporting, enabling consistent metrics that can confidently be reported internally, externally, to payers, regulatory bodies, board committees, and potentially investors.
  
  
This role will support LifeStance in establishing the next generation of clinical analytics capabilities through modern data architecture, cloud data warehouses (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake) and SQL data transformations, data quality frameworks, advanced analytics methodologies, and scalable self-service reporting environments.
  
  
Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITES**
  
  
**Clinical Data & Analytics Strategy**
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain SQL-based data transformations that convert EHR and clinical source data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets that are actionable and translatable to our frontline clinicians
* Partner with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to translate clinical questions into measurable analytic requirements, data models, and dashboard experiences, using electronic health record data.
* Serve as a trusted thought partner for clinical quality, outcomes measurement, patient safety, regulatory readiness, and research-based reporting initiatives.
* Identify emerging opportunities to leverage advancements in analytic AI-enabled quality monitoring, and modern healthcare data platforms in the clinical environment.
* Work collaboratively with analytics team members across functions to ensure consistency in practice and reporting across functions: Operations, Clinical Operations, Payor Relations, Business Development

**Data Integrity & Governance**
  
  

* Maintain rigorous data quality controls, validation processes, lineage documentation, and metric governance standards to ensure trust in clinical reporting.
* Design repeatable testing and reconciliation frameworks that identify discrepancies before they reach operational, executive, board, or external reporting audiences.
* Ensure consistency of metric definitions and calculations across dashboards, reports, scorecards, and enterprise reporting environments.
* Apply and uphold data security and privacy best practices for healthcare and health research datasets, including data de-identification standards and minimum-necessary use principles
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues in clinical datasets, performing exploratory analysis and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency of reported metrics
* Document data models, pipeline logic, and dashboard definitions to support transparency, maintainability, and knowledge-sharing across the analytics team
* Collaborate with enterprise data engineering, analytics engineering, and data analysts to align clinical data models with enterprise data architecture and governance standards

**Dashboard Architecture & User Experience**
  
  

* Lead the design of intuitive, user-centered dashboard experiences that enable clinicians, medical leaders, operations leaders, and executives to quickly identify insights and take action.
* Translate workflow requirements into dashboards that support both operational intervention, strategic decision-making, and quality improvement.
* Design reporting experiences that balance flexibility, self-service analytics, and standardized enterprise measures.
* Apply user-centered design principles to ensure dashboards are adopted, trusted, and operationally relevant.
* Develop executive, board, regulatory, and clinician-facing reporting solutions that provide a consistent source of truth across audiences.

**Research & Outcomes Analytics**
  
  

* Build and curate research-grade datasets that support clinical outcomes studies, publication efforts, payer reporting, and real-world evidence generation.
* Partner with clinical and research leaders to operationalize outcomes measures, patient-reported outcomes, and quality indicators into analytically rigorous datasets.
* Ensure data are appropriately validated, documented, and reproducible for internal and external research use.

**Data Engineering & Platform Development**
  
  

* Design and maintain scalable analytics models, data marts, and reporting layers using cloud based data warehouses (AWS Redshift, Snowflake) and modern cloud data architecture.
* Develop and optimize SQL-based transformations supporting clinical quality, patient safety, outcomes, and research reporting.
* Leverage modern analytics engineering practices.  For example: dbt, automated testing, version control, documentation, and CI/CD methodologies.
* Collaborate with enterprise data engineering teams to ensure clinical analytics solutions align with enterprise architecture and future-state platform strategy.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Informatics, Engineering, Public Health, or a closely related field.
* 7+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, data science, or related disciplines.
* 5 + years experience working directly with clinical subject matter experts and executive stakeholders to define, refine, and operationalize complex measures.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise reporting solutions that support executive, operational, clinical, and regulatory decision-making.
* Advanced SQL expertise with experience building scalable analytic datasets and reporting environments.
* 5+ years developing Power BI or equivalent business intelligence solutions.
* Strong experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience implementing data quality testing, metric validation fram

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**About Tantalus Systems (TSX: GRID)**

Tantalus is a technology company dedicated to helping utilities modernize their distribution grids by harnessing the power of data across all their devices and systems deployed throughout the entire distribution grid – from the substation to the EV charger located behind the meter. We offer smart grid solutions across multiple levels: intelligent connected devices, communications networks, data management, enterprise applications and analytics. Learn more at http://www.tantalus.com/.

Come join us if you’re interested in being part of an entrepreneurial team, solving complex technical problems and delivering innovative solutions that will directly impact the electrification of everything and the decarbonization of our society.

We have operations throughout the United States and Canada with offices in Burnaby (British Columbia, Canada), Raleigh (North Carolina, USA), and Norwalk (Connecticut, USA).

This position offers a competitive salary plus variable compensation based on performance targets and business objectives. Tantalus also offers generous benefits, including medical, dental and vision plans, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts and paid time off.

**The Opportunity**

  

Tantalus is seeking an early-career **Analytics Engineer** to join our Customer Operations team, reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Experience.

  

In this role, you will help turn data from Tantalus Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) deployments into clear, actionable insights for utilities and internal teams. You will build reporting tools, automated analyses, dashboards, benchmarks, and data-driven workflows that demonstrate how Tantalus solutions are improving outage response, power quality, system reliability, and operational performance.

  

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of utility operations, data analytics, AI, and customer outcomes. You will help customers understand the measurable value of their Tantalus deployments while supporting internal teams with the insights needed to improve onboarding, service delivery, network operations, and future analytics offerings.

  

**Role Location**

This is a hybrid role based in one of Tantalus' offices in Burnaby, BC; Chattanooga, TN; or Raleigh, NC.

  

**Specifically, the Analytics Engineer will:**

  

* Build and enhance automated reporting tools, dashboards, and analytical workflows using AMI, outage, power quality, and utility operational data.
* Develop reporting and trend-analysis capabilities that help customers quantify the operational value and performance improvements delivered through their Tantalus deployments
* Analyze outage performance, reliability, power quality, device performance, and other operational metrics to identify meaningful trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Support the development of benchmarking models that compare performance across customer deployments and help utilities understand their relative cost position and operational outcomes.
* Enhance existing analytics models, reporting frameworks, and internal analytics initiatives.
* Apply AI, machine learning, and automation techniques to improve reporting accuracy, scalability, and insight generation.
* Work with Customer Operations and implementation teams to support customer onboarding to analytics offerings, including data validation, report configuration, and ongoing reporting needs.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and NOC teams to identify data requirements and deliver practical, scalable reporting solutions.
* Help develop analytics and reporting capabilities that support the growth and ongoing operation of Tantalus’s Network Operations Center.
* Prepare analytical reports, visualizations, and documentation that support data-driven decision making and continuous improvement.

  

**What you Bring:**

  

*Education and Experience*

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in analytics, data science, software development, AI/ML, business intelligence, or a related technical field.
* Proficiency in Python, including experience using Python for data analysis, automation, reporting, or machine learning applications.
* Experience querying, manipulating, and analyzing data using SQL.
* Experience using data analysis, data visualization, or machine learning tools to develop reports, dashboards, or analytical solutions.
* Internship, co-op, academic project, or research experience involving data analytics, machine learning, software development, or reporting solutions is considered valuable.
* Foundational understanding of statistics, machine learning, data analytics, and data visualization principles.
* Experience building dashboards, reports, data pipelines, automated workflows, analytical applications, or internal tools.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and practical outputs.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional environment.

  

*Personal Attributes Required*

  

* Curious and eager to learn, with a strong interest in AI, analytics, and emerging technologies.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently while managing competing priorities in a hybrid work environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and approach challenges with creativity and resourcefulness.
* Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.
* Collaborative team player who enjoys working across departments and building relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Customer-focused mindset with a desire to understand customer needs and translate data into meaningful business outcomes.
* Effective communicator with the ability to explain complex information in a clear and concise manner.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and business needs may evolve.

* Excellent oral and written communication skills.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience or familiarity with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.

BAE Systems, a top-ten prime contractor to the U.S. Department of Defense, enables the U.S. government to transform data into intelligence and provides engineering, integration and sustainment support for critical military platforms and systems. Intelligence & Security provides services and products to the Department of Defense, the government, federal law enforcement officials, and troops deployed around the world.
  
  
At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie and a shared ambition to lead the world in defense technologies and national security services. We offer flexible work environment to support the balance in your life and keep you performing at your best. Be a part of a company that is part of the community; driven to improve our future and protect our freedom.
  
  
We are looking for experienced System Engineers to join our technology-based program supporting a key government customer. This program will deliver engineering services for network infrastructure as well as sophisticated enterprise computing infrastructure including end-point devices, data center hosted servers, multi-Cloud services as well as virtualized applications, and storage systems. Enterprise Computing Engineering services include modern application technology including containerized solutions with orchestrated workflow that function both on customer premise, and via remote Cloud services. Network infrastructure engineering services are comprised of core infrastructure, voice and video engineering, field engineering, application management and development for networks, network analytics, firewalls, network access controls and bandwidth service delivery. This is a fast paced, challenging, and career rewarding experience to recruit and develop provide top talent and solutions on one of the most complex and high-profile programs within the government.
  
  
  
  
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills**
We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer with a Bachelors degree, 6 years of experience and a background utilizing the following:
  
  

* AWS Services

+ Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) services such as EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch and CloudTrail
+ Ability to manage and maintain AWS Cloud infrastructure, including resource provisioning, monitoring and cost optimization

* Python Programming

+ Proficient in Python programming language (version 3.9 or later)
+ Ability to write Python scripts to automate tasks, such as data processing, file management and system administration
+ Familiarity with popular Python libraries, such as Boto3 (AWS SDK for Python), requests and Django

* Automation

+ Experience with automation tools, such as Ansible, Terraform and/or CloudFormation
+ Ability to translate deployment practices into automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, Bash scripts and/or other automation tools

* Other

+ Familiarity with Version Control systems such as Git and specifically, GitHub
+ Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools, such as Prometheus and CloudWatch
+ Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Development, Operations and Security teams
+ Knowledge of Agency governance and compliance practices as they relate to AWS and other Cloud environments to include Government best practices and Government Enterprise services, processes and procedures
+ Architect background; ability to advise customer management on technical conversations within the team to support customer tools and operations; be the team technical rep. at technical meetings

**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills**

* AWS Cloud Certification(s)

**Pay Information**
Full-Time Salary Range: $132962 - $226035
  
  
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**THE TEAM YOU WILL BE JOINING**

* A growing enterprise technology organization in the middle of a significant modernization of its infrastructure, cloud environment, and operating practices
* An infrastructure and cloud team completing a large-scale migration of hundreds of servers and SQL instances into Azure, and preparing to take full day-to-day ownership of the new environment
* A collaborative group working across cloud engineering, infrastructure, database administration, application teams, and an external managed services partner
* An organization investing heavily in Azure, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automation
* This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role focused on building, automating, and operating the organization's Azure environment

**LOCATION**

* Fort Mill, SC, Charlotte metro area
* On-site environment
* Opportunity to work closely with infrastructure leadership and the broader technology team during a major period of transformation

**What They Offer You**

* Ownership of a newly built Azure environment as it moves from migration into day-to-day operation, rather than maintaining a mature platform someone else designed
* A deep backlog of hands-on build work: Bicep, GitHub Actions pipelines, provisioning automation, monitoring, and security hardening
* The chance to shape how infrastructure code, pipelines, and environments are built going forward
* Exposure to emerging AI initiatives, including the Azure infrastructure that supports them
* Visibility with infrastructure leadership and room to grow into a lead role as the cloud practice expands
* Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT**

* The organization is closing out a major migration into Azure and will soon own the environment day to day. It needs a senior engineer who can run it and build on it
* There is more infrastructure work stacking up than the current team can absorb. This role adds senior, hands-on capacity, not another layer of design and oversight
* This person will extend the environment as code: building on existing Bicep modules, standing up GitHub Actions pipelines, and automating provisioning so environments can be deployed consistently and quickly
* Security, cost, and reliability run through this role, including identity and access, Azure Policy guardrails, secrets management, monitoring, and cost optimization

At BAM, you will have the chance to work with some of the smartest and most driven individuals in the industry.

• Run internal projects efficiently with self-managing autonomy.

• Play a key role in architecting and managing BAM’s public cloud environments (AWS, GCP).

• Help to design and automate BAM's Kubernetes offerings, especially managed cloud offerings.

• Partner with developers and internal stakeholders to understand requirements and provide recommendations for cloud solutions and strategies to address those needs.

• Work with Infrastructure & Platform teams to provide a consistent end user experience across BAM’s on-premise and cloud environments.

• Write code to automate and optimize deployment of infrastructure and applications (whether it’s Python, Terraform, Go, or something else).

• Develop self-service capabilities that allow stakeholders to access cloud services quickly and efficiently.

• Implement and support applications running on BAM’s cloud and Kubernetes systems, especially as they support our user-facing platforms.

• Use LLMs and autonomous agents as force multipliers for our offerings.

• Extensive hands-on experience architecting and implementing large-scale, highly available, services on public cloud.

• A familiarity with and commitment to DevOps and Platform Engineering best practices.

• Strong knowledge of Linux administration particularly RPM-based operating systems.

• Strong operational understanding of networking concepts, architecture, and best practices, especially as it relates to hybrid cloud integration..

• Systems architecting and design skills, Cloud, Kubernetes, serverless, etc.

• An ability to develop quick and sound solutions to complex problems.

• An orientation toward working in an agile-based team, prioritizing quick frequent deliverables guided by high-level roadmaps rather than large and infrequent waterfall releases.

• A commitment to improving team practices and systems.

• A goal of being supportive of team members in meetings, change reviews, and design discussions.

• Familiarity with Hashicorp Vault.

• Experience with Kubernetes service meshes.

• Contributions to open-source libraries, projects, or communities.

• Experience working with Kubernetes on-prem.

• AWS Certified Developer/DevOps or Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional).

• Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization.

• Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible.

• Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure management.
