title: Python Developer
description:
Platform Software Engineer

**CornerStone Technology Talent Services | Fully Remote – U.S.**

About the Opportunity

CornerStone Technology Talent Services is partnering on a search for a
**Platform Software Engineer**
to join a small, highly collaborative technology environment supporting a mission-critical proprietary business platform.

This is an excellent opportunity for a well-rounded software engineer who enjoys owning work across the application stack rather than operating within a narrowly defined front-end or backend silo.

The platform supports complex business workflows involving operational data, financial information, document processing, analytics, reporting, and integrations with other enterprise systems. You will work closely with senior technology leadership to build new functionality, troubleshoot production issues, maintain integrations, and continuously improve an established production application.

This team has also embraced
**AI-assisted software development as part of its everyday engineering workflow**
. We are particularly interested in engineers who already use tools such as
**Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable agentic coding platforms**
productively and understand both their capabilities and their limitations.

What You'll Do

**Full-Stack Platform Development**

* Develop and enhance production features across a
  **React front end, Python-based API/backend, and relational SQL database layer**
  .
* Take clearly defined requirements from specification through development, testing, code review, and production release.
* Extend an established codebase while following existing architectural patterns, coding standards, and design conventions.
* Build functionality that moves cleanly through the entire stack—from database schema changes to APIs to the user interface.
* Participate in code review and incorporate technical feedback into production-ready solutions.

**Production Troubleshooting & Application Support**

* Investigate and resolve issues reported by internal platform users.
* Trace problems across the
  **UI, application/API, database, integration, and source-system layers**
  rather than treating symptoms in isolation.
* Diagnose data inconsistencies and determine where breakdowns are occurring.
* Resolve application defects and smaller enhancements independently while appropriately escalating larger architectural concerns.
* Proactively identify defects or data-quality issues even when they fall outside your immediate assignment.

**Data & Systems Integration**

* Support integrations between the application and enterprise platforms such as
  **CRM, accounting, and document-management systems**
  .
* Troubleshoot synchronization failures, API/integration issues, and field-mapping problems.
* Perform data backfills, schema updates, mapping changes, and routine integration maintenance.
* Help ensure data remains accurate as information moves between systems.

**Reporting & Automation**

* Develop and maintain automated dashboards and executive-level reporting.
* Generate scheduled reports and business documents programmatically, including
  **Excel workbooks, presentations, and other reporting outputs**
  .
* Validate reported information against source systems and maintain a high standard of accuracy, particularly with financial data.

**AI-Assisted Engineering**

* Use modern
  **agentic coding tools**
  as part of your regular software-development workflow.
* Apply engineering judgment when reviewing, testing, and refining AI-generated code rather than treating AI output as production-ready by default.
* Help build and extend AI-powered application capabilities involving areas such as:
* Document review and extraction
* Workflow automation
* Business-data analysis
* Scoring and decision-support workflows
* Conversational interfaces
* Reporting automation
* Contribute to production LLM capabilities where appropriate, including
  **RAG, tool use, extraction workflows, and prompt evaluation**
  .

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a
**true full-stack engineer with strong debugging instincts**
, not someone whose experience is limited to isolated feature development.

The strongest candidate will bring:

* **4+ years of professional software engineering experience**
  , including applications deployed and supported in production.
* Strong production development experience with
  **Python**
  , ideally using
  **Flask, FastAPI, or Django**
  .
* Experience with a modern JavaScript framework, with
  **React strongly preferred**
  .
* Strong relational database and
  **SQL**
  skills, including:
* Complex queries
* Schema modifications
* Data troubleshooting
* Query/performance optimization
* Ability to independently implement functionality spanning the
  **database → API/backend → user interface**
  .
* Experience troubleshooting production software beyond application code alone.
* Comfort working within a substantial existing codebase rather than requiring a greenfield environment.
* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, data movement, and synchronization issues.
* Experience using
  **Claude Code, Cursor, or another agentic AI development environment in meaningful production development work**
  .
* Strong written communication and the ability to operate effectively in a distributed, asynchronous environment.

Particularly Valuable Experience

Candidates will stand out with experience involving one or more of the following:

* **Microsoft Azure**
  , particularly Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Key Vault
* AWS or Google Cloud environments
* Financial-data-intensive applications
* FinTech, real estate, investment, infrastructure, or similar business platforms
* Production LLM or generative AI applications
* Retrieval-augmented generation (
  **RAG**
  )
* AI-driven document extraction
* Agentic workflows and tool calling
* Salesforce or other CRM integrations
* Programmatic generation of
  **XLSX, PPTX, or PDF**
  files
* CI/CD pipelines
* Application monitoring and observability
* Small engineering teams where developers share both
  **feature-development and production-support ownership**
  .

The Profile We Want to Find

This role is especially well suited for an engineer who can say:

“Give me the issue or requirement, and I can follow it through the database, backend, API, integrations, and front end until I understand what is happening and can get it working correctly.”

The ideal person is technically capable without needing to be the system architect. They are comfortable receiving architectural direction, working within patterns established by senior leadership, taking ownership of execution, and bringing back thoughtful questions when something requires a larger design decision.

Just as importantly, this person should
**enjoy debugging**
. A candidate who only wants greenfield feature development is less likely to thrive here. The work combines feature delivery with real-world production ownership, data investigation, integration maintenance, reporting, and continuous platform improvement.

Why Work with CornerStone Technology Talent Services?

CornerStone Technology Talent Services connects accomplished technology professionals with organizations where their expertise can make a meaningful impact. Our recruiting team understands the difference between matching keywords and understanding how engineers actually build, troubleshoot, and support production technology.

For this search, we are looking beyond a basic Python/React checklist. We want engineers who can demonstrate
**full-stack ownership, disciplined troubleshooting, production maturity, data accuracy, and practical use of modern AI development tools**
.

**If you are a full-stack Python engineer who enjoys solving difficult production problems and has already incorporated agentic AI into the way you build software, we want to hear from you.**

description:
**WHO IS INFINIUM SPIRITS?**

Founded in 2005, we are a family-owned spirits company with an entrepreneurial edge, blending tradition with the drive to build the next generation of iconic brands. At Infinium Spirits, we live our values of integrity, ownership, unity, curiosity and gratitude. We hold each other accountable for our results and believe that the company success is based on the whole collective of team members, not individual contributors. There is no room for egos. We are building a team of thought-leaders across the entire company with expertise in sales, marketing, supply chain, business analytics and finance to fuel a diverse and distinctive portfolio of award-winning brands such as Templeton Rye, Tears of Llorona, Howler Head, Zaya Rum, Seagram’s Vodka, and Corralejo Tequila, just to name a few. In addition to our core powerhouse brands, we continue to seek new opportunities in the beverage category to innovate and meet regional needs.

**COME WORK WITH US**

At Infinium Spirits, success doesn’t happen between the hours of 9 to 5. We are building a team of hard-working, ambitious professionals who are ready to roll up their sleeves, put in the long hours, and create real impact in the marketplace. We want out-of-the-box thinkers who bring new ways to solve problems to the table, if you excel at escape rooms, are energized by logic problems and believe that anything is possible, you have the ingredients we are seeking on our team. We hire people,
**NOT**
resumes. If you think you are right for the role, apply now!

Diversity. Equity. Inclusion. We are committed to creating an inclusive and fair workplace that values diversity. We know that when people feel a sense of belonging, they are more creative, innovative, and successful. We welcome the unique contributions you bring in terms of background, education, opinions, culture, and identity.

**THE BAR WE SET**

Building brands in the spirits industry at our stage means constant change, high expectations, and a healthy dose of chaos. The people who thrive here are those who own their market, push for results, and stay hungry no matter the challenge. This isn’t the right place for everyone.

**ABOUT THE JOB**

We are seeking a hands-on Full Stack Data Analytics Engineer to develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise data, analytics, automation, and AI solutions.

You will collaborate with business and technical teams to build reliable data pipelines, develop business intelligence solutions, automate processes using Microsoft Power Platform, and improve data quality and governance.

This role offers opportunities to work across multiple technologies and business functions while contributing to practical solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making.

You are curious, motivated, and hands-on. You enjoy learning new technologies, understanding business processes, and finding creative, practical ways to solve problems.

We value a strong work ethic, ownership, problem-solving, attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to learn more than deep expertise in any single technology.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/THE DAY-TO-DAY**

**Data Engineering & Integration**

* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines using SQL, Python, and Microsoft Fabric.
* Integrate data from ERP systems, databases, APIs, and external data providers.
* Build and maintain data transformations and structured datasets in Lakehouse environments.
* Support ETL/ELT processes, incremental data loading, and pipeline monitoring.
* Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicate records, and processing errors.
* Optimize query performance and maintain existing data infrastructure.

**Business Intelligence & Analytics**

* Develop and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
* Create and optimize SQL queries, DAX measures, and Power Query transformations.
* Develop reporting solutions for Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and other business functions.
* Support the migration of existing reports and datasets to Microsoft Fabric.
* Investigate reporting discrepancies and reconcile results with source data.
* Help standardize KPIs and business metrics.

**Automation & Power Apps Development**

* Develop lightweight business applications using Microsoft Power Apps, Dataverse, and Copilot-assisted development tools.
* Build and maintain automated workflows using Power Automate and related technologies.
* Develop Python scripts and integrations to automate business processes.
* Automate repetitive data processing, validation, and reporting tasks.
* Troubleshoot and improve existing applications and integration workflows.

**AI Applications & Agent Development**

* Support the development of AI-powered applications and internal knowledge assistants using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Explore and develop AI agents for workflow automation, document processing, data retrieval, and business support.
* Integrate AI applications with approved enterprise data sources, APIs, and business systems.

**Master Data Management & Data Governance**

* Maintain and improve master data for customers, products, distributors, and other business dimensions.
* Support data mapping, standardization, cleansing, and reconciliation across source systems.
* Develop and maintain data validation rules and automated data quality checks.
* Investigate master data discrepancies and resolve mapping and integration issues.
* Maintain documentation of data definitions, transformation logic, business rules, and source-to-target mappings.
* Support data governance processes, including change tracking, data ownership, and reporting consistency.
* Collaborate with business teams to improve data accuracy, completeness, and reliability.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Work with business users to understand data and reporting requirements.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions with guidance from the team.
* Participate in solution design discussions and technical reviews.
* Maintain clear documentation of processes, code, dependencies, technical decisions, and business rules.
* Proactively communicate project progress, technical challenges, dependencies, and potential delays.
* Collaborate with team members to improve solutions and support business continuity.

**\*This**
is not intended to be a comprehensive list of the duties and responsibilities of the position and that the duties and responsibilities may change without notice.

**AM I THE RIGHT FIT?**

Not everyone can be a Full Stack Data Analytics Engineer. To be seriously considered for the role here is what you’ll bring:

**Education/Licenses/Certifications:**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering, BI development, data analytics, or a related technical role.
* Experience developing or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Experience with Power BI or a comparable business intelligence platform.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Lakehouse environments, or similar cloud data platforms.
* Experience with PySpark, Power Query, and DAX.
* Experience integrating ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Dataverse, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
* Experience working with customer, product, distributor, or other enterprise master data.
* Familiarity with data governance concepts such as data lineage, stewardship, validation controls, and certified datasets.
* Exposure to generative AI, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI agents, MCP, or LLM APIs.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Experience with R for statistical analysis or data modeling.

description:
Description:

The Data Engineer is a key member of the Detroit Pistons Business Strategy & Analytics department, responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the data infrastructure that supports business reporting, analytics, fan engagement, revenue generation, and operational decision-making across the organization.

This role will support the existing Microsoft SQL Server data warehouse while helping advance the organization’s transition to a modern data Lakehouse methodology leveraging Microsoft Fabric. The Data Engineer will work closely with the Senior Director of Data Strategy & Reporting to support the department’s data architecture, governance, reporting, and integration roadmap.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Data Architecture & Engineering**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines, data models, database objects, and integration processes within a Microsoft-based data environment.
* Assist in the transition from a traditional data warehouse structure to a modern data lakehouse methodology using Microsoft Fabric.
* Build scalable ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.
* Support the design and implementation of Microsoft Fabric components, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, notebooks, and Power BI integration.

* Support the Senior Director of Data Strategy & Reporting in implementing data governance standards, data quality processes, and enterprise data best practices.

* Prepare reliable, well-documented, and governed data assets to support reporting, analytics, automation, and AI applications.
* Support Power BI datasets, semantic models, dataflows, and reporting infrastructure as needed.
* Partner with analysts and business stakeholders to ensure data models meet business requirements, reporting standards, and performance expectations.

**Data Management & Integration**

* Integrate data from multiple internal and external systems into the organization’s data warehouse, data lakehouse, and analytics environment.
* Work with APIs, flat files, relational databases, SaaS platforms, and cloud-based systems to ensure reliable data ingestion and availability.
* Monitor pipeline health, investigate failures, and implement long-term solutions that improve reliability and reduce operational risk.
* Maintain clear technical documentation for integrations, refresh schedules, dependencies, data transformations, and business logic.

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in data engineering, database development, business intelligence, data warehousing, or a related data role.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server and MS SQL data warehouse environments.
* Advanced T-SQL skills, including stored procedures, views, joins, indexing, query optimization, and data modeling.
* Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple structured and semi-structured data sources.
* Strong understanding of data warehouse concepts, dimensional modeling, star schemas, data marts, and modern lakehouse methodologies.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Power BI, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Synapse, or related Microsoft data tools.
* Experience with Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, or other modern data engineering languages and frameworks.
* Familiarity with preparing data for AI applications, including data quality, metadata, and secure access.
* Ability to translate business needs into scalable data engineering solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

title: Associate Data Engineer
description:
At Casey's, everyday interactions across our stores, digital experiences, fuel operations, supply chain, merchandising, marketing, and corporate functions generate data that can improve how the business operates and serves its guests. Marketplace Data Engineering transforms that data into governed, reliable data products used for reporting, analytics, data science, AI, and operational decision-making.

We are looking for an Associate Data Engineer who is curious, collaborative, and motivated to grow as an engineer. You will pair with experienced team members to develop data pipelines and models, test and deploy changes, troubleshoot production issues, and learn the standards behind Casey's Enterprise Data Lake. You will work with Databricks, Python, SQL, cloud services, Git-based delivery practices, and approved AI-assisted engineering tools while building practical knowledge of Casey's business and data ecosystem.

The Associate Data Engineer contributes to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of governed data products on Casey's Enterprise Data Lake. Working with more experienced engineers, product partners, analysts, and business stakeholders, this role develops reliable data pipelines and models using Databricks, Python, SQL, and related cloud technologies. The role learns and applies Casey's engineering, security, data governance, and software-delivery standards while helping troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve the reliability, quality, performance, and maintainability of Marketplace data products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, test, deploy, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines and data products using Databricks, Python, SQL, and approved enterprise frameworks.
* Evaluate source systems and work with engineers, analysts, product partners, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements, dependencies, and intended business use.
* Contribute to data models across Raw, Protected, and Purpose zones in accordance with Casey's Enterprise Data Lake architecture, naming conventions, and governance standards.
* Write maintainable, reusable, and well-documented code using version control, branching, pull requests, peer review, and CI/CD practices.
* Create and maintain automated tests and validation processes covering data accuracy, completeness, schema, business rules, and pipeline behavior.
* Participate in deployment and release activities across development and production environments using approved service identities and access-management practices.
* Monitor data jobs and pipelines, investigate failures and data-quality issues, document findings, and partner with senior engineers or Operations to restore service.
* Assist with performance and cost optimization for Databricks jobs, queries, pipelines, and compute resources.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, operating procedures, support information, and data lineage.
* Collaborate with Analytics Solutions, Data Science, Enterprise Data & Governance, Operations, product partners, and business teams to deliver trusted data for reporting, analytics, AI, and operational use cases.
* Use approved AI-assisted development tools to accelerate learning, coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating outputs and following security and responsible-use standards.
* Participate in the team's on-call or off-hours support rotation based on the criticality of supported data products.
* Continuously build knowledge of Casey's business domains, data architecture, engineering standards, and software-delivery practices through pairing, feedback, and structured learning.

**Compensation**: Starting pay range: $66,000 - $90,800. Actual pay may vary based on Casey's assessment of the candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, and qualifications. Other factors impacting pay include local prevailing wages and internal equity. This position is eligible for an annual cash bonus based on company performance. Our full salary range for this role does extend beyond the hiring range listed, allowing team members the opportunity to continue to grow within the company.

Requirements:

* This position requires authorization to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Casey's will not provide sponsorship or employer support for applications or petitions for F-1 OPT, F-1 CPT, H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, J-1, or any other employment-based visa.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Data Analytics, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent years of related work experience.
* Experience using SQL or Python to analyze, transform, or validate data.
* Foundational understanding of relational data, data modeling, or dimensional modeling concepts.
* Familiarity with common data-integration patterns involving databases, files, APIs, streams, or event data.
* Understanding of software-development fundamentals such as source control, testing, debugging, code review, and deployment.
* Ability to investigate technical and data-quality problems, evaluate available information, and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, curiosity, and willingness to learn from feedback and pairing.
* Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate across engineering, product, analytics, operations, and business teams.

Qualified candidates must live within a daily commutable distance of Casey's Store Support Center in Ankeny, IA and be willing to work onsite 5 days per week.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, or Databricks Workflows.
* Experience with GitHub or Azure DevOps, including branches, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Exposure to Azure services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Microsoft Entra ID, or Azure Key Vault.
* Understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, or cataloging concepts.
* Familiarity with monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing cloud data workloads.
* Experience using AI-assisted software-development tools responsibly.
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification or willingness to pursue it after joining.

title: Dev Ops Engineer
description:
Overview:

**Dev Ops Engineer**

Hybrid – Paoli, PA

The DevOps Engineer plays a critical role in Turn5's E-Commerce development organization, owning the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and runtime environments that power our e-commerce platform and supporting services. Reporting to the Sr. Technical Delivery Manager and working closely with developers, architects, and the IT support team, this role keeps development and production environments reliable, observable, and fast, and helps the team ship changes with confidence.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that provide reliable, repeatable builds, testing, and deployments for ASP.NET and C# applications.
* Manage and support Kubernetes clusters through Rancher, including workload deployment, scaling, upgrades, and overall cluster health.
* Build, maintain, and optimize Docker images and container configurations for development and production workloads.
* Administer our internal container and NuGet package repositories (ProGet), including feeds, access, retention, and package promotion across environments.
* Configure and maintain load balancers to ensure high availability, proper traffic distribution, and consistent performance of production services.
* Manage Cloudflare configuration, including DNS, caching, security rules, and traffic routing, to protect and accelerate our e-commerce sites.
* Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting across applications and infrastructure, respond to alerts, and tune thresholds to surface real issues without excess noise.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production and development environment issues, partnering with developers to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.
* Analyze performance and monitoring data, and funnel findings and improvement recommendations back to the development team.
* Support the E-Commerce Development team day to day by providing environments, tooling, and technical guidance that keep development work moving.
* Work with the IT support team on networking, access, server, and environment needs, coordinating handoffs and resolving shared issues.
* Document environments, deployment processes, and runbooks so knowledge is shared and incident response is consistent.
* Participate in incident response and an after-hours support rotation as needed for critical production issues.

**What We’re Looking For**

We value strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to grow. If you’re stronger on some of these and lighter on others, that’s perfectly fine – we’re more interested in your ability to solve problems, collaborate, and grow with the team. If you have a solid foundation and are excited to learn, we want to hear from you.

  

* Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows with a modern CI/CD platform.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and a management platform such as Rancher, including deploying and troubleshooting containerized workloads.
* Proficiency with Docker or similar container tooling and container-based development and deployment practices.
* Experience configuring and managing load balancers and web traffic routing.
* Experience with Cloudflare or a similar CDN provider, including DNS, caching, and security features.
* Experience managing private container registries and NuGet package repositories, such as ProGet or similar artifact management tools.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools and practices, and a data-driven approach to performance tuning.
* Familiarity with ASP.NET Core on .NET 10 and C# sufficient to build, debug, and troubleshoot application issues alongside developers.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to stay calm and methodical during production incidents.
* Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, IT support, and non-technical stakeholders.

**Who You’ll Work With**

You’ll join an eCommerce Development group made up of senior and mid-level developers, and you’ll work closely with our IT Development and IT Support teams. We prioritize work-life balance, clear communication, and helping each other succeed.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Hybrid schedule:
* Local (within 50 miles of our HQ in Paoli, PA): typically 2 days onsite per month (yes, month!)
* Remote: 2 weeks onsite per year
* Competitive compensation in-line with experience & impact, plus a quarterly bonus program
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision plus immediate vesting on your 401k match
* A people-first culture where curiosity, ownership, and collaboration are valued
* Opportunities to grow your technical skillset and contribute to impactful, high-visibility products

**About Turn5**

Turn5 is one of the largest and fastest growing eCommerce retailers in the Greater Philadelphia area. Best known for our award-winning, eCommerce platforms, AmericanMuscle.com, ExtremeTerrain.com, and AmericanTrucks.com, we’ve been engaging muscle car, truck, and off-road enthusiasts with exceptional products, services, and experiences since 2004. With the acquisition of Eckler’s in 2022, a pioneer in classic car restoration & modification for over 60 years, Turn5’s catalog of brands has expanded to now offer aftermarket automotive products for vehicles as classic as the Model T.

Our purpose, however, extends beyond selling car parts. We have a commitment to creating meaningful customer experiences at every step of their journey. Whether it’s supplying a unique product that customizes the look and feel of their ride, providing thousands of educational videos for the DIYer or leveraging user generated content to inspire even the most experienced owner, we are obsessed with ensuring we reach as many like-minded gearheads across the globe as we can.

Inspire11’s Privacy Policy: https://www.inspire11.com/privacy-policy/

**U.S. Compensation & Benefits**

**Compensation at Inspire11**
  
Inspire11 follows Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, the Equal Pay Act of 1963, the Illinois Human Rights Act, the Illinois Equal Wage Act, and the Illinois Equal Pay Act of 2003. We believe that people performing the same role at the same level, with similar levels of ability or experience, should be similarly compensated. We also believe that the most critical factors driving compensation should be an Eleven’s skill, experience, performance, responsibility, and effort. We may also consider an employee’s length of service, relevant education, training, or certification, and the requirements of a specific job. We may also consider whether the cost of living or competition for talent in specific markets requires adjustments in compensation for employees in those markets. Our goal is to fairly compensate all our Elevens based on these factors within the Company’s financial ability.

Compensation may be increased or decreased at Inspire11’s discretion based on an employee’s performance reviews, market conditions, and the Company’s financial performance. Inspire11 will always notify an employee in writing before any change is made to their compensation.

**Bonuses**
  
We may allow employees in Sales, Recruiting, or Leadership to earn periodic bonuses based on sales, revenue, client-specific or practice-specific targets. These targets are communicated to each eligible employee via offer letter or annual update. All such target-based bonuses are calculated based on the Company and an individual’s periodic performance and will only be awarded if: (a) the employee is meeting performance expectations and is an employee in good standing of the Company; (b) the target is met; and (c) the Company’s current financial performance and market conditions permit the bonus to be paid out. All periodic bonuses are discretionary and are earned only when paid out.

Each year, the Company will decide whether the Company’s financial performance, market performance, and business realities allow it to create an annual bonus pool. If the Company decides that annual bonuses may be awarded, then the Leadership Team will grant annual bonuses to employees in good standing based on the same factors discussed in the previous paragraph while also considering employees’ diligence, performance, expertise, skill, judgment, and experience. To be eligible to participate in this annual bonus pool, an employee must be hired by no later than October 1st of the preceding year. Annual bonuses and merit increases may be prorated based on hire date. Employees eligible for target-based periodic bonuses are not eligible to participate in the annual bonus pool.

**Options or Other Equity in Inspire11**
  
Inspire11 has a legacy program that allowed certain high-performing employees to purchase shares of the Company through an affiliate. The Company also has a newer program that grants options annually to high-performing employees based on their performance reviews, their managers’ recommendation, and leadership approval. These options have a vesting period associated with them.

**Benefits**
  
Full-time employees are eligible for the following contributory benefits, where premiums are partially paid by the Company and partially by the employee:

* Medical insurance plans,
* Dental insurance plans, and
* Vision insurance plans.

Full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits provided wholly by the Company:

* Short-term disability, providing for a benefit of 60% of an employee’s salary up to a maximum of $2,000 per week for up to 11 weeks after a 7-day waiting period;
* Long-term disability, providing for 60% of an employee’s salary up to a maximum of $10,00

title: Senior Multi-Cloud DevOps Engineer
description:

The Senior Multi-Cloud DevOps Engineer will work closely with cloud architects, automation engineers, developers, security teams, and customer stakeholders to evaluate new technologies and turn technical designs into secure, scalable, production-ready cloud solutions.

Success in this role means delivering highly automated infrastructure and deployment pipelines that allow engineering teams to rapidly adopt new technologies while maintaining security, reliability, repeatability, and strong engineering standards.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

 **Job Description**

**About the opportunity**

AI Engineering builds the shared agent platform behind Xplor's AI capabilities: the agent runtime, model gateway, retrieval, guardrails, evaluations, and cost controls. We build the hard parts once, so every product team can ship AI features faster and safely.

We're looking for a hands-on Site Reliability Engineer to own how our agent platform behaves in production. AI workloads bring new reliability problems: long streaming responses, background agents, model-provider quotas, outputs that can fail silently, agents that take real actions, and spend that grow with usage. You'll treat them as first-class engineering problems. As AI agents take on more of our operational work, you'll decide what they're allowed to do and make sure they do it safely.

**Why this role is exciting**

* **Reliability for a new kind of workload**. The playbook for running AI agents in production is still being written, and you'll help write it.
* **Scale with real stakes.** A multi-tenant platform serving thousands of businesses, and AI features they depend on to run their day.
* **Greenfield foundations**. Define the SLOs, alerting, game days, agent guardrails, and standard deployment paths that every product team will build on.
* **Cost is an engineering problem**. Token economics, model routing and cost per task matter as much as uptime.
* **AI-native operations**. Use AI agents to automate toil, speed up investigations and improve infrastructure code; with the approval gates, scoped permissions and audit trails that make it safe.

**What you’ll do**

* Define SLOs and error budgets for agent APIs, streaming and background work, including quality signals like task success, tool-call failures and evaluation regressions, and alert on what matters to customers.
* Own the platform's AWS infrastructure (ECS on Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, Redis and Amazon Bedrock) as Terraform delivered through Spacelift.
* Build observability in Datadog and Coralogix with OpenTelemetry, including AI signals like token usage, provider latency and cost per task.
* Make data stores resilient, with tested backups and restores, failover, defined disaster recovery targets (RTO/RPO) and safe migrations.
* Build resilience into the model layer: provider failover, quota and rate-limit management, and safe rollout and rollback of model and prompt changes.
* Protect the platform under multi-tenant load with per-tenant quotas, isolation and circuit breakers that stop runaway agents and runaway spend.
* Partner with Security on operational controls for AI risks, including prompt injection, excessive agent permissions and unbounded consumption (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
* Set the guardrails for AI agents that work on our infrastructure: what they can change, which actions need human approval, and how every action is audited.
* Work with Security and Privacy to keep model inference and customer data in the right regions for customers in Australia, New Zealand, the US, the UK and the EU.
* Lead incident response and blameless reviews, take part in on-call, and run game days for the failures that matter most.
* Make deployments safe by default, and give product teams simple, standard ways to run agent workloads.
* Track and reduce cloud and model spend.

**Our stack**

* Cloud: AWS: ECS on Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, ElastiCache Redis, CloudFront, Route 53, Secrets Manager and SSM
* AI: Amazon Bedrock and other model providers behind a multi-provider gateway
* Infrastructure as code: Terraform, delivered through Spacelift
* Observability: Datadog, Coralogix and OpenTelemetry
* Delivery: GitHub Actions, containers, Amazon ECR and preview environments

This position has an annual base salary range of $150,000 to $200,000 USD.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S., excluding Hawaii and Alaska. We’d prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones.

#LI-Remote

 **Qualifications**

**What would make me a good candidate?**

* 7+ years in SRE, DevOps or platform engineering, running multi-tenant SaaS in production
* Strong AWS experience and Terraform at scale (Spacelift, Terraform Cloud, Atlantis or similar)
* Experience building SLO-based alerting and observability with Datadog or similar tools, ideally with OpenTelemetry
* A track record of leading incidents calmly and turning post-incident reviews into lasting fixes
* Hands-on PostgreSQL operations: backups, point-in-time recovery, performance tuning and upgrades
* Production-quality coding skills for automation and tooling
* A least-privilege mindset and a disciplined approach to using AI tools

**It would be great if you also have**

* Experience running LLM or AI workloads in production, or a real interest in learning how they fail differently from traditional services
* Use of AI agents to automate operational work, such as incident triage, runbooks or infrastructure-code review, and a clear sense of where human review still matters
* Experience in regulated environments such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS
* Amazon Bedrock quotas and inference profiles, policy as code, LLM evaluation, AI security tooling, or multi-region data-residency requirements

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersection of differences - people of different cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you don’t quite tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

 **Additional Information**

**Values and Life at Xplor**

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

* Find a better way
* Do the right thing

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

description:

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  
  
The Data Engineer will design, build, and support scalable data pipelines and data products that enable analytics, reporting, operational insights, and AI-driven solutions across Nationwide Pet. This role partners closely with business teams, analytics, product owners, software engineers, and data scientists to deliver reliable, governed, high-quality data solutions in cloud and hybrid environments.
  
  
**Required skills:**
Snowflake, Python, Data Warehousing & Data Modeling, AWS Services, Data Pipeline Development, API Integrations, Advanced SQL, Spark, CI/CD, GitHub
  
  
**Required**

* Experience architecting data solutions using modern platforms such as AWS, Snowflake, Databricks etc.
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), APIs, SaaS integrations
* Build and support batch pipelines, even-driven pipelines, API-based integrations, Data ingestion frameworks, Data quality validation frameworks
* Experience enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases through scalable data platforms, data observability frameworks, monitoring tools, and Power BI reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, lineage, and security controls.
* Experience monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale data pipelines
* Exceptional problem-solving and critical thinking skills
* Strong collaboration and communication skills

**Work Hours: This role supports NW Pet and Pacific Time Zone hours.**

Nationwide embraces an agile work environment and collaborative culture through the understanding of business processes, relationship entities and requirements using data analysis, quality, visualization, governance, engineering, AI engineering, and machine learning to produce targeted data solutions. As a Data Engineer, you’ll be responsible for acquiring, curating, and publishing data for analytical or operational uses. * Develops and maintains scalable data pipelines for both streaming and batch requirements and builds out new API integrations to support continuing increases in data volume and complexity.
* Writes and performs data unit/integration tests for data quality. With input from business requirements and stories, creates and executes test data and scripts to validate that quality and completeness criteria are satisfied. Creates automated testing programs and reusable test data for future code changes.
* Practices code management and integration with engineering Git principles and practices.
* Supports delivery of data engineering solutions within a defined product or platform scope.

Reports to Manager/Director Data Management.

title: LillyDirect Pharmacy Data Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Data Engineer for our LillyDirect Pharmacy Covered Entity (LDPCE) Master Data team. This role involves designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure to support our critical scientific and business initiatives, ultimately contributing to the delivery of life-changing medicines.
  
  
As a Data Engineer for Master Data, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the data solutions that ensure the availability, quality, and integrity of data for analysis and/or business transactions for our LillyDirect Pharmacy Covered Entity business. You will design and implement efficient data storage, processing, and retrieval solutions, build data pipelines, and optimize data models, working closely with the Technical Lead, DevOps engineer, architects, and business analysts. You will need strong skills in data integration, acquisition, cleansing, harmonization, and transformation, and you will play a key role in turning raw data into reliable, governed datasets that downstream teams can trust.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines for batch and near-real-time processing in Python and PySpark on Databricks and AWS.
* Develop and optimize data models, ETL/ELT workflows, and data integration across multiple systems and platforms, using Delta Lake and lakehouse (medallion) patterns.
* Support data integrations with Reltio and Transcend, including data loads, extracts, and reconciliation.
* Build data quality, lineage, and reconciliation checks so that profile and consent data is accurate, complete, and auditable.
* Implement data governance, security, and quality standards across data assets, including access controls, masking, and retention for sensitive data (PII/PHI) and consent data.
* Collaborate with the Technical Lead, product owners, architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
* Own pipelines and work streams from design through production, and contribute to architectural and design decisions.
* Promote best practices in coding, code review, automated testing, and deployment, and release code through CI/CD pipelines.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve performance, reliability, and cost of data pipelines, and support production incidents and root cause analysis.
* Automate manual processes and identify opportunities to optimize data workflows and reduce costs.

**How You Will Succeed**

* Deliver scalable solutions by designing robust data pipelines and architectures that meet performance and reliability standards.
* Build in privacy and consent by treating consent and data protection as a design principle in pipelines from the start, and by raising risks early.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to turn business needs into technical outcomes.
* Share expertise, mentoring junior engineers and adopting best practices in data engineering and cloud technologies.
* Continuously improve systems through automation, performance tuning, and proactive issue resolution.
* Communicate with clarity to ensure alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or equivalent work experience.
* Overall 5+ years of experience in data engineering using core technologies such as SQL, Python, PySpark, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) services including Lambda, Glue, EMR S3, Redshift, Athena, and IAM roles/policies.
* 2+ years of experience working in Agile environments, with hands-on experience using GitHub and CI/CD pipelines for code deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, including workspace configuration, notebook development, Delta Lake, and performance optimization.
* 1+ years of experience with orchestration tools like Airflow or Databricks Workflows for workflow automation.

**Additional Skills/Preferences**

* Experience building high-performance, scalable data pipelines following Data Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, and Data Mart standards and deep understanding of ETL/ELT workflows.
* Strong expertise in data modelling, managing large datasets, and implementing secure, compliant data governance practices.
* Working knowledge of data governance, security, and data quality practices, including handling sensitive data (PII/PHI) in a regulated environment.
* Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to translate key business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; a problem-solving mindset and attention to detail.
* Pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience, including privacy requirements such as HIPAA.
* Hands-on experience with Reltio (or a comparable MDM platform), including match and merge, survivorship, and integration patterns.
* Familiarity with consent and preference management (for example opt-in/opt-out, purpose, and channel); experience with Transcend or a similar consent platform.
* Familiarity with streaming frameworks such as Kafka, Kinesis, or MSK.
* Experience with Unity Catalog, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and data quality frameworks (for example Great Expectations or dbt tests).
* Partner with and influence vendor resources on solution development to ensure understanding of data and technical direction for solutions as well as delivery.
* AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Associate or Professional)

By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
  
  
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
  
  

* Travel to Office expectations\*\*

**For Hybrid Roles**

**Position Summary**
PointClickCare builds cloud platforms that power safer, more connected care for millions of patients. As an Intermediate DevOps Engineer, you will design, build, and operate scalable cloud infrastructure and developer platforms that support both application and AI-driven workloads. You are a strong individual contributor who owns complex systems end-to-end, improves reliability and automation, and partners closely with software and data teams to bring services and models into production. You balance delivery and quality, applying DevOps and SRE best practices to improve developer velocity, system reliability, and operational insight.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
You will be part of our growing team of top engineers with the ability to directly impact the success of the organization. You'll be a part of the DevOps team reporting to the DevOps Team Lead and working alongside our other DevOps Engineers. You'll work day to day with the Software Engineering team as well as our IT team.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing Day To Day**

* Design, implement, and operate cloud-native infrastructure for production workloads.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for applications and ML systems.
* Develop and manage infrastructure-as-code to ensure consistency, scalability, and repeatability.
* Improve deployment reliability through automation, testing, and rollout strategies.

* Alert quality and noise reduction

* Design and maintain observability solutions using metrics, logs, and traces.

* Continuously improve system resilience through proactive automation.
* Partner with application, platform, and data teams to deliver reliable systems.
* Provide technical guidance and code reviews for devops team members.
* Contribute to architecture discussions and influence technical direction within your domain.
* Document standards, runbooks, and best practices.
* Participate in on-call rotations

**What You'll Bring**

* Ability to own systems from design through production support. Design and setup end to end CI/CD Pipelines.
* Practical understanding of distributed systems and cloud infrastructure.
* Bias toward automation, observability, and operational excellence.
* Growth-Oriented Leadership
* Willingness to mentor and support teammates.
* Comfort collaborating across functions and advocating for better practices.
* Ability to communicate trade-offs clearly and constructively.
* Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).
* Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and high-availability architectures.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in complex, distributed environments.

**Skills And Experience We’re Looking For**
**Must-haves**

* 3-5 years of progressive experience designing and implementing large-scale, automated infrastructure and CI/CD Pipelines
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Hands-on expertise in:
* cloud-native architectures and microservices.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, IaC 2.0, etc.)

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Us**
UJET leads the way in AI-powered contact center innovation, delivering a future-proof, cloud platform that redefines the customer experience with cutting-edge AI, true multimodality, and a mobile-first approach. We infuse AI across every aspect of your customer journey and contact center operations, to drive automation and efficiency. UJET's AI solutions empower agents, optimize customer journeys, and transform contact center operations for elevated experiences and actionable insights. Built on a cloud-native architecture with a unique CRM-first approach, UJET ensures unmatched security, scalability, and prioritized data insights (without storing PII). Designed for effortless use, UJET partners with businesses to deliver exceptional interactions, smarter decision-making, and accelerated growth in the AI-driven world.
  
  
Learn more at www.ujet.cx.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer in Austin, TX, Los Angeles, CA, or Portland, ME to design, build, and evolve the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure that powers our cloud-native SaaS platform.
  
  
This is a deeply technical, hands-on engineering role requiring
**strong production experience with Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Kubernetes infrastructure, Terraform, and cloud networking**
, preferably on GCP.
  
  
You will be responsible for the foundational infrastructure that supports our engineering organization, including Kubernetes clusters, GCP networking, infrastructure automation, identity and access management, and shared infrastructure services.
  
  
We are looking for engineers who have directly designed, built, operated, and troubleshot complex Kubernetes environments running on cloud providers—not simply deployed applications into existing clusters.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, operate, and maintain production infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including GKE, VPC networking, load balancers, Cloud DNS, IAM, and related cloud services.
* Own the architecture and lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters, including provisioning, upgrades, node pool management, autoscaling, networking, capacity planning, and operational troubleshooting.
* Develop and maintain Terraform modules, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, and automated provisioning workflows that enable consistent, reliable infrastructure management.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, DNS, cloud services, and distributed systems.
* Design and maintain GCP networking infrastructure, including VPCs, subnetworks, firewall rules, routing, NAT, load balancing, and connectivity between services and environments.
* Build and improve infrastructure observability using Prometheus, logging systems, metrics, alerting, and related monitoring tools.
* Implement and maintain infrastructure security controls, including IAM policies, service accounts, secrets management, and least-privilege access patterns.
* Drive infrastructure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization across our GCP environment.
* Plan and execute major infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and architectural improvements while minimizing production risk.
* Partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and Security teams to establish scalable infrastructure patterns and clear technical ownership.
* Participate in technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and mentorship of other engineers.

**Required Qualifications**
**Cloud Native Infrastructure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred**

* 3+ years of hands-on production experience, including designing, provisioning, operating, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure.
* Deep practical knowledge of GCP networking, including VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, routing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, and Cloud Load Balancing.
* Experience managing GCP projects, IAM policies, service accounts, and infrastructure security configurations.
* Demonstrated experience debugging production infrastructure problems involving multiple GCP services.
* Requires periodic in-person collaboration at a UJET office or designated location.

**Kubernetes / GKE**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience operating production Kubernetes clusters, preferably Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Direct experience provisioning, administering, upgrading, and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes architecture and internals, including the control plane, worker nodes, scheduling, networking, services, ingress, storage, and resource management.
* Experience managing node pools, autoscaling, resource requests and limits, cluster capacity, and Kubernetes version upgrades.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex Kubernetes infrastructure issues involving networking, DNS, node health, scheduling, resource pressure, and cluster-level failures.
* Experience using tools such as kubectl, Helm, and Kubernetes monitoring and diagnostic utilities.

**Experience limited to deploying containerized applications into Kubernetes does not satisfy this requirement.**
**Infrastructure as Code and Automation**

* 3+ years of professional experience using Terraform to provision and manage production cloud infrastructure.
* Experience developing reusable Terraform modules, managing remote state, and implementing safe infrastructure change processes.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with Git-based infrastructure management workflows, code reviews, and automated validation.

**Systems and Networking**

* Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, routing, firewalls, and load balancing.
* Ability to diagnose difficult infrastructure problems using logs, metrics, traces, packet-level analysis, and systematic debugging techniques.
* Experience designing secure, resilient, and scalable production infrastructure.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional engineering experience
* Extensive experience operating GKE clusters in large-scale, multi-cluster, or multi-region production environments.
* Experience with GKE networking, Workload Identity, Gateway API, Ingress controllers, and cluster autoscaling technologies.
* Experience designing multi-project GCP architectures with centralized networking, IAM governance, and infrastructure guardrails.
* Experience operating Prometheus, Grafana, and centralized logging infrastructure.
* Experience with Kubernetes infrastructure security, including RBAC, network policies, workload identity, and secrets management.
* Experience performing major Kubernetes or GCP infrastructure migrations with minimal production disruption.
* Experience with infrastructure cost optimization, capacity modeling, and cloud resource efficiency.
* Experience supporting highly available SaaS platforms or distributed systems operating at significant production scale.
* Mentors senior engineers and drives improvements in engineering practices, reliability, maintainability, and infrastructure scalability.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Our GCP infrastructure is secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient.
* Kubernetes clusters are well-managed, observable, consistently maintained, and upgraded with minimal production disruption.
* Infrastructure provisioning is automated, repeatable, and maintainable through Terraform.
* Complex infrastructure incidents are diagnosed quickly, with sustainable improvements that prevent recurrence.
* Engineering teams can depend on stable, well-designed cloud infrastructure foundations.
* Infrastructure architecture and operational practices continuously improve as the company scales.

**Why Join Us?**
You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging infrastructure problems at the foundation of a cloud-native SaaS platform. You'll help shape our GCP and Kubernetes architecture, drive meaningful technical improvements

title: Analytics Engineer
description:

At Wellthy, we dream of a world where everyone has the care infrastructure they need to manage their own health and the health and well-being of their loved ones.
  
  
We’re building something new in the care space - reimagining how care is delivered, accessed, and supported by families around the globe. As we grow, we’re seeking collaborative, curious, and purpose-driven teammates to help us expand what’s possible.
  
  
Our work is grounded in the expertise of seasoned care professionals who deeply understand families’ real challenges paired with agile, tech-powered solutions that deliver support efficiently and at scale. We embrace a mindset of continuous learning, especially around emerging technologies. Tools like AI and other innovations are accelerators, enabling us to scale our impact, work smarter, and stay at the forefront of care delivery.
  
  
Through Wellthy, millions of families have access to support to help them manage care during every stage of life, with hands-on experts guiding families through caregiving or backup care journeys. And with the acquisition of Patch Caregiving, Wellthy continues to expand how care shows up for working families by pairing care navigation and coordination with on-site and near-site employer-based childcare. This combination allows us to support families not just in navigating care decisions, but in accessing real, hands-on help when and where they need it most. Together, we’re building a more connected, comprehensive care experience for families and caregivers alike.
  
  
We partner with leading companies including more than 40 Fortune 500 companies to support the care needs of their workforces globally. We also work alongside health plans and carriers to embed care support into their offerings, enhancing the experience and outcomes for members.
  
  
We’re building, evolving, and expanding the market category for care, and we’re looking for responsive, collaborative, curious, and purposeful colleagues to join us.
  
  
**As an Analytics Engineer**
, you will help company leaders make better decisions by building and maintaining our data stack to power analysis, insights, and reports.
  
  
**We love collaborating here at Wellthy and in this role you will work closely with**
all areas of our organization (Marketing, Product, Client Success and Care Team).
  
  
**You will report directly to our**
VP Data, Product, and Engineering Operations.

* Build and maintain data transformations using dbt for analytics, and help empower end users to do self-service reporting and data exploration

* 2–5 years of experience in analytics engineering or a closely related role
* Experience with analytics modeling (e.g. dimensional modeling, staging/intermediate/mart layers)
* Strong SQL skills
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining data transformations with dbt or similar tools
* Comfortable using the command line and version control (git)
* Experience querying a cloud data warehouse (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift)
* Experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to write, explain, and QA code, along with the judgment to review, test, and validate AI-generated output before it goes into production
* Strong communicator, life-long learner, problem solver, and always curious

**Qualifications That Are Preferred But Not Mandatory**

* Experience writing basic Python scripts (e.g. for data processing, API calls, or automation)
* Experience working with user event tracking data to support product analytics (e.g. Snowplow, Segment, Rudderstack)
* Experience building reporting in modern BI tools (e.g. Omni, Looker, Tableau, Thoughtspot)
* Experience automating data workflows
* Familiarity with AWS tools (e.g. S3, Lambda)

**Total Rewards Package**

* Stock Options
* Remote work environment.
* Medical, dental and vision benefits within 30 days of hire.

* Mental health benefits.

* Generous parental leave (maternal and paternal) during a new child’s first year (born into family or adopted) and pregnancy loss leave.

To work from home, you must have a strong internet connection, quiet space to take calls and a professional (distraction free) environment.

**Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?**

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

### **Data Engineer II, JVM**

### **San Diego, CA**

The Data Engineering Team fuels real-time, intelligent data insights for PlayStation’s Cloud Streaming offering. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with teams across PlayStation to deliver a scalable and reliable data platform that drives a data-first culture and outlook.

As a Data Engineer II, you will develop and maintain server-side applications for shaping, managing, and transforming data on a large geographically distributed infrastructure for PlayStation. Your work will include developing JVM based applications using Kotlin, Scala, or Java, Flink jobs, and APIs to provide real time data and insights across the Cloud Streaming ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow throughout our data pipeline. You will also work closely with our Business Intelligence team to translate product requirements to usable insights that fuel our business decisions. You bring passion and expertise to continuously improve the value that our data platform provides to data producers and consumers across the organization, providing tooling, standard methodologies, and state-of-the art technology to empower data-driven decisions to the company. You are self-motivated and thrive in a distributed team environment - comfortable taking initiative, handling your own work, and collaborating effectively across time zones and communication channels, embodying our one team mantra!

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design and implement middleware and backend systems capable of handling high throughput and load
* Develop and maintain stream processing jobs using Flink (stateful / stateless), and implement scalable ETL jobs that enable our partners and customers to glean intelligent insight
* Optimize performance, reliability, and monitoring of the data pipeline stack
* Support migration efforts of our on-premises Kafka to new cloud technologies
* Perform in-depth analysis of functional or business requirements
* Contribute to architectural decisions for PlayStation’s cloud streaming data pipeline
* Liaise with Business Intelligence and product domain teams to help turn data into information, and information into business value

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of experience in software development and backend engineering developing and maintaining high throughput and concurrent systems with high availability and fault tolerance
* Proficient in JVM Languages (Kotlin, Scala, Java) and Python
* Experience with Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark, and SQL
* Knowledge of software paradigms like functional programming, object oriented programming, TDD
* Knowledge of web technologies including REST, JSON, gRPC, and WebSockets
* Expertise on data structures (JSON, Avro, Protobuf) as well as unstructured and semi-structured data
* Experience with ETL, stream processing, real-time pipelines, and batch processing
* Familiarity with software development tools and processes like Git and CI/CD
* Track record monitoring and analyzing system performance, isolating issues or bottlenecks that could impact reliability, performance and scalability
* Self-motivated, strong interpersonal and communication skills; ability to work with geographically remote teams
* Experience with Amazon Web Services at enterprise scale including, but not limited to, OpenSearch, MSK, and EKS is a plus
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud deployment technologies is a plus

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.
  
  
In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package.

$150,100—$225,100 USD

title: Full Stack Data Analytics Engineer
description:
**Full Stack Data Analytics Engineer**

Founded in 2005, we are a family-owned spirits company with an entrepreneurial edge, blending tradition with the drive to build the next generation of iconic brands. At Infinium Spirits, we live our values of integrity, ownership, unity, curiosity and gratitude. We hold each other accountable for our results and believe that the company success is based on the whole collective of team members, not individual contributors. There is no room for egos. We are building a team of thought-leaders across the entire company with expertise in sales, marketing, supply chain, business analytics and finance to fuel a diverse and distinctive portfolio of award-winning brands such as Templeton Rye, Tears of Llorona, Howler Head, Zaya Rum, Seagram’s Vodka, and Corralejo Tequila, just to name a few. In addition to our core powerhouse brands, we continue to seek new opportunities in the beverage category to innovate and meet regional needs.

**COME WORK WITH US**

At Infinium Spirits, success doesn’t happen between the hours of 9 to 5. We are building a team of hard-working, ambitious professionals who are ready to roll up their sleeves, put in the long hours, and create real impact in the marketplace. We want out-of-the-box thinkers who bring new ways to solve problems to the table, if you excel at escape rooms, are energized by logic problems and believe that anything is possible, you have the ingredients we are seeking on our team. We hire people, **NOT** resumes. If you think you are right for the role, apply now!

Diversity. Equity. Inclusion. We are committed to creating an inclusive and fair workplace that values diversity. We know that when people feel a sense of belonging, they are more creative, innovative, and successful. We welcome the unique contributions you bring in terms of background, education, opinions, culture, and identity.

**THE BAR WE SET**

Building brands in the spirits industry at our stage means constant change, high expectations, and a healthy dose of chaos. The people who thrive here are those who own their market, push for results, and stay hungry no matter the challenge. This isn’t the right place for everyone.

**ABOUT THE JOB**

We are seeking a hands-on Full Stack Data Analytics Engineer to develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise data, analytics, automation, and AI solutions.

You will collaborate with business and technical teams to build reliable data pipelines, develop business intelligence solutions, automate processes using Microsoft Power Platform, and improve data quality and governance.

This role offers opportunities to work across multiple technologies and business functions while contributing to practical solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making.

You are curious, motivated, and hands-on. You enjoy learning new technologies, understanding business processes, and finding creative, practical ways to solve problems.

We value a strong work ethic, ownership, problem-solving, attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to learn more than deep expertise in any single technology.

* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines using SQL, Python, and Microsoft Fabric.
* Integrate data from ERP systems, databases, APIs, and external data providers.
