* Support ETL/ELT processes, incremental data loading, and pipeline monitoring.
* Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicate records, and processing errors.
* Optimize query performance and maintain existing data infrastructure.

**Business Intelligence & Analytics**

* Develop and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
* Create and optimize SQL queries, DAX measures, and Power Query transformations.
* Develop reporting solutions for Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and other business functions.
* Support the migration of existing reports and datasets to Microsoft Fabric.
* Investigate reporting discrepancies and reconcile results with source data.
* Help standardize KPIs and business metrics.

**Automation & Power Apps Development**

* Develop lightweight business applications using Microsoft Power Apps, Dataverse, and Copilot-assisted development tools.
* Build and maintain automated workflows using Power Automate and related technologies.
* Develop Python scripts and integrations to automate business processes.
* Automate repetitive data processing, validation, and reporting tasks.
* Troubleshoot and improve existing applications and integration workflows.

**AI Applications & Agent Development**

* Support the development of AI-powered applications and internal knowledge assistants using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Explore and develop AI agents for workflow automation, document processing, data retrieval, and business support.
* Integrate AI applications with approved enterprise data sources, APIs, and business systems.

**Master Data Management & Data Governance**

* Maintain and improve master data for customers, products, distributors, and other business dimensions.
* Support data mapping, standardization, cleansing, and reconciliation across source systems.
* Develop and maintain data validation rules and automated data quality checks.
* Investigate master data discrepancies and resolve mapping and integration issues.
* Maintain documentation of data definitions, transformation logic, business rules, and source-to-target mappings.
* Support data governance processes, including change tracking, data ownership, and reporting consistency.
* Collaborate with business teams to improve data accuracy, completeness, and reliability.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Work with business users to understand data and reporting requirements.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions with guidance from the team.
* Participate in solution design discussions and technical reviews.
* Maintain clear documentation of processes, code, dependencies, technical decisions, and business rules.
* Proactively communicate project progress, technical challenges, dependencies, and potential delays.
* Collaborate with team members to improve solutions and support business continuity.

* **This** is not intended to be a comprehensive list of the duties and responsibilities of the position and that the duties and responsibilities may change without notice.

**AM I THE RIGHT FIT?**

Not everyone can be a Full Stack Data Analytics Engineer. To be seriously considered for the role here is what you’ll bring:

**Education/Licenses/Certifications:**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering, BI development, data analytics, or a related technical role.
* Experience developing or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Experience with Power BI or a comparable business intelligence platform.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Lakehouse environments, or similar cloud data platforms.
* Experience with PySpark, Power Query, and DAX.
* Experience integrating ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Dataverse, Power Apps, and Power Automate.

* Exposure to generative AI, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI agents, MCP, or LLM APIs.

* Experience with R for statistic

title: LillyDirect Pharmacy Data Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Data Engineer for our LillyDirect Pharmacy Covered Entity (LDPCE) Master Data team. This role involves designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure to support our critical scientific and business initiatives, ultimately contributing to the delivery of life-changing medicines.
  
  
As a Data Engineer for Master Data, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the data solutions that ensure the availability, quality, and integrity of data for analysis and/or business transactions for our LillyDirect Pharmacy Covered Entity business. You will design and implement efficient data storage, processing, and retrieval solutions, build data pipelines, and optimize data models, working closely with the Technical Lead, DevOps engineer, architects, and business analysts. You will need strong skills in data integration, acquisition, cleansing, harmonization, and transformation, and you will play a key role in turning raw data into reliable, governed datasets that downstream teams can trust.
  
  
**What you’ll be doing:**  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines for batch and near-real-time processing in Python and PySpark on Databricks and AWS.
* Develop and optimize data models, ETL/ELT workflows, and data integration across multiple systems and platforms, using Delta Lake and lakehouse (medallion) patterns.
* Support data integrations with Reltio and Transcend, including data loads, extracts, and reconciliation.
* Build data quality, lineage, and reconciliation checks so that profile and consent data is accurate, complete, and auditable.
* Implement data governance, security, and quality standards across data assets, including access controls, masking, and retention for sensitive data (PII/PHI) and consent data.
* Collaborate with the Technical Lead, product owners, architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.
* Own pipelines and work streams from design through production, and contribute to architectural and design decisions.
* Promote best practices in coding, code review, automated testing, and deployment, and release code through CI/CD pipelines.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve performance, reliability, and cost of data pipelines, and support production incidents and root cause analysis.
* Automate manual processes and identify opportunities to optimize data workflows and reduce costs.

**How You Will Succeed:**  

* Deliver scalable solutions by designing robust data pipelines and architectures that meet performance and reliability standards.
* Build in privacy and consent by treating consent and data protection as a design principle in pipelines from the start, and by raising risks early.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to turn business needs into technical outcomes.
* Share expertise, mentoring junior engineers and adopting best practices in data engineering and cloud technologies.
* Continuously improve systems through automation, performance tuning, and proactive issue resolution.
* Communicate with clarity to ensure alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience Requirement:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or equivalent work experience.
* Overall 5+ years of experience in data engineering using core technologies such as SQL, Python, PySpark, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) services including Lambda, Glue, EMR S3, Redshift, Athena, and IAM roles/policies.
* 2+ years of experience working in Agile environments, with hands-on experience using GitHub and CI/CD pipelines for code deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, including workspace configuration, notebook development, Delta Lake, and performance optimization.
* 1+ years of experience with orchestration tools like Airflow or Databricks Workflows for workflow automation.

·
  
  
**Additional Skills/Preferences:**  

* Experience building high-performance, scalable data pipelines following Data Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, and Data Mart standards and deep understanding of ETL/ELT workflows.
* Strong expertise in data modelling, managing large datasets, and implementing secure, compliant data governance practices.
* Working knowledge of data governance, security, and data quality practices, including handling sensitive data (PII/PHI) in a regulated environment.
* Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to translate key business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; a problem-solving mindset and attention to detail.
* Pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience, including privacy requirements such as HIPAA.
* Hands-on experience with Reltio (or a comparable MDM platform), including match and merge, survivorship, and integration patterns.
* Familiarity with consent and preference management (for example opt-in/opt-out, purpose, and channel); experience with Transcend or a similar consent platform.

* Experience with Unity Catalog, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and data quality frameworks (for example Great Expectations or dbt tests).

REPAY enables its customers to accept payments anytime, anywhere, and through any channel while providing a secure, seamless, and enjoyable payment experience for the end consumers. REPAY offers a comprehensive suite of electronic payment and funding solutions, including debit and credit card processing, ACH processing, Instant Funding, and electronic bill payment systems with full IVR, text, and mobile capabilities. The scalability of its products allows merchants of all sizes to add an instant arsenal of intelligent payment technology solutions to their businesses without significant development costs or infrastructure investments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

REPAY is a fast-paced FinTech company experiencing significant growth and expansion. We are adding a DevOps Engineer to our growing team. The DevOps Engineer works as part of a team of engineers focused on building, maintaining, and supporting cloud native infrastructure for REPAY’s SaaS platform. The engineer will be primarily focused on implementing configuration management to automate the setup and configuration of servers and environments using Puppet and Terraform. The engineer also be responsible for maintaining and supporting the various CI/CD application tools along with assist in completing departmental objectives through assigned duties.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Monitor, maintain, and support applications in Azure and AWS cloud Development and Test environments.
* Work with internal engineering teams to identify and implement improvements to infrastructure (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, monitoring etc.
* Write code and contribute to the software architecture of a highly concurrent, high throughput system on AWS cloud.
* Contribute to roadmap development, execution, and releases.
* Manage Azure and AWS cloud Inventory and new infrastructure deployments.
* Assist the team in achieving established goals and departmental objectives.
* Participate in an environment that emphasizes trust, open communication, creative thinking, and cohesive team effort.
* Implement and support configuration management using Puppet and IaC with Terraform to automate the creation, setup, and configuration of servers and environments.
* Contribute to infrastructure improvements, architecture, development, and deployment.

title: LillyDirect Pharmacy DevOps Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. As a DevOps Engineer on the LillyDirect Pharmacy Covered Entity Master Data team, you will own CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, platform security, and the monitoring and operations that keeps our AWS, Databricks, Reltio, and Transcend integrations reliable. You will work with data engineers, the technical lead, and platform teams across Tech@Lilly. Your work helps ensure the right data, used with the right consent, reaches patients and the business.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  
Pipelines and automation
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data workloads using GitHub Actions or similar tools, with automated testing, security scanning, and approvals.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, optimize pipelines, and resolve failures quickly.
* Manage build artifacts and packages through Lilly's approved repositories (JFrog Artifactory).
* Automate promotion of Databricks jobs, notebooks, and configuration across environments.

Infrastructure and platform
  
  

* Develop and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK) for AWS and Databricks environments, so they are repeatable and reviewed.
* Manage AWS services used by the platform (for example S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, IAM, KMS, VPC, CloudWatch) with a focus on security and cost, including least-privilege IAM roles and encryption of sensitive data.
* Support Databricks workspace operations, including cluster policies, Unity Catalog access, and cost governance.
* Support secure, automated integrations with Reltio and Transcend, including secrets, access, and environment configuration.

Reliability and operations
  
  

* Build monitoring, logging, and alerting for pipeline health, data quality checks, and platform SLAs.
* Support production releases, incident response, root cause analysis, and document runbooks.
* Embed compliance controls (access, audit trails, change management through ServiceNow change and incident processes) so releases meet regulatory and privacy requirements.
* Partner with the technical lead, data engineers, and architecture and security teams to improve developer productivity and release quality.

How You Will Succeed
  
  

* You collaborate with data engineers, architects, and security partners to turn release needs into reliable automation.
* You automate repeatable work and fix root causes, not symptoms.
* You build controls for privacy, consent, and compliance into pipelines from the start.
* You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and raise risks early.
* You keep learning as our cloud and platform adoption grows.

Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.

Additional Skills and Preferences
  
  

* Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar), including artifact management with Artifactory or similar tools.
* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
* Strong working knowledge of AWS services and security (for example S3, IAM, VPC, Lambda, CloudWatch), with willingness to build skills in Azure as adoption grows.
* Scripting or programming skills in Python and shell, plus experience with Git and version control workflows.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting production workloads.
* Familiarity with data platforms and pipelines, such as Databricks, Spark, or AWS Glue.
* Understanding of secrets management, access control, and change management in regulated or security-sensitive environments, including environments that handle sensitive data such as PII or PHI.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners.
* Experience with Databricks DevOps, including Unity Catalog, workflows, and cluster policies, and the Databricks Terraform provider or Asset Bundles.
* Experience integrating with master data or consent platforms such as Reltio or Transcend.
* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow for incident and change management.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, or container-based deployments.
* Pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industry experience, including privacy requirements such as HIPAA.
* Experience with observability tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, or Datadog.
* AWS certification, preferably AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or Databricks certification.

title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

The program is an IDIQ contract for an AWS-based cloud hosting system. Currently, Peraton is supporting the Cloud Security, IoT, and AIML use cases for the environment in a hybrid work environment with Federal employees. Peraton also support the following applications as part of the environment: Dremio, Tableau, Globus, Posit/RStudio, Atlassian, ThingLogix, Alteryx and CloudCheckr.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking an experienced and proactive **Cloud DevOps Engineer** to join our dynamic team. This fully remote position involves managing and optimizing AWS cloud infrastructure through tasks such as incident management, ticket resolution, automation of operational tasks using scripting languages, and configuration management using tools like CloudFormation, Terraform, and Ansible.

The Department of Interior (DOI) CHS III program is leading the way for Cloud Hosting and Applications Modernization across DOI and its subordinate bureaus. CHS III is facilitating the migration of legacy on-premises applications to a modern, secure and scalable multi-cloud platform. From sensors in active volcanic regions to earthquake detection data, CHS III is DOI's central cloud processing and data solution.

  

**Work Location:** Remote

  

**What You Will Do****:**

* Participate in root cause analysis of system incidents.

* Respond to and resolve tickets in the operations support queue in a timely and efficient manner, ensuring issues are tracked, documented, and closed according to SLAs.

* Use tools such as AWS CloudFormation, GitLab and GitLab Runners to respond to support requests to manage and maintain AWS infrastructure, including EC2, RDS, S3, ELB, VPC, IAM Roles and Policies, Security Groups and related services.

* Automate routine operational tasks to improve system reliability, security monitoring and configuration management using AWS step functions, lambda functions, SSM documents, AWS EventBridge, SNS, SQS using scripting languages such as python, bash and powershell.

* Implement configuration management solutions (e.g., Ansible, Chef, or AWS Systems Manager).

* Set up and maintain observability tools (CloudWatch, DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, etc.) to monitor infrastructure and application performance.

* Ensure security best practices (IAM policies, encryption, VPC design, secrets management) and compliance with organizational standards.

* Analyze and optimize AWS cloud costs without compromising performance or scalability.

* Work cross-functionally with customer DevOps engineers, attend weekly team meetings and report status on open tickets and DevOps assignments.

##### **Qualifications**

  

**Basic** **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree and 3 years of professional experience, or a high school diploma/equivalent and 9 years of professional experience.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.

* Strong hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing cloud-based solutions using core AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, CloudFormation, and IAM for secure and scalable infrastructure.

* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, GitLab, GitLab Runners, or other third-party tools to automate application deployments.

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible, or AWS CDK to automate cloud resource provisioning and configuration management.

* Experience with Python, Bash, AWS CLI, or other scripting languages to automate deployments, streamline workflows, troubleshoot issues, and resolve operational challenges within AWS environments.

* Candidate must have at least one of the following certifications or be able to attain within 90 Days: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate, AWS Certified Developer – Associate, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional.
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field strongly preferred.

* One or more AWS Speciality Certification(s) such as AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Speciality, AWS Certified Security - Speciality, AWS AI Fundamentals.

* Experience with incident management, root cause analysis, and resolving high-priority incidents in large, multi-tenant environments using Jira, Confluence, etc.

* Exemplary communication, analytical skills, and technical knowledge across the client environment.

* Ability to produce concise and clear technical documentation.

* Experience working in an Agile environment

* Experience in leveraging AI tools to accelerate workflows and code generation, and for producing concise and clear technical AI-assisted documentation.

* Experience with using or supporting applications such as Dremio, Tableau, Posit and/or Nebari

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Us**

At Alteva RCM, we're dedicated to helping healthcare providers thrive through expert revenue cycle management, strategic insight, and innovative solutions. We're always looking for passionate, driven professionals who want to make a meaningful impact, grow their careers, and be part of a collaborative team committed to excellence.

**Senior DevOps Engineer**

**Alteva RCM | Technology | Full-Time | Queens, NY**

  

**About Alteva RCM**
====================

Alteva RCM is a healthcare revenue cycle management company that partners with medical practices and surgical centers nationwide. We help providers operate more efficiently, strengthen revenue cycle operations, and navigate the complexity of today's healthcare environment.

We serve a wide range of specialties and operate at scale, with technology playing a central role in how we support clients and internal operations.

  

**About the Role**
==================

This is Alteva's first dedicated DevOps hire. Today, infrastructure is run by a managed service provider, and DevOps work is handled piecemeal across IT, vendors and developers. The engineering team is growing quickly, and we need one person who owns how code gets from a developer's machine to production, safely and repeatably.

You will own our environments, deployment pipelines and infrastructure standards, and serve as the technical authority directing our managed service provider on production. You will set and hold the balance between developer productivity and security in a HIPAA-regulated environment as the team scales.

This is a hands-on role. You will build things yourself, not only write policy.

**What You'll Own**
===================

**Environments & Infrastructure**
---------------------------------

* Own development, test and staging environments end to end: provisioning, configuration, access and cost
* Define the target architecture and standards for production, and direct the managed service provider's work against them
* Manage infrastructure as code across Azure, plus a smaller AWS footprint
* Isolate environments so production data stays in production, and provide realistic masked or synthetic data for development and testing

**CI/CD & Release**
-------------------

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications and supporting services
* Own release mechanics: deployment automation, rollback readiness and environment promotion
* Become the single intake point for infrastructure and environment requests from the development teams

**Security & Compliance**
-------------------------

* Implement least-privilege access, secrets management and audit logging that meet HIPAA requirements
* Work with IT and security on endpoint and network controls so developers can work effectively without weakening protection
* Keep infrastructure and access documentation current enough to pass an audit

**Reliability & Support**
-------------------------

* Set up monitoring, alerting and logging so issues are caught early and routed to the right people
* Write the runbooks, escalation paths and setup documentation the managed service provider uses to support systems after hours, on weekends and on holidays
* Lead incident response and post-incident review for platform issues

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Required**
------------

* 5+ years in DevOps, platform engineering or SRE, including ownership of production environments
* Deep hands-on Azure experience: networking, identity (Entra ID), compute and app hosting, Key Vault, Azure Monitor
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or Bicep
* CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, ideally for .NET workloads
* Containers: Docker required, Kubernetes or AKS a strong plus
* Scripting in PowerShell plus Bash or Python

description:
**HIRING A PYTHON DEVELOPER I IN HOUSTON**

**ACCOUNTABILITY**

The Python Developer I is an entry-level role responsible for designing, building, and supporting automations and AI-enabled tools that reduce manual effort and improve quality across the firm’s MEP engineering, design, and business operations. Working under the guidance of Director of IT, the developer delivers Python and PowerShell scripts, Microsoft Power Automate workflows, and pyRevit scripts that support engineers, designers, and project staff. The developer works within established coding standards, Azure DevOps processes, and the firm’s IT security and AI-use policies; production deployments, access to sensitive project or client data, and changes to firm-wide systems require review and change management approval.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Develop, test, and maintain Python scripts and small applications that automate repetitive engineering, design, and administrative workflows (e.g., load and equipment schedules, calculation spreadsheets, report and file generation).
* Build and maintain no-code/low-code automations using Microsoft Power Automate and related Microsoft 365 tools (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Excel, Forms, Power Apps).
* Create and support Autodesk Revit automation using pyRevit, Dynamo, and/or the Revit API to help MEP design teams with model QA/QC checks, sheet and view setup, parameter management, and data export.
* Assist in integrating AI capabilities—such as large language models and document/data extraction tools—into internal workflows, in line with the firm’s data security and responsible AI-use guidelines.
* Meet with engineers, designers, and project staff to understand manual processes and pain points, document requirements, and translate them into user stories and technical tasks.
* Use Azure DevOps for source control (Git), work item tracking, code reviews, and build/release pipelines.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives, and provide accurate estimates and status updates.
* Write clear documentation and user guides, train end users on new tools, and provide troubleshooting and support for deployed automations.
* Monitor, maintain, and improve existing automations to keep them reliable as software versions, templates, and firm standards change.
* Perform additional assignments as requested/needed.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Associate's degree combined with a strong portfolio of Python or automation projects (e.g., GitHub repositories, internship work, or class projects) will be considered.
* Degree Required: Associate degree or higher in a technical field.
* Experience: 0–2 years of related experience; internships, co-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects count toward this requirement.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

* No certifications are required.
* Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, Azure, or Azure AI (fundamentals or associate level) are a plus.
* Agile or Scrum certification (e.g., PSM I, CSM) is a plus.

**EXPERIENCE**

* 0–2 years of experience in software development, scripting, or automation, including internships, co-ops, or significant academic/personal projects.
* Hands-on experience writing Python and/or PowerShell scripts; a portfolio or code samples are welcome.
* Exposure to no-code/low-code automation platforms such as Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, or comparable tools preferred.
* Experience with Azure DevOps (Repos, Boards, Pipelines) or a comparable Git-based development platform preferred.
* Exposure to Autodesk Revit—including the Revit API, Dynamo, or pyRevit—preferred.
* Experience working on a team using Agile development practices (Scrum or Kanban) preferred.
* Experience using or integrating AI tools, large language model APIs, or prompt engineering is a plus.
* Experience or coursework in the AEC, MEP, or professional engineering services industry is a plus.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Working knowledge of Python fundamentals, including data structures, functions, modules, error handling, virtual environments, and common libraries (e.g., pandas, openpyxl, requests).
* Basic PowerShell scripting skills for Windows and Microsoft 365 automation.
* Understanding of version control with Git, including branching, commits, and pull requests.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and working with data in Excel, CSV, and SQL databases.
* Basic understanding of AI and large language model concepts, their limitations, and responsible use with company and client data.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break a manual process into automatable steps.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical topics to engineers and non-technical staff.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to testing, documentation, and code quality.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, take direction and feedback, and work both independently and as part of a team.
* Interest in learning MEP engineering concepts (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection) and BIM workflows.

This role combines engineering-domain expertise, coding, analytics, and condition-monitoring development to help improve product performance, reliability, and customer outcomes.

You will collaborate with internal engineering partners, industry stakeholders, and global team members while supporting small projects and developing the capabilities to lead appropriate initiatives with coaching from experienced team members. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining hands-on engineering knowledge with analytics and coding to solve real-world equipment and product challenges.

This role provides an opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of software engineering and production operations, with exposure to reliability, observability, automation, operational readiness, incident management, and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
**About Norm**

Norm builds AI-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale.

Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services.

Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management.

Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters.  
  
**AI Fluency:**  
Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.  
  
Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

**This Role:**
--------------

The Senior Analytics Engineer will own the analytics data products that our internal teams rely on to make decisions. You will turn prototypes and one-off analyses into trusted, production-grade models and metrics. That means reusable models, business-facing metrics, access controls, tests, documentation, and the guidance our Lightdash AI agents need to answer questions correctly.

This role reports directly to the Director of Data and works closely with the rest of the data team and with internal partners such as GTM and Finance. It is a hands-on role that combines modeling judgment with stakeholder discovery.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* Own analytics data products across internal business functions
* Design and maintain reusable intermediate models, business-facing gold models, metrics, access controls, tests, documentation, and Lightdash agent guidance
* Turn ideas into production data products by working with stakeholders to define requirements, validating the results, and publishing them
* Reconcile concepts that differ across source systems, and publish mappings, unmatched records, assumptions, and quality checks so conflicts stay visible
* Deliver changes through the full production process, including SQL, dbt tests, Lightdash metadata, access rules, content validation, and AI agent instructions
* Diagnose incorrect or stale results across the data layers, and partner with data engineering when the cause sits below the serving layer
* Review modeling changes, pair with teammates, and help maintain shared standards

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

### **Core Qualifications**

* 5+ years of analytics engineering or equivalent experience, including contribution to a production dbt project with tests, CI, incremental models, and documentation
* Strong dimensional modeling judgment: you can design conformed entities and facts at the correct grain, and make clear decisions when source systems use conflicting definitions
* Experience delivering a metrics or semantic layer used by both people and tools, with safe access controls for sensitive data
* Familiarity with and regular use of AI coding agents. You verify their output and know when they are not the right tool
* Strong SQL skills and enough Python experience to understand existing pipelines and build transformation tasks
* Clear technical writing. You treat model documentation and metric definitions as part of the data product

### **Nice to Haves**

* Experience with Lightdash, or another semantic layer managed as code
* AWS knowledge and familiarity with tools like Athena, Iceberg, and Spark
* Experience with legal, private equity, or financial services data, including restricted or client-sensitive information
* Experience setting standards or mentoring on a small team

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

**Base Salary**: $175,000 to $215,000 per year

The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

**Equity:** Included

**Benefits:** 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program

**Relocation:** Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress-free.

**Work Location**
-----------------

**Location:** New York City

**Work model:** Hybrid

**In-office expectation:** 3–4 days per week

To learn more about Norm, visit our **website**.

title: Data Engineer, Operations Analytics
description:
At Rowan Digital Infrastructure, we are transforming data center delivery for speed and scale. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class data center solutions to hyperscale customers who share our commitment to sustainability, and to do so with an unwavering focus on efficiency, quality, and flexibility. Our data center solutions are tailored to our customers’ needs and delivered by our exceptional end-to-end team. Rowan is assembling a strategic portfolio of data center sites in Tier 1 markets across the United States at various stages of development, and we’re looking for incredible and passionate people to help us advance our company and our commitment to building a more sustainable future.

Rowan is backed by Quinbrook, a leading investor in the energy transition, and Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager.

Ready to join us in transforming the future of data centers and sustainability? Apply now to explore exciting career opportunities at Rowan Digital Infrastructure and be a part of our mission to revolutionize data center delivery.

**Role Summary**

The Data Engineer, Operations Analytics builds the data platform, pipelines, data standards, and quality controls that make the team’s data reliable. Working alongside the Data Scientist, this role owns the data from the agreed handoff point through to curated, analysis-ready tables. The role reports to the Director, Operations Analytics.

This role partners closely with the Data Scientist, IT, vendor partners, Operations, and Compliance to make sure reliable data is in place before the first turnkey solution in mid-2027, which will add new data sources and users. As the team grows, it also gives the Reporting Lead and Business Analysts documented standards and curated tables to build on. As a second owner of the analytics workspace, the position reduces dependence on any one person, keeps the platform supportable through shared change control and documentation, and supports audit readiness. It also prepares and governs data for AI and language model use cases.

**Travel:** Ability to travel up to 25% for company gatherings or to project sites.

**Location:** Denver, Colorado (3-day hybrid in-office role)

**Compensation:** $108K - $125K (Offers Bonus)

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Build and evolve the team’s data platform on Azure and Databricks, including ingestion, storage, and curated layers
* Govern the workspace through Unity Catalog, including catalog and schema design, permissions, lineage, and data classification, so access is controlled and auditable as new users and data sources come online
* Own ingestion into Databricks from the agreed handoff point with vendor partners and IT, and review upstream building and facility data platform work
* Design, build, test, and monitor production pipelines for power, cooling, equipment, and monitoring data, and scale them as new data sources and users come online
* Define and maintain a reference data standard and data dictionary, including consistent naming for sites, assets, equipment, and vendors, documented so new team members can onboard quickly
* Build data quality checks, monitoring, alerts, and runbooks so issues are detected and resolved quickly
* Publish and maintain curated tables that serve models, Tableau scorecards, and KPIs so every report and model draws on the same trusted data
* Partner with the Data Scientist to build and maintain Genie spaces and LLM-powered tools, including the curated tables, metadata, table and column descriptions, and certified queries they depend on
* Prepare and maintain data for AI and language model use cases, such as document and text ingestion, vector search indexes, and retrieval pipelines, held to the same quality and change control standards as other production data
* Serve as second owner of the Databricks workspace and co-own change control with the Data Scientist, including code review and separate development and production environments
* Partner with the Data Scientist, Operations, Reliability, Engineering, and IT teams, and with the Reporting Lead and Business Analysts as they join, to align data structures with modeling, reporting, and operational needs
* Create repeatable exports of platform evidence, such as access and activity logs, to support audits and the Compliance Analyst

**Education, Skills, and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related data platform role
* Hands-on experience building data platforms and operating production pipelines in Databricks using SQL, Python, and Spark
* Experience with Azure data and cloud services, including storage, networking, and identity concepts
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to build, review, and document code
* Experience with data modeling, data quality monitoring, and change control practices such as code review and separate development and production environments
* Experience with complex operational datasets, including time-series or telemetry data
* Ability to document standards clearly and communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience building data pipelines for AI and LLM applications, such as document parsing and chunking, embedding generation, vector search indexes, and retrieval evaluation
* Preferred familiarity with Databricks, AI/BI Genie, Vector Search, Model Serving, Tableau, and Airtable
* Preferred experience with data center, industrial, or building systems data

**Fueled by Excellence & Collaboration**

At Rowan, we are a distributed team united by a common mission to transform data center delivery. Across our two offices, we offer a hybrid work environment supported by teamwork, technology, and in-office gathering time to help you be successful. We are headquartered in downtown Denver, Colorado and have an office in Seattle, Washington. Our team of talented and passionate individuals is spread out across the U.S.

**Here to support you**

At Rowan, we want to make sure you can do great work. We offer competitive benefits focused on helping you be and achieve your best.

* Hybrid working environment
* Team building and educational opportunities
* Generous benefits package including robust health benefits and a 401(k)-company contribution
* Unlimited PTO
* RTD ECO pass or parking reimbursement

* Competitive compensation, bonus, and an incentive plan
* Relocating for this role? We offer relocation assistance on a case-by-case basis to help make your transition smooth

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Rowan Digital is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity in all aspects of our workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

title: Data Engineer II, Eva Trust Dev Team
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Own the data pipelines that let 30K+ AWS data center engineers get trusted, data-backed answers from Eva, our generative AI assistant. You'll lead the move of operational data from manual processes to automated pipelines, dashboards that generate themselves, and knowledge Eva can use the moment someone needs it.
  
  
As a Data Engineer II on the Eva Trust team, you'll design, build, and operate the pipelines behind data center analytics. You'll own data domains end to end: you'll ingest data from operational systems, transform and validate it, and publish trusted datasets. Those datasets feed automated dashboards and structured knowledge bases, so insights reach people directly in Eva instead of through manually maintained reports.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and own data pipelines that ingest, transform, and validate data center operational data from multiple source systems
* Lead the migration of manual, high-maintenance data processes and legacy dashboards to automated, monitored pipelines
* Design data models and publish trusted, reusable datasets that power automatically generated dashboards
* Turn curated data into structured knowledge bases and Eva skills so insights show up directly in Eva
* Set and enforce data quality, freshness, and monitoring standards, including alarms and runbooks
* Find and retire brittle or duplicate data dependencies, and improve pipeline reliability and cost
* Work with data center partners to understand their data sources and needs, then turn ambiguous asks into clear plans
* Write clean, tested, documented code, take part in design and code reviews, and mentor junior engineers and interns

A day in the life
  
  
You might start the day reviewing pipeline health and deciding how to fix a recurring freshness issue at its source. Then you meet a data center operations partner to plan how a widely used dashboard's data moves into Eva. In the afternoon you write the design for a new ingestion pipeline, review a junior engineer's code, and work with the Eva platform team on how a new knowledge base plugs in. You finish by checking Eva's answers against your published data.
  
  
**About The Team**
Eva Trust is part of the Data Center Gen AI team in AWS Infrastructure Services. We make sure Eva, the AI assistant used by 30K+ people across the data center community, is accurate, safe, and trusted, and that it brings up the right information where people need it. We own the data pipelines, dashboards, structured knowledge, evaluations, and guardrails behind Eva. We combine deep data center domain expertise with data and AI engineering, and we invest in growing the people around us.
  
  
\*Why AWS\*
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
\*Diverse Experiences\*
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
\*Work/Life Balance\*
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
\*Inclusive Team Culture\*
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
\*Mentorship and Career Growth\*
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of data engineering experience
* 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using data modeling experience
* 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using SQL experience
* 1+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using each of the following: ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)/ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

description:
Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!
  
  
**Job Description**
Do you want a career supporting the world's best Navy? The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is seeking a Data Engineer to join a growing team dedicated to collecting and transforming data from the United States Nuclear Navy for analytics throughout the Laboratory. As a Data Engineer, you will be part of a team responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining the Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) process for incoming shipboard data used in naval nuclear propulsion systems. You will evaluate new and emerging technologies to deliver scalable solutions to transforming shipboard data in an enterprise-wide data warehouse from which operational metrics and support analytics can be easily and reliably generated.

Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field.

* Experience in Linux shell scripting and software development using languages such as SQL and Python.
* Experience in optimization and performance tuning of ETL workloads and understanding of database internals.

* Disability, Life & Accident Insurance
* 401(k) Savings program & Capital Accumulation Plan

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Wellness Program
* Visit us online to view all NNL benefits!

**Pay Range**
$70,900.00 - $108,500.00 annually
  
  
Salary information provided is a general guideline only. Annual salary is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.
  
  
The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is operated for the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) by Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC (FMP), a wholly owned subsidiary of Fluor Corporation. Naval Nuclear Laboratory personnel are FMP employees who work at four DOE facilities: Bettis Atomic Power Laboratory, Knolls Atomic Power Laboratory, Kenneth A. Kesselring Site, and Naval Reactors Facility, and at the U.S. Department of Defense-owned Nuclear Power Training Unit-Charleston. FMP employees also have an established presence at numerous shipyards, satellite, and vendor locations.
  
  
For more than 75 years, the Naval Nuclear Laboratory has developed advanced nuclear propulsion technology, provided technical support, and trained world-class nuclear operators to ensure the safe and reliable operation of our nation's submarine and aircraft carrier fleets. title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer | Azure | Recent Grad | Hybrid
description:
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable, secure and highly available cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud (OCI). The role focuses on infrastructure automation, reliability, resiliency, networking, security and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments. You will collaborate with application, security and operations teams to implement best practices for deployment, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery while driving continuous improvement and cost optimization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud (OCI) to meet availability, performance and security requirements.
* Build and manage virtual networks (VCN/VNet), subnets, route tables, DNS, VPNs, FastConnect/ExpressRoute and cross-tenancy routing to support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.
* Implement and operate load balancers, storage solutions, backups, and disaster recovery strategies to ensure resiliency and data protection.
* Manage identity and access (IAM), whitelisting, endpoint configuration and firewall policies to secure cloud environments and enforce least privilege.
* Develop, maintain and run automation using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Bash and REST APIs to provision infrastructure, orchestration and configuration management.
* Create and maintain monitoring, logging and dashboarding (metrics, logs, alerts) to enable rapid detection and incident response; participate in on-call rotations and incident post-mortems.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure issues across compute, networking and storage layers, drive root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to improve reliability.
* Perform capacity planning, cloud optimization and cost control activities, recommending improvements and right-sizing resources.
* Document architecture, operational runbooks, topology diagrams, network configurations and standard operating procedures for teams and audits.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (security, applications, networking, SRE) to deliver secure, compliant and production-ready platforms and to drive continuous improvement.
* Implement server administration tasks, manage IP addressing, and maintain firewalls and routing for complex deployments.
* Design and run tests for disaster recovery and failover, validate backup/restoration procedures and maintain recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).

**Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience
* 1+ years experience working with cloud platforms (must have Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud / OCI experience).
* Strong practical knowledge of networking concepts including VCN/VNet, subnets, route tables, DNS, VPN, FastConnect/ExpressRoute, IP addressing and routing.
* Skilled in automation and scripting using Terraform, Python, PowerShell and Bash; experience consuming REST APIs for infrastructure automation.
* Experience with identity and access management (IAM), security controls, whitelisting, endpoint configuration and firewall management in cloud environments.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboards, incident response and troubleshooting server, storage and networking issues.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Fundamentals, Cloud Infrastructure Foundations, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate.
* Hands-on experience with OCI-specific features (VCN, FastConnect, Load Balancer, Object/Block Storage) and cross-tenancy designs a plus.
* Background as an Infrastructure Engineer or SRE and familiarity with disaster recovery, backups, resiliency, cloud optimization and capacity planning a plus.
* Experience with Terraform modules, CI/CD integration, cloud cost optimization tools, dashboarding platforms and log aggregation systems a plus.
* Strong written documentation skills, clear communication, collaborative mindset, problem-solving orientation and a focus on continuous improvement.

**Benefits**

**PTO, Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, Vision, 401K, bonus and profit sharing**

* Exposure to Autodesk Revit—including the Revit API, Dynamo, or pyRevit—preferred.
* Experience working on a team using Agile development practices (Scrum or Kanban) preferred.
* Experience using or integrating AI tools, large language model APIs, or prompt engineering is a plus.
* Experience or coursework in the AEC, MEP, or professional engineering services industry is a plus.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Working knowledge of Python fundamentals, including data structures, functions, modules, error handling, virtual environments, and common libraries (e.g., pandas, openpyxl, requests).
* Basic PowerShell scripting skills for Windows and Microsoft 365 automation.
* Understanding of version control with Git, including branching, commits, and pull requests.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and working with data in Excel, CSV, and SQL databases.
* Basic understanding of AI and large language model concepts, their limitations, and responsible use with company and client data.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical topics to engineers and non-technical staff.

title: Data Engineer-Integration Specialist
description:
With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential.
  
  
The Office of Innovation & Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia - increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency.
  
  
**Job Description**
Data Engineering at the City is a unique opportunity for meaningful, exciting work and professional development using state-of-the art technologies and software development best practices. This is a position on a diverse team of engineers, analysts, and GIS specialists, contributing to developing, maintaining, and optimizing our data pipelines and integration strategies, assisting departments and agencies in innovating, and enhancing the City’s service to its residents.
  
  
The data engineer/integration specialist will develop an intimate understanding of the City’s diverse data and contribute to improving the City’s data engineering infrastructure, pipelines, models, and integrations. The team uses a blend of open source, custom developed and off-the-shelf tools, including Python, Bash, SQL, DBT, GIS, Docker, Terraform, Apache Airflow, Jenkins, Postgres, PostGIS, AWS, GitHub, Github actions, MuleSoft as an iPaaS and SAS API providers like ArcGIS Online and CARTO.
  
  
Some prominent services the team is responsible for include DataBridge, OIT’s enterprise data warehouse, AIS, the City’s custom address information systems which supports public address search and internal geocoding, and Databridge-Airflow, a custom workflow generator and orchestrator for departmental integrations (https://metadata.phila.gov/) and open data publishing (https://opendataphilly.org/). Some examples of OIT’s commitment to serving the public through the effective and innovative integration of City open data include:
  
  
https://Atlas.phila.gov
  
  
https://property.phila.gov
  
  
https://Openmaps.phila.gov
  
  
https://streetsmartphl.phila.gov/
  
  
www.phila.gov/solarmap
  
  
www.phila.gov/stressmap
  
  
We are looking for a candidate who is not only technically skilled but also passionate about leveraging data to improve City operations and community life. This team is fundamental to the innovation of City services that directly affect residents. If you are eager to contribute to a team that values innovation, efficiency, service-oriented work and data-driven decision-making, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Working with business partners of varying technical ability to understand how their data is produced, stored, and updated, designing enhancements to optimize enterprise integrations and public data accessibility.
* Design and develop new and expand and refine existing data pipelines using Apache Airflow, custom Python-based software, and other tools to connect diverse systems of record, centralized databases, and SaaS environments, improving data platform components, data governance, master data management, data standardization, enrichment and quality assurance.
* Play a key role in enterprise integration and open data initiatives, developing and supporting critical systems like the City’s DataBridge, Databridge-Airflow and AIS.
* Write clear, descriptive technical documentation for systems/applications, partner with data stewards of various technical levels and communicate technical details to non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Geography/GIS, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered.
* Demonstrated experience in data engineering or a similar role, with a focus on data management/integration/ETL/ELT.
* Proven track record with Python, SQL, and database management.
* Experience with working with modern data engineering tech stack.
* Familiarity with development of custom ETL/CI/CD tools and the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies.

Previous work in a public sector or large organization setting is a plus.
  
  
Competencies:
  
  

* Clear and concise writing and communication skills.
* Creative problem-solving and critical thinking.
* Ability to work with data from diverse domains.
* Efficient time management and the ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously.
* Ability to seek innovative opportunities and continuous improvement.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools, packages, and best practices.
* Eagerness to participate in knowledge sharing and contribute to team discussions on coding standards.

Knowledge and Skills:
  
  

* Proficient in Python
* Familiarity with modern Python development practices (e.g., type annotations, data validation, automated testing) a plus
* Strong SQL skills and experience with databases (Postgres preferred).
* Familiarity with Docker, bash and minimal Linux server administration.
* Experience with cloud services (AWS preferred).
* Understanding of Git/GitHub for version control and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience or ability to learn Airflow, DBT, Terraform, Kubernetes, Mulesoft.
* Experience working with spatial datasets a plus.
* Experience using command line interfaces.

Abilities:
  
  

* To reason about, model and manipulate complex datasets.
* To maintain clean and secure data environments.
* To work effectively in a hybrid (on-premises and cloud) environment.
* To communicate complex technical concepts in understandable terms.

To thoughtfully evaluate new data engineering tools and practices within a public service context.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Salary cannot exceed $95,605**
