title: Analytics Engineer II
description:
**About Branch**
Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible, so more people can be covered. We innovate using data, tech, and automation to simplify insurance from start to finish—we eliminated inaccurate quotes in favor of real prices, created a better way to bundle, and cut unnecessary costs in the traditional insurance process. Then we pass those savings along to our members. Basically, we’re doing insurance the way it was meant to be.
  
  
But we didn’t just create the insurance we’ve always wanted, we also created the company we’ve always wanted to work for. As we redefine insurance, we also want to redefine what it means to work in insurance. Find out for yourself.
  
  
*Branch has a preference for candidates in Ohio, but is open to candidates located in AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, MD, MI, MO, NV, NC, OH, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, and WI.*
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.
  
  
Branch is remote first, with most Branchers choosing to work from home. Our headquarters are located in Columbus, Ohio, where we come together from time to time to build relationships and connect with each other in real life. We also have office space in Columbia and Concordia, Missouri as well as Forreston, Illinois. Once a year, the entire company gathers for “BranchFest”, a highlight of the year for many Branchers.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Branch, we're reshaping the insurance experience with efficient, transparent, member-centered products. As an Analytics Engineer, you'll build the data models, tables and self-service tools that our Accounting, Actuarial and Claims teams rely on, working in SQL and dbt on BigQuery.
  
  
You'll join the Analytics Engineering team in Branch's Data Office, reporting to the Senior Manager, Analytics Engineering. Requests come to the team as tickets, and you'll take yours from the question through to production data. As you grow in the role, you'll own a data domain and the stakeholder relationships that come with it.
  
  
AI is built into how the team works. Claude Code drafts pull requests inside our dbt project, and the team reviews, corrects and improves what it produces. Branch also moves faster than a large carrier: work that takes a quarter elsewhere ships here in a couple of weeks. That pace is the best part of the job and the biggest adjustment for anyone arriving from a larger company.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who wants to write the code themselves, see their work end to end, and grow quickly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build views, tables, data models, data dictionaries and self-service tools in SQL and dbt, with support from peers and senior members of the Data Office.
* Monitor data quality proactively, prevent unwanted changes and defects, and fix them promptly when they occur.
* Work tickets from Accounting, Actuarial and Claims stakeholders from the request through to production.
* Understand each project's full scope, how it interacts with other projects, and how data flows between them. Advocate for best practices and adherence to service guidelines.
* Review AI-generated code carefully, catch its mistakes, and help the team's AI tools improve over time.
* Collaborate with leaders to implement, refine and document processes and best practices that improve quality and the functionality of our self-service tools.
* Build a working knowledge of how data development works at Branch and of the insurance business behind the data.

**Skills & Experience**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in data or reporting development, including data modeling and data quality monitoring.
* Strong, hands-on SQL is required. You have built the models and transformations yourself, not only the dashboards on top of them.
* Experience with dbt is a strong plus.
* Experience with process automation, automated reporting and business intelligence.
* Experience with Python is a strong plus. JavaScript or another programming language is also valued.
* Experience building with AI coding tools, Claude Code in particular, is a strong plus.
* Experience with insurance data, especially claims, accounting or actuarial data, is a plus.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where you own your work from start to finish.

**Why join us at Branch?**
We’re all about getting back to getting each other’s back - that means Branchers, too. So we provide benefits that let you work and live to your fullest.
  
  

* Above-market salary - Branch is a data-driven company, so we do the math on salaries, too. If you get an offer from Branch, you can expect compensation that hits above the mark.
* Pay equity and transparency - Our pay isn’t just market-driven, it’s equitable. We let experience and performance drive your success, never your gender, race, orientation, or beliefs.
* Remote-first (with perks) - Work from where you’re most comfortable. We’ll take care of your work from home set-up and monthly internet. We also have a Columbus headquarters if you’d like to join us in an office.
* Flexible YouTime - We don’t just let you control your own time off. We actually encourage you to use it. After your first year at Branch, we’ll give you $1000 toward your next vacation.
* Employee stock options - You’re not just an employee. If you’re full-time, you’re also a part-owner. You’ll have stock options so you can invest in the company you’re helping to grow.
* Medical, vision, dental - Get all the coverage you need for a healthy, happy life.
* 401k and contribution matching - Invest in your future. Branch helps you get to retirement on time with a portion of your contributions matched each month.

**What To Expect**
In light of recent hiring scams across the United States, here’s what the process will look like with Branch (so you know it’s us):
  
  

* Please apply to open positions directly through our site. If you don’t see it here, then it shouldn’t exist on another job board. If you’re ever unsure about the legitimacy of a Branch job posting found on another site, please check the listings here to verify.
* If you're selected to move onto the next phase of the hiring process, a member of our Branch talent team will reach out to you directly from the email domain @ourbranch.com to guide you through our process.
* The process will include a number of interviews, which will all happen either over the phone or on video calls.
* We will never ask for personal payment or require you to purchase equipment during our interview process. Always be sure to protect your personal information.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer**
At Branch, we are deeply committed to community. Branch is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants and/or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to the individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Compensation Range: $70K - $100K

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (AI-Enabled)
description:
**Ready to Help Shape How Data and AI Are Used Across the Business?**

Are You Someone Who...

* Has expert SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt in a production environment?
* Understands dimensional modeling deeply, including fact design, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions?
* Has built semantic layers, governed metrics, and trusted datasets that business teams rely upon?
* Is comfortable working across Snowflake and Power BI, including data models, DAX, governed datasets, access controls, and cost-aware design?
* Has practical experience applying AI or generative AI to enterprise analytics and understands the importance of using approved, appropriately secured data?
* Enjoys translating business needs into well-designed data products and explaining technical concepts clearly to stakeholders?
* Wants to help establish standards and build trusted data assets that an organization will rely on for years to come?

If you answered yes, this may be the opportunity for you.

Founded in 1974, Brandes Investment Partners is a pioneer in global value investing. We serve institutions, pension funds, intermediaries, and financial advisors worldwide through a disciplined, long-term investment approach grounded in the principles of Benjamin Graham.

We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer (AI-Enabled) to join our newly established Data Office as one of its founding hires. You’ll help build and own the governed analytics layer that supports reporting, self-service analytics, AI, and better decision-making across the firm. The annual base salary range we reasonably expect to pay for this role is $130,000 to $165,000. Placement within the range will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and overall fit for the position, as well as internal equity considerations and market conditions.

What You’ll Do

This is a hands-on senior role with the opportunity to help establish our analytics environment and standards from the beginning. You will:

* Design and build the analytics layer in Snowflake using dbt, transforming raw data into trusted, well-documented, reusable models.
* Establish a single source of truth for key business measures by defining and maintaining semantic layers and governed metrics.
* Partner with teams across operations, investments, distribution, and client service to translate business needs into data models, certified datasets, and reporting solutions.
* Build and support governed Power BI datasets and dashboards that enable reliable self-service analytics.
* Identify and deliver AI-enabled analytics use cases, including natural language querying and LLM-powered workflows using governed data.
* Establish strong practices around data quality, documentation, lineage, testing, code review, and CI/CD.
* Partner with the Senior Data Engineer on architecture, data ingestion, performance, and cost-efficient use of the platform.
* Help drive adoption through documentation, training, and enablement while measuring the usage and business value of the solutions delivered

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a hands-on senior technical builder who combines strong technical depth with business fluency. Preference given to local candidates but will consider non-local or remote. Candidates require a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, along with a minimum of six years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or data engineering, including at least three years building production data models on a cloud data platform.

The role calls for production experience with dbt and Snowflake, a track record of delivering governed metrics and reporting to business stakeholders, and hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled analytics or generative AI use cases using enterprise data. Experience within financial services, asset management, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.

Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Python/Snowpark, Airflow, Dagster, Fivetran, Atlan, Alation, or Monte Carlo is also valuable, as is exposure to data governance and data stewardship initiatives.

Why This Role Matters

This isn't simply an opportunity to maintain an established reporting environment.

It’s an opportunity to help build the foundation for how Brandes uses trusted data and AI. As one of the founding hires of the Data Office, you'll have the opportunity to establish standards, build governed data assets, and help shape capabilities designed to support the firm for years to come

If you're the kind of person who looks at data and sees the opportunity to make it more trusted, more useful, and more intelligent, we'd like to hear from you.

Why Join Brandes?

As you get to know Brandes, you will quickly recognize that value is at the heart of everything we do. Value refers not only to our investment style, but also to how we engage with our colleagues and conduct ourselves as a firm.

We often say that Brandes is purpose-built for value. We believe this focus on value-valuing our colleagues sets us apart.

This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by managing your own territory while being part of a firm that values its people and fosters an environment that supports our mission:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Absentia Labs**
-----------------------

Absentia Labs is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that powers the next generation of biomedical discovery. We work at the intersection of biology, chemistry, machine learning, and large-scale systems, transforming fragmented scientific data into reliable, machine-learning-ready knowledge.

Biomedical data is dispersed, semi-structured, and inherently noisy, yet deeply interconnected across experiments, assays, compounds, and biological systems. Extracting value from this complexity requires deliberate schema design, principled abstractions, and rigorous post-processing pipelines that can support both scientific reasoning and large-scale AI.

We believe breakthroughs start with strong data foundations. This role sits at the architectural core of our platform, shaping how scientific data is modeled, validated, versioned, and served across the organization.

**The Role**
------------

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will own the design and evolution of Absentia Labs’ biomedical data platform. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, making long-horizon architectural decisions while remaining hands-on in implementation.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working in high-ambiguity, research-driven environments, and who understands that data engineering for AI is as much about representation and correctness as it is about scale.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Architect and lead the design of end-to-end data systems for large-scale biomedical datasets (chemical, biological, toxicology, omics, assay, clinical, and experimental data).
* Define and evolve schema-driven data models that reconcile noisy, semi-structured, and heterogeneous sources into coherent, interoperable representations.
* Establish best practices for data quality, validation, provenance, lineage, and versioning suitable for scientific and ML workflows.
* Build and maintain cloud-native data infrastructure (data lakes, warehouses, object storage, streaming systems) with an emphasis on scalability and reliability.
* Design pipelines that support both batch and streaming access for ML training, evaluation, and inference.
* Partner closely with ML engineers, scientists, and product leads to translate research needs into durable data abstractions.
* Make principled trade-offs around performance, cost, flexibility, and correctness in production systems.
* Provide technical leadership through design reviews, architectural guidance, and mentorship of other engineers.
* Identify and proactively address systemic risks in data integrity, scalability, and operational complexity.

**Who You Are**
---------------

You are a data engineer who thinks in systems and interfaces, not just pipelines. You are comfortable owning poorly defined problems and converging on robust solutions through thoughtful design and iteration.

You understand that biomedical data is rarely “clean,” and that schema design, normalization, and semantics are first-order engineering problems—especially in AI-driven settings.

**You Likely Have**
-------------------

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or ML infrastructure roles, with clear ownership of production systems.
* Proven experience designing and operating large-scale, production-grade data pipelines.
* Strong proficiency in Python and data-centric software engineering practices.
* Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including storage, compute, and security primitives.
* Familiarity with distributed data processing and orchestration systems (e.g., Spark, Beam, Ray, Airflow, Dagster).
* Experience supporting ML/AI workloads, including dataset generation, feature pipelines, and reproducible training workflows.
* Strong architectural judgment and the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly across disciplines.

**Bonus If You Have**
---------------------

* Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity participation, allows you to share directly in the long-term success and growth of the company.
* Prior work with biomedical or life-science data (e.g., omics, assays, molecular representations, clinical or toxicology data).
* Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).
* Exposure to ontology-aware data modeling or schema evolution in scientific domains.
* Infrastructure-as-code and systems experience (Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience in early-stage startups or research-heavy environments.
* Open-source contributions or technical publications.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* A chance to architect the data backbone of an AI-driven biomedical platform.
* Direct impact on how scientific data is translated into machine intelligence.
* High autonomy, high trust, and ownership over critical systems.
* Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangements.
* A deeply technical, low-ego culture focused on learning and rigor.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Please submit your resume and a short note on why this role resonates with you. Links to GitHub, technical writing, or relevant projects are encouraged.

Compensation Range: $115K - $200K

description:

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

* Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

**YOUR MISSION**

Reporting to the IT Operations Manager, the Cloud Administrator is responsible for the design, implementation, and management of our Azure Government cloud infrastructure and services. This role is critical to supporting our mission in the space industry, ensuring our cloud environment is secure, compliant, scalable, and optimized for performance. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Azure Government, infrastructure as code, containerization, and government security compliance.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Azure Government Cloud Management

* Design, deploy, and manage Azure Government cloud infrastructure and services

CI/CD and Infrastructure Automation

* Manage hybrid identity solutions connecting Azure AD with O365 GCC High
* Develop automation workflows using Power Automate to streamline business processes

AI and Advanced Services

* Implement and manage AI services including Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, and Machine Learning
* Design AI solutions that meet government security and compliance requirements
* Support data science and engineering teams with AI/ML infrastructure needs

Network Security and Firewall Management

* Configure and manage Palo Alto Networks firewalls in Azure environments
* Implement network segmentation, VNets, NSGs, and Azure Firewall solutions
* Maintain VPN connections and ExpressRoute circuits for hybrid connectivity
* Monitor network traffic and respond to security incidents

Monitoring and Operations

* Implement comprehensive monitoring using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights
* Perform capacity planning and performance tuning
* Respond to incidents and conduct root cause analysis
* Document architecture, configurations, and operational procedures
* Participate in on-call rotation for critical infrastructure support

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* 5+ years of experience administering Azure cloud environments
* Azure Government cloud experience with understanding of compliance requirements
* Kubernetes experience, preferably with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
* Office 365 GCC High administration experience
* Power Automate (or equivalent) proficiency for workflow automation
* Palo Alto Networks firewall configuration and management experience
* AI services (or equivalent) experience including implementation of AI/ML solutions
* Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash)
* Deep understanding of networking concepts, security principles, and cloud architecture
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep)
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
* U.S. Citizen and eligible for DoD Secret or TS/SCI clearance

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)

* Experience in aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated industries
* Familiarity with DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG)

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar - delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.  
  
Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact - both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

  
Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

**Position Summary**  
  
This Senior Platform Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, security, governance, and support of Xcel Energy's enterprise Databricks Lakehouse Platform across AWS and GCP. This role provides technical leadership for cloud-based data platform services, including platform operations, Unity Catalog, identity and access management, automation, monitoring, disaster recovery, and cost optimization. Working across data engineering, infrastructure, architecture, security, and business teams, the engineer ensures the platform is scalable, reliable, secure, and capable of supporting enterprise analytics, reporting, and AI/ML initiatives.  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

  

* Solution Delivery: Lead and support solution lifecycle technical activities. Ensure solutions are designed for great user experience and operational performance. Lead design, ensuring Enterprise Architecture, Security, Audit, Operations and Compliance aspects are continuously integrated into solutions. Provide input to cost and schedule estimation. Responsible for overall integrity of system design and operation.
* Relationship Management: Conduct peer reviews and approve system changes and technical solution design. Coach and mentor less experience team members. Partner cross-organizationally to drive minimal costs on optimal solutions. Provide in-depth technical information to stakeholders as needed.
* Strategy & Planning: Innovate through usage of industry emerging capabilities and evolving customer needs. Provide input to strategic roadmap and technical dependencies.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Continuously stay current on, and apply, technical industry knowledge pertaining to the respective domain
* Operations: Review solution performance and continually assess health of systems. Track and drive awareness to operational and technical debt risks. Provide escalated support to incident and problem management with vendors and internal teams. Utilize analytics to improve availability, reliability, efficiency, and capacity.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Ten years of related functional experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Technology, Science, Business or related field, or 4 years of experience equivalent to the position.
* Excellent communication skills, effective with varying organizational levels and skill set, and able to translate between technical and non-technical concepts.
* Excellent Relationship Management and collaboration skills, with a track record of working as one team cross-organizationally to drive inovation and business results.
* Expertise managing the lifecycle of technical solutions.
* Deep Subject Matter Expertise within the respective system domain products, platforms, processes and architecture.
* Broad and deep knowledge of technology architecture, infrastructure, network, security and software principles and models.
* Experience working in partnership with internal and external vendors.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Extensive knowledge of future technology trends within area of expertise. Demonstrated leadership on technical aspects of large scale projects.
* Experience coaching other developers in system deployment or operational troubleshooting.
* Experience with delivery methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum) and operational models (ITIL).
* Experience and understanding of core IT Service Management functions, such as Change Management and Incident Management.

**Preferred Requirements**

  

* Five or more years of hands-on experience administering and supporting the Databricks Lakehouse Platform in AWS and/or GCP environments.
* Experience with AWS and GCP cloud services, including IAM roles and policies, service accounts, networking, storage, security integration, and resource governance.
* Experience administering Unity Catalog and enterprise identity, access, security, and data governance controls.
* Experience developing and supporting scalable data ingestion solutions using Databricks Lakeflow, ZeroBus, and other Databricks-native ingestion capabilities.
* Experience integrating Databricks with external applications, BI tools, databases, data warehouses, data lakes, ingestion platforms, and ETL/ELT technologies.
* Experience with Databricks Lakebase, including connectivity, security, administration, and application integration.
* Experience designing and supporting Lakehouse Federation and secure federated data access across platforms and data sources.
* Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining Databricks workspaces, clusters, and associated cloud resources using infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, Apache Spark, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, MLOps, and Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Experience monitoring and optimizing Databricks performance, reliability, scalability, security, compliance, and cloud costs.
* Experience managing platform releases, upgrades, backup strategies, and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with data engineering, data science, BI, infrastructure, architecture, security, operations, and business teams to deliver enterprise Databricks solutions.
* Experience in the utility or energy industry is a plus.

title: Analytics Engineer II
description:
**About Branch**
================

Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible, so more people can be covered. We innovate using data, tech, and automation to simplify insurance from start to finish—we eliminated inaccurate quotes in favor of real prices, created a better way to bundle, and cut unnecessary costs in the traditional insurance process. Then we pass those savings along to our members. Basically, we’re doing insurance the way it was meant to be.

But we didn’t just create the insurance we’ve always wanted, we also created the company we’ve always wanted to work for. As we redefine insurance, we also want to redefine what it means to work in insurance. Find out for yourself.

*Branch has a preference for candidates in Ohio, but is open to candidates located in AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, MD, MI, MO, NV, NC, OH, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, and WI.* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Branch is remote first, with most Branchers choosing to work from home. Our headquarters are located in Columbus, Ohio, where we come together from time to time to build relationships and connect with each other in real life. We also have office space in Columbia and Concordia, Missouri as well as Forreston, Illinois. Once a year, the entire company gathers for “BranchFest”, a highlight of the year for many Branchers.

**About the Role**

At Branch, we're reshaping the insurance experience with efficient, transparent, member-centered products. As an Analytics Engineer, you'll build the data models, tables and self-service tools that our Accounting, Actuarial and Claims teams rely on, working in SQL and dbt on BigQuery.

You'll join the Analytics Engineering team in Branch's Data Office, reporting to the Senior Manager, Analytics Engineering. Requests come to the team as tickets, and you'll take yours from the question through to production data. As you grow in the role, you'll own a data domain and the stakeholder relationships that come with it.

AI is built into how the team works. Claude Code drafts pull requests inside our dbt project, and the team reviews, corrects and improves what it produces. Branch also moves faster than a large carrier: work that takes a quarter elsewhere ships here in a couple of weeks. That pace is the best part of the job and the biggest adjustment for anyone arriving from a larger company.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to write the code themselves, see their work end to end, and grow quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build views, tables, data models, data dictionaries and self-service tools in SQL and dbt, with support from peers and senior members of the Data Office.
* Monitor data quality proactively, prevent unwanted changes and defects, and fix them promptly when they occur.
* Work tickets from Accounting, Actuarial and Claims stakeholders from the request through to production.
* Understand each project's full scope, how it interacts with other projects, and how data flows between them. Advocate for best practices and adherence to service guidelines.
* Review AI-generated code carefully, catch its mistakes, and help the team's AI tools improve over time.
* Collaborate with leaders to implement, refine and document processes and best practices that improve quality and the functionality of our self-service tools.
* Build a working knowledge of how data development works at Branch and of the insurance business behind the data.

**Skills & Experience**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in data or reporting development, including data modeling and data quality monitoring.
* Strong, hands-on SQL is required. You have built the models and transformations yourself, not only the dashboards on top of them.
* Experience with dbt is a strong plus.
* Experience with process automation, automated reporting and business intelligence.
* Experience with Python is a strong plus. JavaScript or another programming language is also valued.
* Experience building with AI coding tools, Claude Code in particular, is a strong plus.
* Experience with insurance data, especially claims, accounting or actuarial data, is a plus.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where you own your work from start to finish.

**Why join us at Branch?**

We’re all about getting back to getting each other’s back - that means Branchers, too. So we provide benefits that let you work and live to your fullest.

* **Above-market salary -** Branch is a data-driven company, so we do the math on salaries, too. If you get an offer from Branch, you can expect compensation that hits above the mark.
* **Pay equity and transparency -** Our pay isn’t just market-driven, it’s equitable. We let experience and performance drive your success, never your gender, race, orientation, or beliefs.
* **Remote-first (with perks) -** Work from where you’re most comfortable. We’ll take care of your work from home set-up and monthly internet. We also have a Columbus headquarters if you’d like to join us in an office.
* **Flexible YouTime -** We don’t just let you control your own time off. We actually encourage you to use it. After your first year at Branch, we’ll give you $1000 toward your next vacation.
* **Employee stock options -** You’re not just an employee. If you’re full-time, you’re also a part-owner. You’ll have stock options so you can invest in the company you’re helping to grow.
* **Medical, vision, dental -** Get all the coverage you need for a healthy, happy life.
* **401k and contribution matching -** Invest in your future. Branch helps you get to retirement on time with a portion of your contributions matched each month.

**What to expect**

In light of recent hiring scams across the United States, here’s what the process will look like with Branch (so you know it’s us):

* Please apply to open positions directly through our site. If you don’t see it here, then it shouldn’t exist on another job board. If you’re ever unsure about the legitimacy of a Branch job posting found on another site, please check the listings here to verify.
* If you're selected to move onto the next phase of the hiring process, a member of our Branch talent team will reach out to you directly from the email domain @ourbranch.com to guide you through our process.
* The process will include a number of interviews, which will all happen either over the phone or on video calls.
* We will never ask for personal payment or require you to purchase equipment during our interview process. Always be sure to protect your personal information.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer**

At Branch, we are deeply committed to community. Branch is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants and/or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to the individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $70K - $100K

title: Analytics Engineer (X)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

#### **ANALYTICS ENGINEER (X)**

We are seeking a skilled Analytics Engineer to build and maintain robust data systems that enable high-impact quantitative analysis and business decision-making. This role combines strong software engineering practices with expertise in large-scale data processing and advanced analytical methods to deliver reliable, scalable solutions across the organization. This is an opportunity to work on mission-critical systems that power quantitative decision-making at global scale.

#### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines for processing high-volume datasets using tools such as Spark, Kafka, and/or Flink
* Develop quantitative models and statistical frameworks to support experimentation, forecasting, and performance measurement
* Build and maintain data infrastructure that ensures data quality, consistency, and accessibility for analytical workflows
* Collaborate with product engineering, product, and operations teams to translate business requirements into production-grade data systems and insights
* Conduct A/B tests, causal analysis, and performance evaluations to drive measurable improvements in key metrics
* Implement monitoring, alerting, and automation for data systems to support real-time decision support
* Mentor team members on best practices for scalable data engineering and quantitative problem-solving

#### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, or quantitative field
* 2+ years of experience building production data pipelines and infrastructure at scale
* Experience in Python, SQL, and distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, Hadoop)

#### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Demonstrated expertise in statistical methods, predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, and experimental design
* Solid understanding of cloud services for data storage, processing, and orchestration
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering business impact through reliable systems
* Prior work in consumer technology, or social media domains
* Experience with real-time streaming systems and low-latency data processing
* Contributions to open-source data tools or publications on large-scale analytics systems
* Track record of reducing operational costs or improving system efficiency through data optimizations
* Have the ability to bridge engineering excellence with rigorous analytical approaches

#### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$140,000 - $225,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

**About the role**
This role will be part of Bally Media, a Bally's Interactive company, that operates the Bally Sports Live and Stadium sports streaming services. Bally Sports Live reimagines how fans experience live sports through free streaming apps built around real-time interactive communities, free-to-play games, and rewards. We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to drive the modernization, scalability, and reliability of our infrastructure across AWS and on-prem environments. Reporting to the Director, Platform Engineering, you'll work closely with software engineers, broadcast engineers, and product managers to evolve our cloud-first, AI-enabled DevOps practice.
  
  
You'll contribute to critical projects improving CI/CD across our backend, web, mobile, and CTV apps, strengthening observability and incident response, and aligning processes across teams and platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who owns problems end to end, collaborates openly, brings a calm, reliability-first mindset to incidents, and is always looking to automate toil and improve how we build and operate. * Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and Ansible
* Contribute to improvements in system architecture, focusing on reliability, observability, and cost-efficiency
* Modernize our CI/CD practices, including the adoption of AI-assisted tooling, to enable safe, rapid delivery of services across environments
* Improve operational visibility through monitoring, logging, and tracing, applying AIOps approaches to anomaly detection and incident response.

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

We are looking for an individual to join our systems team and help us build our production and corporate systems and keep them up and running reliably. An engineer who is passionate about building reliable and highly available systems and tools. A strong candidate will be an expert in containerization, AWS technologies, Kubernetes, and GitOps.
  
  
We’re looking for someone who cares and wants to be involved in our product, mission, and success - way beyond checking off tasks. And of course, at BetterHelp you will enjoy true teamwork and lots of fun!

* Design, implement, deploy, and maintain reliable systems and processes.

You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of a platform that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for document processing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* CI/CD Pipeline Ownership:

+ Design, build, and maintain robust, automated CI/CD pipelines using a combination of Harness, Github, Tekton, and Lightspeed (LSE).
+ Ensure seamless integration from code commit to production deployment, focusing on speed, quality, and security.
+ Manage and optimize the build, test, and release processes for all components of the IDP platform, including Python and React JS applications.

* OpenShift Deployments:

+ Manage and automate deployments of microservices and applications to OpenShift clusters.
+ Implement and maintain deployment strategies such as blue-green, canary, and rolling updates.
+ Ensure high availability, scalability, and resilience of applications running on OpenShift.

* Database Management:

+ Oversee the management and maintenance of Postgres databases.
+ Implement and manage database schema changes using Liquibase.

* Helm Chart Lifecycle Management:

+ Lead the authoring, versioning, and release management of Helm charts for all platform services.
+ Establish and enforce best practices for Helm chart development to ensure reusability and maintainability.
+ Manage the lifecycle of charts in our Artifactory repository.

* Kafka/Messaging Operations:

+ Oversee the operational health of our Kafka messaging backbone.
+ Responsible for topic management, including creation, partitioning, and access control.
+ Perform consumer group tuning and monitoring to ensure optimal performance and data throughput.

* Container Governance and Security:

+ Implement and manage a strict container governance policy.
+ Integrate automated image scanning (Snyk/Checkmarx) into the CI/CD pipeline to identify vulnerabilities.
+ Manage the container lifecycle within Artifactory, including promotion, retention, and patching strategies for base and application images.

* Observability Stack Build-out:

+ Architect, build, and maintain a comprehensive observability stack using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/Splunk.
+ Develop dashboards, alerts, and logging solutions to provide deep insights into platform health and performance.
+ Proactively identify and resolve issues through effective monitoring and root cause analysis.

**Required Skills And Experience**

+ Experience: 3+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering role.
+ CI/CD: Proven hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Harness, Tekton, Lightspeed (LSE), and experience with Python and React JS build processes.
+ Database: Experience with Postgres database management and schema migration using Liquibase.
+ Containerization: Expert-level knowledge of Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift.
+ Helm: Demonstrable experience in creating and managing complex Helm charts.
+ Messaging Systems: Strong operational experience with Kafka, including administration and performance tuning.
+ Security: Experience with container security scanning tools (e.g., Snyk, Checkmarx) and repository management (e.g., Artifactory).
+ Observability: Proficiency in setting up and managing monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK stack or Splunk.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**

+ GenAI/LLM Exposure: Direct experience building, supporting, or working with platforms that utilize Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
+ Python: Advanced proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and developing backend services.
+ Certifications: OpenShift or Kubernetes certifications (e.g., CKA, CKAD, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration) are a plus.
+ Industry Experience: Experience working in a highly regulated environment such as finance or government.

**Education:**

+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

title: Software engineer, cloud infrastructure
description:
**About Watershed**
Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.
  
  
We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!
  
  
The role
  
  
Watershed’s Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the foundational systems that power our product and help every engineer ship safely and efficiently. We own core compute, databases, networking, deployments, and observability, with a focus on production reliability, predictable infrastructure costs, security, and a low-toil developer experience.
  
  
Our work spans both operational excellence and high-leverage platform improvements. Current areas of investment include: upgrading our networking architecture, improving the usability of test environments and deployment systems, evolving our observability toolkit, hardening Watershed’s AI infrastructure as our AI product suite grows, and supporting agentic engineering workflows.
  
  
You will
  
  

* Design, build, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure that powers all of Watershed (across compute, databases, networking, deployment systems, and observability)
* Contribute to technical planning, design reviews, team processes, and a culture of thoughtful, high-impact development
* Collaborate with product engineers (our internal customers) to understand their needs and provide high-leverage infrastructure primitives that help them move faster, safely
* Strengthen Watershed’s cloud security in partnership with our Security and Compliance functions, and drive infrastructure cost efficiency in collaboration with our Finance team
* Participate in the team’s 24/7 on-call rotation and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements

You might be a good fit if
  
  

* You have 2–5 years of software and/or infrastructure engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience
* You have hands-on experience in some of these areas: Kubernetes, Terraform / infrastructure as code, CI/CD, networking, relational databases, observability, reliability, or cloud security. Experience with a major cloud provider is a must; experience with GCP is helpful, but not required
* You enjoy the challenge of building the appropriate level of tooling for the stage and arc of the company, in particular being on the front lines of supporting AI infrastructure and agentic products
* You enjoy building enabling systems that help other engineers deliver excellent customer outcomes

**Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)**
Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.
  
  
**What’s the interview process like?**
It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.
  
  
**What if I need accommodations for my interview?**
At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
**At Instructure**
, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
  
  
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:
  
  
We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to build the data models that teams across Instructure use to run the business. You'll work in dbt and Snowflake every day. You'll also sit in the room with business leaders, understand the decisions they're making, and design data that answers their questions correctly the first time.
  
  
This role is broad by design. You'll support analytics across Finance, Operations, Product Management, Sales, and other parts of the company, so you'll see how the whole business fits together. It suits someone who writes clean SQL and also asks "what is this number used for?" before building it. You'll own models from source to dashboard, and you'll help set the standards for how we design, test, and document our data.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain dimensional models in dbt and Snowflake that support reporting and analysis across Finance, Operations, Product Management, and other business functions.
* Translate business questions into clear data requirements by working directly with senior leaders across the company.
* Own the full model lifecycle: source ingestion patterns, staging, intermediate and mart layers, tests, documentation, and deployment.
* Set and enforce modeling standards, including naming conventions, grain definitions, slowly changing dimension handling, and testing practices.
* Tune Snowflake performance and cost through smart materialization choices, clustering, and warehouse sizing.
* Partner with data engineers and business systems teams to make sure upstream data arrives in a shape we can model well.
* Review pull requests, mentor analysts and engineers, and raise the quality bar across the team.
* Explain data definitions and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences in plain language, and push back when a request would produce a misleading metric.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role.
* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or another quantitative field is preferred.
* Deep, hands-on experience with dbt, including macros, packages, incremental models, snapshots, and testing.
* Strong Snowflake skills, with advanced SQL and a good sense of performance and cost.
* Proven experience designing dimensional models (star schemas, facts, dimensions, conformed dimensions) and a clear point of view on when to use them and when not to.

description:

Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus' recruiting process in general should email **recruiting@kapitus.com**

Kapitus is building a next-generation enterprise data and AI capability for our financial services organization. This is a multi-year modernization program that replaces hundreds of legacy analytics workflows with governed, reusable business data products on a modern cloud data platform, stands up an AI/ML platform, and moves the organization from producing reports to producing decisions.

We are hiring Data Engineers to build that platform and the products on it. The core stack is Snowflake and dbt, organized around a layered medallion architecture bronze/silver/gold-style layers extended with governed conformed entities, certified semantic definitions, and reusable serving structures. You will build ingestion and transformation pipelines, model data across layers, migrate legacy workflows onto the platform, and ship data products through evidence-based acceptance gates.

You report to the Director of Data Engineering, who owns the platform architecture and engineering standards. This is a delivery role on a program that runs to tight timelines and real acceptance criteria: your work is done when it is validated, evidenced, and accepted code complete is not product complete. You will work alongside internal engineers and consulting-partner teams across onshore and offshore locations, all held to the same engineering bar.

Senior Data Engineers additionally own complex workstreams or product slices, lead technical design within the approved architecture, review other engineers' work, mentor team members, and drive difficult migrations or production issues to closure.

  

**What you will do:**

**Build**

* Develop ELT pipelines on Snowflake and dbt: source ingestion, layered transformations through the medallion zones, and governed serving structures for BI, API, ML, and AI consumption.
* Model data within the platform's layered architecture — staging, conformed core entities, dimensional and product-level models — following approved modeling standards for grain, keys, and naming.
* Implement approved data contracts, conformed entity definitions, keys, relationships, and certified semantic definitions consistently across models; do not create local definitions when a governed one exists.
* Migrate legacy analytics workflows (e.g., Alteryx) onto the modern stack: analyze the existing logic, implement it correctly in dbt and Snowflake, prove parity where required, and support retirement of the legacy asset.
* Implement data quality as code: dbt tests, source freshness checks, reconciliation and validation queries, and pipeline observability — quality controls ship with the pipeline, not after it.
* Build for reuse: contribute to shared ingestion frameworks, certified transformation patterns, and common serving structures rather than one-off solutions.

**Engineer**

* Work software-engineering style: Git-based workflows, peer code review, CI/CD, environment promotion, and documentation that lets someone else operate what you built.
* Follow and help improve the platform's engineering standards — repository structure, dbt project conventions, testing requirements, and performance and cost discipline (warehouse sizing, query efficiency, clustering choices).
* Tune what you ship: profile query performance, manage Snowflake compute cost consciously, and treat efficiency as part of correctness.
* Support what you ship in production: use observability to diagnose failures, participate in incident and root-cause analysis, implement durable corrective actions, and prevent recurring defects rather than repeatedly patching symptoms.
* Surface risks and ambiguity early — resolving a problem before build is cheaper than discovering it during validation or production.

**Deliver**

* Deliver against the program's acceptance gates: build to approved designs and acceptance criteria, produce developer verification evidence for your work, and support independent acceptance validation — engineers test their own work thoroughly but do not independently approve it for acceptance.
* Work from design specifications and data contracts; when a specification is ambiguous or wrong, raise it and get it resolved rather than improvising silently.
* Collaborate across a distributed team — internal and partner engineers, onshore and offshore — with clean handoffs, clear written communication, and deliberate use of overlap hours.
* Estimate your work honestly, flag variance early, and close defects from validation findings promptly and with root cause understood.

  

**What we're looking for:**

* 5+ yearsof hands-on data engineering experience building production data pipelines and warehouse models. Senior-level candidates (8+ years) are considered for Senior Data Engineer and should demonstrate workstream-level technical leadership, design ownership, code-review responsibility, and mentoring — not simply additional years of experience.
* Strong hands-on Snowflakeexperienceincluding warehouse and database objects, performance and cost-aware SQL, role-based access concepts, tasks/streams or equivalent patterns, and loading/unloading at production scale.
* Production dbt experiencebuilding and maintaining real dbt projects: layered model organization, incremental models, tests and documentation, macros, and working in a shared multi-developer project with CI.
* Expert SQL skills complex transformations, window functions, performance tuning, and the judgment to know when SQL is the wrong tool.
* Solid Python experiencefor data engineering ingestion utilities, API integrations, automation, and orchestration code.
* Layered/medallion architecture experience. You have built in a bronze/silver/gold or equivalent layered warehouse and understand why layer discipline, grain, and conformed entities matter; experience with governed variants incorporating conformed/core entity models, certified metrics, semantic definitions, or data contracts is a strong plus.
* Engineering fundamentalsGit, code review, CI/CD, environment promotion, and automated testing as normal practice, not aspiration.
* Data quality and verification mindset you are someone who thoroughly tests and reconciles your own work and produces complete verification evidence that a pipeline is correct; formal acceptance validation is performed independently.
* Clear written communication for design notes, pull request descriptions, and documentation that hold up across time zones.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Foresight**

Foresight's mission is to bring the world's critical infrastructure into service faster by better enabling teams to deliver complex capital projects.

The AI buildout runs on physical things: data centers, power, and the supply chains behind them. A single hyperscale campus involves an owner, a general contractor, dozens of trades, long-lead equipment suppliers, lenders and commissioning teams. Each works from its own schedule and its own spreadsheets. When a project slips, the people who could fix it usually find out last. For an AI data center, a month late can mean tens of millions in lost revenue.

Foresight is the control tower for these projects. We connect schedules, field progress and execution data across every party, forecast where delivery is heading, and help teams act before a delay becomes a missed date. On one 15-project portfolio, Foresight found a project 245 days behind, cut reporting overhead by 90%, and helped prevent more than $100M in lost revenue.

We work with top data-center owners, developers and general contractors across the world, including Crusoe, Applied Digital, and NTT. We raised a $25M Series A led by Macquarie Capital and are headquartered in New York.

**The role**

We're looking for a **Senior Data Engineer** to build the data foundation behind Foresight.

You will build the pipelines that take complex project data from the tools our customers already use and turn it into clean, trusted, well-modeled data. That data powers our predictions, AI recommendations, analytics and customer reporting. This is a hands-on role on a new team, for someone who cares about data being correct, explainable and available when it matters.

At Foresight, data engineering is product engineering. Every number a customer sees, every forecast and every recommendation starts with data you made trustworthy. This could translate to work on:

* Ingestion from industry tools: Build robust pipelines that bring in project data from the scheduling and planning tools the industry runs on, and handle every messy, inconsistent file along the way.
* A reliable history of every update: Model data so each update is preserved exactly as it arrived, and teams can compare any two points in time with confidence.
* Data that powers ML and AI: Build the features, training datasets and search indexes behind our predictions and AI recommendations, and keep them fresh as new data lands.
* Analytics and reporting: Build the models and pipelines behind customer dashboards, stakeholder reports and exports, plus the internal analytics we run the business on.
* Quality, isolation and governance: Build automated data-quality checks, lineage and access controls, so every customer's data stays accurate, isolated and in the region it belongs.

**What you'll do**

* Own pipelines from design through production: define data contracts, set freshness and quality targets, and keep them met.
* Partner with ML engineers on the features and datasets their models need, and with full stack engineers on the data behind each product feature.
* Design for failure: pipelines that retry safely, can be re-run without duplicating data, and recover cleanly from bad inputs.
* Make data observable, so problems are caught by monitors before a customer notices them.
* Keep cost in check as data volumes grow, choosing the simplest tool that does the job well.
* Help set the team's data standards and shape the platform as one of its first data engineers.

  
**Requirements**

**You might be a fit if you**

* Have 5+ years of experience building and running production data pipelines, with ownership from source to consumer.
* Are strong in Python and advanced SQL, including writing and tuning complex queries.
* Have deep data modeling experience in Postgres or a similar relational database: schema design, indexing, partitioning and migrations.
* Have experience parsing and normalizing messy real-world data: large files, inconsistent formats, missing or contradictory values.
* Are hands-on with workflow orchestration for multi-step pipelines with dependencies, retries and backfills.
* Have experience with AWS data services such as S3, managed databases, streaming and serverless compute.
* Havea testing mindset for data: validation, quality checks, and reproducible, idempotent pipelines.
* Are clear in communication and comfortable making pragmatic trade-offs on a small team.

**Bonus points**

* Experience preparing data for ML: feature pipelines, training datasets, and keeping offline and online data consistent.
* Experience with embeddings and vector search (pgvector or a search engine) for AI features.
* Event-driven data: change data capture, streaming platforms, and the outbox pattern.
* Familiarity with project scheduling data or tools from construction, engineering or energy.
* Working with regulated enterprise or public-sector data: SOC 2, GDPR, data residency.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data pipelines.
* Early-stage or founding-team experience.

None of these are required. If the core of this role excites you, apply.

 **Benefits**

**Why join now**

* **Real stakes, real customers**. Real stakes, real customers. You won't be building for a hypothetical buyer. Owners and contractors are building now, on deadlines measured in revenue per day.
* **Blank canvas, solid ground**. You get first-engineer level scope on a product that already has paying customers, real data and proven outcomes to tell.
* **Defining a category**.Agentic software for physical infrastructure is a new category. What you build will become the standard.
* **Small, senior team**. Flat, direct, low on process. We debate openly, decide quickly and ship.

**Compensation and location**

* **Total Comp**: $180,000-240,000, based on experience, level, and location.
* **Benefits**: Health, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO .
* **Location**: New York, San Francisco, and Montreal are preferred. Occasional travel to may be required.

Foresight is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on any protected basis.

title: Tableau Data Engineer & Modeler
description:
**OUR STORY**  
  
TechInsights is the information Platform for the semiconductor industry.  
  
Regarded as the most trusted source of actionable, in-depth intelligence related to semiconductor innovation and surrounding markets, TechInsights’ content informs decision makers and professionals whose success depends on accurate knowledge of the semiconductor industry—past, present, or future.  
  
Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform, the world’s largest vertically integrated collection of unmatched reverse engineering, teardown, and market intelligence in the semiconductor industry. This collection includes detailed circuit analysis, imagery, semiconductor process flows, device teardowns, illustrations, costing and pricing information, forecasts, market analysis, and expert commentary. TechInsights’ customers include the most successful technology companies who rely on TechInsights’ analysis to make informed business, design, and product decisions faster and with greater confidence. For more information, visit www.techinsights.com.  
  
  
  
**WHY WORK WITH US**

* Company-sponsored training and development opportunities
* Comprehensive benefits package (health, dental, vision, wellness, RRSP/401K Matching, annual fitness reimbursement)
* Flexible vacation policy
* Trusted device reimbursement program
* Community involvement opportunities through charitable alliances: https://www.techinsights.com/community-involvement
* Wellness resources and support
* Inclusive environment that prioritizes diversity, equity, and accessibility
* High-growth company driven by high performance
* Expected salary range: $86,275 - $91,350 USD

  
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**  
  
TechInsights’ Data & Analytics team turns corporate data into clear insights that guide leadership’s decisions on operations and new business initiatives. As our Tableau Data Engineer & Modeler, you’ll own the pipelines and data models behind our Tableau Cloud environment. You’ll build and maintain Tableau Prep flows and design published data sources that are fast, trusted and well governed. You’ll also shape those models so they work as well for AI agents using the Tableau MCP server as they do for people building dashboards. This is a hands-on role close to our core source systems (Salesforce, PostgreSQL on AWS and NetSuite). You’ll have real ownership of our Tableau data structure and work directly with the people who use the data.  
  
**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Design certified, reusable published data sources that become the single source of truth for core business entities, using validated business logic and the right grain for each use case.
* Standardize calculated fields, LOD expressions and hierarchies at the data-source level so dashboards stay consistent.
* Tune extracts and live connections for performance and refresh cost through aggregation, filtering, incremental refresh and field pruning.
* Prepare models for AI agents using the Tableau MCP server. This means writing clear field names, captions, descriptions and metadata, and removing duplicate fields, unclear measures and inconsistent date logic.
* Test agent queries against our models, find where answers go wrong, and fix the model rather than the prompt.
* Help define Tableau Pulse metrics and the semantic layer that both people and agents rely on.
* Check every new or changed model and report against Finance-approved figures or the source system of record before release. Nothing goes live until differences are explained, documented and signed off by the data owner.
* Build automated data quality checks between source systems and Tableau, and flag process failures to data owners.
* Maintain lineage and documentation in Tableau Catalog / Data Management, and set up row-level security, user filters and permissions that follow our governance framework.
* Build, schedule and monitor Tableau Prep flows from Salesforce, PostgreSQL and other sources. You’ll own run reliability, failure alerts and recovery.
* Refactor older flows and extracts so they’re faster, easier to maintain and cheaper to refresh.
* Work with Analysts, Sales, Finance and Salesforce admins to turn reporting needs into durable models, and train Tableau authors through documentation and code review.

  
**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

* 4+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering or BI development, including 2+ years building production Tableau data sources
* Have built and maintained at least 3 production Tableau Prep flows that run on a schedule and use complex joins, unions, pivots and aggregations
* Have published at least 5 Tableau data sources used across multiple dashboards or teams, with clear decisions on relationships vs. joins and extracts vs. live connections
* 3+ years writing advanced SQL, ideally PostgreSQL, including window functions, CTEs and materialized views. You can show at least one query you improved by reading its query plan.
* Have designed at least one dimensional model (star schema) end to end, covering grain, slowly changing dimensions, conformed dimensions and many-to-many relationships
* Have reconciled data models or reports to financial or system-of-record figures at least twice, documenting differences and getting stakeholder sign-off
* Have set up row-level security or user-based access controls in Tableau for at least one production data source
* 1+ year working with Salesforce data as a source, including objects, relationships and history tables
* Can explain how the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the Tableau MCP server let AI agents read metadata and query data sources, and name at least 3 model features that make agent answers more or less accurate
* Can share 2+ examples of technical documentation you wrote, such as data dictionaries, lineage notes or design decisions, for both technical and non-technical readers

Preferred

* A current Tableau certification, such as Tableau Certified Data Analyst or Tableau Certified Architect
* Hands-on use of at least 2 of these: Tableau Pulse, Tableau Catalog / Data Management, VizQL Data Service, Tableau REST API or Metadata API
* Have tested LLM or AI agent access to BI data and measured how accurate the answers were against a known source
* 1+ year using Python for automation, API work or Tableau Prep scripting steps
* Experience with AWS data services (RDS, S3, Lambda) and Git version control for data assets
* Experience with at least one other semantic layer or BI tool, such as Power BI / Microsoft Fabric or dbt

  
As part of the recruitment process for this position, you will be required to submit your latest citizenship and/or permanent residency information. This information will be used to comply with U.S. Export Control Laws and Regulations.  
  
**WORKING ARRANGEMENT**  
  
This role is on-site at our Denver office.

Technology knows no bounds, and neither does TechInsights. Bringing together talented humans from different perspectives, backgrounds and abilities is something we take seriously. We’re committed to building an inclusive environment that welcomes you to be your authentic self and allows us to push past the boundaries together.

TechInsights is committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

AI technology may be used to assist in the screening and assessment of applications for this position. Our recruiters are involved at every stage, and all hiring decisions are made by People and hiring teams.

As part of any recruitment process, TechInsights collects and processes personal data relating to job applicants. We are committed to being transparent about how we collect and use that data and to meeting our data protection obligations. Our Privacy policy can be referenced here: https://www.techinsights.com/privacy-policy

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
*Please note that we are not currently accepting resumes or additional support from talent agencies or third-party sources. Any resumes received from these sources will be considered unsolicited. We value integrity and clear communication with our partners, and appreciate your understanding in this matter.*

**The role, at a glance:**

Biamp is bringing a SaaS web application in-house from a third-party development partner, and we’re hiring a DevOps Engineer to lead the technical side of that transition. You’ll migrate the build and deployment pipelines from GitHub Actions to our internal Bitbucket and Jenkins environment, then own the resulting CI/CD infrastructure and 24x7 production operations going forward. This is a high-leverage role: you’ll set the patterns that govern how our Software Operations team runs this platform for years, and you’ll do it with executive visibility because the in-sourcing itself is a strategic initiative.

**How you'll contribute:**

* **Lead the migration.** Move build and deployment pipelines from GitHub Actions to Bitbucket and Jenkins with a clear cutover plan, validation gates, and rollback path. Capture institutional knowledge from the outgoing partner along the way.
* **Own CI/CD.** Architect and maintain the Jenkins pipelines, shared libraries, and supporting tooling that the development teams rely on every day. Continuously cut build and deployment times.
* **Run production.** Take responsibility for 24x7 availability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Define SLOs and SLIs, drive incidents to resolution, and reduce toil through automation.
* **Manage cloud infrastructure as code.** Stand up and evolve the underlying cloud infrastructure using Terraform (or equivalent IaC), with consistent, repeatable, reviewable changes.
* **Keep us secure and compliant.** Build pipelines and artifact-management practices that hold up under our security and regulatory commitments, including secure build, signing, and provenance.
* **Plan for failure.** Maintain disaster-recovery and business-continuity plans, run DR drills, and meet defined RTO and RPO targets.
* **Partner with developers.** Work directly with the application teams to shape a workflow that’s fast and pleasant to use, and document it well enough that newcomers can self-serve.

**A successful candidate should have:**

* 3+ years in DevOps, SRE, or a closely related role, including production responsibility for a SaaS application.
* Hands-on experience with both GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines — enough to confidently translate workflows from one to the other.
* Strong Jenkins fundamentals: pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile), shared libraries, and the plugin ecosystem.
* Comfort with Git workflows and repository management across GitHub and Bitbucket.
* Working knowledge of a major cloud platform (AWS or Azure) across compute, storage, networking, and managed services.
* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, or similar.
* Solid scripting in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or comparable.
* Experience deploying .NET applications (MSBuild, NuGet, IIS or Kestrel).
* Working knowledge of containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Track record on an on-call rotation, including running or contributing to incident response.
* Clear written and verbal communication — you’ll be working closely with both internal teams and an outgoing third-party partner.

**Some nice-to-haves:**
-----------------------

* Familiarity with JFrog Artifactory, JFrog Xray, or JFrog Advanced Security.
* Experience with SonarQube or comparable code-quality tooling.
* Exposure to NIST SSDF, EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), SOC 2, or similar frameworks.
* Prior experience moving a product from third-party management to in-house operations.
* Configuration management with Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
* Application security tooling (OWASP, SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning).
* Database and data-migration experience (SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
* Log aggregation and analysis (ELK, Splunk).
* CDN configuration, feature flags, or progressive delivery.
* AWS or Azure certification.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent experience is fine.

**What we offer:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision
* 3 weeks annual PTO and 9 paid holidays
* 401(k) + matching
* Employer-paid base life insurance, short, and long-term disability
* Health savings accounts (with Biamp contribution) and flexible spending accounts
* Tuition reimbursement
* Charitable donation matching
* Discretionary company achievement bonus
* Referral bonuses

We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space.

As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences.

* Security checks are integrated into existing engineering workflows without creating unnecessary bottlenecks.

**Other Information:**

Very comfortable working in a fast-paced and intense startup environment

Willing to work in-person in our office in Mission Bay 4-5 days/week

Likes matcha KitKats, believes every LLM prompt is just Schrödinger’s cat waiting to be observed, and knows too many random facts about the Mongol postal system
