title: DevOps Platform Engineer and Linux Systems Administrator
description:
Absolute Business Solutions Corp (ABSC) is not just another tech company. We’re a community of innovators, engineers, analysts and business professionals working together with our customers to tackle the most complex challenges. For more than 20 years we’ve supported critical Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), Federal Civilian missions and global, multi-national corporations. We specialize in supporting our clients in the Intelligence, Technology, Defense, AI/ML, and Data Science fields. As we continue to grow at a rapid pace, we need some amazing new professionals to join our team.

ABSC has an exciting opening for a TS/SCI-cleared DevOps Platform Engineer and Linux Systems Administrator supporting DIA-NDOC’s D3P modernization under the DTP contract. You will operate the Kubernetes-based application platform and shared runtime services that support a production big-data pipeline, helping ensure the environment remains reliable, secure, scalable, and ready for mission use.

The 10-year DOMEX Technology Platform (DTP) program modernizes the secure data, application, and infrastructure capabilities supporting DIA’s National Digital Exploitation & OSINT Center (NDOC). The program delivers scalable media processing, data discovery, enrichment, and analytical services that help mission users transform large volumes of digital information into timely, actionable intelligence. Team members work across software development, systems engineering, cybersecurity, platform operations, and mission integration to sustain current operations while delivering the next generation of DTP capabilities.

**Work location and schedule:** Most work is performed onsite at the customer location in Bethesda, MD. A flexible schedule and occasional remote work may be available based on customer requirements and deliverables.

**Security clearance required for this role:** An active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a CI polygraph is required.

**Responsibilities**
====================

As an integral member of the DTP team, you will work closely with Government stakeholders and cross-functional engineering teams on the following key tasks:

* Deploy, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, patch, upgrade, and maintain a production platform built on Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, and related shared services.
* Administer Linux-based applications and systems, including installation, configuration, hardening, performance analysis, and operational troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot pod failures, networking issues, image pulls, scheduling constraints, certificates, storage, and application connectivity.
* Use Helm or comparable tools to manage Kubernetes application packages and configuration.
* Support shared platform services such as Elastic, Redis, message queues, API gateways, and other distributed services.
* Integrate platform services with physical and virtual infrastructure to maintain availability, reliability, security, and performance.
* Design and support scalable and redundant application infrastructure across physical and virtual environments.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure and platform automation using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Bash, Python, or comparable tools.
* Implement platform security, monitoring, logging, observability, capacity management, and DevOps best practices.
* Contribute to engineering documentation, diagrams, models, Agile release planning, scrums, design sessions, and bug triage.

**Requirements**
================

**To be successful in this role, you must meet the following qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field with four or more years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree with two or more years of relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a CI polygraph.
* Current DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher certification, such as Security+ CE or CySA+.
* Ability to obtain Privileged User Account certification as required by DoD 8140 policy.
* Hands-on experience administering and operating Kubernetes.
* Experience using Helm or a comparable Kubernetes package and configuration-management tool.
* Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux from the command line, including processes, filesystems, networking, permissions, logs, certificates, and system resources.
* Experience supporting at least one shared data or application platform service, such as Elastic, Redis, message queues, or API gateways.
* Familiarity with infrastructure and platform automation tools.
* Working knowledge of platform-security and observability practices.
* Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

**Desired Skills**
==================

You will wow us even more if you have some of these skills:

* Knowledge of Agile methodologies.
* Development or scripting experience with Bash, PowerShell, Salt, Python, Groovy, or Java.
* Experience with Kafka or another messaging platform.
* Experience supporting GPU-based Kubernetes environments.
* Experience with Salt, Helmfile, GitLab, Nexus, or Argo CD.

**Salary and Compensation**
===========================

Salary is commensurate with education and years of experience. The anticipated salary range for this requisition is $90k to $170k based on education, experience, technical qualifications, clearance, and applicable contractual requirements.

**Who we are:**
===============

ABSC is a technology and services company that combines the agility of a small business with proven processes refined over more than two decades in business. We specialize in supporting public sector clients in the Intelligence, Defense, Health, and Safety areas. Our team stands ready to deliver the next generation of programs, personnel, and solutions to help advance our federal government customers’ driving innovation, agility, and security across all mission areas.

**Some of our benefits include:**
=================================

* Generous PTO plus 11 Federal Holidays
* Retirement Planning – 401k Fully Vested with Match
* Annual Health and Wellness Allowance – buy an Apple Watch, a treadmill, or hit the gym on us
* Career Development – Annual Funds to spend on Education and Training
* Volunteer Time Off – Annually, all employees can spend 8 hours directly supporting a charity of choice
* Charitable Match – ABSC matches an employee’s donation to a qualifying charity
* Referral Program – We pay for internal and external referrals!
* LOV Awards – Earn bonus awards throughout the year from our Living Our Values awards program

Apply to join our team today! We are always looking to grow our team - if you know someone who is seeking a new career opportunity, please share this job opening with them. ABSC offers generous external referral bonuses. You don’t need to be an employee to benefit from our Referral Program.

*ABSC is a proud V3, Virginia Values Vets, member which recognizes our commitment to hiring Veterans. If you are a veteran, please be sure to include that in your application.*

Equal Opportunity Employer, including veterans and individuals with disabilities.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
**Position Title:** Cloud Engineer
  
**Location:** Hybrid / Indianapolis, IN
  
**Starting Pay for position:** $130k
  
  
JOIN OUR TEAM!
  
  
**About Herff Jones:**  
Indianapolis-based Herff Jones is the leading provider of graduation and educational products and services designed to inspire achievement and create memorable experiences for students. Herff Jones’ products include class rings and jewelry, caps and gowns, diplomas and announcements as well as motivation and recognition programs. Focused on building long-term relationships through a nationwide network of over 1,400 employees and sales partners, the professionals at Herff Jones have been helping elevate the student experience throughout the lifelong journey of education for more than 100 years. For more information about Herff Jones, please visit www.herffjones.com.
  
  
**Position Summary:**  
The Herff Jones IT Team is seeking a Cloud Engineer to join our Infrastructure Services team. This role is the technical owner of our AWS and Azure environments and the bridge between our on-premises datacenter and the cloud: the person who builds the foundation, keeps it secure, well-governed, and resilient, and drives it forward. The Cloud Engineer provides and governs the cloud environment that implementation partners build in during a major infrastructure modernization initiative, supports the systems hosted there, and builds and maintains the cloud resources for work outside that initiative. In the near term, the role also shares support of our Windows and Linux server infrastructure. The Cloud Engineer is one of six engineers on our Infrastructure Services team, each with a complementary specialty, who share support, cross-coverage, and an on-call rotation, and partners closely with the Security and Application teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Cloud Architecture & Engineering
  

* Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable infrastructure in AWS and Azure, including compute, storage, networking, serverless, and container services.
* Establish and maintain cloud landing zones, including account and subscription structure, guardrails, tagging, and governance aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.
* Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Bicep) with source control and CI/CD pipelines, and automate routine tasks using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Develop and maintain cloud standards, reference architectures, and documentation, including diagrams and configuration baselines.
* Contribute to the multi-year infrastructure roadmap for the cloud and hybrid domain.

Hybrid Infrastructure & Partner Support
  

* Design and maintain secure hybrid connectivity and DNS between on-premises sites and AWS and Azure (e.g., site-to-site VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute), in partnership with network engineering.
* Provide and govern the cloud environment that implementation partners build in, ensuring the underlying infrastructure aligns with our security and governance standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot and support partner-built systems hosted in our environment, and build and maintain cloud resources for initiatives outside the partner engagement.
* Share support of on-premises Windows and Linux server infrastructure with other Infrastructure engineers in the near term, including patching, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.
* Support workload migrations and the operational handoff of partner-delivered infrastructure, including runbooks, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery.

Cloud Security & Governance
  

* Implement cloud security controls, including IAM, least-privilege access, encryption, logging, and policy enforcement, in partnership with the Security team.
* Integrate cloud platforms with enterprise identity (Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM Identity Center) in partnership with other Infrastructure engineers.
* Monitor and optimize cloud spend through rightsizing, reserved capacity, and cost reporting, and support budget planning and forecasting.
* Support PCI DSS requirements, audit readiness, and vulnerability remediation for cloud and server infrastructure.

Cloud Operations & Incident Response
  

* Implement and tune monitoring, alerting, and logging for cloud and hybrid workloads (e.g., Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor).
* Serve as an escalation point for cloud and hybrid infrastructure incidents; lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for Priority 1–2 issues.
* Plan and execute changes and maintenance windows, with rollback plans, following the Change Management process.
* Participate in a shared on-call rotation with the Infrastructure team for after-hours support.
* Mentor engineers and support staff, and contribute to cross-training and knowledge sharing.

Additional Responsibilities
  

* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills:**  
Required
  

* Hands-on production experience with core AWS and Azure services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring; strong AWS experience is highly preferred.
* Working knowledge of cloud landing zones and multi-account or multi-subscription governance, and of the AWS Well-Architected Framework or Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.
* Experience with hybrid connectivity and cloud networking (VPC/VNet design, VPN, AWS Direct Connect or Azure ExpressRoute, DNS, and routing) and with serverless services (e.g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions).
* Solid Windows Server and Linux administration experience in enterprise environments.
* Scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for infrastructure automation.
* Disciplined approach to documentation and change management.

Preferred
  

* Industry cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or equivalent.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation or CDK, Bicep, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and with containers and Kubernetes (e.g., Docker, Amazon EKS, AKS).
* Multi-cloud experience across AWS and Azure, including migrating workloads from on-premises datacenters.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and hybrid identity.
* Experience supporting consultants, managed service providers, or implementation partners working in a shared cloud environment, including during large-scale infrastructure transformation programs.
* Familiarity with PCI DSS requirements and with NIST or CIS frameworks.

Soft Skills
  

* Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Composure and sound judgment under pressure during outages and periods of major change.
* Collaborative and proactive attitude with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Education & Experience:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 5+ years of systems engineering experience in multi-site enterprise environments, including at least 3 years designing and operating production workloads in AWS or Azure.

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment:**  

* Hybrid position based in Indianapolis, IN, with a mix of on-site and remote work.
* Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use; occasional work in datacenter environments, including lifting equipment up to 50 lbs.
* Participation in a shared after-hours on-call rotation and scheduled maintenance windows.
* Occasional travel to Herff Jones facilities may be required.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**About Foresight**

Foresight's mission is to bring the world's critical infrastructure into service faster by better enabling teams to deliver complex capital projects.

The AI buildout runs on physical things: data centers, power, and the supply chains behind them. A single hyperscale campus involves an owner, a general contractor, dozens of trades, long-lead equipment suppliers, lenders and commissioning teams. Each works from its own schedule and its own spreadsheets. When a project slips, the people who could fix it usually find out last. For an AI data center, a month late can mean tens of millions in lost revenue.

Foresight is the control tower for these projects. We connect schedules, field progress and execution data across every party, forecast where delivery is heading, and help teams act before a delay becomes a missed date. On one 15-project portfolio, Foresight found a project 245 days behind, cut reporting overhead by 90%, and helped prevent more than $100M in lost revenue.

We work with top data-center owners, developers and general contractors across the world, including Crusoe, Applied Digital, and NTT. We raised a $25M Series A led by Macquarie Capital and are headquartered in New York.

**The role**

We're looking for a **Senior Platform Engineer** to build the cloud foundation that Foresight runs on.

You will design and run the infrastructure, delivery pipelines and observability that let every engineer ship safely and often. You will make the platform secure and compliant by default, so enterprise customers can trust it with their most important project data. This is a hands-on role on a new team, for someone who treats the platform as a product and measures success by how fast and safely others can ship on it.

At Foresight, the platform is a product, and our engineers are its customers. You make the right way to build, ship and run software also the easiest way. This could translate to work on:

* Cloud foundation: Design our AWS environments as code, from networking and compute to managed databases and storage, so any environment can be rebuilt from scratch with confidence.
* Delivery pipelines: Build CI/CD that takes a merged change to production safely, with automated tests, security scanning, preview environments and fast rollback.
* Observability on a budget: Build logging, metrics, tracing and alerting that show what every service is doing, without letting monitoring costs run away.
* Security and compliance by default: Build identity and access controls, secrets management, encryption and audit trails that meet enterprise standards such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
* Reliability at scale: Build autoscaling, backups, disaster recovery and incident response, and deploy in the regions our customers' data must stay in.

**What you'll do**

* Treat other engineers as your customers: build paved roads, templates and self-service tools they actually want to use.
* Keep the platform as simple as the problem allows.
* Automate everything that reaches production; no manual changes to live systems.
* Own cloud cost: make spend visible by service and customer, and keep it in line as we grow.
* Lead incident response and blameless postmortems, then fix the root cause so it doesn't happen twice.
* Help set the team's infrastructure standards and shape the platform as one of its first platform engineers.

  
**Requirements**

**You might be a fit if you**

* Have 5+ years of experience building and running production infrastructure on AWS, with ownership of uptime and cost.
* Are strong in infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform, CDK or similar, including modules others reuse.
* Have experience running containerized services on AWS, such as ECS, EKS or Lambda, and knowing when each fits.
* Have built and owned CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing, deployment strategies and rollback.
* Are hands-on with observability: logs, metrics, traces, SLOs and alerting that people trust.
* Have solid grounding in cloud security: IAM least privilege, network design, secrets management and encryption.
* Are comfortable writing code in Python, Go or a similar language to build tooling and automation.
* Are calm and clear in communication during incidents and comfortable making pragmatic trade-offs on a small team.

**Bonus points**

* Hands-on with OpenTelemetry and open observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or Loki.
* Prepared a company for SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audits, including automated evidence collection.
* Experience with GitOps, progressive delivery (canary or blue-green) and supply-chain security (image signing, SBOMs).
* Operated multi-region or data-residency deployments, including in regulated or public-sector environments.
* Experience running infrastructure for ML and AI workloads, including GPU or hosted model services.
* FinOps experience: cost allocation, rightsizing and savings plans.
* Early-stage or founding-team experience.

None of these are required. If the core of this role excites you, apply.

 **Benefits**

**Why join now**

* **Real stakes, real customers**. Real stakes, real customers. You won't be building for a hypothetical buyer. Owners and contractors are building now, on deadlines measured in revenue per day.
* **Blank canvas, solid ground**. You get first-engineer level scope on a product that already has paying customers, real data and proven outcomes to tell.
* **Defining a category**.Agentic software for physical infrastructure is a new category. What you build will become the standard.
* **Small, senior team**. Flat, direct, low on process. We debate openly, decide quickly and ship.

**Compensation and location**

* **Total Comp**: $180,000-240,000, based on experience, level, and location.
* **Benefits**: Health, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO .
* **Location**: New York, San Francisco, and Montreal are preferred. Occasional travel to may be required.

Foresight is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on any protected basis.

description:

Are you passionate about standardizing data platforms and automating data engineering to drive analytics and reporting? title: Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
**About us**
============

**Forus is building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to accelerate new science to patients.**  
  
Our platform automates the complexity between a doctor prescribing a medicine and a patient starting treatment, including insurance coverage, financial assistance, and supply chain navigation. We provide this support free to doctors and patients, helping them get life-changing medicine faster, cheaper, and easier. The resulting network enables biopharma companies to design better research, launch new drugs more effectively, and invest in harder-to-treat conditions.  
  
**Forus has exceptional product-market fit and is growing rapidly through organic adoption:**

* **Accelerating scale:** We already support patients across more than 85% of ZIP codes and partner with 9 of top 15 largest biopharma companies in the world.
* **AI-native, durable model:** Our business becomes stronger as AI improves, as every new doctor, patient, and partner makes the network more valuable.
* **Backing to build for the long term:** We raised $300M+ from leading investors to build an exceptional team and unlock the full scale of the opportunity.

**Our number one priority is scaling to market demand.** We are looking for individuals who are high horsepower, high throughput, and hyper resourceful to help us increase capacity and grow. We move fast and need to move faster.  
  
**If we succeed, science will be the only limit to medicine.**

*All full-time roles are in person in New York.*

**About the role**
==================

As a Data & Analytics Engineer at Forus, you will build the data foundation that powers how we operate, measure, and grow. You will design and maintain our core data models, pipelines, and reporting infrastructure, ensuring the right people have access to clean, trustworthy, decision-grade data. This is a cross-functional, impact-heavy role in which you will work closely with product, ops, growth, and leadership to build the systems that enable better, faster decisions across the company.  
  
You will also help define our data & analytics engineering practices: how we structure metrics, review code, manage pipelines, and build for scale. Your work will directly support everything from product usage visibility to operational performance to life sciences client reporting.  
  
This is a demanding role, with a high level of autonomy and responsibility. You will be expected to "act like an owner" and commit yourself to Forus' success. If you are low-ego, hungry to learn, and excited about intense, impactful work that drives both company growth and accelerated career progression, we want to hear from you.

**If you join, you will:**
--------------------------

* Build and maintain the core data models that serve as the foundation for internal analytics and client-facing insights
* Design and operate the data pipelines that transform raw sources into clean, analytics-ready tables
* Create dashboards and reporting tools that drive performance visibility and decision-making across product, ops, and GTM
* Define and enforce metric consistency across teams — including core business KPIs and product usage definitions
* Help improve and scale our analytics stack (we use GCP BigQuery and Dataform, Fivetran, Postgres, and dashboarding tools)
* Collaborate with stakeholders across teams to understand data needs and translate them into reliable systems
* Contribute to internal data culture through documentation, education, and code quality standards

**We’re looking for you if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 3–6 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a technical data analyst role with production ownership
* Expert-level SQL and comfort working in a code-first environment (versioning, testing, documentation)
* Experience designing data models that balance usability, performance, and long-term maintainability
* Familiarity with the modern data stack — dbt, Fivetran, Airflow, GCP/AWS/Snowflake, Metabase (or equivalents)
* Strong written and verbal communication that allows you to be an effective participant in both internal debates and external relationships
* Track record of moving quickly, finding shortcuts, and going to unreasonable lengths to deliver on goals
* High NPS with your former teammates

This is a list of ideal qualifications for this position. If you don't meet every single one of them, you should still consider applying! We’re excited to work with people from underrepresented backgrounds, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

**Working with us**
===================

Forus is based in New York, with our full team working out of a beautiful and spacious office in SoHo.  
  
We run as a high-trust environment with high autonomy, which requires that everyone is fully competent and operates in line with our principles:

* **Do the math.** Be rigorous, assume nothing. Break problems down and reason from the ground up. Stay open to changing your mind.
* **Resourceful optimism.** Assume problems are solvable. Be audacious. Resist false constraints and push beyond the obvious before deciding.
* **Spit it out.** Speak directly, invite critique, avoid equivocation. We want right answers, not comfortable ones. All killer, no filler.
* **Raise the bar.** Hold a high standard for your pace and execution, and elevate the performance of the team around you. Mamba mentality.
* **Fight for users.** Start with users’ realities, not ours. Resist optimizing for internal convenience over user outcomes.

**We provide competitive compensation with meaningful equity** (for full-time employees)**.** Everyone who joins will be a major contributor to our success, and we reflect this through ownership and pay.  
  
**We also provide rich benefits to ensure you can focus on creating impact** (for full-time employees)**:**

* Fully covered medical, vision, and dental insurance.
* Memberships for One Medical, Talkspace, Teladoc, and Kindbody.
* Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and 16 weeks of parental leave.
* 401K plan setup, FSA option, commuter benefits, and DashPass.
* Lunch at the office every day and Dinner at the office after 6:30 pm.

*Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Forus (for full-time employees). Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity.*

*Forus is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

Compensation Range: $170K - $250K

description:

----------------

**About Branch**
================

Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible, so more people can be covered. We innovate using data, tech, and automation to simplify insurance from start to finish—we eliminated inaccurate quotes in favor of real prices, created a better way to bundle, and cut unnecessary costs in the traditional insurance process. Then we pass those savings along to our members. Basically, we’re doing insurance the way it was meant to be.

But we didn’t just create the insurance we’ve always wanted, we also created the company we’ve always wanted to work for. As we redefine insurance, we also want to redefine what it means to work in insurance. Find out for yourself.

*Branch has a preference for candidates in Ohio, but is open to candidates located in AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, MD, MI, MO, NV, NC, OH, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, and WI.* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Branch is remote first, with most Branchers choosing to work from home. Our headquarters are located in Columbus, Ohio, where we come together from time to time to build relationships and connect with each other in real life. We also have office space in Columbia and Concordia, Missouri as well as Forreston, Illinois. Once a year, the entire company gathers for “BranchFest”, a highlight of the year for many Branchers.

**About the Role**

At Branch, we're reshaping the insurance experience with efficient, transparent, member-centered products. As an Analytics Engineer, you'll build the data models, tables and self-service tools that our Accounting, Actuarial and Claims teams rely on, working in SQL and dbt on BigQuery.

You'll join the Analytics Engineering team in Branch's Data Office, reporting to the Senior Manager, Analytics Engineering. Requests come to the team as tickets, and you'll take yours from the question through to production data. As you grow in the role, you'll own a data domain and the stakeholder relationships that come with it.

AI is built into how the team works. Claude Code drafts pull requests inside our dbt project, and the team reviews, corrects and improves what it produces. Branch also moves faster than a large carrier: work that takes a quarter elsewhere ships here in a couple of weeks. That pace is the best part of the job and the biggest adjustment for anyone arriving from a larger company.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to write the code themselves, see their work end to end, and grow quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build views, tables, data models, data dictionaries and self-service tools in SQL and dbt, with support from peers and senior members of the Data Office.
* Monitor data quality proactively, prevent unwanted changes and defects, and fix them promptly when they occur.
* Work tickets from Accounting, Actuarial and Claims stakeholders from the request through to production.
* Understand each project's full scope, how it interacts with other projects, and how data flows between them. Advocate for best practices and adherence to service guidelines.
* Review AI-generated code carefully, catch its mistakes, and help the team's AI tools improve over time.
* Collaborate with leaders to implement, refine and document processes and best practices that improve quality and the functionality of our self-service tools.
* Build a working knowledge of how data development works at Branch and of the insurance business behind the data.

**Skills & Experience**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in data or reporting development, including data modeling and data quality monitoring.
* Strong, hands-on SQL is required. You have built the models and transformations yourself, not only the dashboards on top of them.
* Experience with dbt is a strong plus.
* Experience with process automation, automated reporting and business intelligence.
* Experience with Python is a strong plus. JavaScript or another programming language is also valued.
* Experience building with AI coding tools, Claude Code in particular, is a strong plus.
* Experience with insurance data, especially claims, accounting or actuarial data, is a plus.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where you own your work from start to finish.

**Why join us at Branch?**

We’re all about getting back to getting each other’s back - that means Branchers, too. So we provide benefits that let you work and live to your fullest.

* **Above-market salary -** Branch is a data-driven company, so we do the math on salaries, too. If you get an offer from Branch, you can expect compensation that hits above the mark.
* **Pay equity and transparency -** Our pay isn’t just market-driven, it’s equitable. We let experience and performance drive your success, never your gender, race, orientation, or beliefs.
* **Remote-first (with perks) -** Work from where you’re most comfortable. We’ll take care of your work from home set-up and monthly internet. We also have a Columbus headquarters if you’d like to join us in an office.
* **Flexible YouTime -** We don’t just let you control your own time off. We actually encourage you to use it. After your first year at Branch, we’ll give you $1000 toward your next vacation.
* **Employee stock options -** You’re not just an employee. If you’re full-time, you’re also a part-owner. You’ll have stock options so you can invest in the company you’re helping to grow.
* **Medical, vision, dental -** Get all the coverage you need for a healthy, happy life.
* **401k and contribution matching -** Invest in your future. Branch helps you get to retirement on time with a portion of your contributions matched each month.

**What to expect**

In light of recent hiring scams across the United States, here’s what the process will look like with Branch (so you know it’s us):

* Please apply to open positions directly through our site. If you don’t see it here, then it shouldn’t exist on another job board. If you’re ever unsure about the legitimacy of a Branch job posting found on another site, please check the listings here to verify.
* If you're selected to move onto the next phase of the hiring process, a member of our Branch talent team will reach out to you directly from the email domain @ourbranch.com to guide you through our process.
* The process will include a number of interviews, which will all happen either over the phone or on video calls.
* We will never ask for personal payment or require you to purchase equipment during our interview process. Always be sure to protect your personal information.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer**

At Branch, we are deeply committed to community. Branch is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants and/or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to the individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $70K - $100K

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**An exciting career awaits you**
At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions using modern data architecture, Azure data services, including Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure Functions, and Databricks.
  
  
This role also includes close collaboration with analytics, product, architecture, governance, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth (strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, and orchestration tools such as Azure Data Factory and/or Databricks Workflows), a continuous improvement mindset, and the ability to mentor while contributing to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and solution design reviews.
  
  
This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Conducts the design, innovation and optimization of data extraction, ingestion and transformation processes.
* Facilitates the development and design of complex data architecture to process and store high-volume data sets.
* Enables the development of complex data pipelines; advocates for and implements data security and privacy measures.
* Conducts complex data quality and processing tasks using open source and cloud services.
* Provide technical expertise during critical incidents.
* Facilitates the adoption of best practices for data security and privacy and collaborates with other departments to ensure seamless data integration.
* Facilitates the implementation of continuous improvements in data processing methods and drives consistency and best practices across data engineering projects.
* Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; participates in strategic planning sessions for data infrastructure.
* Oversee quality assurance and testing for data solutions.
* Mentors less experienced data engineers.

Education and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or related field required.
* 5+ years of relevant data engineering experience required.

**Skills**

* Big Data Technologies - Familiarity with big data technologies and frameworks, such as Hadoop, Spark, and distributed computing, for processing and analyzing large volumes of data.
* Cloud Platform - Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and their associated services for data storage, processing, and analytics.
* Data Governance - Ability to establish and oversee a set of procedures, policies, and standards that ensure the effective and efficient management of an organization's data assets. This includes ensuring data quality, compliance with relevant laws and regulations, and secure data handling practices. It also involves the coordination between different departments to ensure that data is accurate, accessible, and used responsibly and ethically.
* Data Integration - Proficiency in integrating data from various sources, including structured and unstructured data, using technologies such as ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, data pipelines, and data ingestion frameworks.
* Data Lifecycle - The data lifecycle refers to the sequential stages that data goes through from its creation or acquisition to its eventual disposal. These stages typically include data creation, storage, processing, analysis archival, and eventual deletion or destruction, with each phase governed by specific policies and practices.
* Data Modeling - Skill in designing and implementing data models that align with business requirements, ensuring data integrity, performance, and scalability.
* Data Operations - Data operations refer to the various actions and processes involved in managing, manipulating, and analyzing data throughout its lifecycle. These operations encompass tasks such as collection, storage, retrieval, transformation, and visualization of data to derive meaningful insights and support decision-making.
* Data Pipelines - Data pipelines are a set of processes that enable the flow of data from one or multiple sources to a destination, often involving tasks such as extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL). These pipelines are designed to efficiently and reliably move and process data, ensuring its quality and accessibility for various analytical and operational purposes.
* Data Privacy - Ability to understand and implement practices that ensure the protection and confidential handling of personal and sensitive information. This includes knowledge of relevant laws and regulations (such as GDPR or HIPAA), the ability to design and enforce policies that safeguard data, and the skills to manage data access rights and consent protocols.

* General Programming – Applies a computer language to communicate with computers using a set of instructions and to automate the execution of tasks.
* Metadata Management – Proficiency in metadata management solutions to enable efficient data discovery, data lineage tracing, and data asset management.
* NoSQL Databases – NoSQL databases are a type of database management system that provides a flexible and scalable approach to storing and retrieving data, often diverging from the traditional relational database model. Unlike relational databases, NoSQL databases are designed to handle large volumes of unstructured or semi-structured data, offering high performance and horizontal scalability for modern applications.
* Real Time Processing – Real-time processing refers to the method of handling data or performing computations immediately as they occur, without any noticeable delay. In real-time processing systems, data is processed, and responses are generated within a timeframe that meets the requirements of the application or task, typically within milliseconds or microseconds.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a
**Senior DevOps Engineer**
to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure that powers our platform. You'll play a critical role in scaling our AWS infrastructure, improving Kubernetes environments, automating deployments, and building tools that make our engineering team more productive.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems, building reliable systems, and eliminating operational friction through automation. You'll help establish scalable infrastructure patterns and developer-friendly workflows that allow engineers to ship software quickly, reliably, and securely.

We value pragmatic engineering, thoughtful automation, and choosing the right tools for the problem rather than introducing complexity for its own sake.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable AWS infrastructure across production and development environments.
* Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters, containerized applications, and deployment workflows.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Argo CD, incorporating automated testing, dependency scanning, and container image scanning.
* Develop reusable infrastructure components and automate provisioning using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code best practices.
* Create standardized deployment patterns, infrastructure templates, and self-service tooling that improve developer productivity.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms.
* Improve infrastructure reliability, performance, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks, environment configuration, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Integrate tools such as Trivy, Snyk, or Checkov into development and deployment workflows to identify vulnerabilities and infrastructure misconfigurations.
* Manage cloud access controls, IAM policies, secrets management, and secure configuration practices using AWS-native services or tools such as HashiCorp Vault.
* Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term improvements.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers to improve deployment workflows, application performance, and overall developer experience.
* Help establish infrastructure standards and operational practices that support a growing engineering organization.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and operating production infrastructure on AWS.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar tools.
* Strong experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code tooling.
* Proficiency in Python, Go, Bash, or similar scripting and programming languages.
* Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, and distributed systems.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes.
* Familiarity with container security scanning, dependency scanning, and infrastructure validation tools.
* Working knowledge of AWS IAM, secrets management, and cloud networking best practices.
* Experience troubleshooting complex production issues and improving system reliability.
* Ability to make sound architectural decisions while balancing scalability, maintainability, cost, and operational simplicity.
* Strong ownership mindset and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-moving engineering environment.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience building internal developer platforms, self-service infrastructure, or standardized deployment workflows (paved roads).
* Experience with Kubernetes packaging and configuration tools such as
  **Helm templates or Jsonnet**
  .
* Familiarity with declarative configuration languages and tools such as
  **ytt/Starlark, CUE, or Dhall**
  .
* Experience evaluating configuration and templating approaches based on expressiveness, maintainability, and operational practicality.
* Experience with GitOps workflows using Argo CD or Flux.
* Experience with Kubernetes operators, service meshes, or advanced cluster networking.
* Experience with cloud security and infrastructure scanning tools such as Trivy, Snyk, Checkov, or tfsec.
* Familiarity with policy-as-code tools such as Open Policy Agent (OPA), Kyverno, or HashiCorp Sentinel.
* Experience with secrets management tools such as HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.
* Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS applications or distributed systems at scale.
* Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, data pipelines, or compute-intensive workloads.
* Experience operating infrastructure in regulated environments or supporting SOC 2 compliance requirements.
* Experience working in an early-stage or rapidly scaling startup.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Cloud infrastructure is reliable, scalable, observable, and cost-efficient.
* Kubernetes environments and deployment pipelines are stable, automated, and easy to maintain.
* Engineers can provision infrastructure and deploy applications with minimal operational friction.
* Infrastructure changes are repeatable, version-controlled, and consistently validated.
* Monitoring and alerting provide clear visibility into system health and performance.
* Security checks are integrated into existing engineering workflows without creating unnecessary bottlenecks.
* Manual operational work is reduced through automation and improved developer tooling.
* The engineering organization has infrastructure foundations that support continued growth and faster software delivery.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Location:**
Remote (US) or Hybrid – Boston, MA (2 days per week in office)
  
  
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.
  
  
Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis are critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
PathAI is hiring its first dedicated Developer Operations Engineer to own the systems that let our engineers ship: release automation, CI/CD, build and deployment infrastructure, and developer environments across our products. That includes AISight, our digital pathology platform used by hospitals and labs and deployed both in the cloud and on-premises, as well as the software behind our biopharma clinical trial services.
  
  
Today this work is spread across product engineers and is constantly weighed against feature delivery. You will change that. You'll own your own backlog and OKRs, set technical direction for how we build, test, and release software, and partner closely with our product and integration engineering teams, embedding with them when a project calls for it. Because our clinical software is regulated as a medical device, you'll design automation that makes releases faster and safer while meeting our quality system requirements.
  
  
This is a high-leverage senior role with a clear path to growing into a team. Your work will directly return engineering capacity to the organization and make frequent, low-risk releases routine.
  
  

* You will own our release process end to end for both cloud and on-premises deployments, automating manual steps such as versioning, localization, and zero-downtime (blue-green) cutovers
* You will partner with our quality and regulatory teams to design compliant release and rollback processes, so we can ship changes and revert them quickly and safely
* You will design and maintain fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines, with sensible container image build strategies and consistent configuration across repositories, using DORA metrics to measure and improve delivery performance
* You will bring all of our product lines onto a common release and infrastructure model, including zero-downtime deployments, repository consolidation, and faster pipeline feedback for developers
* You will standardize deployment tooling, monitoring, and observability across cloud, on-premises, production, and test environments, including packaging and upgrade paths for customer-hosted installations
* You will build the product performance metrics we report as part of ongoing regulatory monitoring
* You will automate the release documentation our quality system requires as a regulated medical device company
* You will find and fix the root causes of recurring operational issues, tightening feedback loops between support and engineering
* You will set long-term direction for how every PathAI service is built, deployed, and operated

**Who You Are (Required)**

* You have 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform, build/release, or site reliability engineering
* You have deep expertise designing and maintaining CI/CD systems (e.g. GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Kargo)
* You have strong experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)
* You have hands-on experience with a major cloud provider, preferably AWS, as well as deploying and supporting software in customer-hosted, on-premises environments
* You are proficient in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python or Go
* You have experience implementing zero-downtime deployment strategies such as blue-green or canary releases
* You are familiar with monitoring and observability tooling (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
* You have the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar codebases and reason through operational problems in systems you didn't write
* You can self-direct: you can define a roadmap, prioritize your own backlog, and communicate progress to engineering leadership

**Preferred**

* You have experience in a regulated environment (FDA, IVDR, ISO 13485, or IEC 62304)
* You have experience consolidating repositories into a monorepo or standardizing build tooling across many services
* You have a background in healthcare, life sciences, or medical imaging, especially deploying into hospital IT environments with restricted or air-gapped networks

This is a hybrid position based in Boston, MA. Relocation benefits are not available for this position.
  
  
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $127,500 - $195,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
*Please note that we are not currently accepting resumes or additional support from talent agencies or third-party sources. Any resumes received from these sources will be considered unsolicited. We value integrity and clear communication with our partners, and appreciate your understanding in this matter.*
**The Role, At a Glance**
Biamp is bringing a SaaS web application in-house from a third-party development partner, and we’re hiring a DevOps Engineer to lead the technical side of that transition. You’ll migrate the build and deployment pipelines from GitHub Actions to our internal Bitbucket and Jenkins environment, then own the resulting CI/CD infrastructure and 24x7 production operations going forward. This is a high-leverage role: you’ll set the patterns that govern how our Software Operations team runs this platform for years, and you’ll do it with executive visibility because the in-sourcing itself is a strategic initiative.
  
  
**How You'll Contribute**

* Lead the migration. Move build and deployment pipelines from GitHub Actions to Bitbucket and Jenkins with a clear cutover plan, validation gates, and rollback path. Capture institutional knowledge from the outgoing partner along the way.
* Own CI/CD. Architect and maintain the Jenkins pipelines, shared libraries, and supporting tooling that the development teams rely on every day. Continuously cut build and deployment times.
* Run production. Take responsibility for 24x7 availability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Define SLOs and SLIs, drive incidents to resolution, and reduce toil through automation.
* Manage cloud infrastructure as code. Stand up and evolve the underlying cloud infrastructure using Terraform (or equivalent IaC), with consistent, repeatable, reviewable changes.
* Keep us secure and compliant. Build pipelines and artifact-management practices that hold up under our security and regulatory commitments, including secure build, signing, and provenance.
* Plan for failure. Maintain disaster-recovery and business-continuity plans, run DR drills, and meet defined RTO and RPO targets.
* Partner with developers. Work directly with the application teams to shape a workflow that’s fast and pleasant to use, and document it well enough that newcomers can self-serve.

**A Successful Candidate Should Have**

* 3+ years in DevOps, SRE, or a closely related role, including production responsibility for a SaaS application.
* Hands-on experience with both GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines — enough to confidently translate workflows from one to the other.
* Strong Jenkins fundamentals: pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile), shared libraries, and the plugin ecosystem.
* Comfort with Git workflows and repository management across GitHub and Bitbucket.
* Working knowledge of a major cloud platform (AWS or Azure) across compute, storage, networking, and managed services.
* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, or similar.
* Solid scripting in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or comparable.
* Experience deploying .NET applications (MSBuild, NuGet, IIS or Kestrel).
* Working knowledge of containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Track record on an on-call rotation, including running or contributing to incident response.
* Clear written and verbal communication — you’ll be working closely with both internal teams and an outgoing third-party partner.

**Some Nice-to-haves**

* Familiarity with JFrog Artifactory, JFrog Xray, or JFrog Advanced Security.
* Experience with SonarQube or comparable code-quality tooling.

**Position Summary**
The Herff Jones IT Team is seeking a Cloud Engineer to join our Infrastructure Services team. This role is the technical owner of our AWS and Azure environments and the bridge between our on-premises datacenter and the cloud: the person who builds the foundation, keeps it secure, well-governed, and resilient, and drives it forward. The Cloud Engineer provides and governs the cloud environment that implementation partners build in during a major infrastructure modernization initiative, supports the systems hosted there, and builds and maintains the cloud resources for work outside that initiative. In the near term, the role also shares support of our Windows and Linux server infrastructure. The Cloud Engineer is one of six engineers on our Infrastructure Services team, each with a complementary specialty, who share support, cross-coverage, and an on-call rotation, and partners closely with the Security and Application teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***Cloud Architecture & Engineering***

* Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable infrastructure in AWS and Azure, including compute, storage, networking, serverless, and container services.
* Establish and maintain cloud landing zones, including account and subscription structure, guardrails, tagging, and governance aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.
* Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Bicep) with source control and CI/CD pipelines, and automate routine tasks using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Develop and maintain cloud standards, reference architectures, and documentation, including diagrams and configuration baselines.
* Contribute to the multi-year infrastructure roadmap for the cloud and hybrid domain.

***Hybrid Infrastructure & Partner Support***

* Design and maintain secure hybrid connectivity and DNS between on-premises sites and AWS and Azure (e.g., site-to-site VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute), in partnership with network engineering.
* Provide and govern the cloud environment that implementation partners build in, ensuring the underlying infrastructure aligns with our security and governance standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot and support partner-built systems hosted in our environment, and build and maintain cloud resources for initiatives outside the partner engagement.
* Share support of on-premises Windows and Linux server infrastructure with other Infrastructure engineers in the near term, including patching, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.
* Support workload migrations and the operational handoff of partner-delivered infrastructure, including runbooks, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery.

***Cloud Security & Governance***

* Implement cloud security controls, including IAM, least-privilege access, encryption, logging, and policy enforcement, in partnership with the Security team.
* Integrate cloud platforms with enterprise identity (Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM Identity Center) in partnership with other Infrastructure engineers.
* Monitor and optimize cloud spend through rightsizing, reserved capacity, and cost reporting, and support budget planning and forecasting.
* Support PCI DSS requirements, audit readiness, and vulnerability remediation for cloud and server infrastructure.

***Cloud Operations & Incident Response***

* Implement and tune monitoring, alerting, and logging for cloud and hybrid workloads (e.g., Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor).
* Serve as an escalation point for cloud and hybrid infrastructure incidents; lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for Priority 1–2 issues.
* Plan and execute changes and maintenance windows, with rollback plans, following the Change Management process.
* Participate in a shared on-call rotation with the Infrastructure team for after-hours support.
* Mentor engineers and support staff, and contribute to cross-training and knowledge sharing.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Other duties as assigned.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Hands-on production experience with core AWS and Azure services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring; strong AWS experience is highly preferred.
* Working knowledge of cloud landing zones and multi-account or multi-subscription governance, and of the AWS Well-Architected Framework or Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.
* Experience with hybrid connectivity and cloud networking (VPC/VNet design, VPN, AWS Direct Connect or Azure ExpressRoute, DNS, and routing) and with serverless services (e.g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions).
* Solid Windows Server and Linux administration experience in enterprise environments.
* Scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for infrastructure automation.
* Disciplined approach to documentation and change management.

**Preferred**

* Industry cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or equivalent.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation or CDK, Bicep, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and with containers and Kubernetes (e.g., Docker, Amazon EKS, AKS).
* Multi-cloud experience across AWS and Azure, including migrating workloads from on-premises datacenters.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and hybrid identity.
* Experience supporting consultants, managed service providers, or implementation partners working in a shared cloud environment, including during large-scale infrastructure transformation programs.
* Familiarity with PCI DSS requirements and with NIST or CIS frameworks.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Composure and sound judgment under pressure during outages and periods of major change.
* Collaborative and proactive attitude with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 5+ years of systems engineering experience in multi-site enterprise environments, including at least 3 years designing and operating production workloads in AWS or Azure.

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment**

* Hybrid position based in Indianapolis, IN, with a mix of on-site and remote work.
* Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use; occasional work in datacenter environments, including lifting equipment up to 50 lbs.
* Participation in a shared after-hours on-call rotation and scheduled maintenance windows.
* Occasional travel to Herff Jones facilities may be required.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description Overview:
  
  

* Designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports complex data pipelines, data products and data management solutions across modern cloud, warehouse and lakehouse platforms. Applies software-engineering, data-modeling and distributed-processing practices to deliver secure, reliable, maintainable and cost-conscious solutions. Works independently on defined outcomes, collaborates across technology and data teams, and contributes to reusable engineering patterns and continuous improvement.

Primary Responsibilities:
  
  

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support complex production data pipelines and data products with guidance on broader architecture where needed.
* Develop maintainable data-processing and transformation solutions using SQL and programming languages such as Python.
* Implement solutions using Snowflake, Databricks, dbt and comparable modern data platforms and frameworks.
* Build data solutions across relational databases, cloud object storage, warehouse and lakehouse architectures, including open table formats such as Apache Iceberg where applicable.
* Develop batch, micro-batch, CDC and streaming pipelines using approved enterprise patterns and technologies such as Apache Kafka or comparable platforms.
* Integrate data from relational and mainframe systems, APIs, event streams, SaaS platforms, files and object storage.
* Apply normalized, dimensional and denormalized data-modeling techniques appropriate to analytical and data-product requirements.
* Tune SQL, Snowflake and Databricks/Spark workloads for performance and cost using appropriate partitioning, parallelism and compute practices.
* Implement data quality, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, logging, monitoring and alerting controls.
* Build pipelines that support error handling, restartability, idempotency, retry, replay and recovery using established patterns.
* Participate in production support, incident resolution and root-cause analysis; implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Use Git, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD and environment promotion practices for data engineering delivery.
* Develop and reuse shared components, templates and patterns; contribute improvements to engineering standards and documentation.
* Participate in technical design and code reviews, identify implementation risks and escalate architectural concerns appropriately.
* Partner with product owners, architects, governance, cybersecurity, platform and consuming teams to clarify requirements and deliver supported solutions.
* Contribute to technical epics and stories, estimate assigned work, identify dependencies and deliver through Agile practices.
* Provide day-to-day technical assistance and informal mentoring to less-experienced engineers. This role does not have direct people-management responsibility.
* Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite.
* Design, implement, maintain and enhance internal controls to mitigate risk on an ongoing basis. Identify risk-related issues requiring escalation to management.
* Maintain internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points and issues raised by external regulators, as applicable.
* Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the Company brand.
* Complete other related duties as assigned.

Education and Experience Required:
  
  

* Associate’s degree and a minimum of 5 years’ systems analysis and/ or application development work experience or Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years’ systems analysis and/ or application development work experience. In lieu of degree, a combined minimum of 7 years’ education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 3 years’ systems analysis and/or application development work experience
* Strong SQL skills, including development of complex transformations and analytical queries.
* Experience with Python or another general-purpose programming language used for data engineering.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience with ELT/ETL and transformation practices, including dbt or a comparable framework.
* Experience with relational data stores and warehouse or lakehouse data-modeling concepts.
* Experience with distributed processing using Apache Spark/PySpark or a comparable framework.
* Experience with Git-based source control, automated testing and CI/CD fundamentals.
* Experience with batch data processing and working knowledge of streaming or event-driven concepts.
* Knowledge of cloud and object-storage concepts, preferably in Microsoft Azure.
* Experience working with structured and semi-structured data using formats such as Parquet, JSON, CSV, Avro and XML.
* Experience with Linux/Unix environments and scripting.
* Demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex data pipeline components and data products within an established architecture.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data-processing, data-quality and production issues across multiple technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to apply established engineering patterns while identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate implementation choices, risks and dependencies to technical and product partners.
* Demonstrated ability to manage assigned work from design through production support with limited day-to-day supervision.

Education and Experience Preferred:
  
  

* Production experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Spark/PySpark and dbt.
* Experience with Apache Iceberg or another open table format.
* Experience with Apache Kafka, CDC or event-driven data processing.
* Experience with orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows or dbt orchestration.
* Experience with Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code technology.
* Experience with data catalogs, metadata, lineage, observability or automated data-quality tooling.
* Experience delivering governed enterprise data products.
* Experience working in a regulated environment such as financial services.

**Location**
Buffalo, New York, United States of America

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.
  
  
Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.
  
  
At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.
  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**
The Senior Analytics Engineer builds reliable data solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance across Empower. Operating in a hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A/503B environment, this individual contributor owns analytics delivery from problem definition through deployment and monitoring. The role translates ambiguous business needs into scalable, maintainable, cost-effective data models, pipelines, and reporting solutions while strengthening data quality and infrastructure reliability. Success requires strategic thinking, disciplined execution, sound technical judgment, and learning agility to balance immediate priorities with sustainable engineering practices. The engineer identifies valuable analytics opportunities, communicates findings clearly, and partners with stakeholders to align solutions with business objectives. Through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and reusable tools, this role increases team productivity and supports Empower’s mission of expanding access to high-quality medications with dependable, actionable insights that guide decisions.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Analytics Delivery and Business Impact**

* Project Delivery: Lead analytics projects from problem definition through deployment and monitoring, delivering solutions aligned with business objectives and stakeholder needs.
* Opportunity Assessment: Propose analytics initiatives with data-driven business cases that clarify expected value, operational benefits, and priorities for stakeholder evaluation.
* Solution Design: Design scalable, maintainable, cost-effective data models, pipelines, and reporting solutions that resolve ambiguous business problems through structured technical analysis.

**Data Quality and Operational Reliability**

* Data Quality: Identify and resolve data issues, validate analytical outputs, and monitor deployed solutions to maintain reliable insights for business users.
* Infrastructure Improvement: Improve data infrastructure and engineering workflows to reduce recurring issues, increase processing efficiency, and sustain reliable analytics delivery.
* Engineering Discipline: Maintain version-controlled code and solution documentation to support consistent maintenance, accountable changes, and reliable analytics in regulated operations.

**Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Technical Mentorship: Mentor junior team members through technical guidance and knowledge sharing, strengthening problem-solving capability and consistent analytics engineering practices.
* Reusable Solutions: Develop shared tools and libraries that reduce duplicated effort, improve engineering consistency, and increase team productivity across analytics projects.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, communicate insights through effective data storytelling, and adapt solutions to evolving priorities.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:**

* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and data modeling methods, including Kimball and Data Vault 2.1, for scalable, maintainable analytics solutions.
* Technical proficiency with Apache Hop, dbt, Snowflake, AWS, and Azure to build reliable data pipelines and improve infrastructure efficiency.
* Ability to use Power BI, DAX, and data storytelling to communicate actionable insights and explain technical findings to varied stakeholders.
* Skill in Git, conceptual modeling with LucidChart, structured problem-solving, and technical mentoring to support maintainable solutions, knowledge sharing, and team productivity.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* At least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role delivering practical business solutions required.
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience required.
* Knowledge of the pharmacy business and Certified Data Vault 2.0 Practitioner certification for translating business requirements into structured data models required.
* Certified DBT Developer and Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300) certifications, demonstrating analytics development and reporting expertise highly preferred.
* Snowflake experience or SnowPro certification, along with AWS Data Engineering or AWS Data Analytics certification supporting cloud analytics delivery preferred.

**KEY COMPETENCIES:**

* Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
* Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
* Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
* Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
* Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
* Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
* Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
* Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
* Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

**VALUES:**

* People: Empowering people defines who we are.
* Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
* Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
* Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

**EMPLOYEE BENEFITS, HEALTH AND WELLNESS:**
We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more: https://careers.empowerpharmacy.com/benefits/
  
  
**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**
While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
