title: Senior Data Engineer (Online Data)
description:
**What You Can Expect**
In this role, you will design, build, and optimize the data pipelines and analytical solutions that power Zoom’s Online business, including billing, checkout, growth, and revenue analytics. Working end to end, you will own the full data engineering lifecycle, from ETL design and ingestion through data quality, performance tuning, and model delivery to stakeholders across Data Science, Finance, and Product. Each day brings a mix of deep technical work and meaningful cross-functional collaboration, with opportunities to shape how the Online business understands and acts on its data. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting into the Data Systems and Online Technology organization. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence three (3) days per week at our Seattle, WA or San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Online Data team is the analytical backbone of Zoom’s Online business, delivering the data infrastructure and insights that support billing, checkout, growth, and revenue operations. Working alongside Senior Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and Data Visualization Engineers within the Data Systems and Online Technology organization, our team ensures that decision-makers across Product, Finance, and Data Science have reliable, well-governed data to work from. We build systems and standards that keep Zoom’s Online business moving with confidence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement scalable ETL workflows and data pipelines that transform raw data into structured, analytics-ready formats, with automated validation checks and monitoring to ensure ongoing quality and reliability.
* Build analytical datasets from clickstream, user interaction, and product usage events to support web analytics, feature adoption analysis, and user journey insights.
* Establish and maintain data governance practices, including data definitions, lineage, ownership documentation, and access controls for sensitive data, in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Implement automated data quality frameworks covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, and freshness, and establish alerting to identify and resolve data issues proactively.
* Optimize pipeline performance and database efficiency through query tuning, indexing strategies, caching configurations, and model accuracy evaluation for large-scale structured and unstructured data.
* Analyze complex datasets using statistical techniques and machine learning methods, build interactive visualizations, and run hypothesis testing to surface insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead end-to-end development of data products from concept through deployment, integrating machine learning models into production and providing technical guidance to peers across data engineering and ML workflows.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Data engineering expertise: 8+ years of hands-on experience designing and optimizing complex data pipelines and ETL workflows, including error handling, monitoring, and performance tuning, using tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Airflow, dbt, and Python.
* SQL and database mastery: Proficiency designing normalized schemas, optimizing complex queries, and applying advanced database features for high-performance analytical workloads.

title: Founding Data Engineer, Pricing and Comps
description:
### **About the Role**

As the founding data engineer on a marketplace team, you will build the data pipelines and pricing systems that turn inconsistent sold-listing data into reliable comparable sales and estimates. Your work will help ensure users and stakeholders can understand both the price and its confidence.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build and own scheduled ingestion pipelines for sold-listing data from multiple marketplaces and external sources.
* Design entity resolution systems that match inconsistent listing text and images to canonical items.
* Develop valuation logic that weighs comparable sales by recency, condition, and the number of available comps.
* Monitor data quality to identify drift, fraud, stale comps, and other integrity issues before they affect users.
* Partner with computer vision colleagues to define item matching across sources with differing levels of detail.
* Make build-versus-buy decisions about data sources, licensing, and third-party pricing feeds.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 5 years of data engineering experience, including building and owning large-scale production ETL and data pipelines.
* Experience working with messy, adversarial data in marketplace, pricing, fraud, or similarly noisy domains.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with modern data tools such as dbt, Airflow or Dagster, and Spark or similar technologies.
* Experience with statistical estimation or pricing models, including basic regression-based comparable-sales logic.
* Experience designing entity resolution or record-linkage systems at scale, and production monitoring for data quality, drift, or anomalies.
* Experience processing data from multiple external sources, making technical build-versus-buy decisions, and communicating pricing confidence and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders.
* Pricing intelligence, third-party data licensing, or early-stage startup experience is a plus.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Annual base salary: $160,000 to $220,000. Visa sponsorship is not available.

### **Location**

Hybrid, New York, New York, United States.

description:
**Who We Are**

* **Container Orchestration:** Manage production-grade containerized workloads on Kubernetes (Amazon EKS) or Amazon ECS. Optimize container image builds, build caching, and cluster resource scaling (e.g., Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler).
* **Observability & SRE:** Instrument system-wide observability using OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or AWS CloudWatch. Define and track SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, while establishing actionable alerting pipelines that minimize alert fatigue.
* **DevSecOps & Compliance:** Integrate automated vulnerability scanning (container images, dependencies, IaC) using tools like Snyk or Trivy into CI/CD pipelines. Manage centralized identity, role-based access controls (RBAC), and secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).
* **Automation & Internal Tooling:** Develop custom automation scripts and micro-tools using Python (boto3) or Go to eliminate manual toil, support automated backups, and validate disaster recovery procedures.
* **Cloud Cost Governance (FinOps):** Partner with engineering teams to monitor cloud consumption, optimize resource allocation, and implement automated scaling policies to maintain cost-efficient infrastructure.

### **Required Skills**

* **Cloud Architecture:** 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-grade systems on AWS (VPC, IAM, EKS/ECS, RDS, S3, EventBridge).
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Deep operational experience with Terraform (state management, module design) or AWS CDK.
* **Containers & Orchestration:** Strong background in Docker containerization and hands-on operational experience with Kubernetes (EKS) or AWS ECS, including Helm templating.

* **Telemetry & Reliability:** Proven experience implementing logging, metrics, and tracing platforms (Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana) and designing structured on-call incident responses.

* Experience implementing GitOps workflows with Argo CD or Flux.
* Familiarity with Policy-as-Code frameworks (Open Policy Agent/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or Checkov).
* Understanding of MLOps pipelines and supporting infrastructure for machine learning workloads (e.g., Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker).
* Practical experience running OpenSearch/Elasticsearch clusters at scale.

Employees are responsible for traveling to and from client sites as required by their project or assignment, regardless of location. Travel may include sites outside the employee’s primary office location, state, or region.

title: Amazon Dedicated Cloud Engineer, US ADC Security
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to operate the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure and help U.S. Government agencies solve complex technical problems? AWS has established a specialized group of service teams responsible for the work we do with the U.S. Intelligence Community, building and operating some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world.  
  
The US ADC Security Engineering team is seeking a motivated ADC Engineer I to support day-to-day operations of large-scale cloud systems. You have a working knowledge of Linux, networking, and cloud services fundamentals, and you are eager to learn, follow established procedures, and grow your troubleshooting skills alongside experienced engineers.  
  
This is a shift-work position. The team runs 24/7 operations, which may require you to work some nights and/or weekends.  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Provide front-line operations support for large-scale distributed systems on a 24/7 shift rotation.
* Monitor systems and alarms, and troubleshoot issues using established runbooks and procedures.
* Gather data on customer issues and escalate to senior engineers or service teams in a timely manner.
* Execute routine operational tasks and use existing automation and scripts to complete work accurately.
* Write and maintain simple scripts (e.g., Bash or Python) that automate repetitive tasks, with guidance and code review from senior engineers.
* Document troubleshooting steps, update runbooks, and share what you learn with the team.

  
A day in the life  
You start your shift by reviewing open tickets, alarms, and handoff notes from the previous shift. You work through issues using runbooks, collect logs and metrics to help find the cause of problems, and escalate to senior engineers when an issue goes beyond established procedures. Between tickets, you complete routine operational tasks, work on small scripts that cut down repetitive manual steps, update documentation, and learn the environment from experienced engineers. Before handing off, you record what was done and what is still open so the next shift can pick up smoothly.  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why Amazon Security?  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Platform Engineer, Cloud AI Infrastructure, Sr
description:
Summary
  
The Senior Platform Engineer, Cloud & AI Infrastructure designs, builds, automates, and operates the secure cloud platforms that enable OnPoint’s AI, data, analytics, and automation capabilities in Azure and M365. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role responsible for translating complex requirements into reliable, reusable, and production-ready platform services.
  
The position provides technical leadership for assigned Azure and AI infrastructure capabilities, including architecture, infrastructure automation, identity and networking integration, observability, resiliency, and cost optimization. It establishes engineering patterns that help teams move from experimentation to production without compromising security, supportability, or enterprise standards.
  
Working with Technology Operations, Architecture, Information Security, Data, Solution Engineering, and the Innovation Center of Excellence, this role resolves complex platform challenges, mentors engineers, and enables approved self-service capabilities. The position leads through technical expertise and cross-team influence rather than people management.
  
Primary outcomes, first 12 months
  

* Establish reusable, automated deployment patterns for priority cloud, AI, and data workloads.
* Reduce provisioning lead time and manual configuration through infrastructure as code and standardized platform services.
* Act as the Microsoft ecosystem (365, Azure, etc.) evangelist of new and existing capabilities – the first to be informed, the first to use, the first to teach others to use, and always with energy and commitment to ensuring this platform’s return on investment.
* Implement production-readiness standards covering security, monitoring, support ownership, recovery, and cost.
* Improve reliability and operational visibility through service health measures, actionable alerts, and tested recovery procedures.
* Establish platform cost and capacity baselines and deliver prioritized optimization improvements.
* Enable safe experimentation and repeatable promotion into production through approved environments and controls.

Key responsibilities
  
Cloud architecture and platform engineering
  

* Independently lead the design and implementation of complex Azure infrastructure spanning compute, storage, networking, identity, security, and shared platform services.
* Develop and maintain reference architectures, reusable deployment patterns, and documented technical decisions aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Translate business and workload requirements into designs that balance reliability, security, performance, cost, and operational complexity.
* Identify platform dependencies and constraints, recommend improvements, and contribute to platform roadmaps and lifecycle planning.

Infrastructure automation and delivery
  

* Engineer version-controlled infrastructure using Terraform and/or Bicep, supported by PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Python.
* Utilize Microsoft 365 and other platforms to automate corporate functions for IT Operations and advise on how other teams can do the same.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated validation, controlled promotion, secure configuration, and recovery or rollback procedures.
* Establish reusable modules and approved self-service provisioning patterns that reduce manual work and configuration drift.
* Apply code review, testing, documentation, and change-management practices to infrastructure engineering.

AI and data platform enablement
  

* Engineer the infrastructure foundations for AI services, agent workloads, Databricks, and related enterprise data and automation platforms.
* Implement secure connectivity, workload identities, secrets management, environment separation, capacity controls, and platform telemetry.
* Partner with application, AI, and data engineers to establish scalable deployment and operational patterns for inference, retrieval, and agent workloads.
* Support infrastructure dependencies and integrations for Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Power Platform in partnership with their platform owners.
* Clearly define infrastructure ownership, application responsibilities, and support boundaries before production release.

Security, governance, and operational resilience
  

* Implement approved identity, access, networking, encryption, policy, and monitoring controls in partnership with Information Security.
* Define and monitor service-level indicators and objectives for assigned platform services.
* Maintain operational runbooks, configuration evidence, recovery-test results, and technical documentation supporting audit and operational readiness.

Technical leadership and collaboration
  

* Lead technical delivery for complex platform initiatives and coordinate dependencies across teams.
* Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.
* Explain technical options, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, security, maintainability, and total cost – particularly but not limited to the Microsoft ecosystem.

Required qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Seven or more years of progressively responsible infrastructure, systems, cloud, or platform engineering experience, including substantial hands-on Azure engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability to independently design, implement, and operate complex production cloud solutions.
* Advanced knowledge of Azure networking, private connectivity, DNS, identity, role-based access, managed identities, secrets management, and cloud governance.
* Demonstrated experience building reusable infrastructure as code and automated deployment pipelines using Git-based engineering practices.
* Strong scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, Python, and/or Azure CLI.
* Experience implementing observability, performance tuning, capacity management, high availability, and tested disaster recovery.
* Hands-on experience supporting production AI or data platform infrastructure, with the ability to explain its security, connectivity, scaling, and operational requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, cross-platform issues and lead corrective action.
* Experience leading technical implementations, mentoring engineers, and communicating architectural trade-offs.

Certifications
  
Required
  

* An active Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification, or the ability to obtain it within 12 months of hire, supported by demonstrated equivalent architecture and engineering experience.

Preferred
  

* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, particularly for candidates with strong infrastructure automation and delivery-pipeline responsibilities.

Preferred qualifications
  

* Experience with Azure-hosted AI services, agent infrastructure, retrieval architectures, and secure model-service connectivity.
* Experience with Databricks infrastructure, workspace deployment, private networking, identity integration, and platform monitoring.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Copilot, or Power Platform integrations and environment governance.
* Experience in financial services or another regulated enterprise environment.
* Experience developing shared platform services, self-service engineering capabilities, and cloud cost-management practices.

### **Position Summary:**

The AWS Cloud Engineer will design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure using Amazon Web Services. This role involves cloud architecture, automation, deployment, security, and performance optimization while ensuring reliable and cost-effective cloud operations.

* Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and infrastructure.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cloud Computing, or a related field.

title: Cloud Engineer I
description:
Job Summary

* The Enterprise Cloud & Infrastructure Services team is seeking a motivated Cloud Engineer I to help deploy, secure, and operate production workloads across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, using automation and best practices wherever possible.
* This is a hands-on role in the University’s Infrastructure Services. The cloud engineer will assist in the development and deployment of cloud solutions and environments, gain exposure to projects from governance through operations, and build a strong foundation in cloud architecture, security, data protection, and identity management. The cloud engineer will be expected to work independently as skills grow.

Minimum Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.

Preferred Education and Experience

**Education and Certifications**

* BS degree with a minimum of four (4) years of experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Entry-level cloud certification, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Fundamentals or Administrator Associate, or Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer.
* AWS Platform experience, understand some of the following AWS service provisioning including EC2, ECS, VPC, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, Redshift, SWF, SQS, etc.
* Understanding of Cloud Computing: virtualization technologies, Infrastructure as a Service, Platform as a Service, and Software as a Service Cloud delivery models and the current competitive landscape.
* Understanding of DevOps methodology, including CI/CD tooling, monitoring, and alerting.
* Experience in AWS costs optimization.
* Experience migrating workloads between local environments and the public cloud.
Understanding of highly available systems and disaster recovery methods.  

**Cloud Platforms and Services**

* Hands-on exposure with AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud deployment, technical and security architecture, database architecture, and virtualization architecture.
* Familiarity with native cloud services (compute, storage, networking, databases, containers) and how they differ from traditional on-premises services.
* Exposure to deployment and functionality of container services (e.g.: Docker, Kubernetes, Container Service) desired but not required.
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service (PaaS), and other “as a Service” models (IaaS, SaaS).

* Scripting or programming experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use of Git.

**Infrastructure and Architecture**

This position is available within the University of Maryland’s Division of Information Technology (DIT).
  
  
The Senior Platform Engineer is a member of the Enterprise Linux Services team. title: Supply Chain Analytics Engineer II
description:
At **DICK'S Sporting Goods** , we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world's greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

**OVERVIEW:**

The Analytics Engineer II bridges business operations, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence by applying knowledge of Supply Chain processes, system workflows, and data relationships to develop trusted data products, scalable semantic models, and AI-enabled analytical capabilities. The role is responsible for the transformation, modeling, quality, documentation, delivery of governed business-ready data assets that provide a trusted foundation for reporting, self-service analytics, operational decision-making, and AI-enabled solutions. The role partners with Data Engineering on data ingestion and platform capabilities and supports downstream analytics teams through reliable data products, governed definitions, and technical knowledge transfer.

  
  

**Data Products & Analytics Solutions** :

  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders, Product, and Data Engineering teams to understand Supply Chain operations, business processes, system workflows, and data requirements. Translate business needs into scalable analytics solutions that support operational decision-making and align with business objectives.
* Design, build, maintain, and enhance curated datasets, semantic models, and reusable analytical products that provide a trusted foundation for reporting, self-service analytics, operational decision-making, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Apply SQL, data transformation techniques, business logic, and data modeling practices to integrate, validate, and transform complex data into trusted, governed, and business-ready information assets that accurately reflect business processes and system workflows.
* Develop and maintain semantic layers, certified datasets, governed metrics, and business definitions that promote reporting consistency, improve data accessibility, and reduce duplication across analytics solutions.
* Prepare and optimize analytical data products, semantic models, governed business definitions, and data experiences that support AI-enabled and conversational analytics, predictive insights, and other emerging data-driven capabilities. Contribute to AI-enabled analytics use cases through semantic preparation, prompt development, and output validation, in partnership with appropriate technical and governance teams.
  

  

**Data Quality, Governance & Reliability:**

* Apply established standards for data quality, performance, and governance across analytical data products. Leverage business process, system, and technical knowledge to execute test plans, validate source-to-target data flows, assess data quality, and validate analytical solutions. Document, communicate, and resolve identified issues using standardized testing methodologies.
* Maintain business and technical metadata, source-to-target mappings, data lineage, ownership information, technical specifications, and supporting documentation within approved data catalog and knowledge management tools to improve discoverability, auditability, governance, and change-impact analysis.Apply enterprise data-classification, privacy, security, access-control, and retention requirements to analytical datasets, semantic models, and self-service analytics solutions. Partner with appropriate security, privacy, and governance teams to ensure compliance with established standards.
* Monitor assigned data products in production, triage data quality and reliability incidents, support recovery and escalation activities, communicate identified business impact, document root causes, implement corrective actions and contribute to preventive reliability improvements.
* Assess upstream and downstream impacts of data, schema, metric, system, and process changes. Coordinate testing, stakeholder communication, and implementation activities to ensure analytical assets remain accurate, reliable, and aligned with evolving business and system requirements.
  

  

**Business & Technical Partnership:**

* Develop effective working relationships with business partners to understand business processes, system workflows, data needs, and analytical challenges.
* Collaborate with Operations, Finance, Product, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and Business Intelligence teams to support the design, delivery, and maintenance of data assets.
* Partner with internal and external teams to identify and capture new data requirements, perform root-cause analysis, and support the diagnosis and resolution of data-related issues.
  

  

**Data Integration & Lifecycle Support:**

* Monitor and support vendor, product, and operational data integrations (e.g. FTP, Kafka, DataStage) to ensure reliable data delivery, data quality, and availability of analytical data products.
* Collaborate with Product, Data Engineering, and technology teams on development, testing, incident resolution, and monitoring activities related to data integrations and processing workflows.
* Participate in the implementation of new data sources and data elements by supporting requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and change management activities.
  

  

**Team Practices & Continuous Improvement :**

* Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to downstream analytics teams regarding data models, semantic layers, governed metrics, data availability, and structural changes.
* Build knowledge of Supply Chain operations, business processes, system workflows, and data structures to effectively support analytical solutions and operational decision-making.
* Share knowledge and provide guidance to less experienced teammates in data analysis, troubleshooting, and analytics development activities. Support assigned planning, delivery, and continuous improvement activities.
* Maintain awareness of evolving analytics, AI-enabled analytics, business intelligence, and data management practices, applying new skills and knowledge to improve analytical solutions and team capabilities.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree - BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Statistics, Supply Chain, or a related field
* Analytics engineering, business intelligence, data management, data engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience should include proficient SQL, multi-source data transformation, dimensional or semantic modeling, data-quality testing, documentation, production support, and delivery of analytical data products.
* Demonstrated ability to understand business processes and system workflows and connect them to how data is generated, transformed, and consumed is required.
* Supply-chain or Manhattan-system experience is preferred.
* Relevant training or certifications in SQL, analytics engineering, cloud data platforms, data governance, BI tooling, or AI-enabled analytics are preferred.
* Proficiency in SQL, data transformation techniques, and data modeling concepts used to integrate, validate, and prepare data for analytical solutions
* Experience working with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) to support data analysis and reporting needs.
* Experience supporting data ingestion, integration, and orchestration processes using technologies such as Kafka, FTP, ETL/ELT frameworks, or similar tools.Experience developing datasets and analytical solutions using business intelligence and self-service analytics platforms (e.g. Cognos, Power BI, Qlik)
* Familiarity with metadata management, data lineage, documentation, and data catalog practices that promote data quality, discoverability

We are building technology for national security and defense missions at the highest levels of government and decision-making. Our software helps bring together complex data, systems, and workflows to support critical decisions across the national-security enterprise. As our platform scales, our technology must operate reliably across cloud, on-premises, and distributed environments.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to help make that possible. This is an opportunity for an ambitious engineer with strong technical foundations who wants to take meaningful ownership, solve challenging problems, and grow quickly in a high-impact environment.
  
  
You will own the systems that take our software from a developer’s laptop all the way into production—and increasingly into distributed customer and edge environments. You will work across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, observability, automation, security, and edge deployment to make our software easier to build, deploy, operate, and scale.
  
  
This is an end-to-end ownership role. You won't be limited to a narrow infrastructure function or handed fully defined requirements. You will help identify problems, determine the right approach, build the solution, deploy it, operate it, and continuously improve it. When something breaks, you will be expected to understand the problem, work across layers of the stack, and drive it through to resolution.
  
  
We are looking for someone who already has strong technical fundamentals, is naturally curious, learns quickly, and wants to take on increasingly difficult problems. You should be excited by the opportunity to grow your scope rather than waiting for someone else to define it.
  
  
Because we operate in defense environments, our deployments can be very different from a typical SaaS environment. You may work with cloud infrastructure one day and help deploy software into a disconnected, bandwidth-constrained, resource-constrained, or otherwise challenging environment the next. You will work directly with software engineers, technical leadership, customers, and field teams to make those deployments successful.

* Own reliable release and recovery mechanisms, including deployment validation, rollbacks, upgrades, failure recovery, and disaster recovery.
* Partner closely with software engineers to improve application architecture, deployment patterns, developer workflows, testability, and operational reliability.
* Troubleshoot problems across the full stack. Investigate issues spanning applications, containers, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, infrastructure, and deployment systems—and drive them to resolution.

* Support production systems and deployments, including participation in an on-call rotation for critical systems as the team and customer footprint grows.
* Help shape the deployment architecture as we scale, evolving our platform from early-stage product development toward operating software reliably across a growing distributed customer and edge footprint.

Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco is reimagining how IT infrastructure is managed through secure, cloud-managed solutions. The Network Platform Data Science team helps turn Cisco’s rich, multifaceted customer and network data into smarter decisions, improved customer experiences, and faster innovation. You’ll partner across Engineering, Product, Security, UX, Finance, Licensing, and other teams to deliver data platforms and products that are reliable, governed, and ready for AI to use accurately. The environment is at massive scale (10 PB+ across 30+ systems) and blends data engineering rigor with trusted data context—so teams can move from “data exists” to “data is trusted and actionable.”
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You will set technical direction for reliable, scalable batch and streaming pipelines and data products across structured and unstructured data. You will define and continuously improve expectations for data quality, freshness, availability, observability, recovery, and cost, then lead production incident investigations to deliver lasting fixes. You will build and evolve a trusted, machine-readable data context layer—covering business definitions, metric semantics, ownership, lineage, quality/freshness, and governed access integrated with existing catalog/governance systems. You will apply AI and agentic workflows to well-scoped data engineering needs (pipeline development, validation, and bug triage), including evaluating results and using bounded permissions with human review for production-changing actions. Success means the organization has a trusted data foundation that scales, is observable and recoverable, reduces “definition drift,” and helps teams—including AI applications—use data accurately and confidently.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree + 7 years of related experience, or Masters 3+ years of related experience, or PHD +1 year of related experience
* 5+ years advanced SQL including data modeling, complex transformations, and query performance tuning.
* 5+ years Python building production data pipelines/services with automated testing and maintainable code.
* 3+ years of Snowflake building, optimizing, and operating production data workloads (Postgres experience is a plus).
* Experience with distributed processing and orchestration (e.g., Spark and Airflow/Glue or equivalent) plus engineering practices across CI/CD, access controls, data quality, observability, incident response, or cost management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience applying AI tools/agents to scoped data engineering work (pipeline validation/bug triage), including evaluating outputs and grounding them in trusted context while managing data access and operational risk.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. Partner with MLEs and data analysts to turn recurring data needs and model failure cases into reusable mining capabilities, define acceptance criteria, and improve scenario coverage through feedback.

title: Associate Data Engineer, Manufacturing Planning Systems, Semi
description:
**What to Expect**

The Associate Data Engineer builds and sustains the data-structure pipeline that holds the Semi production plan. That pipeline supports forecasting, production planning, and the handoff into execution. You work with planners so the plan the factory runs is complete, current, and checkable.

You help keep the modules and the checks that set sequence and priority. You do not own the production plan. Planners own that decision. You help shape the data the plan runs on, the load from the ERP and the other sources, and the SQL that shows supply against demand. An experienced engineer leads this work. This seat is Semi at Gigafactory Nevada.

 **What You'll Do**

* Help build and sustain the data-structure pipeline and the checks on it. You are not the technical owner of every planning module. An experienced engineer leads that
* Help develop and maintain the logic that sets priority and sequence for the Semi plan
* Help implement the check that balances a production constraint with demand. You do not own the production plan. Planners own that decision
* Work with demand planning and production planning to automate a step they still do by hand
* Work with operations so a planning task at the factory can be run again without waiting on one person
* Help design the data model the plan runs on, so a read stays fast enough for the weekly cycle
* Help build the load from the ERP and the other sources. Validate it before it reaches the live plan
* Write SQL that compares supply and demand and shows the gap
* Help turn planning data into a report a lead can use. Document the rule, the release, and the open item

  
**What You'll Bring**

* 0–1 years in software development or data engineering. Internships, co-ops, and school projects count. Able to judge a data problem before writing the code, and comfortable when the plan changes
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Science, Operations Research, or equivalent experience

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:

Credence is seeking a Cloud Platform Engineer to support secure AWS hosting environments for Department of War customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role that supports the broader cloud hosting lifecycle. The position includes AWS infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, container platforms, automation, technical solutioning, troubleshooting, monitoring, security, and operational support.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing, implementing, automating, and troubleshooting AWS-based environments. Candidates should be comfortable working across infrastructure, deployments, container platforms, security controls, and customer requirements.

**Responsibilities**

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Design, implement, operate, and improve secure AWS hosting solutions supporting development, test, and production environments
* Collaborate with Cloud Engineers, Solutions Architects, cybersecurity professionals, application teams, and customer stakeholders to develop and implement technical solutions
* Translate technical and customer requirements into practical cloud infrastructure, deployment, and hosting solutions
* Build, maintain, and improve reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar technologies
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated build, test, security scanning, deployment, and release workflows
* Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot containerized workloads using Docker, Amazon ECS/Fargate, and Amazon EKS/Kubernetes
* Support container platforms, including workload deployment, configuration, networking, storage, scaling, monitoring, and troubleshooting
* Develop scripts, tools, and automation using Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar technologies to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Convert recurring operational issues into reusable automation, platform capabilities, or standardized deployment patterns
* Support AWS-hosted environments as needed, including troubleshooting, incident response, planned maintenance, technical escalations, and production support
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, operating system, networking, permissions, database, pipeline, container, and deployment issues
* Support cloud platform services related to monitoring, logging, access control, configuration management, patching, backup, and security
* Work with cybersecurity and compliance teams to ensure infrastructure and automation align with customer, federal, and organizational requirements
* Research and recommend tools, technologies, and engineering practices that improve platform reliability, automation, security, and developer experience
* Create and maintain technical designs, implementation plans, deployment procedures, runbooks, reusable patterns, and operational documentation
* Participate in a rotating on-call schedule, typically approximately one week every four months

**Requirements**

Required Qualifications

* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* CompTIA Security+ certification, or the ability to obtain it within the first 60 days
* AWS certification, or the ability to obtain one within the first 90 days
* At least 3 years of progressively responsible experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, infrastructure automation, systems engineering, or a related technical field
* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting AWS environments
* Experience with core AWS services such as EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, security groups, RDS, EFS, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and AWS Systems Manager
* Hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or another Infrastructure as Code technology
* Experience developing, maintaining, or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or similar platforms
* Production experience with Docker and at least one container platform, such as Amazon ECS Fargate or Amazon EKS/Kubernetes
* Experience developing automation using Python, Shell, PowerShell, or a similar scripting language
* Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across infrastructure, deployments, networking, permissions, and containerized workloads
* Ability to contribute to technical solution design and communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, and implementation approaches
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical processes and communicate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with both Amazon ECS/Fargate and Amazon EKS/Kubernetes
* Experience with Terraform modules, remote state, workspaces, providers, and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns
* Experience with Git-based development workflows, branching strategies, merge requests, pull requests, and code reviews
* Experience with Kubernetes tools and concepts such as Helm, namespaces, ingress, service networking, storage, autoscaling, and container registries
* Experience supporting secure environments subject to federal, Public Trust, NIST, DoD, or similar compliance requirements
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, or Grafana
* Experience with AWS networking, load balancing, DNS, identity, security controls, or hybrid connectivity
* Experience administering Linux or Windows servers in cloud or enterprise environments
* Experience with Active Directory or LDAP-based identity solutions
* Experience integrating generative AI services, APIs, or AI-assisted tools into cloud applications, engineering workflows, automation, or operational platforms
* AWS Associate, Specialty, or Professional-level certification
* Experience leading technical solutioning discussions with customers or stakeholders

Compensation

* The anticipated salary range for this position is
  **$100,000-$180,000**

description:

**Database Administrator (DBA) / Enterprise Data Engineer**  
**Estimated Level of Effort:** 75–80 hours per month

**Position Summary**  
The South Carolina Department of Probation, Parole, and Pardon Services (SCDPPPS) supervises individuals placed on probation, parole, and other community-release programs. SCDPPPS relies on custom, mission-critical applications while modernizing its core Offender Management System (OMS).

The Database Administrator (DBA) / Enterprise Data Engineer supports the development, integration, security, modernization, and sustainment of these applications and their supporting data environments. The position designs and maintains enterprise data architecture; manages legacy-data migration and validation; enables reporting, telemetry, and analytics; and administers and optimizes databases supporting OMS, PIC, PAC, IIMS, SSO, and other assigned systems.

**Reporting Relationship**  
Reports to the Program Manager, Chief Information Officer, Data Architect, or designated technical lead.

**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Enterprise Data Architecture and Engineering**

* Design, develop, and maintain an enterprise data warehouse, data lake, or comparable data platform supporting structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
* Define data models, schemas, metadata, integration patterns, storage approaches, and lifecycle-management practices.
* Establish standards for data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, retention, lineage, cataloging, quality, and security.
* Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for batch, near-real-time, and real-time data processing.
* Design secure, reliable interfaces among enterprise applications, reporting platforms, analytics tools, and data repositories.

**Legacy Data Migration and Validation**

* Plan, execute, document, and support migration of legacy data to the enterprise data environment.
* Assess source-system structures, data quality, business rules, integration dependencies, and technical constraints.
* Develop data mappings, transformation rules, migration procedures, reconciliation methods, validation criteria, and rollback plans.
* Migrate and validate data associated with OMS, PIC, PAC, IIMS, SSO, and other assigned applications.
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, standardization, deduplication, reconciliation, and exception resolution to ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity.
* Produce validation results, discrepancy logs, remediation recommendations, and migration-completion documentation.

**Business Intelligence, Reporting, and Telemetry**

* Develop and maintain Power BI reporting pipelines, semantic models, datasets, dashboards, and reports.
* Implement telemetry-based reporting to support visibility into application activity, system health, performance, and operational metrics.
* Develop real-time and near-real-time ingestion workloads for reporting, monitoring, analytics, and decision support.
* Optimize reporting data models, refresh processes, queries, and dashboards for performance, security, accuracy, and usability.
* Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, key performance indicators, data definitions, and dashboard enhancements.

**Database Administration and Performance Management**

* Perform database design, configuration, administration, maintenance, optimization, and operational support for assigned databases and data platforms.
* Monitor database health, availability, capacity, storage, performance, query efficiency, replication, backups, and telemetry.
* Resolve performance issues through indexing, query tuning, partitioning, caching, archiving, configuration improvements, and capacity planning.
* Execute database-maintenance activities, including backup and recovery validation, integrity checks, statistics maintenance, patch coordination, and monitoring.
* Implement and maintain database security controls, including role-based access control, least-privilege access, authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, and logging.

* Experience with legacy data migration, mapping, profiling, cleansing, reconciliation, validation, and remediation.
* Proficiency with SQL, relational database design, normalization, indexing, query optimization, backup and recovery, and performance tuning.
* Experience developing Power BI data models, datasets, dashboards, reports, and refresh pipelines.
* Knowledge of data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, security, and access-control principles.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver reliable support within an estimated commitment of 75–80 hours per month.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing streaming, event-driven, telemetry, or real-time data-ingestion solutions.

Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to 9M+ users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.
  
  
As an engineer focused on Starlink’s software and network infrastructure, you will design, operate and scale the infrastructure we use to run the world’s largest satellite constellation and manage a network that handles millions of daily users worldwide. These positions cover a variety of areas ranging from Site Reliability Engineering, to Developer Operations, to our internal Kubernetes platforms. You will develop automation to deploy and manage on-premise compute resources, create highly scalable and maintainable software products, and directly collaborate with engineering across the board.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Develop automation to deploy and manage on-premise Kubernetes clusters
* Deploy and manage core infrastructure such as databases, monitoring and distributed storage
* Closely collaborate with software engineers to create highly scalable, operable, and maintainable products
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services -- from inception and design, through deployment, operation and refinement
* Monitoring and alerting supporting systems to have high availability
* Hands-on integration and troubleshooting across the entire Starlink stack
* Identify areas for improvement and create innovative solutions that enable high system availability

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems/IT, or an engineering discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps; OR 7+ years of professional experience in Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps in lieu of a degree
* 2+ years of professional experience with Linux operating systems
* Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or other infrastructure tools
* Experience with containerization technologies (i.e. OCI containers, Kubernetes)
* Experience scripting in Bash, Python, or other similar languages
* Development experience in Python, C++, or Go

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* 1+ years of experience with Python and Python-based development frameworks
* Experience managing Kubernetes clusters, not just using them
* Knowledge of Linux boot process and systems configuration
* Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & continuous monitoring
* Understanding of relevant build technologies, such as Bazel and Makefiles
* Focus on performance bottlenecks and performance improvement techniques
* Understanding of distributed databases and data modeling
* Experience with automatically managing dozens, hundreds, or thousands of servers (eg: Terraform or Ansible)
* Strong networking knowledge of TCP/IP
* Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with customers, peers, management etc. in both formal and informal situations

**Additional Requirements**

* Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

**Compensation And Benefits**
Pay Range:
  
  
Level 3: $165,000.00 - $230,000.00
  
  
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
  
  
Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.
  
  
**Itar Requirements**

* 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
* 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Cloud Engineer Junior - Secret Clearance
description:

The Cloud Engineer - Journeyman designs, engineers, and integrates secure, scalable multi‑cloud and hybrid cloud infrastructures that underpin mission‑critical enterprise systems in highly regulated government environments. The role focuses on implementing Infrastructure as Code, cloud automation, and governance controls to standardize provisioning, enforce guardrails, and maintain compliant operations across major public cloud platforms. The engineer collaborates with security, networking, and application teams to modernize legacy workloads, improve observability and disaster recovery, and document architectures and operational patterns for ongoing support.

  

This is a hybrid position based in Arlington, VA.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  
* Design and implement multi‑cloud and hybrid cloud architectures across major public cloud platforms to support enterprise workloads with strong emphasis on security, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates, and automation pipelines to standardize and automate cloud resource provisioning.
  
* Engineer cloud networking constructs including virtual networks/VPCs, subnets, routing, peering, and secure connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute) integrated with on‑premises enterprise networks.

* Optimize cloud resource utilization through rightsizing, scaling policies, use of reserved and spot instances, and performance tuning to manage spend while meeting service level objectives.
  
* Design and test disaster recovery and business continuity strategies for cloud workloads, including backup, replication, multi‑region architectures, and documented recovery playbooks for mission‑critical systems.
  
* Support DevOps practices by integrating CI/CD pipelines with cloud platforms, container orchestration tools, and configuration management solutions to streamline deployments and reduce operational risk.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates and supporting automated deployment pipelines.
  
* Demonstrated experience configuring and managing cloud networking, identity and access management, and security controls in at least one major public cloud provider.
  
* Experience implementing and operating cloud monitoring and logging solutions and supporting incident response in production environments.
  
* Must hold an active Secret clearance and meet applicable DoD 8140 requirements.
  
* Must be a US Citizen.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

  
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer.
  
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate certification.
  
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes in production cloud environments.
  
* Experience working in federal or other highly regulated enterprise IT environments with formal cloud governance frameworks.

title: DevOps Platform Engineer and Linux Systems Administrator - Active Clearance
description:
Absolute Business Solutions Corp (ABSC) is not just another tech company. We’re a community of innovators, engineers, analysts and business professionals working together with our customers to tackle the most complex challenges. For more than 20 years we’ve supported critical Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), Federal Civilian missions and global, multi-national corporations. We specialize in supporting our clients in the Intelligence, Technology, Defense, AI/ML, and Data Science fields. As we continue to grow at a rapid pace, we need some amazing new professionals to join our team.

ABSC has an exciting opening for a TS/SCI-cleared DevOps Platform Engineer and Linux Systems Administrator supporting DIA-NDOC’s D3P modernization under the DTP contract. You will operate the Kubernetes-based application platform and shared runtime services that support a production big-data pipeline, helping ensure the environment remains reliable, secure, scalable, and ready for mission use.

The 10-year DOMEX Technology Platform (DTP) program modernizes the secure data, application, and infrastructure capabilities supporting DIA’s National Digital Exploitation & OSINT Center (NDOC). The program delivers scalable media processing, data discovery, enrichment, and analytical services that help mission users transform large volumes of digital information into timely, actionable intelligence. Team members work across software development, systems engineering, cybersecurity, platform operations, and mission integration to sustain current operations while delivering the next generation of DTP capabilities.

**Work location and schedule:** Most work is performed onsite at the customer location in Bethesda, MD. A flexible schedule and occasional remote work may be available based on customer requirements and deliverables.

**Security clearance required for this role:** An active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a CI polygraph is required.

**Responsibilities**

As an integral member of the DTP team, you will work closely with Government stakeholders and cross-functional engineering teams on the following key tasks:

* Deploy, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, patch, upgrade, and maintain a production platform built on Kubernetes, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, and related shared services.
* Administer Linux-based applications and systems, including installation, configuration, hardening, performance analysis, and operational troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot pod failures, networking issues, image pulls, scheduling constraints, certificates, storage, and application connectivity.
* Use Helm or comparable tools to manage Kubernetes application packages and configuration.
* Support shared platform services such as Elastic, Redis, message queues, API gateways, and other distributed services.
* Integrate platform services with physical and virtual infrastructure to maintain availability, reliability, security, and performance.
* Design and support scalable and redundant application infrastructure across physical and virtual environments.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure and platform automation using Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Bash, Python, or comparable tools.
* Implement platform security, monitoring, logging, observability, capacity management, and DevOps best practices.
* Contribute to engineering documentation, diagrams, models, Agile release planning, scrums, design sessions, and bug triage.

Requirements

**To be successful in this role, you must meet the following qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field with four or more years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree with two or more years of relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a CI polygraph.
* Current DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher certification, such as Security+ CE or CySA+.
* Ability to obtain Privileged User Account certification as required by DoD 8140 policy.
* Hands-on experience administering and operating Kubernetes.
* Experience using Helm or a comparable Kubernetes package and configuration-management tool.
* Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux from the command line, including processes, filesystems, networking, permissions, logs, certificates, and system resources.
* Experience supporting at least one shared data or application platform service, such as Elastic, Redis, message queues, or API gateways.
* Familiarity with infrastructure and platform automation tools.
* Working knowledge of platform-security and observability practices.
* Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

**Desired Skills**

You will wow us even more if you have some of these skills:

* Knowledge of Agile methodologies.
* Development or scripting experience with Bash, PowerShell, Salt, Python, Groovy, or Java.
* Experience with Kafka or another messaging platform.
* Experience supporting GPU-based Kubernetes environments.
* Experience with Salt, Helmfile, GitLab, Nexus, or Argo CD.

**Salary and Compensation**

Salary is commensurate with education and years of experience. The anticipated salary range for this requisition is $90k to $170k based on education, experience, technical qualifications, clearance, and applicable contractual requirements.

**Who we are:**

ABSC is a technology and services company that combines the agility of a small business with proven processes refined over more than two decades in business. We specialize in supporting public sector clients in the Intelligence, Defense, Health, and Safety areas. Our team stands ready to deliver the next generation of programs, personnel, and solutions to help advance our federal government customers’ driving innovation, agility, and security across all mission areas.

title: Senior Backend Cloud Engineer
description:
**What we do:**
  
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

**Who we are:**
  
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

**The Role**

  

At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust.

You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data.

* Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering.

* Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant.

* Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way.

* Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence.

* Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response.

* Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase.

* A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish.

* Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration.

* Strong understanding of APIs, messaging systems (Kafka), and modern data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, OpenSearch).

* Experience building services in a cloud-native environment, preferably AWS.

* Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes.

* Comfortable working in a remote-first, asynchronous team environment.

**Bonus Skills and Qualifications**

* Familiarity with functional programming patterns and idiomatic Scala.

* Experience with Databricks and ClickHouse (or similar lakehouse and analytical/OLAP data stores).

* Experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions.

* Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

* Prior work on security products, data pipelines, or high-availability systems.

* Python development experience, particularly with security analysis tools and malware detection frameworks (YARA, PE analysis, binary analysis).

* Familiarity with machine learning workflows, AutoML, and MLflow for model deployment and management.

* Experience with binary analysis libraries (LIEF, ssdeep, TLSH) and security tooling integration.

**Benefits:**

Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

* Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.
* 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.
* Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.
* Medical and dependent care FSA options.
* Flexible PTO policy.
* Parental leave.
* Generous equity offering.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.

**Base Salary Range**: $120,000 - $170,000

**Bonus Target:** 10%

In accordance with applicable state and federal laws, the range provided is Halcyon’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Base pay is one part of the total package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and equity in the Company.

**We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer.**

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
**Hungry for a career that’s as rewarding as it is delicious?**
At Aspire Bakeries, we don’t just bake breads, cookies, and cakes - we create foods that bring people together. From La Brea Bakery® artisan breads to Otis Spunkmeyer® cookies, our products are enjoyed by millions of people every day. And behind every bite are talented manufacturing and support teams who take pride in their work and our food.
  
  
We’re looking for hard-working people who will bring integrity, creativity, and a passion for excellence to everything they do - whether that’s on the bakery floor, in the office, or supporting customers. In return, we offer a workplace culture built on care, ownership, and growth - where your contributions matter and your career can rise as high as our bread loaves!
  
  
With 13 commercial bakeries across North America and a reputation as an industry leader, Aspire Bakeries is rising together with our people and our customers to be the best all-around bakery solution. If you’re ready to grow with us, we’d love to hear from you
  
  
**Why You’ll Love Working At Aspire Bakeries**

* Culture - Our culture thrives on collaboration, diversity, and a shared passion for excellence. We support team members, empower growth, and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.
* Health & Wellness - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus company-paid life insurance and additional voluntary options to fit your needs.
* Work-Life Balance - Paid parental leave, generous paid time off, and holidays so you can recharge and spend time on what matters most.
* Financial Security - A competitive 401(k) with immediate company match, plus short- and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
* Growth & Development - Opportunities to build skills, grow your career, and develop expertise through Aspire Bakeries’ learning and development programs.
* Flexibility & Support - HSA and FSA plans to help you manage everyday expenses.
* Recognition & Rewards - Performance incentive plans that celebrate achievements across sales, bakery performance, and individual contributions.

**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Cloud Engineer**
to join our team. As a
**Cloud Engineer**
, you will be accountable for the day-to-day administration, operation, continuous improvement, and engineering of Aspire Bakeries’ cloud infrastructure, with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure and its integration with on-premises systems. You will help ensure hybrid workloads are secure, reliable, cost-effective, and supported by repeatable infrastructure-as-code automation using Terraform and Azure DevOps.
  
  
This role requires you to be onsite
**four days per week**
, giving you hands-on collaboration with the team and daily exposure to the pulse of the business.
  
  
**Compensation**

* Salary Range: $100,000-$170,000 depending on experience

**Core Accountabilities (What You’ll Be Doing)**

* Operate and optimize Microsoft Azure infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, monitoring, backup, and platform services to support secure, reliable, and responsive workloads.
* Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code automation using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines to enable repeatable, auditable provisioning and decommissioning of Azure resources.
* Design and support cloud and hybrid solutions integrating Azure with on-premises infrastructure, virtualization, networking, security, and identity services.
* Implement and maintain cloud identity, access, security, hardening, vulnerability management, logging, and monitoring requirements in partnership with Identity and Cybersecurity teams.
* Deliver and validate backup, recovery, and business continuity capabilities for Azure workloads, including disaster recovery testing and runbook development.
* Improve infrastructure efficiency, reliability, performance, and cost through system optimization, upgrades, patching, right-sizing, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Maintain infrastructure standards, documentation, architectural diagrams, Terraform modules, runbooks, naming conventions, and tagging standards while serving as a technical owner for assigned cloud services.

**Minimum Qualifications (What You Bring To The Table)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience administering server, storage, identity, and enterprise application systems, including hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Working knowledge of Azure IaaS and PaaS services, including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, Recovery Services Vault, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.
* Hands-on experience authoring and operating Terraform for Azure, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and pipeline-driven plan/apply/destroy workflows using Azure DevOps or a comparable CI/CD platform.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, Azure RBAC, Conditional Access, and MFA.
* Experience with server virtualization and hybrid connectivity concepts, including VMware and/or Hyper-V, site-to-site VPN, SD-WAN, or ExpressRoute.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell scripting and automation, enterprise backup and recovery, infrastructure monitoring, and ITIL-aligned change, incident, and problem management practices.

**Preferred Qualifications (Extra Ingredients For Success)**

* Microsoft Azure, VMware, Cisco, GIAC, CISSP, or comparable cloud and infrastructure certification.
* Experience with Commvault/Metallic, Azure-native backup, geo-replication, and immutable or air-gapped storage.
* Familiarity with Ansible for operating system/application configuration and day-two infrastructure operations.
* Experience with Bash and a general-purpose programming language such as Python.
* Experience with SAN, NAS, Azure Files, Azure NetApp Files, cloud storage tiers, Graylog, or comparable enterprise infrastructure and observability technologies.

We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to screen, assess, or select applicants.

title: Data Engineer II - Remote
description:

description:

Every team member plays a vital role in delivering reliable, high-speed internet and exceptional customer experiences. At Ezee Fiber, our success is built on delivering
**Speed, Simplicity, and Service**
in everything we do. Guided by our core values of
**Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, and Collaboration**
, we empower our employees to do the right thing, support one another, take ownership of their work, and work together to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers and the communities we serve.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Senior Data Engineer designs, builds, optimizes, and supports scalable data infrastructure and business logic that enable network performance analysis, customer insights, operational reporting, and enterprise analytics. Building on Ezee Fiber's Data Engineer scope, this senior-level role owns complex data engineering solutions, establishes technical standards, improves data reliability and performance, and provides technical guidance across data initiatives. **Essential Functions**

* Design, develop, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from CRM, OSS/BSS, GIS, network monitoring tools, REST APIs, and other enterprise platforms.
* Write efficient, reusable, production-quality Python and SQL code to process, transform, validate, and serve large and complex datasets.

* Design and optimize data models, data lakes, data warehouses, and related architecture to support business intelligence, analytics, and operational use cases.
* Own and enhance data infrastructure across cloud and on-premise environments, including platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, MS SQL, and PostgreSQL.

* Establish and promote engineering standards for data pipelines, schemas, documentation, testing, deployment, observability, and version control.

* Support data lineage, metadata, documentation, and data-integrity practices across systems and applications.

Education and Experience Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, software/data platform engineering, or a closely related role, including experience independently designing and supporting production-grade data solutions.
  
  

* Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, REST APIs, and at least one modern ETL/ELT or orchestration framework such as Airflow or dbt.
* Strong experience with cloud-based and/or on-premise data platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, MS SQL, or PostgreSQL.
